summary.en: Escort the pilgrims of the Luddic Church on their sacred path.
summary.zh: 护送路德教会的朝圣者踏上他们的朝圣之路。

briefing.en: Visit the six shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. The pilgrimage is traditionally completed by returning to Gilead, in the Canaan system.
briefing.zh: 拜访 朝圣者之路 上的六处 圣地。朝圣之道的传统终点是回到 Canaan 星系的 Gilead。

briefing.en: Return to the shrine of Gilead in the Canaan system to complete the Pilgrim's Path.
briefing.zh: 回到 Canaan星系 Gilead 上的 圣地 以完成 朝圣者之路。
拜访六处 卢德圣地
完成 Canaan星系 Gilead 上的朝圣

texts.en: You light the candle from one that still burns, bringing one of its companions back to life and carrying on its flame.
texts.zh: 你用已燃的烛火点亮了另一支，让它的一位同伴起死回生，薪火相传。

texts.en: A novice escorts you back up the lift and back into the rich sea-air of Volturn.
texts.zh: 一名见习修士领你乘升降梯上去，重又回到 Volturn 那咸腥浓郁的海风里。

texts.en: The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful, yet you are keenly aware of the thin envelope of technology protecting you from the ravages of vacuum and radiation.
texts.zh: 搭乘穿梭机返航的过程平稳顺利，然而你敏锐地意识到，保护你免受真空和辐射摧残的是一层由科技造就的薄外衣。

texts.en: The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful, yet you are keenly aware of the thin envelope of technology protecting you from the ravages of vacuum and radiation.
texts.zh: 搭乘穿梭机返航的过程平稳顺利，然而你敏锐地意识到，保护你免受真空和辐射摧残的是一层由科技造就的薄外衣。

options.en: I have come to ask for permission to visit the shrine.
options.zh: 我来此是为了得到访问圣地的许可。

texts.en:
A long pause.

"I shall order traffic control to give you permission to land, captain," the Excubitor Orbis says finally. "May your spirit find that for which it searches."
texts.zh:
通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。

"我会让交通管制中心给予你降落许可，舰长。" 行星教卫终于开口，"愿你的灵魂能寻找到它所追寻之物。"

texts.en:
A long pause.

Excubitor Orbis Oak sighs. "I shall review your request in seven days," he says, "Starting from now."

He lifts a stylus and scratches something on a sheet of nondigital medium, his gaze now elsewhere. "Remember that Patience is the child of Humility."

"Blessings be, captain," he finishes.
texts.zh:
通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。

行星教卫 Oak 叹了口气。"我会在七天之后考虑你的诉求。" 他说道，"从现在开始计时。"

他拿起一支笔，在一张非数字化媒介的纸张上写写画画，目光却投向了别处。"记住，耐心源自谦逊。"

"愿神灵护佑你，舰长。" 他最后说道。

options.en: What about the time I've already waited?
options.zh: 那我已经等了的时间算什么？

texts.en: You try to speak but he's already terminated his end of the link.
texts.zh: 你正想说话，但他已经从他那一端终止了链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link after exchanging a few pleasantries.
texts.zh: 你在寒暄了几句后切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: He nods acknowledgement, nothing more, then terminates his end of the commlink.
texts.zh: 他仅仅是点头表示了解，然后便从他那一侧终止了链接。

options.en: Why are you denying me access to the shrine?
options.zh: 你为什么不让我进入圣地？

texts.en: "Because I have judged it so," he says, his tone of long-held authority which suggests that this is all that is required to settle the matter.
texts.zh: "因为这是我的判断，"他说，语气中带着长期执政的权威，看来这就是解决问题所需要的一切。

texts.en:
"Because you are an unacceptable risk; you choose sin after sin, and your bestrayed path will lead to sin sixfold once again."

"Ludd declared that none are beyond redemption," he says, "So I give thanks that it is the all-forgiving Creator who is to judge your soul, not I."
texts.zh:
"因为你的存在就是不可接受的风险，你接二连三地犯下罪行，你那叛逆之道将再度通往六重大罪。"

"卢德有言，世间无人不可得救，" 他说到，"感谢卢德，审判你灵魂的是大慈大悲的造物主，而不是我。"

texts.en:
His dark eyes examine yours via the comm-link for a long moment before he speaks.

"Firstly, so that you may improve yourself," he says. "The virtue of patience is oft spake but little held."

"Secondly, for the general betterment. All who live and pass here benefit by orderly and virtuous conduct. Even I in my own self become bettered for upholding discipline in good faith."
texts.zh:
在开口说话前，他黑色的眼睛通过通讯链接审视了你很长一段时间。

"首先，你可以借此提升一下你自己，" 他说到。"耐心的美德，常常被人挂在嘴边，却鲜有人能真正拥有。"

"其次，也是为了让我们所有人变得更好。此地的所有居民与过客，都因有序且合乎美德的行为而受益。即便是我自己，也会因秉持信念与维护纪律而得以提升。"

texts.en:
"Thirdly and directly - because I shall not lie even by omission to your honest inquiry - it provides my staff with time to investigate your background and character. To determine as best we can your intentions."

There it is: a background check. Do the Knights actually use paper records? Is that why it takes so long? Incredible.
texts.zh:
"最后，直截了当地说 —— 因为我不应通过撒谎亦或是无视你真诚的询问来进行回避 —— 它为我的骑士们提供了调查你的背景和性格的时间，从而让我们尽可能确定你的意图。"

原来如此，这是为了背景调查。难道这些骑士真的使用纸质记录吗？所以这就是需要这么长时间的原因？真难以置信。

texts.en: "Poorly," he says.
texts.zh: "并不乐观，" 他说道。

texts.en: "Well enough," he says begrudgingly. "Despite your impetuous disposition."
texts.zh: "还算过得去，" 他满不情愿地说道。"如果忽略你那暴躁的脾气的话。"

options.en: Why are you denying me access to the shrine?
options.zh: 你为什么不让我进入圣地？

texts.en:
"Yes," he says, and the wrinkle of the smallest smile in the Persean Sector appears by his mouth.

A long pause.

"I shall order traffic control to give you permission to land, captain," the Excubitor Orbis says finally. "May your spirit find that for which it searches."
texts.zh:
"好的。" 他说道，嘴角浮现出英仙座星域中最微小的笑容形成的褶皱。

漫长的等待。

"我将会命令交通管制处给予你着陆许可，舰长。" 行星教卫终于开口，"愿尔之灵魂寻得其所寻之物。"

options.en: You told me to find redemption...
options.zh: 你曾告诉我要寻求救赎...

texts.en:
"Yes," he says, and the wrinkle of the smallest smile in the Persean Sector appears by his mouth.

A long pause.

"I shall order traffic control to give you permission to land, captain," the Excubitor Orbis says finally. "May your spirit find that for which it searches."
texts.zh:
"好的。" 他说道，嘴角浮现出英仙座星域中最微小的笑容形成的褶皱。

通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。

"我将会命令交通管制处给予你着陆许可，舰长。" 行星教卫终于开口，"愿尔之灵魂寻得其所寻之物。"

texts.en:
"Yes," he says, his frown deepening.

"And I see no indication that you have found it."
texts.zh:
"是的，" 他说着，眉头紧蹙。

"而且我看不出任何你已经找到它的迹象。"

texts.en:
You notice a young novice watching you. As you accidentally meet their eyes, their smile widens; target acquired. They approach, keen on proselytization to a spacer captain.

These enthusiastic missionaries are a common enough affliction of spacedocks, so you are not unprepared. As they first draw breath to speak, you seize the initiative and say-
texts.zh:
你注意到一个年轻的见习修士在看着你。当你对上那人的目光时，对方的笑容变得灿烂起来，像是发现了目标一般。修士往这边走来，似乎是想改变一位太空舰长的信仰。

这些热情的传教士是太空船坞里常见的折磨怪，所以你其实早有准备。当对方深吸一口气就要说话时，你抓住主动权说道 ——

options.en: Thank you, but I'm already familiar with your religion.
options.zh: 谢谢，但我已经对你们的宗教很熟悉了。

options.en: I'd like to learn more about your faith.
options.zh: 我很乐意再深入了解一下你们的信仰。

options.en: I have felt myself drawn to the Path.
options.zh: 我感到自己已经被卢德之道所吸引。

options.en: Look. I'm a supporter of AI rights, so... (truth)
options.zh: 听着。我是支持 AI 权利的，所以... (实话)

options.en: I'm a strong supporter of AI rights. (provoke)
options.zh: 我是赋予 AI 人权提议的坚定支持者。

texts.en:
Your polite rebuff only kindles their pious urge to engage.

"So you've already heard the Good News," the novice says eagerly. "Blessed are you in the eyes of Ludd, already and truly. Do you count yourself among the Faithful or has a sense of spiritual longing brought you to this shrine?"
texts.zh:
你礼貌性的拒绝只是让对方虔诚的热情烧得更旺了。

"这么说，你已经得知好消息了。" 见习修士满面热情，"你在卢德的眼中已存真福。你认为自己是虔诚的信徒吗？还是精神上的渴望把你带到了这圣地来？"

options.en: I was simply curious about the shrine.
options.zh: 我很好奇圣地长什么样。

options.en: I... may have some spiritual questions.
options.zh: 我...也许有些唯心方面的问题。

options.en: You misunderstand; I already walk the Path.
options.zh: 你误解了我的话语，我早已踏上了卢德之道。

options.en: No. What good is a religion that hates technology?
options.zh: 不。一个憎恨科技的宗教有什么好的？

options.en: Sorry, but I'm busy. Very busy. Good-bye.
options.zh: 抱歉，但我是个忙人，非常忙。再见。

texts.en:
"Wonderful! Blessed already are those whose spirit of reason calls them to the Church."

This is everything they could have hoped for, everything they've been training for. You're given an earful and more about sin, forgiveness, redemption, and the spiritual salve of a simple life. Lots about walking a path and stories about how all sorts of people were impressed with things Ludd said and did.

The novice winds down, and, noticing your endurance flagging, says "May... may I pray with you for a safe journey through the holy vacuum?"
texts.zh:
"太棒了！受精神呼唤前往教会的人已是受福之人。"

这是对方期盼的回答，也是对方为之训练的目标。你听了一大堆话，是关于罪、宽恕、救赎和朴素生活等的种种精神慰藉。还有很多故事，指引人如何与道同行，以及各种各样的人是如何折服于卢德的言行的。

注意到你的不耐烦，见习修士不再滔滔不绝，反而说到，"我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

options.en: Politely pretend to join the novice in prayer
options.zh: 礼貌地假装和见习修士一起祈祷

options.en: Pretend to join the novice in prayer
options.zh: 假装和见习修士一起祈祷

options.en:
Just walk away
#"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."
options.zh:
径直离开  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."
#"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."

texts.en:
You politely hold your hands together and mumble something prayer-like, taking a moment to appreciate the poetry of the quoted scripture despite the naive delivery.

When the prayer finishes, the novice beams a bright smile at you. Behind them, you notice that the shrine's Curate Sacraria - the priest of highest authority here - has been watching your exchange from a candle-lit alcove.
texts.zh:
你礼貌地双手合十，边随意地呢喃着一些类似祷文的东西，边欣赏着所引用的祷文中的诗意来，尽管它的表达方式很幼稚。

当祷告结束时，见习修士对你粲然一笑。你注意到，在那身后，圣地的神龛祭司 —— 这里的最高权威牧师 —— 一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。

texts.en: As if on cue - or perhaps because they were hovering nearby the whole time - the curate of the shrine steps up to you and the novice.
texts.zh: 好像是碰巧 —— 又或者是因为对方根本就没离开过 —— 此时，圣地的祭司向你和见习修士走来。

texts.en:
"That's quite enough, my child," they say with iron concealed beneath soft words, "Perhaps you should undertake a prayer of contrition in the chapel while I speak with the captain."

Abashed, the novice bows and flees. The curate turns to you, face worn with lines of more than just patience.
texts.zh:
"够了，我的孩子。" 对方轻柔的话语里透露出铁一般的执着。"也许在我和舰长说话时，你应该在小教堂里做一个忏悔的祈祷。"

见习修士羞愧地鞠了一躬，逃也似地离开了。祭司看向你，在她脸上留下痕迹的不止有多年的耐心。

texts.en:
"Ah, the blessed faith of the young," the curate dismisses the novice with a nod. "Forthright and, I'm afraid, tactless."

"My name is $personName, and I am entrusted with the care of this shrine. I felt called to personally welcome you, captain."
texts.zh:
"啊，年轻人的神圣信仰..." 祭司点了点头，让见习修士离开了。"直率，但恐怕还有些莽撞。"

"我是 $personName，负责照看这处圣地的牧师。这位舰长，我受召来亲自招待您。"

options.en: I'm not a pilgrim, I just wanted to see the shrine.
options.zh: 我不是为了朝拜，我只是想参观圣地。
你说 '受召' 是什么意思？

options.en: I bet you use that line with everyone.
options.zh: 我敢打赌你跟谁都这么说。

options.en: It's good to finally talk to an adult.
options.zh: 很庆幸终于能和一位成年人交谈了。

texts.en: The curate smiles. "You have my welcome whether you have come for faith or not."
texts.zh: 祭司笑了。"不管是不是为了信仰而来，圣地都欢迎你的参观。"

texts.en:
"It is my calling to serve the pilgrims who come here."

A pause, then, "And also those who are not pilgrims." $HeOrShe looks expectantly at you, $hisOrHer silence asking which one you are - pilgrim or not?
texts.zh:
"为来到这里的朝圣者服务是我的使命。"

对方停顿了一下，随即继续道，"当然我也会为并非朝圣者的人服务。" $HeOrShe满面期待地看着你，$hisOrHer的沉默则是对你的询问 —— 你是不是朝圣者呢？

texts.en:
"It is my calling to serve the pilgrims who come here."

A pause, then, "And also those who are not pilgrims." $HeOrShe looks expectantly at you.
texts.zh:
我生来就是为了服侍来此的朝圣者。

稍顿，又说道，“还有那些并非朝圣者的人。” $HeOrShe 期待地看着你。

options.zh: 和我介绍一下这地方吧。

options.en: I would like to consider myself a pilgrim.
options.zh: 我愿意把自己当成朝圣者。

options.en: How do you know I'm not a pilgrim?
options.zh: 你怎么知道我不是朝圣者的？

options.en: Thank you; my interest is purely secular.
options.zh: 谢谢，但我对这里只有些世俗的兴趣。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat, then gives a practiced speech: "Taken together, these shrines form the Pilgrim's Path. It is not merely a linear path through space. Though of course," $heOrShe takes a patient tone, "In secular use the name has been given to the major shipping lanes between Church and Hegemony-controlled volumes."

The curate continues, "The Pilgrim's Path is a spiritual journey unique to each individual as they explore and discover their faith through our shared teachings, the holy Word gifted to us by the Creator who touched the prophet Ludd. The faithful are encouraged to make a pilgrimage at least once in their life, if they are able."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe清了清嗓子，开始进行一段熟练的说明。"如果在太空中画一条线，把这些圣地串在一起，就形成了{朝圣者之路}。对我们来说，它可不仅仅是一条穿过太空的路程。话虽如此..." $heOrShe慢条斯理地说道，"在世俗语境中，这个名字常被用来指代来往于教会和霸主控制的星际空间之间的重要航道。"

祭司继续说下去。"对每个人来说，{朝圣者之路}是他们独一无二的精神旅程，他们通过我们共同的教义，也就是曾感动先知卢德的造物主赐予我们的圣言，来探索和发现自己的信仰。我们鼓励信众，若有能力的情况下，在他们的一生中至少应当进行一次朝圣之旅。"

options.en: One could make a few credits transporting pilgrims between shrines...
options.zh: 看来在圣地之间为朝圣者提供交通服务可以赚些星币...

options.en: It could be charitable to transport pilgrims between shrines...
options.zh: 看来在圣地之间为朝圣者提供交通服务是不错的慈善事业...

options.en: I would like to visit the shrines.

texts.en:
"Gilead, Jangala, Hesperus... a handful," $heOrShe says with a pause, eyes searching. "Some have been lost over the years; Opis of course. And others sanctified anew. Here of course; Beholder Station orbiting Kumari Aru, though militant elements frequent the volume. And Volturn, though the present authorities are fickle about access."

"There... was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is a dangerous place however, to say nothing of the system's infestation of pirates."
texts.zh:
"Gilead、Jangala、Hesperus...有不少。" $heOrShe停顿了一下，目光仿佛在寻找着什么。"有些已经遗失在岁月中了，比如 Opis。还有一些地方被重新革凡登圣。譬如此地，Kumari Aru 轨道上的 Beholder 空间站就是一处，尽管武装分子频繁在附近出没。还有 Volturn 圣地，然而当局对是否允许拜访那里一事反复无常。"

"还有曾经的 Killa 圣地...可能现在还在。不过那里的环境本来就很危险，更别提该星系常受到海盗侵扰了。"

texts.en:
"Ye... es," the curate says, eyeing you skeptically.

"I'm sure," $heOrShe continues charitably, "that charging a nominal fare for fuel, air, and foodstuff would not be wholly out of line. The faithful would not expect you to beggar yourself to provide safe transport."
texts.zh:
"是...的。" 祭司说，看向你的目光满是怀疑。

"可以肯定的是，" $heOrShe宽容地继续道，"对燃料、空气和食物收取象征性的费用是合理的。信徒们不会指望你无偿提供安全的交通服务。"

texts.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
texts.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

texts.en:
"Here, captain, let me 'upload' to you the coordinates for all of the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path."

$HeOrShe fumbles with a battered off-brand datapad, clearly uncomfortable with its use.
texts.zh:
"舰长，来，让我向你 '上传' 朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标。"

$HeOrShe在一个破旧不堪的杂牌数据平板上摸索着，显然是不太擅长使用它。

options.zh: 指导 $himOrHer 使用数据平板

texts.en: After a moment, you point out the correct sequence of commands for transferring the nav data.
texts.zh: 过了一会儿，你指出了用于传输导航数据的正确命令集。

texts.en: "My thanks," $heOrShe says humbly.
texts.zh: "谢谢。" $heOrShe谦卑地说。

options.en: By the way, do you know one Brother Livewell Cotton?
options.zh: 对了，你知道 Livewell Cotton 修士吗？

options.en: I'm sure this will be interesting, curate.
options.zh: 我猜这会很有趣的，祭司。

options.en: No, thank you. Now I have a journey to begin.
options.zh: 不，我才该感谢你。现在我该开始一段旅程了。

options.en: Now I know where to avoid. Good-day.
options.zh: 现在我知道该避开哪些地方了，再会。

options.en: Not Moloch nor Mammon shall lead me astray.
options.zh: 双子恶魔们也无法令我误入歧途。

texts.en:
The curate freezes, suddenly wary. "Ah."

$HeOrShe lets a breath out. "Now there's a name I have not heard in a very long time."

Before you can speak, the curate continues "It's nothing untoward. I do tend to this shrine and my transient flock, but I am not a hermit. Of course I have heard of Cotton. And met him on one occasion. I made my report to the Knights long ago and that was the end of it."

"I hesitate to ask, but must: why do you inquire so?"
texts.zh:
祭司僵住了，突然露出了戒备的模样。"啊。"

$HeOrShe吐出了一口气。"我很久没听过这个名字了。"

你还没来得及说什么，祭司就继续说了下去。"没什么大问题。我确实在照顾着这个圣地和在这暂住的信徒们，但我不是隐士。我当然听说过 Cotton，甚至见过他一次。那时我向骑士们做了相关报告，不过我与此人的交集仅此而已。"

"虽然有些犹豫，但我必须得问你：你为何向我打听他？"

options.en: I am going to kill him.

texts.en: "And were you to find him?"
texts.zh: "那如果你找到他了呢？"

options.en: I am going to kill him.

texts.en:
The curate looks tired, but considers this response.

"Would he tell you anything you did not already believe?" $HeOrShe sits down on a bench with a sigh. "You need not answer that. And I would prefer you did not."

"People come to this shrine seeking answers. I have found that most who come here already have the answers they seek; truly what they seek is permission to accept that which they already know."
texts.zh:
祭司看起来很疲惫，但还是思考了一下你的回应。

"他会告诉你一些你还不相信的事吗？" $HeOrShe叹了口气并坐到了长凳上，"不必回答，我只希望你不要这样做。"

"人们来到这圣地寻求答案。但我发现，大多数来到这里的人，心中其实早已有了他们寻求的答案；他们真正寻求的，是获得许可，去接受那些他们已经知道的事情。"

texts.en: The curate stands, and brushes off $hisOrHer robe. "If it pleases you," the curate does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh: 祭司站了起来，轻振$hisOrHer的长袍。"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" 祭司避开了你的目光，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

texts.en:
"I would counsel you against that path," the curate says flatly.

The curate brushes off $hisOrHer robes. "If it pleases you," $heOrShe does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh:
"我奉劝你不要踏上那条道路。" 祭司断然地说。

祭司轻振$hisOrHer的长袍。"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" $heOrShe避开了你的目光，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

texts.en:
The curate sighs, rubbing $hisOrHer eyes as if a sharp headache had just come upon $himOrHer, then speaks.

"I could not say if you would find the finality you seek on that particular path."
texts.zh:
祭司叹了口气，揉了揉$hisOrHer的眼睛，仿佛正在忍受剧烈的头痛，然后开口道：

"我并不知道这条道路是否通向你所追求的最终结局。"

options.en: By broadside or sidearm, I can ensure finality.
options.zh: 不管用舷炮还是佩枪，我都会确保那是我想要的结局。

texts.en:
"He's not the first of his kind, nor will he be the last, nor is he the only," $heOrShe says with a pained voice.

"If it pleases you," the curate does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh:
"他不是第一个选择如此的人，也不会是最后一个，更不是唯一的一个。" $heOrShe痛苦地说道。

"如果这让你满意的话，" 祭司没有和你对视，"我现在要去见其他的朝圣者了。"

texts.en:
"As you say," the curate concedes without meeting your eyes.

"If it pleases you," the curate does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh:
"就照你的意思来吧。" 祭司勉为其难地同意了，但没有对上你的目光。

"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" 祭司避开了你的目光，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

texts.en:
"Well. Whatever your intentions, I would counsel you to walk a path far from 'Brother' Cotton," the curate says flatly.

The curate brushes off $hisOrHer robes. "If it pleases you," $heOrShe does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh:
"好吧，无论你意欲何方，我都劝你最好能踏上一条远离 Cotton '修士' 的道路。" 祭司断然地说。

祭司轻振$hisOrHer的长袍。"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" $heOrShe说，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

texts.en: $PersonPost $personName nods in acknowledgement as you take the first step on whatever path you might follow.
texts.zh: $PersonPost $personName 向你点头致意，而你也迈步走向了那条属于自己的道途。

texts.en: $PersonPost $personName motions a sign of blessing as you take your first step on this Pilgrim's Path.
texts.zh: $PersonPost $personName 在你踏上朝圣者之路时为你祈福。

texts.en: $PersonPost $personName gives you a strange look as you walk away, as if $heOrShe knows not what path you might take.
texts.zh: $PersonPost $personName 在你离开时投来了奇怪的目光，似乎是因为$heOrShe无法看出你将去往何方。

texts.en: $PersonPost $personName gives you a strange look as you walk away, as if $heOrShe has concern for the path you might take.
texts.zh: $PersonPost $personName 在你离开时投来了奇怪的目光，似乎是因为$heOrShe很关心你将要选择的方向。

texts.en: The curate smiles at your words. "Yes, to do so would be a praiseworthy service."
texts.zh: 祭司听了你的话后微笑起来。"没错，这样做是值得称赞的。"

texts.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
texts.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

texts.en:
"Might you indeed," the curate says with a small smile. "Even to a secular visitor they represent wonders both beautiful and terrible of human and natural aspects of Creation."

"Some unbelievers, I am told, have inadvertently found their faith while walking the Pilgrim's Path." $HeOrShe shrugs coyly, "Providence works in ways most mysterious."
texts.zh:
"当然可以。" 祭司浅笑着说。"即使对世俗的游客来说，它们也能充分体现人类和自然造物的美丽与恐怖。"

"有人告诉过我，有些本来不信教的人，在朝圣者之路上无意中找到了信仰。" $HeOrShe耸肩的动作微小得你几乎没有察觉，"天意难测。"

texts.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
texts.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

texts.en:
The curate lets a broad smile appear. "Then let me be first to welcome you on your first step on the Pilgrim's Path. You will experience wonders both beautiful and terrible, great and small, of human and natural aspects of Creation."

"Some unbelievers, I am told, have inadvertently found their faith while walking the Pilgrim's Path." $HeOrShe shrugs, "Providence works in ways mysterious to us."
texts.zh:
祭司露出了灿烂的笑容。"那么就让我荣幸地成为庆祝你踏上朝圣者之径的第一人。你将体验到人类与自然造物的美丽与恐怖、宏大与渺小。"

"有人告诉过我，有些本来不信教的人，在朝圣者之路上无意中找到了信仰。" $HeOrShe耸了耸肩，"天意难测。"

texts.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
texts.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

texts.en:
"Before you go, captain, I beg you indulge me. I would 'upload' to you the coordinates for all of the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Perhaps you will follow this fascination?"

$HeOrShe fumbles with a battered off-brand datapad, clearly uncomfortable with its use.
texts.zh:
"舰长，请允许我在你离开之前向你 '上传' 朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标。也许你会深深着迷于此。"

$HeOrShe在一个破旧不堪的杂牌数据平板上摸索着，显然是不太擅长使用它。

options.zh: 指导 $himOrHer 使用数据平板

texts.en: The curate nods. "Each person finds expression of spirit in their own way. That is the beauty of the gift of consciousness. Or," $heOrShe adds with a wink, "Its evolution, as you may prefer."
texts.zh: 祭司点点头。"每个人对心灵都有自己的解读，这便是意识的妙处，或者说..." $heOrShe眨了眨眼睛，"这是种进化，假如这么说你更好理解的话。"

texts.en: "Then you may rest certain that you have come to the right place," the curate says warmly.
texts.zh: "那么你可以放心，你来对地方了。" 祭司热情地说。

texts.en: The curate nods. "A fair rebuke. It is simply that you do not look like a pilgrim to me. I should not be so rigid of mind."
texts.zh: 祭司点点头。"很合适的指摘。在我看来你就不像个朝圣者。或许我不该这么固执的。"

texts.en: "Perhaps your interest here is purely secular?" The curate smiles a little, then says "You have my welcome whether you come with faith or not."
texts.zh: "也许你对这里的兴趣无关信仰？" 祭司微微一笑，"无论是否拥有信仰，这儿都欢迎你。"

texts.en: The curate smiles a little. Is $heOrShe hiding something behind $hisOrHer display of piety?
texts.zh: 祭司微微一笑。$heOrShe是否在那虔诚下隐藏着别的东西呢？

texts.en: The curate smiles a little. "You speak already as if you walk among the Faithful. But as Ludd said, 'The truth of words is revealed by where stands the speaker.'"
texts.zh: 祭司微微一笑。"你的言辞让人感觉你已拥抱信仰。但正如卢德所说，'话语的真理是由说话者的立场所揭示的。'"

texts.en: "Yes." The curate smiles a little, "Yes, I do. You have caught me out from atop a world-weary wall built around your soul."
texts.zh: "是的。" 祭司微微一笑，"没错，我的确如此。你的灵魂筑起了一道厌世之墙与信仰隔离，却依然翻上墙顶接受我的引导。"

texts.en: "Forgive them their youth," the curate says with a sad smile. "We live it but once."
texts.zh: "请原谅他们的莽撞。" 祭司苦笑着说，"我们都是从那个时候过来的。"

texts.en:
You join the novice in prayer, repeating the words as best you can with hands clasped. At first it feels silly to partake in this naive ritual led by a cloistered child of the Church. It is like a lamb leading the lion.

And yet.

Perhaps there is value in the unblushing faith held by such an innocent.

When the prayer finishes, the novice beams a bright smile at you. Behind, you notice that the shrine's Curate Sacraria - the priest of highest authority here - has been watching your exchange from a candle-lit alcove.
texts.zh:
你加入了见习修士的祷告，双手合十，尽可能地重复着祷告词。起初，参加这个由一个与世隔绝的教会孩子主持的天真的仪式感觉很傻。就像狮子去接受小羊羔的指引一样。

然而那只是一开始的想法。

也许这样一个天真无邪的孩子毫不羞愧地秉持的信念，的确有其价值所在。

当祷告结束时，见习修士对你灿烂地微笑着。你注意到，在后面，圣地的神龛祭司 —— 这里的最高权威牧师 —— 一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。

texts.en:
You keep quiet and let the youth rattle on while you get in a good eye-roll.

Letting out a sigh, you happen to spot the shrine's Curate Sacraria, the priest of highest authority here, watching your interaction from a candle-lit alcove. They make eye contact and raise an eyebrow.
texts.zh:
你不言一语，面前的年轻人喋喋不休，你只得翻了翻白眼。

你叹了口气，碰巧注意到圣地的神龛祭司，这里的最高权威牧师，一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。对方对上了你的目光，并扬了扬眉毛。

texts.en:
"Oh," says the novice, "I-"

And you're gone.
texts.zh:
"哦，"见习修士喊道，"我 ——"

但你已经走远了。

texts.en:
"Oh! Pardon my presumption, $playerBrotherOrSister. May... may I pray with you for a safe journey through the holy vacuum?"

The novice perhaps asked this rhetorically, for they're already clasping their hands, eyes closed, and calling for submission before divine providence that you may navigate holy Creation to better serve in carrying out Ludd's teachings, and so on.
texts.zh:
"哦！请原谅我的冒昧，$playerBrotherOrSister。我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

见习修士只是礼貌性地这么问了一下，因为还没等你回应，对方已经双手合十、双目紧闭开始祷告，祷词无非是煽动你向神圣天意展现自己的顺从，以便神赐予你驾驭神圣的造物的能力，更坚定地执行卢德的教义等等。

options.en: Pretend to join the novice in prayer
options.zh: 假装和见习修士一起祈祷

options.en: Politely pretend to join the novice in prayer
options.zh: 礼貌地假装和见习修士一起祈祷

options.en: Take this opportunity to sneak away

texts.en:
"Wait," says the novice, "I-"

And you're gone.
texts.zh:
"等等，"见习修士喊道，"我 ——"

但你已经走远了。

texts.en:
The novice seems to brighten up at this. "It's actually a misunderstanding that the teachings of Ludd are anti-technological, after all..." They see the look on your face at the threat of another scripture reading.

"Ahem. In other words, we believe the problem with advanced technology is not necessarily intrinsic. Well, some technologies are abhorrent- planet-killers, mind-interfacing, crass immortality. Anyway, the six industrial sins are committed when the human spirit is corrupted by technology used without virtue."
texts.zh:
见习修士听到你的话后似乎眼前一亮。"常人认为卢德教义反科技，这实际上是一种误解，毕竟..." 话说到一半，对方注意到了你面如死灰的表情，仿佛已经忍耐经文到了极限。

"嗯嗯。换句话说，我们认为先进技术的问题不一定是内在的。好吧，的确有些技术本身就令人憎恶 —— 行星杀手、心灵接口、愚蠢的永生。总之，工业的六宗罪是因为人们的精神被无道德底线的技术侵蚀所导致的。"

texts.en:
Point made, they nod emphatically. "You fly a space-ship, right? There are many good reasons to do this. To deliver charity, to unite families, to feed the hungry..."

The novice rattles off some extremely optimistic scenarios, and you're forced to concede - to yourself - that it's not unlikely that some of these causes have been inadvertently served in the course of your career.
texts.zh:
说到点子上后，对方笃定地点着头。"你是开飞船的，对吧？这样的职业很好，很值得从事。可以做慈善，让家庭和睦，还能帮助有需要的人..."

见习修士滔滔不绝地说出了一些理想的情景，而你则必须承认 —— 扪心自问 —— 在你的职业生涯中，对方提到的一些事的确可能在不经意间发生。

texts.en:
Their mouth shuts, attack-routine shunting to another approach pattern in response to your spoiling feint, then opens again.

"If-" they begin, but you've already turned away.
texts.zh:
修士立马闭嘴了，开始转化攻击模式以应对你的破坏性佯攻，然后再次开口。

"如果 ——" 对方开始说话，但你已经转身离开了。

texts.en: "Oh, praise Ludd!" the novice exclaims, "That you would be so drawn to spiritual salvation, $playerBrotherOrSister. May... may I pray with you for a safe journey through the holy vacuum?"
texts.zh: "喔，卢德在上！" 见习修士惊呼道，"你竟如此浸淫于精神救赎，$playerBrotherOrSister。我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

texts.en:
This stops the novice short with a look just this side of panic. It is as if hearing you blaspheme so might sully their own faith. You notice their hands unconsciously motion a sign of contrition.

"Ah, that is not- pardon me, I mean to say, 'Blessed are the ignorant', so Ludd said, 'that they might be led on their first steps toward the path to righteousness.' And I believe that, t-truly," the novice stammers.

You see movement now, from the candle-lit alcove behind the novice.
texts.zh:
这话让见习修士猛地顿住，脸上几乎露出惊慌。仿佛听你如此亵渎，连他们自己的信仰都要被玷污了似的。你留意到他们的手不自觉地比了个忏悔的手势。

"啊，那不是—— 恕我失言，我是想说，'无知者有福'，卢德曾如是说，'好叫他们踏上通往义路的第一步。' 我信这个，真、真的，" 见习修士结结巴巴地说道。

这时你看见，见习修士身后烛光照亮的壁龛里，有东西动了动。

texts.en:
This stops the novice short with a look just this side of panic. It is as if hearing you blaspheme so might sully their own faith. You notice their hands unconsciously motion a sign of contrition.

"Ah, that is not- pardon me, I mean to say, 'Blessed are the ignorant', so Ludd said, 'that they might be led on their first steps toward the path to righteousness.' And I believe that, t-truly," the novice stammers.

You see movement now, from the candle-lit alcove behind the novice.
texts.zh:
这让见习修士呆滞了一会，眼光中透露着惊恐，仿佛在听到你亵渎的话语后自己的信仰也会受到玷污。你注意到对方的手无意识地在做出忏悔的手势。

"啊，那不 —— 请原谅我，我的意思是，'无知者也可享有福音'，卢德是这么说的，'他们也被允许引入正义之道。' 而我相信这一点，真...真的。" 见习修士结结巴巴地说。

这时你注意到那个见习修士后方烛光照亮的壁龛里骚动起来。

texts.en:
Without making eye contact, you notice one of those youthful proselytizing types attempting to engage with the occasional hard-case spacer. If you wanted to chat, you'd only have to give the subtlest sign and they'd be filling your ears with hymns of Ludd.

Behind, a humbly yet splendidly robed shadow lurks in a candle-lit alcove. The shrine's Curate, you must assume.
texts.zh:
在避开对方目光的前提下，你注意到了一个年轻的传教者试图与偶尔出现的顽固宇宙民交流。如果想和对方聊聊，你只需要给出一个最微妙的手势，对方就会用卢德的赞美诗填满你的耳朵。

在他后方，一个穿着华丽长袍但姿态谦卑的身影潜伏在烛光照亮的壁龛边。你猜那应该是圣地的住持祭司。

options.en: Why not. Look over to the young missionary.
options.zh: 为什么不呢？把目光投向那年轻的传教士。

texts.en:
As you meet their eyes, their smile widens; target acquired. They approach, keen to recite the unabridged Sacred Texts of Ludd to you.

They first draw breath to speak and you seize the initiative to say-
texts.zh:
当你对上那人的目光时，对方的笑容变得灿烂起来，像是发现了目标一般。对方往这边走来，带着为你背诵未删节版 [卢德圣典] 的渴望。

当对方深吸一口气就要说话时，你抓住主动权说道 ——

texts.en:
As you meet their eyes, their smile widens; target acquired. They approach, keen to recite the unabridged Sacred Texts of Ludd to you.

They first draw breath to speak and you seize the initiative to say-
texts.zh:
当你对上那人的目光时，对方的笑容变得灿烂起来，像是发现了目标一般。对方往这边走来，带着为你背诵未删节版 [卢德圣典] 的渴望。

当对方深吸一口气就要说话时，你抓住主动权说道 ——

texts.en:
Their mouth shuts, attack-routine shunting to another approach pattern in response to your spoiling feint, then opens again.

"If-" they begin, but you've already turned away.
texts.zh:
修士立马闭嘴了，开始转化攻击模式以应对你的破坏性佯攻，然后再次开口。

"如果 ——" 对方开始说话，但你已经转身离开了。

texts.en:
Your polite rebuff only kindles their pious urge to engage.

"So you've already heard the Good News," the novice says eagerly. "Blessed are you in the eyes of Ludd, already and truly. Do you count yourself among the Faithful or has a sense of spiritual longing brought you to this shrine?"
texts.zh:
你礼貌性的拒绝只是让对方虔诚的热情烧得更旺了。

"这么说，你已经得知好消息了。" 见习修士满面热情，"你在卢德的眼中已存真福。你认为自己是虔诚的信徒吗？还是精神上的渴望把你带到了这圣地来？"

options.en: I was simply curious about the shrine.
options.zh: 我很好奇圣地长什么样。

options.en: I... may have some spiritual questions.
options.zh: 我...也许有些唯心方面的问题。

options.en: You misunderstand; I already walk the Path.
options.zh: 你误解了我的话语，我早已踏上了卢德之道。

options.en: No. What good is a religion that hates technology?
options.zh: 不。一个憎恨科技的宗教有什么好的？

options.en: Sorry, but I'm busy. Very busy. Good-bye.
options.zh: 抱歉，但我是个忙人，非常忙。再见。

texts.en:
"Oh! Pardon my presumption, $playerBrotherOrSister. May... may I pray with you for a safe journey through the holy vacuum?"

The novice perhaps asked this rhetorically, for they're already clasping their hands, eyes closed, and calling for submission before divine providence that you may navigate holy Creation to better serve in carrying out Ludd's teachings, and so on.
texts.zh:
"哦！请原谅我的冒昧，$playerBrotherOrSister。我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

见习修士只是礼貌性地这么问了一下，因为还没等你回应，对方已经双手合十、双目紧闭开始祷告，祷词无非是煽动你向神圣天意展现自己的顺从，以便神赐予你驾驭神圣的造物的能力，更坚定地执行卢德的教义等等。

options.en: Pretend to join the novice in prayer
options.zh: 假装和见习修士一起祈祷

options.en: Politely pretend to join the novice in prayer
options.zh: 礼貌地假装和见习修士一起祈祷

options.en: Take this opportunity to sneak away

texts.en:
You join the novice in prayer, repeating the words as best you can with hands clasped. At first it feels silly to partake in this naive ritual led by a cloistered child of the Church. It is like a lamb leading the lion.

And yet.

Perhaps there is value in the unblushing faith held by such an innocent.

When the prayer finishes, the novice beams a bright smile at you. Behind, you notice that the shrine's Curate Sacraria - the priest of highest authority here - has been watching your exchange from a candle-lit alcove.
texts.zh:
你加入了见习修士的祷告，双手合十，尽可能地重复着祷告词。起初，参加这个由一个与世隔绝的教会孩子主持的天真的仪式感觉很傻。就像狮子去接受小羊羔的指引一样。

然而那只是一开始的想法。

也许这样一个天真无邪的孩子毫不羞愧地秉持的信念，的确有其价值所在。

当祷告结束时，见习修士对你灿烂地微笑着。你注意到，在后面，圣地的神龛祭司 —— 这里的最高权威牧师 —— 一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。

texts.en:
You keep quiet and let the youth rattle on while you get in a good eye-roll.

Letting out a sigh, you happen to spot the shrine's Curate Sacraria, the priest of highest authority here, watching your interaction from a candle-lit alcove. They make eye contact and raise an eyebrow.
texts.zh:
你不言一语，面前的年轻人喋喋不休，你只得翻了翻白眼。

你叹了口气，碰巧注意到圣地的神龛祭司，这里的最高权威牧师，一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。对方对上了你的目光，并扬了扬眉毛。

texts.en:
You politely hold your hands together and mumble something prayer-like, taking a moment to appreciate the poetry of the quoted scripture despite the naive delivery.

When the prayer finishes, the novice beams a bright smile at you. Behind them, you notice that the shrine's Curate Sacraria - the priest of highest authority here - has been watching your exchange from a candle-lit alcove.
texts.zh:
你礼貌地双手合十，边随意地呢喃着一些类似祷文的东西，边欣赏着所引用的祷文中的诗意来，尽管它的表达方式很幼稚。

当祷告结束时，见习修士对你粲然一笑。你注意到，在那身后，圣地的神龛祭司 —— 这里的最高权威牧师 —— 一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。

texts.en:
"Wonderful! Blessed already are those whose spirit of reason calls them to the Church."

This is everything they could have hoped for, everything they've been training for. You're given an earful and more about sin, forgiveness, redemption, and the spiritual salve of a simple life. Lots about walking a path and stories about how all sorts of people were impressed with things Ludd said and did.

The novice winds down, and, noticing your endurance flagging, says "May... may I pray with you for a safe journey through the holy vacuum?"
texts.zh:
"太棒了！受精神呼唤前往教会的人已是受福之人。"

这是对方期盼的回答，也是对方为之训练的目标。你听了一大堆话，是关于罪、宽恕、救赎和朴素生活等的种种精神慰藉。还有很多故事，指引人如何与道同行，以及各种各样的人是如何折服于卢德的言行的。

注意到你的不耐烦，见习修士不再滔滔不绝，反而说到，"我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

texts.zh: "喔，卢德在上！" 见习修士惊呼道，"你竟如此浸淫于精神救赎，$playerBrotherOrSister。我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

texts.en:
This stops the novice short with a look just this side of panic. It is as if hearing you blaspheme so might sully their own faith. You notice their hands unconsciously motion a sign of contrition.

"Ah, that is not- pardon me, I mean to say, 'Blessed are the ignorant', so Ludd said, 'that they might be led on their first steps toward the path to righteousness.' And I believe that, t-truly," the novice stammers.

You see movement now, from the candle-lit alcove behind the novice.
texts.zh:
这话让见习修士猛地顿住，脸上几乎露出惊慌。仿佛听你如此亵渎，连他们自己的信仰都要被玷污了似的。你留意到他们的手不自觉地比了个忏悔的手势。

"啊，那不是—— 恕我失言，我是想说，'无知者有福'，卢德曾如是说，'好叫他们踏上通往义路的第一步。' 我信这个，真、真的，" 见习修士结结巴巴地说道。

这时你看见，见习修士身后烛光照亮的壁龛里，有东西动了动。

texts.en:
This stops the novice short with a look just this side of panic. It is as if hearing you blaspheme so might sully their own faith. You notice their hands unconsciously motion a sign of contrition.

"Ah, that is not- pardon me, I mean to say, 'Blessed are the ignorant', so Ludd said, 'that they might be led on their first steps toward the path to righteousness.' And I believe that, t-truly," the novice stammers.

You see movement now, from the candle-lit alcove behind the novice.
texts.zh:
这让见习修士呆滞了一会，眼光中透露着惊恐，仿佛在听到你亵渎的话语后自己的信仰也会受到玷污。你注意到对方的手无意识地在做出忏悔的手势。

"啊，那不 —— 请原谅我，我的意思是，'无知者也可享有福音'，卢德是这么说的，'他们也被允许引入正义之道。' 而我相信这一点，真...真的。" 见习修士结结巴巴地说。

这时你注意到那个见习修士后方烛光照亮的壁龛里骚动起来。

texts.en:
The novice seems to brighten up at this. "It's actually a misunderstanding that the teachings of Ludd are anti-technological, after all..." They see the look on your face at the threat of another scripture reading.

"Ahem. In other words, we believe the problem with advanced technology is not necessarily intrinsic. Well, some technologies are abhorrent- planet-killers, mind-interfacing, crass immortality. Anyway, the six industrial sins are committed when the human spirit is corrupted by technology used without virtue."
texts.zh:
见习修士听到你的话后似乎眼前一亮。"常人认为卢德教义反科技，这实际上是一种误解，毕竟..." 话说到一半，对方注意到了你面如死灰的表情，仿佛已经忍耐经文到了极限。

"嗯嗯。换句话说，我们认为先进技术的问题不一定是内在的。好吧，的确有些技术本身就令人憎恶 —— 行星杀手、心灵接口、愚蠢的永生。总之，工业的六宗罪是因为人们的精神被无道德底线的技术侵蚀所导致的。"

texts.en:
Point made, they nod emphatically. "You fly a space-ship, right? There are many good reasons to do this. To deliver charity, to unite families, to feed the hungry..."

The novice rattles off some extremely optimistic scenarios, and you're forced to concede - to yourself - that it's not unlikely that some of these causes have been inadvertently served in the course of your career.
texts.zh:
说到点子上后，对方笃定地点着头。"你是开飞船的，对吧？这样的职业很好，很值得从事。可以做慈善，让家庭和睦，还能帮助有需要的人..."

见习修士滔滔不绝地说出了一些理想的情景，而你则必须承认 —— 扪心自问 —— 在你的职业生涯中，对方提到的一些事的确可能在不经意间发生。

texts.en:
"Wait," says the novice, "I-"

And you're gone.
texts.zh:
"等等，"见习修士喊道，"我 ——"

但你已经走远了。

texts.en:
"Oh," says the novice, "I-"

And you're gone.
texts.zh:
"哦，"见习修士喊道，"我 ——"

但你已经走远了。

texts.en: As if on cue - or perhaps because they were hovering nearby the whole time - the curate of the shrine steps up to you and the novice.
texts.zh: 好像是碰巧 —— 又或者是因为对方根本就没离开过 —— 此时，圣地的祭司向你和见习修士走来。

texts.en:
"That's quite enough, my child," they say with iron concealed beneath soft words, "Perhaps you should undertake a prayer of contrition in the chapel while I speak with the captain."

Abashed, the novice bows and flees. The curate turns to you, face worn with lines of more than just patience.
texts.zh:
"够了，我的孩子。" 对方轻柔的话语里透露出铁一般的执着。"也许在我和舰长说话时，你应该在小教堂里做一个忏悔的祈祷。"

见习修士羞愧地鞠了一躬，逃也似地离开了。祭司看向你，在她脸上留下痕迹的不止有多年的耐心。

texts.en:
"Ah, the blessed faith of the young," the curate dismisses the novice with a nod. "Forthright and, I'm afraid, tactless."

"My name is $personName, and I am entrusted with the care of this shrine. I felt called to personally welcome you, captain."
texts.zh:
"啊，年轻人的神圣信仰..." 祭司点了点头，让见习修士离开了。"直率，但恐怕还有些莽撞。"

"我是 $personName，负责照看这处圣地的牧师。这位舰长，我受召来亲自招待您。"

texts.en: "You are welcome here," the curate calls to you as you go. "Always."
texts.zh: "我们欢迎你拜访此地。" 祭司在你离开的时候说到，"永远欢迎。"

texts.en: The curate smiles. "You have my welcome whether you have come for faith or not."
texts.zh: 祭司笑了。"不管是不是为了信仰而来，圣地都欢迎你的参观。"

texts.en: "Perhaps your interest here is purely secular?" The curate smiles a little, then says "You have my welcome whether you come with faith or not."
texts.zh: "也许你对这里的兴趣无关信仰？" 祭司微微一笑，"无论是否拥有信仰，这儿都欢迎你。"

texts.en: "Forgive them their youth," the curate says with a sad smile. "We live it but once."
texts.zh: "请原谅他们的莽撞。" 祭司苦笑着说，"我们都是从那个时候过来的。"

texts.en: The curate smiles a little. "You speak already as if you walk among the Faithful. But as Ludd said, 'The truth of words is revealed by where stands the speaker.'"
texts.zh: 祭司微微一笑。"你的言辞让人感觉你已拥抱信仰。但正如卢德所说，'话语的真理是由说话者的立场所揭示的。'"

texts.en: "Yes." The curate smiles a little, "Yes, I do. You have caught me out from atop a world-weary wall built around your soul."
texts.zh: "是的。" 祭司微微一笑，"没错，我的确如此。你的灵魂筑起了一道厌世之墙与信仰隔离，却依然翻上墙顶接受我的引导。"

texts.en: The curate smiles a little. Is $heOrShe hiding something behind $hisOrHer display of piety?
texts.zh: 祭司微微一笑。$heOrShe是否在那虔诚下隐藏着别的东西呢？

texts.en:
"It is my calling to serve the pilgrims who come here."

A pause, then, "And also those who are not pilgrims." $HeOrShe looks expectantly at you, $hisOrHer silence asking which one you are - pilgrim or not?
texts.zh:
"为来到这里的朝圣者服务是我的使命。"

对方停顿了一下，随即继续道，"当然我也会为并非朝圣者的人服务。" $HeOrShe满面期待地看着你，$hisOrHer的沉默则是对你的询问 —— 你是不是朝圣者呢？

texts.en:
"It is my calling to serve the pilgrims who come here."

A pause, then, "And also those who are not pilgrims." $HeOrShe looks expectantly at you.
texts.zh:
我生来就是为了服侍来此的朝圣者。

稍顿，又说道，“还有那些并非朝圣者的人。” $HeOrShe 期待地看着你。

texts.en: "Then you may rest certain that you have come to the right place," the curate says warmly.
texts.zh: "那么你可以放心，你来对地方了。" 祭司热情地说。

texts.en: The curate nods. "A fair rebuke. It is simply that you do not look like a pilgrim to me. I should not be so rigid of mind."
texts.zh: 祭司点点头。"很合适的指摘。在我看来你就不像个朝圣者。或许我不该这么固执的。"

texts.en: The curate nods. "Each person finds expression of spirit in their own way. That is the beauty of the gift of consciousness. Or," $heOrShe adds with a wink, "Its evolution, as you may prefer."
texts.zh: 祭司点点头。"每个人对心灵都有自己的解读，这便是意识的妙处，或者说..." $heOrShe眨了眨眼睛，"这是种进化，假如这么说你更好理解的话。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat, then gives a practiced speech: "Taken together, these shrines form the Pilgrim's Path. It is not merely a linear path through space. Though of course," $heOrShe takes a patient tone, "In secular use the name has been given to the major shipping lanes between Church and Hegemony-controlled volumes."

The curate continues, "The Pilgrim's Path is a spiritual journey unique to each individual as they explore and discover their faith through our shared teachings, the holy Word gifted to us by the Creator who touched the prophet Ludd. The faithful are encouraged to make a pilgrimage at least once in their life, if they are able."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe清了清嗓子，开始进行一段熟练的说明。"如果在太空中画一条线，把这些圣地串在一起，就形成了{朝圣者之路}。对我们来说，它可不仅仅是一条穿过太空的路程。话虽如此..." $heOrShe慢条斯理地说道，"在世俗语境中，这个名字常被用来指代来往于教会和霸主控制的星际空间之间的重要航道。"

祭司继续说下去。"对每个人来说，{朝圣者之路}是他们独一无二的精神旅程，他们通过我们共同的教义，也就是曾感动先知卢德的造物主赐予我们的圣言，来探索和发现自己的信仰。我们鼓励信众，若有能力的情况下，在他们的一生中至少应当进行一次朝圣之旅。"

options.en: I would like to visit the shrines.

texts.en:
"Gilead, Jangala, Hesperus... a handful," $heOrShe says with a pause, eyes searching. "Some have been lost over the years; Opis of course. And others sanctified anew. Here of course; Beholder Station orbiting Kumari Aru, though militant elements frequent the volume. And Volturn, though the present authorities are fickle about access."

"There... was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is a dangerous place however, to say nothing of the system's infestation of pirates."
texts.zh:
"Gilead、Jangala、Hesperus...有不少。" $heOrShe停顿了一下，目光仿佛在寻找着什么。"有些已经遗失在岁月中了，比如 Opis。还有一些地方被重新革凡登圣。譬如此地，Kumari Aru 轨道上的 Beholder 空间站就是一处，尽管武装分子频繁在附近出没。还有 Volturn 圣地，然而当局对是否允许拜访那里一事反复无常。"

"还有曾经的 Killa 圣地...可能现在还在。不过那里的环境本来就很危险，更别提该星系常受到海盗侵扰了。"

options.en: I would like to visit the shrines.
I would make a pilgrimage to each of the shrines.
options.zh: 我打算去所有圣地朝圣。

texts.en:
"Gilead, Jangala, Hesperus... a handful," $heOrShe says with a pause, eyes searching. "Some have been lost over the years; Opis of course. And others sanctified anew. There is Beholder Station orbiting Kumari Aru, though militant elements frequent there. And Volturn, though the present authorities are fickle about access."

"There... was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is a dangerous place however, to say nothing of the system's infestation of pirates."
texts.zh:
"Gilead、Jangala、Hesperus...有不少。" $heOrShe停顿了一下，目光仿佛在寻找着什么。"有些已经遗失在岁月中了，比如 Opis。还有一些地方被重新革凡登圣。Kumari Aru 轨道上的 Beholder 空间站就是其中一处，尽管武装分子在那附近频繁出没。还有 Volturn 圣地，然而当局对是否允许拜访那里一事反复无常。"

"还有曾经的 Killa 圣地...可能现在还在。不过那里的环境本来就很危险，更别提该星系常受到海盗侵扰了。"

options.en: One could make a few credits transporting pilgrims between shrines...
options.zh: 看来在圣地之间为朝圣者提供交通服务可以赚些星币...

options.en: It could be charitable to transport pilgrims between shrines...
options.zh: 看来在圣地之间为朝圣者提供交通服务是不错的慈善事业...

options.en: I would like to visit the shrines.
I would make a pilgrimage to each of the shrines.
options.zh: 我打算去所有圣地朝圣。

texts.en:
"Ye... es," the curate says, eyeing you skeptically.

"I'm sure," $heOrShe continues charitably, "that charging a nominal fare for fuel, air, and foodstuff would not be wholly out of line. The faithful would not expect you to beggar yourself to provide safe transport."
texts.zh:
"是...的。" 祭司说，看向你的目光满是怀疑。

"可以肯定的是，" $heOrShe宽容地继续道，"对燃料、空气和食物收取象征性的费用是合理的。信徒们不会指望你无偿提供安全的交通服务。"

texts.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
texts.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

texts.en: The curate smiles at your words. "Yes, to do so would be a praiseworthy service."
texts.zh: 祭司听了你的话后微笑起来。"没错，这样做是值得称赞的。"

texts.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
texts.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

texts.en:
"Might you indeed," the curate says with a small smile. "Even to a secular visitor they represent wonders both beautiful and terrible of human and natural aspects of Creation."

"Some unbelievers, I am told, have inadvertently found their faith while walking the Pilgrim's Path." $HeOrShe shrugs coyly, "Providence works in ways most mysterious."
texts.zh:
"当然可以。" 祭司浅笑着说。"即使对世俗的游客来说，它们也能充分体现人类和自然造物的美丽与恐怖。"

"有人告诉过我，有些本来不信教的人，在朝圣者之路上无意中找到了信仰。" $HeOrShe耸肩的动作微小得你几乎没有察觉，"天意难测。"

texts.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
texts.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

texts.en:
The curate lets a broad smile appear. "Then let me be first to welcome you on your first step on the Pilgrim's Path. You will experience wonders both beautiful and terrible, great and small, of human and natural aspects of Creation."

"Some unbelievers, I am told, have inadvertently found their faith while walking the Pilgrim's Path." $HeOrShe shrugs, "Providence works in ways mysterious to us."
texts.zh:
祭司露出了灿烂的笑容。"那么就让我荣幸地成为庆祝你踏上朝圣者之径的第一人。你将体验到人类与自然造物的美丽与恐怖、宏大与渺小。"

"有人告诉过我，有些本来不信教的人，在朝圣者之路上无意中找到了信仰。" $HeOrShe耸了耸肩，"天意难测。"

texts.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
texts.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

texts.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
texts.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

texts.en:
"Before you go, captain, I beg you indulge me. I would 'upload' to you the coordinates for all of the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Perhaps you will follow this fascination?"

$HeOrShe fumbles with a battered off-brand datapad, clearly uncomfortable with its use.
texts.zh:
"舰长，请允许我在你离开之前向你 '上传' 朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标。也许你会深深着迷于此。"

$HeOrShe在一个破旧不堪的杂牌数据平板上摸索着，显然是不太擅长使用它。

options.zh: 指导 $himOrHer 使用数据平板

texts.en:
"Here, captain, let me 'upload' to you the coordinates for all of the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path."

$HeOrShe fumbles with a battered off-brand datapad, clearly uncomfortable with its use.
texts.zh:
"舰长，来，让我向你 '上传' 朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标。"

$HeOrShe在一个破旧不堪的杂牌数据平板上摸索着，显然是不太擅长使用它。

options.zh: 指导 $himOrHer 使用数据平板

texts.en: After a moment, you point out the correct sequence of commands for transferring the nav data.
texts.zh: 过了一会儿，你指出了用于传输导航数据的正确命令集。

texts.en: "My thanks," $heOrShe says humbly.
texts.zh: "谢谢。" $heOrShe谦卑地说。

options.en: By the way, do you know one Brother Livewell Cotton?
options.zh: 对了，你知道 Livewell Cotton 修士吗？

options.en: I'm sure this will be interesting, curate.
options.zh: 我猜这会很有趣的，祭司。

options.en: No, thank you. Now I have a journey to begin.
options.zh: 不，我才该感谢你。现在我该开始一段旅程了。

options.en: Now I know where to avoid. Good-day.
options.zh: 现在我知道该避开哪些地方了，再会。

options.en: Not Moloch nor Mammon shall lead me astray.
options.zh: 双子恶魔们也无法令我误入歧途。

texts.en: $PersonPost $personName nods in acknowledgement as you take the first step on whatever path you might follow.
texts.zh: $PersonPost $personName 向你点头致意，而你也迈步走向了那条属于自己的道途。

texts.en: $PersonPost $personName motions a sign of blessing as you take your first step on this Pilgrim's Path.
texts.zh: $PersonPost $personName 在你踏上朝圣者之路时为你祈福。

texts.en: $PersonPost $personName gives you a strange look as you walk away, as if $heOrShe knows not what path you might take.
texts.zh: $PersonPost $personName 在你离开时投来了奇怪的目光，似乎是因为$heOrShe无法看出你将去往何方。

texts.en: $PersonPost $personName gives you a strange look as you walk away, as if $heOrShe has concern for the path you might take.
texts.zh: $PersonPost $personName 在你离开时投来了奇怪的目光，似乎是因为$heOrShe很关心你将要选择的方向。

texts.en:
The curate freezes, suddenly wary. "Ah."

$HeOrShe lets a breath out. "Now there's a name I have not heard in a very long time."

Before you can speak, the curate continues "It's nothing untoward. I do tend to this shrine and my transient flock, but I am not a hermit. Of course I have heard of Cotton. And met him on one occasion. I made my report to the Knights long ago and that was the end of it."

"I hesitate to ask, but must: why do you inquire so?"
texts.zh:
祭司僵住了，突然露出了戒备的模样。"啊。"

$HeOrShe吐出了一口气。"我很久没听过这个名字了。"

你还没来得及说什么，祭司就继续说了下去。"没什么大问题。我确实在照顾着这个圣地和在这暂住的信徒们，但我不是隐士。我当然听说过 Cotton，甚至见过他一次。那时我向骑士们做了相关报告，不过我与此人的交集仅此而已。"

"虽然有些犹豫，但我必须得问你：你为何向我打听他？"

options.en: I am going to kill him.

texts.en: "And were you to find him?"
texts.zh: "那如果你找到他了呢？"

options.en: I am going to kill him.

texts.en:
"Well. Whatever your intentions, I would counsel you to walk a path far from 'Brother' Cotton," the curate says flatly.

The curate brushes off $hisOrHer robes. "If it pleases you," $heOrShe does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh:
"好吧，无论你意欲何方，我都劝你最好能踏上一条远离 Cotton '修士' 的道路。" 祭司断然地说。

祭司轻振$hisOrHer的长袍。"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" $heOrShe说，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

texts.en:
The curate looks tired, but considers this response.

"Would he tell you anything you did not already believe?" $HeOrShe sits down on a bench with a sigh. "You need not answer that. And I would prefer you did not."

"People come to this shrine seeking answers. I have found that most who come here already have the answers they seek; truly what they seek is permission to accept that which they already know."
texts.zh:
祭司看起来很疲惫，但还是思考了一下你的回应。

"他会告诉你一些你还不相信的事吗？" $HeOrShe叹了口气并坐到了长凳上，"不必回答，我只希望你不要这样做。"

"人们来到这圣地寻求答案。但我发现，大多数来到这里的人，心中其实早已有了他们寻求的答案；他们真正寻求的，是获得许可，去接受那些他们已经知道的事情。"

texts.en: The curate stands, and brushes off $hisOrHer robe. "If it pleases you," the curate does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh: 祭司站了起来，轻振$hisOrHer的长袍。"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" 祭司避开了你的目光，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

texts.en:
"I would counsel you against that path," the curate says flatly.

The curate brushes off $hisOrHer robes. "If it pleases you," $heOrShe does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh:
"我奉劝你不要踏上那条道路。" 祭司断然地说。

祭司轻振$hisOrHer的长袍。"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" $heOrShe避开了你的目光，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

texts.en:
The curate sighs, rubbing $hisOrHer eyes as if a sharp headache had just come upon $himOrHer, then speaks.

"I could not say if you would find the finality you seek on that particular path."
texts.zh:
祭司叹了口气，揉了揉$hisOrHer的眼睛，仿佛正在忍受剧烈的头痛，然后开口道：

"我并不知道这条道路是否通向你所追求的最终结局。"

options.en: By broadside or sidearm, I can ensure finality.
options.zh: 不管用舷炮还是佩枪，我都会确保那是我想要的结局。

texts.en:
"He's not the first of his kind, nor will he be the last, nor is he the only," $heOrShe says with a pained voice.

"If it pleases you," the curate does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh:
"他不是第一个选择如此的人，也不会是最后一个，更不是唯一的一个。" $heOrShe痛苦地说道。

"如果这让你满意的话，" 祭司没有和你对视，"我现在要去见其他的朝圣者了。"

texts.en:
"As you say," the curate concedes without meeting your eyes.

"If it pleases you," the curate does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
texts.zh:
"就照你的意思来吧。" 祭司勉为其难地同意了，但没有对上你的目光。

"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" 祭司避开了你的目光，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

texts.en:
The attendant receives your request with only the subtlest disapproval. To your surprise, a subcurate approaches to escort you to the shrine's viewing chamber.

A vast, dim gallery opens upon a hundred-meter diamond plate window allowing a full view of the glory of Kumari Aru. Here, pilgrims quietly contemplate the miracle of Creation, taking in the sublime and terrible beauty of the gas giant looming below. Storm systems the size of a standard terrestrial world churn with slow majesty, inner-lit with green-violet sheet lightning, teeming with xenolife.

Does something incomprehensible look up from the lee of a dark cloudbank at the bright point in that alien sky?
texts.zh:
圣务侍接受了你的请求，只是稍显不悦。出乎你意料的是，一名助理祭司走了过来，领你去了圣地的观礼室。

一个巨大而昏暗的回廊围绕着一扇百米宽的菱形窗口展开，让人得以一览 Kumari Aru 的壮丽美景。在这里，朝圣者们冥思创世者的神迹，体验下方赫然耸立的气态巨行星所展现出的庄严敬畏之美。规模相当于一个标准的类地星球风暴系统缓慢而威严地翻腾着，大片绿紫色的雷电不时闪烁其中，孕育着数不尽的异种生命。

不知在那阴暗的云层之下，是否有什么难以名状之物正抬头望着它们的天空中的亮点？

texts.en: You exit the sanctum, still pondering what you saw and, perhaps, felt.
texts.zh: 你走出密室，思考着你所看到，或许还有感觉到的。

texts.en:
You notice a young novice watching you. As you accidentally meet their eyes, their smile widens; target acquired. They approach, keen on proselytization to a spacer captain.

These enthusiastic missionaries are a common enough affliction of spacedocks, so you are not unprepared. As they first draw breath to speak, you seize the initiative and say-
texts.zh:
你注意到一个年轻的见习修士在看着你。当你对上那人的目光时，对方的笑容变得灿烂起来，像是发现了目标一般。修士往这边走来，似乎是想改变一位太空舰长的信仰。

这些热情的传教士是太空船坞里常见的折磨怪，所以你其实早有准备。当对方深吸一口气就要说话时，你抓住主动权说道 ——

texts.en:
Without making eye contact, you notice one of those youthful proselytizing types attempting to engage with the occasional hard-case spacer. If you wanted to chat, you'd only have to give the subtlest sign and they'd be filling your ears with hymns of Ludd.

Behind, a humbly yet splendidly robed shadow lurks in a candle-lit alcove. The shrine's Curate, you must assume.
texts.zh:
在避开对方目光的前提下，你注意到了一个年轻的传教者试图与偶尔出现的顽固宇宙民交流。如果想和对方聊聊，你只需要给出一个最微妙的手势，对方就会用卢德的赞美诗填满你的耳朵。

在他后方，一个穿着华丽长袍但姿态谦卑的身影潜伏在烛光照亮的壁龛边。你猜那应该是圣地的住持祭司。

options.en: Why not. Look over to the young missionary.
options.zh: 为什么不呢？把目光投向那年轻的传教士。

texts.en: You've made a contribution recently so providing another at this time might be viewed as an unseemly act of pride.
texts.zh: 你最近已经做过捐赠了，过多的捐赠会被视为傲慢的举动。

texts.en: You inquire with the subcurate about the possibility of contributing to the maintenance of this holy site. With a warm smile, the subcurate explains that an offering of 10 units of supplies would do much to assist the Church in its observance of sacred duties.
texts.zh: 你询问助理祭司是否可以为这片圣迹的维护提供捐助。助理祭司带着热情的微笑解释说，10 单位的补给便可大大助于教会履行其神圣的职责。

texts.en:
You inquire with the subcurate about the possibility of contributing to the maintenance of this holy site. An offering of 10 units of supplies would do much to assist the Church in its observance of sacred duties. Unfortunately you do not have enough supplies on hand.

The subcurate gives a sad smile. "I see that your intent is good. Perhaps you would like to partake of the charity meal we offer each shift?"
texts.zh:
你询问助理祭司是否可以为这片圣迹的维护提供捐助。10 单位的补给便可大大助于教会履行其神圣的职责。不幸的是，你手头没有足够的补给。

助理祭司向你回以一个黯然的微笑，"你的好意我心领了。也许你可能会需要一份我们每天提供的布施餐？"

texts.en: A subcurate accepts your offering with prayer and thanks.
texts.zh: A subcurate accepts your offering with prayer and thanks.

texts.en: Your purser reports that the pilgrims you picked up on $lpt_sourceName to transport to the local $lpt_visitTargetNameShort have been offloaded to a civilian shuttle.
texts.zh: 你的事务长汇报道，那些你在 $lpt_sourceName 带上，要去本地卢德圣地的朝圣者已经被送入一架民用穿梭机中。

texts.en: Your purser reports that the pilgrims you picked up from $lpt_sourceName have been offloaded to a private shuttle and are on their way to the $lpt_visitTargetName. Their payment has forwarded to your accounts.
texts.zh: 你的事务长汇报道，那些你在 $lpt_sourceName 带上的朝圣者已经被送入一架私人穿梭机中带去本地的卢德圣地。他们的付款已经打入你的账户。

texts.en:
The leader of the pilgrims you have transported from $lpt_sourceName insists on having the 'excellent captain' see $lpt_hisOrHer group off. "You should see the shrine, captain," $lpt_heOrShe insists. "I was once an unbeliever; the experience is quite transformational."

$lpt_HeOrShe flashes a perfect smile, "Of course, I understand that this is a journey one must choose for oneself." $lpt_HeOrShe makes a pious gesture, then offloads to a private shuttle $lpt_heOrShe has hired to transport $lpt_himOrHer and $lpt_hisOrHer party to the shrine.
texts.zh:
你从 $lpt_sourceName 带来的朝圣者的领头人非要 "杰出的舰长" 来为他们送行。"你应该去看看圣地，舰长。" $lpt_hisOrHer坚持道。"我也曾是个无信者；那是段脱胎换骨的体验。"

他露出了一个完美的微笑，"当然，我也知道这是个必须由你自己选择去行的旅道。" $lpt_HeOrShe做了一个虔诚的手势，然后搭上了$lpt_HeOrShe为他们一行雇来送他们去圣地的私人穿梭机。

texts.en:
You receive report that the pilgrims you transported here from $lpt_sourceName have been offloaded to a civilian shuttle dedicated to charitable service for Faithful of humble means.

Whether you like it or not, they promised to pray for you for your act of charity.
texts.zh:
你收到报告称，那些你从 $lpt_sourceName 带来的朝圣者已经被送入一架专门为谦卑的信仰者提供慈善服务的民用穿梭机中。

无论你是否喜欢，他们都保证会为这一善举为你祈祷。

texts.en:
The attendant receives your request with only the subtlest disapproval. To your surprise, a subcurate approaches to escort you to the shrine's viewing chamber.

A vast, dim gallery opens upon a hundred-meter diamond plate window allowing a full view of the glory of Kumari Aru. Here, pilgrims quietly contemplate the miracle of Creation, taking in the sublime and terrible beauty of the gas giant looming below. Storm systems the size of a standard terrestrial world churn with slow majesty, inner-lit with green-violet sheet lightning, teeming with xenolife.

Does something incomprehensible look up from the lee of a dark cloudbank at the bright point in that alien sky?
texts.zh:
圣务侍接受了你的请求，只是稍显不悦。出乎你意料的是，一名助理祭司走了过来，领你去了圣地的观礼室。

一个巨大而昏暗的回廊围绕着一扇百米宽的菱形窗口展开，让人得以一览 Kumari Aru 的壮丽美景。在这里，朝圣者们冥思创世者的神迹，体验下方赫然耸立的气态巨行星所展现出的庄严敬畏之美。规模相当于一个标准的类地星球风暴系统缓慢而威严地翻腾着，大片绿紫色的雷电不时闪烁其中，孕育着数不尽的异种生命。

不知在那阴暗的云层之下，是否有什么难以名状之物正抬头望着它们的天空中的亮点？

texts.en: You exit the sanctum, still pondering what you saw and, perhaps, felt.
texts.zh: 你走出密室，思考着你所看到，或许还有感觉到的。

texts.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is strictly overseen by the Knights of Ludd; your shuttle must queue behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers filled with approved industrial goods.

This provides you with time to contemplate the face of Gilead; its continents, once fringed only by alien algae-equivalents, were seeded with Earth-life by a far-roving sporeship of the second wave of human expansion. The Eridani-Utopia Terraforming megacorp followed and its vast machines stabilized the climate and ecological processes. Ludd came then, pulled down the machines, and the believers who followed maintained the world as a garden-wilderness of astounding richness. Truly, it is a gem of the Persean Sector.

Your shuttle receives a ping from traffic control: permission to descend.
texts.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆装满经过批准的工业产品的笨重运输船和拖船后面。

这样一来你便有时间细想 Gilead 的面貌了。它的大陆曾经只被外星藻类覆盖，直到人类进行第二波殖民扩张时，被远道而来的孢子母舰播种了类地生命。波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 紧随其后，用巨型机器稳定了气候和生态。那之后卢德来到了这里，摧毁了机器，跟随着他的信徒们则把世界维持着花园般的未开发模样，至今它依然富饶得惊人。的确，它当得起英仙座星域明珠的名号。

这时你的穿梭机收到了交通管制中心的提示：这是允许降落的意思。

texts.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is overseen by the Knights of Ludd, and their traffic control is characteristically strict. Your shuttle queues behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers.

The face of Gilead is filled with green continents, seeded with Earth-life by sporeship and climate-stabilized by Eridani Utopia's vast terraforming machines. Then Ludd came and the Faithful turned the world into a garden-wilderness of astounding richness; it is a gem of the Persean Sector.

Your shuttle receives a ping from traffic control: permission to descend.
texts.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

Gilead 的星球表面上遍布绿洲，孢子母舰在上面播种了类地生命，波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 的巨型机器则稳定了它的气候和生态。那之后卢德来到了这里，跟随着他的信徒们则把世界变成了花园般的未开发模样，至今它依然富饶得惊人。它是英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

你的穿梭机收到了交通管制中心的提示：这是允许降落的意思。

texts.en: Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is overseen by the Knights of Ludd, and their traffic control is typically strict. Your shuttle queues behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and hauler
texts.zh: 离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士监管，并且他们的交通管制非常严格。你的穿梭机排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

texts.en: The face of Gilead is painted with fragile green continents and glittering blue oceans. Ludd came here and the original Faithful, undiluted by the Church hierarchy, liberated the world from Eridani Utopia's terraforming machines. In place of a sprawl of private fortress-plantations and crowded resort playgrounds for the rich, a garden-wilderness of astounding richness bloomed. It is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的表面由纤巧美丽的绿色大陆和闪闪发光的蓝色海洋组成。卢德曾到过这里，那些追随他的、尚未被教会阶级制度侵蚀的最初信徒们，则将这个世界从 波江座-乌托邦 的地貌改造机器手中解放了出来。于是在这颗星球上，取代了杂乱无章的私人堡垒种植园和拥挤的富人度假乐园，一片富饶得惊人的自然花园盛放了，这让它成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

texts.en: The face of Gilead is painted with fragile green continents and glittering blue oceans. Ludd came here, saw Eridani Utopia's vast terraforming machines and designs for profit, and led the first Faithful to liberate the world. In place of sprawling private fortress-plantations and crowded resort compounds, a garden-wilderness of astounding richness was cultivated. It is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的表面由纤巧美丽的绿色大陆和闪闪发光的蓝色海洋组成。卢德曾到过这里，看到 波江座-乌托邦 的巨型地貌改造机器和为了盈利进行的规划后，让最初信徒们解放了这个世界。于是在这颗星球上，取代了杂乱无章的私人堡垒种植园和拥挤的度假区复合体，一片富饶得惊人的自然花园被耕耘而出，让它成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

texts.en: The face of Gilead bears startlingly green continents and glittering blue oceans. First seeded by sporeships, the terraforming contract was granted by the Domain colonial authorities to the Eridani Utopia Terraforming megacorporation. Their vast machines tamed the world, and just as the project was on the cusp of fruition, Ludd came. From a certain perspective, the followers of Ludd stole the world to create their own vision of paradise: a rustic garden-wilderness. Despite the hypocrisy, or perhaps for it, Gilead is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的表面承载着惊艳的绿色大陆和闪烁的蓝色海洋。在最初由孢子母舰播种生命后，一份人之领殖民部门和波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团之间的合同签订了，后者的巨型机器随后开始开垦这个世界。就在项目即将取得成果之际，卢德来到了这里。从某种角度来看，卢德的追随者窃取了这个世界，将它塑造成了他们心目中的天堂：一座质朴的自然花园。尽管虚伪，但或许正因如此，Gilead 成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

texts.en: The face of Gilead is filled with green continents, seeded with Earth-life by sporeship and climate-stabilized by Eridani-Utopia's vast terraforming machines. Then Ludd came and the Faithful turned the world into a rustic garden-wilderness of astounding richness; it is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的星球表面上遍布绿洲，孢子母舰在上面播种了类地生命，波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 的巨型机器则稳定了它的气候和生态。那之后卢德来到了这里，跟随着他的信徒们则把世界变成了一座质朴的自然花园，这使它成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

texts.en: The face of Gilead is filled with green continents, seeded with Earth-life by sporeship and climate-stabilized by Eridani Utopia's vast terraforming machines. Then Ludd came and turned the world into a rustic garden-wilderness of astounding richness; it is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的表面被绿色的大地所覆盖。孢子母舰在这里播种了类地生命，波江座-乌托邦集团的巨型环境改造机器稳定了这里的气候和生态。随后卢德游历至此，将这个世界变成了富饶惊人的质朴园野，成就了这一英仙座星域瑰宝。

texts.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is strictly overseen by the Knights of Ludd; your shuttle must queue behind a not insignificant flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers filled with approved industrial goods.

As your shuttle inserts into a holding orbit, an override comes in from traffic control. Your pilot forwards the nav instructions to you for approval: immediate permission to descend on a non-standard route to a site which is not the usual pilgrimage transport complex. Instead, you are being directed to a pad serving a sprawling monastic compound.

The local datasphere, such as it is, is not forthcoming on details.
texts.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

你的穿梭机进入悬停轨道时，交通管制发来了超驰指令。驾驶员将导航指示转发给你以供确认：通行许可来的很快，但目的地并非通常的朝圣者交通复合体。取而代之地，你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线下到一处庞大寺院建筑群中的停机坪上。

哪怕是当地的数据库，也没能提供有关目的地的细节。

texts.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is strictly overseen by the Knights of Ludd; your shuttle must queue behind a not insignificant flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers filled with approved industrial goods.

As your shuttle inserts into a holding orbit, an override comes in from traffic control. Your pilot forwards the nav instructions to you for approval: immediate permission to descend on a non-standard route to a site which is not the usual pilgrimage transport complex. Instead, you are being directed to a pad serving a sprawling monastic compound.

The local datasphere, such as it is, is not forthcoming on details. You can only assume that Archcurate Jaspis is insisting on meeting with you.
texts.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

你的穿梭机进入悬停轨道时，交通管制发来了超驰指令。驾驶员将导航指示转发给你以供确认：通行许可来的很快，但目的地并非通常的朝圣者交通复合体。取而代之地，你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线下到一处庞大寺院建筑群中的停机坪上。

哪怕是当地的数据库，也没能提供有关目的地的细节。你只能猜这或许是 Jaspis 大祭司 要见你。
