texts.en: The landing bay, one of a score or so allocated to outsiders, is packed with parties of Luddic pilgrims dressed in traditional handweave led by robed attendants.
texts.zh: 这座登陆台是分配给外人的二十来个台位之一，它被长袍圣务侍带领着的、身着传统手织品的卢德朝圣者队伍挤满。

texts.en:
One such stony-faced attendant, flanked by Knights of Ludd in gleaming powered armor, meets your shuttle on the pad.

"We do not welcome those who have done what you have done, Captain $playerName," the attendant says. "Please leave now."

They appear unyielding and perhaps even consider standing up to you a righteous test of their devotion.
texts.zh:
一个面无表情的圣务侍在着陆台等待着你的穿梭机降落，身着闪闪发光的动力盔甲的卢德骑士伴随在对方身侧。

"我们并不待见你的所作所为，$playerName 舰长。" 圣务侍说，"请你离开。"

他们看起来不会退让，甚至觉得拦在你面前是对忠诚的正义考验。

texts.en:
One such stony-faced attendant, flanked by Knights of Ludd in gleaming powered armor, meets your shuttle on the pad.

"We do not welcome those who so willfully scorn the Faith, Captain $playerName," the attendant says. "Please leave now."

They appear unyielding and perhaps even consider standing up to you a righteous test of their devotion.
texts.zh:
一个面无表情的圣务侍在着陆台等待着你的穿梭机降落，身着闪闪发光的动力盔甲的卢德骑士伴随在对方身侧。

"我们并不待见你的所作所为，$playerName 舰长。" 圣务侍说，"请你离开。"

他们看起来不会退让，甚至觉得拦在你面前是对忠诚的正义考验。

texts.en: One such stony-faced attendant meets your shuttle on the pad and, wasting no time, firmly but politely inquires about your business here.
texts.zh: 一个面无表情的圣务侍在着陆台等待着你的穿梭机降落，对方一上来就强硬却不失礼节地向你询问到访此地的目的。

texts.en:
One such stony-faced attendant meets your shuttle on the pad and with a double-glance at a discreet datapad, rapidly stowed in voluminous robes, invites you to follow them.

"I am blessed, captain $PlayerName," the attendant says, "to invite you to complete the Pilgrim's Path on this day."
texts.zh:
一位面无表情的圣务侍在停机坪上接待了你的穿梭机，迅速瞥了一眼手持数据平板，又飞快地把它塞回宽松的长袍里，然后邀请你跟上他们。

"我很荣幸，$PlayerName 舰长..." 圣务侍说道，"能够邀请您在今天为您的朝圣者之路画上句号。"

options.en: How do you know of this?

texts.en:
You return to your shuttle, taking a final breath of air rich with the exhalations of greenery.

The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.
texts.zh:
吸入最后一口充满了绿色植物气息的空气后，你返回了穿梭机上。

搭乘穿梭机返航的过程一切顺利。

texts.en:
It is a smaller path you are led down; not the highway of humanity for the main shrine, this is a smaller, secondary shrine in the lee of a crag dominated by the immense forest.

Pilgrims are offered tea, and water, and ritual washing. The air is filled with sweat, incense, and the scent of pine. A thrum of odd chanting distorted by the breeze lifts and wanes by the whims of the air currents.

You see shrine curates blessing pilgrims. Soon it is your turn.
texts.zh:
你被带到了一条更小的路上；不是通往主圣地的大道，而是位于峭壁背风处林海中的、一座更小的次级圣地。

这里有为朝圣者准备的茶、水和受洗仪式。空气中弥漫着汗水、熏香和松树的香味。一阵奇怪的吟诵声被微风扰乱，随着气流而起伏。

你看到圣地住持们在为朝圣者祈福。很快就轮到你了。

texts.en: The curate casts scented drops and says the words, though it is almost a blur. It is strange to have come so far, for this.
texts.zh: 祭司撒下带着香味的水滴，念着祷文，然而那声音模糊不清。奔波许久就为了这个，还真是奇怪。

texts.en:
All around you see despair and decadence in equal measure channelled into the elaborate rituals of the Luddic Church. Made safe, made convenient; an insulating layer that allows people to live without truly walking Ludd's Path.

It is easy to forget here in the proud edifice of the Church that Ludd held a hammer, too, and was unafraid to use it without hesitation in the face of evil.
texts.zh:
环顾四周，你意识到绝望和颓废同样程度上渗入了卢德教会精心设计的仪式中。安全而方便的仪式保护着人们，让他们在不必真正遵循卢德之道的情况下也能生活下去。

站在这座骄傲的大教堂里，人们很容易忘记卢德手中也曾执重锤，并有勇气在面对邪恶时毫不犹豫地将其挥出。

texts.en: Around you flows a river of faith and ritual. Your fellow pilgrims have chosen their purpose to pursue, that of Ludd's message. In the collective hardship of life in the Persean Sector, as in the collective hardship of the pilgrimage, they find a kind of peace and meaning that is absent in the hollow left by the Collapse.
texts.zh: 你的周围流淌着信仰和仪式的河流。与你同行的朝圣者已经选好所追求的目标，那便是卢德的旨意。在英仙座星域的艰难生活中、在朝圣路上的同甘共苦中，他们寻找到了在 大崩塌 留下的空洞中所缺失的和平和真义。

texts.en:
Around you people put on the motions of pilgrimage and ritual, play-acting the forms of great meaning for their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable what has been built on the intentionally obfuscated rantings of one rabble-rouser. It is impossible to know what Ludd would made of all this.

The Church, of course, makes a good show of pretending to, and it prospers for it.
texts.zh:
在你周围，人们进行着朝圣和仪式相关的各种活动，为他们的先知卢德表演着具有重大意义的仪式。很难相信这一切都是建立在被一个煽动者故意歪曲的话语之上，这让人很难想象卢德会怎么看待这一切。

至于教会，他们自然装作理解卢德，并借此而繁荣壮大。

texts.en:
Around you flows a river of pilgrims. They've invested such meaning into the journey they've made, supposedly in the path of their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable how much has been built on the words of one obscure figure who managed to be blessed by circumstance with great charisma and a moment to bend the arc of history.

What would the - certainly - long-dead Ludd make of what's become of all of it?
texts.zh:
你的周围流淌着朝圣者的人流。他们为自己跟随先知卢德的脚步的旅程找到了意义。令人难以置信的是，那个设法利用了环境、以巨大的感召力在一瞬间弯曲了历史走向的人，他留下的话语究竟都形成了什么。

那么，那位 —— 当然 —— 早已死去的卢德又会怎么看待这一切呢？

texts.en:
Around you a river of pilgrims flows. They've found meaning in the journey they've made between the shrines, following the path of their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable how much has been built on the words of one person who, blessed or cursed by circumstance, bent the arc of history across the face of the Domain and the Collapse.

Looking upon the crowds, the pointed arches, the trees beyond- What would Ludd make of this?
texts.zh:
你的周围流淌着朝圣者的人流。他们为自己跟随先知卢德的脚步、在各个圣地间穿梭的旅程找到了意义。令人难以置信的是，那个被环境祝福，或者说被环境诅咒的、在 人之领 面前，在 大崩塌 的背景下弯曲了历史走向的人，他留下的话语究竟都形成了什么。

看看这人群，尖拱门和远方的树木 —— 卢德会怎么看待这一切？

texts.en:
You return to your shuttle, taking a final breath of air rich with the exhalations of both the greenery and the mass of humanity.

As your pilot swaps take-off pings with traffic control, they pause at an unusual set of nav instructions which are forwarded to your (now retrieved) datapad: you are being directed to a landing which serves a huge monastic complex, some sort of Church administrative center.

The local datasphere is not forthcoming on details. It's difficult to say if this is a security measure or pious neglect.
texts.zh:
吸入最后一口充满了绿色植物和人类气息的空气后，你返回了穿梭机上。

当你的飞行员与交通管制交换起飞信号时，一组不寻常的导航指令打断了他们，随后这些指令被转发到了你的数据平板上：你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线前往一处庞大寺院建筑群中的着陆场，那似乎是教会的行政中心。

当地的数据库没能提供有关细节。很难说这是保密措施还是一种虔诚的忽视。

options.zh: 沿着对方发来的航线航行

texts.en:
At the landing pad, you are met by a solemn Luddic Knight. A Knight Initiate stands a few paces behind, trying to match the ease and calm of their superior.

"Captain $PlayerName," the Knight says, "Let me speak welcome on behalf of the Church of Galactic Redemption. I extend to you an invitation from the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis to meet and share refreshment."

The Knight stands aside, motioning with gauntlet to invite you to walk toward the administrative structures.
texts.zh:
在停机坪上，一位庄严的卢德骑士正等着你的到来。一名新晋骑士站在他身后几步远的地方，试图模仿前辈的从容镇静。

"$PlayerName 舰长，" 骑士说，"请允许我代表 银河救赎教会 表示欢迎。同时，我谨代表 Jaspis 宗师大人向你发来会面和共进茶点的邀请。"

骑士站到一旁，用戴着臂铠的手邀请你向行政建筑群进发。

texts.en:
At the landing pad, you are met by a solemn Luddic Knight. A Knight Initiate stands a few paces behind, trying to match the ease and calm of their superior.

"Captain $PlayerName," the Knight says, "Let me once again speak welcome on behalf of the Church of Galactic Redemption. I extend to you an invitation from the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis to meet and share refreshment."

The knight stands aside, motioning with gauntlet to invite you to walk toward the administrative structures.
texts.zh:
在停机坪上，一位庄严的卢德骑士正等着你的到来。一名新晋骑士站在他身后几步远的地方，试图模仿前辈的从容镇静。

"$PlayerName 舰长，" 骑士说，"请允许我再度代表银河救赎教会表示欢迎。同时，我谨代表 Jaspis 宗师大人向你发来会面和共进茶点的邀请。"

骑士站到一旁，用戴着臂铠的手邀请你向行政建筑群进发。

texts.en:
You are led by the Knight through gardens and the soaring arcades of Luddic Church architecture: half-remembered dreams of gothic cathedrals given flight by the material science of the Domain. It might be thought impertinent to mention this aspect of the construction, of course.

The Knight-Initiate follows behind, footsteps echoing between arched portals, over slate tiles flecked with glittering pyrite like stars in the night.
texts.zh:
骑士带着你穿过了花园与卢德教会建筑群中高耸的拱廊，这种几乎要被世人遗忘的哥特式教堂，竟然被人之领材料学的奇迹腾飞至如此的高度。当然，在这里提到这一点一定会被当做无礼之徒。

新晋骑士紧随其后，脚步声在拱形的大门之间回响。而你们脚下的地板则被发光的黄铁矿点缀着，如同夜空中的星星。

options.en: Does every successful pilgrim get to meet the Archcurate?
options.zh: 每一个成功的朝圣者都能见到大祭司吗？

options.en: Why am I receiving this treatment?
options.zh: 为什么你们这样对待我？

texts.en:
You pass through wooden doors and halls carpeted in designs of foliage and fauna, presumably of Old Earth: a fawn, a whale; hawks and dragons circling in a blue sky wreathed with leaves of ivy, oak, and palm.

The Archcurate's office appears relatively austere at first glance, but as your eyes adjust, hand-carved wooden paneling emerges, their faces packed with small plants and figures both human and animal. The room is situated to overlook a private atrium-garden. A shaft of sunlight illuminates flowers and catches the softly trickling drops of a fountain.
texts.zh:
你穿过了铺满树叶与动物图案的门和大厅。这些图案似乎来自于古地球：一只小鹿，一头鲸鱼；鹰和龙在布满常春藤、橡树和棕榈叶的蓝天上盘旋。

乍一看，大祭司的办公室显得相对朴素。但随着你仔细观察，却发现了手工雕刻的木质镶条，其上刻满了动植物还有人的图案。这房间的位置刚好能俯瞰私人空中花园；一缕阳光照亮了园中的花海，喷泉的水珠也在阳光中闪动。

texts.en:
"Your Excellency," the Knight calls out too loudly for the space, and bows to the figure within.

The Archcurate Jaspis turns toward you, closing a thick book.

"Come before me, captain," she says. "I would share with you a pot of tea, and my hospitality. Knight Ailanthus, you have my thanks and may leave us be."

A metal carafe with a long handle steams on a heating element, a pot and two simple cups beside.
texts.zh:
"阁下，" 骑士声如洪钟，向里面的人鞠躬致意。

Jaspis 大祭司转身朝向你，同时合上一本厚厚的书。

"坐到我身前来，舰长，" 她开口道，"我愿意与您分享一壶茶及我对客人的欢迎。骑士 Ailanthus ，感谢您的帮助，请让我俩独处吧。"

一个长柄金属水瓶正在加热元件上吐着蒸汽，旁边放着一个茶壶和两个朴实的茶杯。

texts.en:
She takes the handle of the carafe of boiling water, and without looking, gaze still unfocused, fills the teapot.

She is quite blind, you realize.
texts.zh:
她握住装了开水的水壶的握把，不看一眼，目光涣散，却把茶壶沏满。

你意识到，她已目盲。

options.en: Why did you invite me here?

texts.en: She smiles thinly.
texts.zh: 她淡淡一笑。

texts.en:
"You made pilgrimage to the holy shrines of Ludd, you have made affinity with the Church and held compassion for the Faithful." She picks up a teacup and idly taps the side.

"'In my right hand I hold the hammer as my left is open for you to take.'" She says, quoting the Book of Ludd. "The hammer has place alongside the heart."
texts.zh:
"你曾朝拜了卢德的圣地，你与教会的关系亲和稳定，你对忠实的信徒充满怜悯。" 她拿起了一个茶杯，漫不经心地敲了敲。

"'我右手执锤，左手为你敞开。'" 她引用着卢德圣书，"锤与心，应同在。"

texts.en:
"You made pilgrimage to the holy shrines of Ludd. A taxing act to which the Faithful aspire. Yet you also take pain to keep distance from the Church, to hold nothing holy." She picks up a teacup and taps its side idly.

"I have not received you here to admonish or proselytize. If a struggle bedevils your soul, or if it is deaf to the songs of Creation, then that matter is for your own prayer and meditation."
texts.zh:
"你曾朝拜了卢德的圣地，这是信徒们都渴望做出的贡献。然而你隐忍着痛苦，与教会保持距离，将一切视为俗物。" 她拿起了一个茶杯，漫不经心地敲了敲。

"我来接待你并不是为了做出告诫或者劝你改宗。如果你的灵魂深陷于焦灼的斗争中，亦或是它无法听到创生的歌谣，那就由你自己去祈祷和冥想吧。"

texts.en:
"You made pilgrimage to the holy shrines of Ludd, and yet you treat the Church with face dark and averted, speaking cutting words with false jocularity. You are bereft of affinity for the nicety of manners without suffering the years to earn that exalted state." She picks up a teacup and taps its side idly.

"A question sits restless in my mind: is your inclination a life of misjudgment led by directionless passion?"
texts.zh:
"你曾朝拜了卢德的圣地，却始终躲闪着我们、对教会冷面相待，带着虚伪的幽默抛出刻薄的言语。如果这般高贵的姿态不是遭受多年折磨所致，那或许你已经完全丧失了礼节感和亲和力。" 她拿起了一个茶杯，漫不经心地敲了敲。

"有个问题在我的脑海里挥之不去：被缺失方向的激情所误导的生活，这便是你的此生所向吗？"

texts.en:
"The militancy of your zeal has its admirers among the Faithful, but there is question that you are overquick to raise the hammer of wrath when the righteous path is oft led by the heart, and humbly so."

She picks up a teacup and taps its side idly.

"And yet, 'In my right hand I hold the hammer as my left is open for you to take.'" She says, quoting the Book of Ludd. "The hammer has a place."
texts.zh:
"信徒们都很欣赏你的战斗热情，问题在于，你常常过快地挥舞起暴怒的重锤了，要知道，正义之道通常是由内心谦卑地将你引上的。"

她拿起了一个茶杯，漫不经心地敲了敲。

"不过，'我右手执锤，左手为你敞开。'" 她引用着卢德圣书，"锤的确拥有一席之地。"

texts.en:
"The office I am entrusted to has need for the service of an actor of means and ability."

More quietly, her voice gone low and rough, "A hammer."

The Archcurate places her teacup back on the desk, exactly where it was before, then pours tea into her cup, and then into yours.
texts.zh:
"我所受命的职位需要一个有能力、有手段的人。"

悄然间，她的声音变得低沉而强烈，"一柄重锤。"

大祭司把她的茶杯放回了桌上，茶杯精确落回了它原本所在的地方，那之后，她分别向她自己和你的茶杯中倒入茶水。

texts.en: She either ignored or forgot your desire for water instead of tea. You strongly suspect it is the former.
texts.zh: 她要么是无视，要么是忘记了你要的是水而不是茶。你强烈怀疑是前者。

options.en: So you want me to be your 'hammer'?
options.zh: 所以你想让我成为你的那柄 '重锤'？

options.en: I mean what do you want? What is your goal?
options.zh: 你想要什么？你的目标是什么？

options.en: Don't you have the Knights of Ludd for this?
options.zh: 不是有 卢德骑士团 可以为你效劳吗？

options.en: You remind me of Provost Baird.
options.zh: 你让我想起了 Baird 院长。

options.en: I'm not sure you appreciate how hard the Hammer must fall.
options.zh: 我想你大概会对这柄重锤落下的力道感到不满。

options.en: I would be blessed to be of service to the Church.
options.zh: 能够为教会效力，我很荣幸。

options.en: A job offer. I should have known
options.zh: 一份工作邀请，我早就该知道了。

options.en: Your message for Brother Cotton is a leaf?
options.zh: 你给 Cotton 修士的信息是一片叶子吗？

texts.en:
"No. My hammer is," she nods in your direction, "a humbler being by far than you. But he requires aid in his quest, and for that you might well serve."

She sips some tea, "Do understand that I speak not entirely of war and wrath. A hammer may strike subtly, even quietly, if aimed with skill, wisdom, and piety."
texts.zh:
"不。我手下的 '重锤' 是..." 她朝你颔首致意，"一个比你谦逊得多的人。但他在任务中需要帮助，你或许要为此提供协助。"

她啜饮了几口茶，继续道："请你一定要理解，我所说的协助，并不完全是指掀起战火。只要辅以技巧，智慧与虔诚，即便是重锤出击也可以做到无声无息。"

texts.en:
"The Faith has many enemies, both within and without the Church," she says slowly. "Some know what evil they do; others do not. They must be set right."

"I would labor to do good as Ludd taught us, and by all means available, as Ludd also taught us. In doing good, I serve this office. And to greater purpose, I serve the vision Ludd handed down to us."
texts.zh:
"伟大的信仰举目皆敌，教会面临着内忧外患。" 她缓缓说道，"有些人知道自己作恶多端；还有些一无所觉。他们都将得到惩戒。"

"我必如卢德所教的那般，行善积德，尽心竭力。在这善举中，我得以履行这份职责。为了那崇高的旨意，我将献身于 卢德 为我们传下的神谕。"

texts.en:
She smiles sardonically. "You have met the Knights. You know full well that in all matters they will break rather than bend and name such waste 'sacrifice'."

"I should not speak so broadly however. There is one who was sent to me to serve for his noviceship. He is the one I want you to find."
texts.zh:
她讽刺地笑了笑："你是见过骑士团的。你也很清楚，他们都是些撞破南墙不回头的家伙，还美其名曰 '牺牲'。"

"不过，话也不能说的太草率。有个新手被派到我手下见习，他就是我想让你找的人。"

texts.en:
"Do you insult or laud me, I wonder," she says. "Anahita Baird is a powerful woman, intelligent and proud. She also makes herself habit of knocking upon the doors of demons."

She sits back, cradling her teacup.

"Or I should say, rather, she sends others to knock in her place." The Archcurate waves a hand dismissively, "I hold not your work for her against your character. If I may return your Janus-faced compliment: what you have done for Baird may even prove more your suitability for what is in my mind."
texts.zh:
"我很好奇，你到底是在侮辱我还是赞美我，" 她说到，"Anahita Baird 是个女强人，才华横溢，自命不凡。她早就养成了敲响魔鬼大门的坏习惯。" 她坐了回去，把茶杯抱进自己的怀里。

"或者，确切来讲，她是派别人替她去敲这扇门。" 大祭司轻蔑地挥了挥手，"我觉得你为她干的活并不符合你的性格。如果我回应了你这口是心非的恭维，那你为 Baird 所做的一切便能印证我的想法"

texts.en:
"I understand full well that you wish untempered wrath let loose in the cause of holy justice, captain."

Her blind eyes seem fixed on you.

"Let me provide you a channel for your river of tears and blood. Otherwise the products of all that suffering might be spilled directionless, wasted."
texts.zh:
"我完全理解，你为了神圣的正义而显露出的无法掩饰的愤怒，舰长。"

她空虚的双眼在冥冥之中注视着你。

"我会为你的血泪提供宣泄的途径，否则这些痛苦所带来的力量将会毫无意义地浪费掉。"

texts.en:
The Archcurate reaches under her desk then places a book on the pitted surface. It is the holy book of Ludd given to you by Brother Cotton; you had left it as an offering at the shrine, amongst a mountain of trinkets.

That she has it here, and knows you put it there, suggests much about the capabilities of the Church and the attention being paid to you.

"I understand full well that you wish untempered wrath let loose to wreak holy justice, captain." Her blind eyes seem fixed on you. "At least, you have communed with one who does."
texts.zh:
大祭司把手伸到桌子下，拿出一本书并将其放到了不甚平整的桌面上。那是 Cotton 修士送给你的卢德圣书；之前你把它当作祭品留在了圣地的那堆小饰品之中。

而现在她拿到了这本书，并且她知道这书是你放在那里的，这说明了教会的能耐以及教会对你的关注。

"舰长，我完全明白，你希望在无尽的怒火中施展神圣的审判。" 她那失明的双目似乎一直在盯着你。"至少，你和一个有这种想法的人交流过。"

texts.en:
She turns to a small side-shelf, opens a wooden box, and takes out a delicate, desiccated leaf.

"Do you know Ludd's Parable of the Kudzu?" She carefully opens Cotton's book, places the leaf within, closes it, and pushes it toward you.

She leans forward, then says in a harsh whisper, "Take it to him. We will speak of this later."
texts.zh:
她转向旁边的一个小架子，打开了一枚木盒子，取出了一片精致的枯叶。

"你知道卢德关于 Kudzu 的寓言吗？" 她小心翼翼地打开 Cotton 修士的书，把那叶子放进去，又轻轻合上，将书推到你面前。

她凑到你耳边，尖刻地低语道，"把这本书带给他，我们后面再谈。"

texts.en:
"The Church," she says, "might reward such zealousness."

A wry smile appears, "Would one place faith in the machinery of offices, of rules and letters and who-serves-whom? I pray that we do not grow our own demon in Ludd's good name."

"Worry not." She leans back, "My advanced age allows me to say such things that could have a novice excommunicated."
texts.zh:
"教会..." 她说到，"...有可能奖励这种狂热。"

苦笑浮现在她的脸上，"人难道会把信仰寄托在一个由职务，规则，信件和上下尊卑所构成的机器上吗？我真心祈祷，我等万万不可以卢德之名恣意妄为。"

"无需担忧。" 她往后靠了靠，"我年岁已高，即便口出妄言，也不会像新人那般遭受绝罚。"

texts.en:
She takes a leisurely moment to sip her tea.

"You will of course be paid. The coffers of the Church are not so abundant as Tri-Tachyon's plunder, but if these credits may service a righteous path, let us not cast them aside."

"Such acts are for saints." She smiles a little, "Not for those such as you and I."
texts.zh:
她悠闲地喝了一会茶。

"你当然会得到报酬。教会的财力并不如 速子科技 的那帮掠夺者那样雄厚，但如果能将钱财用于正道之上，倒是不妨为此一掷千金。"

"如此行事则是为了卢德的圣者，" 她微微地笑了笑，"并不是为了你我。"

texts.en: "It is," she says simply. "Let that be the end of it for now."
texts.zh: "是的，" 她简单说到，"眼下就到此为止吧。"

texts.en:
The Archcurate carefully puts her hands together, not unlike a position of prayer.

"Captain. Allow me to put the matter to you directly."
texts.zh:
大祭司虔诚地双手合十，与祈祷的姿势并无不同。

"舰长，请允许我直接告诉你这件事。"

texts.en: "My hammer is," she nods in your direction, acknowledging something, "a humbler thing by far than yourself. But he requires aid in his quest, and for that you might well serve."
texts.zh: "我手下的 '重锤' 是..." 她朝你颔首致意，似乎正确认着什么，"一个比你谦逊得多的人。但他在任务中需要帮助，你或许要为此提供协助。"

texts.en:
"My agent is a novice of the Knights of Ludd. He was assigned to my office in order to achieve his Knighthood. He infiltrated a cell of heretical militants affiliated with the ill-named Luddic Path. I have not heard from him in some time."

Her voice, usually somewhere between confident and sardonic, almost breaks on these last few words.
texts.zh:
"我的特工是卢德骑士团的见习修士。他被派到这里来工作是为了取得骑士爵位。在他潜入臭名昭著的 卢德左径 的一个异端武装成员基地后，我已经有一段时间没有收到他的讯息了。"

她那通常介于自信和讥讽之间的音色，在话语的结尾几乎跑偏了。

texts.en:
"If you accept this task from my office, my assistant will provide you with identity files to aid you in finding my agent. You will also be given a modest retainer to fund your efforts, and more if... when you find him."

"You need not answer now. Pray on the matter. Or 'ponder' if that is how you would name it."

She turns back to the book she had open when you entered. "May Providence favor you with a blessed path; I pray it returns to me with an answer in the affirmative."
texts.zh:
"如果你愿意接受以我办公室的名义发布的这项任务，我的助手将为你提供身份文件，以帮助你找到我的代理人。此外你还会得到一笔数额不大的定金，而如果你能找到...不，当你找到他的时候，还会有额外的奖赏。"

"现在不必回答。请先为此事做出祷告，又或许你会把这称为 '琢磨一下'。"

她重新打开了你进来时她正在读的那本书。"愿上天赐予你受到祝福之路，我则希望它能让你给出肯定的答复。"

options.en: Do not expect me to run errands for the Church.

texts.en: She hrums in acknowledgement, attention focused elsewhere now, opening her book with one hand and placing the other upon its open face.
texts.zh: 她轻哼一声表示了解，随即将注意力转到了别处，用一只手打开书，另一只手则放到了那书页上。

texts.en:
You leave Archcurate Jaspis to her book.

A soft-spoken attendant in robes makes an incongruous datapad appear and coordinates transfer of the Archcurate's comms ID - at least, for her office - then passes you off to the blank-faced Knight Ailanthus to escort you to your waiting shuttle.

Your return to orbit is uneventful.
texts.zh:
你起身离开，给 Jaspis 大祭司留下静心读书的空间。

穿着长袍、说话轻声细语的圣务侍摸出了个和她自己的形象很不搭调的数据平板，将大祭司的通讯 ID 调给了你 —— 至少是她办公室的 —— 然后让面无表情的 Ailanthus 骑士将你护送回穿梭机处。

返回轨道的过程一切顺利。

texts.en:
"With such haste?" she says, "You need not play-act enthusiasm to impress me. My opinion has always held that decisions of great import should be given ample time to steep."

"Gift me now with silence," she says as she opens her book with one hand and places the other upon its open face.
texts.zh:
"这么快？" 她说，"你不需要用装腔作势的热情来打动我。我认为，重大的决定应该用足够的时间去思考。"

"现在请让我清净一会。" 她边说边用一只手打开书，把另一只手放到了那书页上。

texts.en:
"Your posturing is best held within, captain."

She opens her book with one hand and places the other upon its open face, "Then diffused through meditation," she says.

After a moment she adds, "Unless self-flagellation is your preferred expression of zeal. I judge not."
texts.zh:
"舰长，你最好内敛一些。"

她用一只手打开书，另一只手则放到了那书页上，"然后让自己的态度通过冥想传达。" 她说道。

过了一会她又补充道："除非你热衷于通过自我鞭笞的方式表达热情，我对此不做评判。"

texts.en: She proceeds, pointedly ignoring your statement.
texts.zh: 她继续说了下去，并且显然无视了你的指摘。

texts.en:
"That even I can see," she says without hesitation. "We both bear burdens with the grace the Creator saw fit to provide; for one, I give thanks that I was not made a boor."

She returns the carafe to the heating element, centering it perfectly.
texts.zh:
"即便如此我也能看明白。" 她没有丝毫迟疑地接了下去，"造物主赐予我们其认为合适的重担，并且我们都心怀感激地承载着；在一切之前，我得感激我没有作为俗人降生。"

她把水瓶放回了加热元件上，水瓶的落点完美居中。

texts.en: "Have water, if you will. My tea will be but a moment."
texts.zh: "如果你想就喝点水吧，茶要待会才好。"

texts.en: "Let us give the tea a moment, child."
texts.zh: "让我们等茶泡好吧，孩子。"

texts.en:
You pour yourself some water and have a sip. It is cold, and it is good.

It is almost disturbingly unlike the water from your own ship, purified from cometary ice, generally, and infused with certain standard additives.
texts.zh:
你自己倒了点水，喝了一口，凉的，但是很好喝。

它和你的星舰上的水有本质上的不同，似乎是从彗星上的冰提纯而来，并且加入了某些标准添加剂。

texts.en: "Water then, if it please you." Her hand opens to indicate a pitcher in the corner, her gaze fixed somewhere past you.
texts.zh: "想喝点水的话，请自便。" 她张手示意角落里的一个陶罐，目光凝视着你身侧的某个地方。

options.en: You wanted to see me. I'm here. Let's get to the point.
options.zh: 你想要见我，所以我来了。让我们开门见山吧。

texts.en:
"Then I share with you water drawn from the well of my home, and my hospitality with it," she says, all part of the ritual. She gets up and retrieves the pitcher of water, placing it next to the tea pot.

Her gaze is still unfocused. She is quite blind, you realize, as she  takes the handle of the carafe of boiling water, and without looking, fills the teapot.
texts.zh:
"那么为了表现我的好客之心，我将与你分享从我家中水井里提的水。" 言下之意，这都是仪式的一部分。她起身端起陶制水灌，把它摆在茶壶旁边。

她的双眼依然未曾聚焦，你意识到她早已目盲。从握住煮沸的水壶握把，到装满茶壶，全程她都没用眼睛去看。

texts.en: "It is a ritual of welcome, captain," she says as if to a small child, then adds with unexpected acid, "You needn't drink the bedamned tea, or the water, but by Ludd's good grace, accept a gift given."
texts.zh: "这不过是为了表达欢迎之意。" 她的言语像是在安抚一个孩童，却又隐含几分尖刻，"不愿意喝茶或喝水是无妨，但还请接受他人的好意，就当是看在卢德的份上。"

options.en: I don't believe an Archcurate should speak like that.
options.zh: 我不觉得一位大祭司会这样子说话。

options.en: It is my policy not to owe anyone anything.
options.zh: 不欠任何人任何事是我的个人信条。

texts.en:
She grabs the long handle of the carafe. "Drink the tea or not. I shall now make it," she says, and gaze still unfocused, fills the teapot.

She is quite blind, you realize.
texts.zh:
她握住水壶的握把，"不论你愿不愿意喝，我都会把茶倒好，" 她边说边动手倒满了茶壶，双眼全程都未曾聚焦。

你意识到，她已目盲。

texts.en: She scoffs. "Oh, so after right and truly blundering the greeting I laid before you, now you are the master of Church affairs? Even I can see plain how you've made such an impression on the ecumene."
texts.zh: 她讥讽道："哦？我之前问候你的时候，你毫无疑问是犯蠢了，结果现在反倒是由你来主持教会事务？这下就连我都能一眼看出，你到底是怎么给世间留下这种印象的了。"

texts.en: "As charming of wit and tongue as hearsay suggested, you must enliven celebration and negotiation in equal part. Even now I find my own self contemplating the necessity of bothering to show hospitality at all."
texts.zh: "传闻你幽默风趣，巧舌如簧，那你也一定能把庆祝和谈判的氛围炒热吧。就算是现在我也在考虑，到底有没有必要展现出一丁点殷勤好客的意思。"

texts.en:
The Knight looks back at you, half-cape fluttering over carefully secured weaponry, with an expression that yours is a stupid question. The tone of the reply is firmly neutral, however.

"No, captain. The Reverend Archcurate requested a meeting with you specifically."
texts.zh:
骑士转身看向你，单肩披风随之扬起，露出了下面还稳妥地挂在身上的武器。那表情在说你的问题真蠢，但是回答的语气却带着一种强硬的中立。

"不，舰长。宗师大人特别指明要和你会面。"

texts.en: "I know not, captain, and could not say," the Knight says crisply, eyes forward.
texts.zh: "我不知道，也不能说，舰长。" 骑士目不斜视，干脆地说。

texts.en: "I know not. It is my duty to extend this hospitality on behalf of the Reverend Archcurate," the Knight says, then with a thought adds, "You are accused of no heresy, or secular crime. Your safety is my duty."
texts.zh: "我不知道。我仅仅是代表宗师大人向您问好。" 骑士说到，思考了一下又开始补充，"您并没有被指控为异端，或是犯下有违教规的罪行。确保您的安全是我的职责。"

texts.en:
The Knight's eyebrows shoot up in surprise. With a blink the Knight recovers composure, and says "Y... es. Of course. This is a request, not a demand. Although. The Reverend Archcurate." A moment's pause. "She suggested that I insist, if necessary."

Beneath the solemnity, the Knight's look pleads for you to not put them in the awkward situation of denying the Archcurate.

You mentally review your model of the Church hierarchy: the Archcurate Conclave is the crown of the Church, meeting or sending representatives to perform the rulings that determine the highest matters; interpreting the canon of Ludd, sanctification, holy law, excommunication. If the Church has rulers, this Archcurate is among them.
texts.zh:
骑士惊讶的扬起眉毛，随即便恢复了镇静，说道，"是...是的，当然了。这是个请求而非命令。即便宗师大人她..." 他停顿了一下，"她建议我在必要时坚持一下。"

在这种庄重的氛围下，骑士恳求你不要让他们因你的抗命而陷入尴尬的境地。

你回想了一下教会的等级制度：教宗密会是教会的最高权力机关。他们有权举行会议或派出代表来裁决教会的事务，此外还能解读卢德的教义、提拔某人、制定圣典或是将某人逐出教会。如果说教会有统治者的话，那这位大祭司一定是其中之一。

options.en: I've changed my mind. Lead on.

texts.en:
You leave the Knight to ponder how to deliver your rejection to the Archcurate.

Your shuttle ascends from the green world. There is no objection from traffic control or any kind of follow-up comms request as you return to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh:
你让骑士自己想想怎么向大祭司传达你的拒绝。

你的穿梭机离开了这个绿色的世界。在返回你$shipOrFleet的途中，没有交通管制或别种形式的后续通信向你传达反对意见。

texts.en: The Knight simply makes a small bow in acknowledgement of your description of the Archurate. You suppose they're being politic.
texts.zh: 骑士只是简单颔首，默认了你对大祭司的描述。你觉得他们对此很谨慎。

texts.en:
You order the pilot to follow the original ascent rather than follow the unusual navigation instructions.

There is no objection from traffic control or any kind of follow-up comms request as you return to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh:
你下令飞行员继续返航，而非跟着非常规航线走。

在返回你$shipOrFleet的途中，没有交通管制或别种形式的后续通信向你传达反对意见。

texts.en:
"The faithful must know to keep watch for what is coming," the attendant says with a strange look, then almost - but not quite - smiles.

"I mean not to sound so arcane; it is merely that our Church has endured hard times, and may yet again."
texts.zh:
"忠实的信徒必须时刻对将要发生的事务保持关注。" 圣务侍带着奇怪的表情说，然后几乎 —— 但不完全地 —— 微笑着。

"我知道不必说得如此神秘；这仅仅是因为教会经历过艰难的时光，也许还会再经历一次。"

options.en: You think hard times will come?
options.zh: 你认为艰难的时光会再次到来吗？

texts.en: "I pray that they do not," the attendant says. "We prepare for if they do."
texts.zh: "我祈祷着不会。" 圣务侍说，"但我们也做好了应对的准备。"

texts.en:
The attendant nods, explaining that you must leave your guards behind because this is a place of peace, and all are equal on the Pilgrim's Path.

The request is an implied request for keeping up appearances: a couple of your guards, unarmed and trained for situations requiring this degree of subtlety, attend to your safety as per matter of course. You note other unusually small parties of "pilgrims", plainly but clearly wealthy by their cut and carriage, led by their own shrine-attendants and accompanied by unusually muscled 'distant cousins'.

Nonetheless, the crowds filing out of the transport complex, on a wide highway of beaten earth and cobble, are enormous. Those that cannot walk are carried; no powered transport is provided.
texts.zh:
圣务侍点了点头，解释说你必须让保镖留下，因为这是个和平的地方，朝圣者之路上人人平等。

这不过是个对外在形象的含蓄要求：几个没有携带武器的保镖接受过应对这种微妙情况的训练，他们理所当然地成为了和你一同拜访此地的朝圣者以照顾你的安全。同时你还注意到了其他一些异常的小规模 "朝圣者"，他们的举手投足毫不掩饰地流露出了明显的富有，由专属的圣务侍带领，还有些肌肉发达的 "远房表亲" 陪同。

从运输中心鱼贯而出的人群数量庞大，他们来到了由碎土和鹅卵石铺成的宽阔公路上。由于此地不提供助力交通工具，那些无法行走的人只能由其他人抬着。

texts.en:
The path of the pilgrims leads up a slope covered in trees more enormous than any you've seen before. Though small in scale compared to the celestial phenomena that is your daily bread, their living architecture forms a natural cathedral.

Dispassionate Knights of Ludd watch as attendants shuttle you through a cordoned path in an arc through a final grove of mighty sequoia-analogs atop the promontory at the terminus of the ridge - it is a temple, struts and spars intertwined with the trees. Golden sunlight filters through heavy branches, and as the breeze lifts a whispering chorus of foliage, you catch an earthy scent over the mass of humanity surrounding you.
texts.zh:
朝圣者之路通向了一个山坡，山坡被你前所未见的巨大树木覆盖着 —— 尽管与你见惯了的天体和太空建筑相比还是太小了 —— 他们的活建筑形成了一个天然的大教堂。

神情冰冷的卢德骑士看着圣务侍将你领过一条围栏小路，小路顺着山坡将你领入位于岬角顶端的巨大类红杉园林，这园林乃是一座支柱与树木交织在一起的寺庙。金色的阳光透过茂密的树枝，微风吹动树叶让它们低声合唱，你则透过周围人群捕捉到了泥土的芳香。

texts.en: You have only a brief moment before the high altar of living wood. Small tokens and offerings are piled high amongst low, cheap candles.
texts.zh: 在高高的活木祭坛前，你只能停留一小会儿。小小的纪念品和祭品在低矮廉价的蜡烛之间堆得很高。

options.en: Offer Brother Cotton's copy of the Book of Ludd
options.zh: 献上 Cotton 修士的卢德之书抄本

texts.en: Thinking quickly, you place Brother Cotton's small book on the pile of offerings. It settles into the scrimshaw, trinkets, and cheap photo-prints like it belongs there.
texts.zh: 你快速思索了一会，把 Cotton 修士的小本子放到了祭品堆上。它融入了那些雕刻物、装饰品和廉价的相片印花，好似它本就属于那里。

texts.en:
And in a moment, it passes.

It is hot, and you are in a large and sweaty crowd full of pilgrims all wrapped up away from you, lost in their own worship.

The attendants do their best to herd the masses along the main pathway. You must push through groups calling and crying and singing and praying.
texts.zh:
转眼间，圣地就不在你眼前了。

炎热的天气里，你被一大群汗流浃背的人群裹挟着前行，这些朝圣者迷失在他们自身的崇拜中。

圣务侍们尽力将群众汇集到主干道上。你必须得挤过那些呼喊、哭泣、唱诵和祈祷着的人们。

texts.en: You return to the shaded halls of the transport complex.
texts.zh: 你回到了运输中心被阴影遮蔽的大厅里。

texts.en:
You enter the shaded halls of the transport complex and move toward your shuttle's landing pad.

One of the shrine attendants intercepts you and, with a quick glance at a discreet datapad (swiftly tucked back into voluminous robes), invites you to follow them.

"I am blessed, Captain $PlayerName," the attendant says, "to invite you to complete the Pilgrim's Path on this day."
texts.zh:
你进入了交通枢纽那昏暗的厅堂，接着走向自己的穿梭机所在的停机坪。

圣务侍们中的一位主动迎上了你，他迅速瞥了一眼手持数据平板，又飞快地把它塞回宽松的长袍里，然后邀请你跟上他们。

"我很荣幸，$PlayerName 舰长，" 圣务侍说到，"能够邀请您在今天为您的朝圣者之路画上句号。"

options.en: How do you know of this?

texts.en:
The attendant dutifully explains that the shrine commemorates the holy site where Ludd first stepped onto Gilead and was brought prostrate, to the shock of non-believers, to kiss the earth itself, so overcome was Ludd by the rapturous touch of Divinity.

Ludd's influence spread by its own evident virtue, the attendant explains, and the industrial terraforming machines were brought down and flowers bloomed in the rubble. There is no mention of strikes, global storms, sabotage, apocalyptic flooding and heatwaves, or corporate terror squads in this narrative. Nor does the attendant mention that, technically, an entire planet owned by the Eridani Utopia Terraforming megacorporation was illegally occupied by a radical cult. Rather, the unbelievers wept as Ludd revealed their sins and told them forgiveness was within reach on this garden-world.

It is an appealing morality tale delivered earnestly.
texts.zh:
圣务侍尽职地解释说，这个圣地是为了纪念卢德第一次踏上 Gilead 而建的，那时卢德被神伟大的才能所折服，在无信者们震惊的目光中，弯下腰亲吻了大地。

圣务侍继续解释说，卢德的精神通过其自身明显的优点传播开来，地貌改造工业机器被摧毁，鲜花在废墟中盛开。在叙述中，对方没有提到罢工、全球风暴、蓄意破坏、末日洪水和热浪，也没有提到企业的恐怖组织。圣务侍更没有提到，严格意义上来说，这件事就是 波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 拥有的整颗星球被激进的教团非法占领。取而代之地，对方说，当卢德揭示了他们的罪恶并告诉他们，在这花园世界里宽恕将触手可及的时候，无信者们感激涕零。

真是个引人入胜的道德故事。

texts.en: You order the pilot to abort your descent rather than follow the unusual nav plan. There is no objection from traffic control or any kind of follow-up comms request as you return to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh: 你下令飞行员取消着陆计划，而非跟着非常规航线走。在返回你$shipOrFleet的途中，没有交通管制或别种形式的后续通信向你传达反对意见。

texts.zh: 你的穿梭机收到了交通管制中心的提示：这是允许降落的意思。

options.en: Join the pilgrims visiting the Luddic shrine
options.zh: 加入拜访卢德圣地的朝圣者们

options.en: Shuttle down to complete the pilgrimage
options.zh: 搭乘穿梭机下到地面来为朝圣之旅画上句号

texts.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is strictly overseen by the Knights of Ludd; your shuttle must queue behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers filled with approved industrial goods.

This provides you with time to contemplate the face of Gilead; its continents, once fringed only by alien algae-equivalents, were seeded with Earth-life by a far-roving sporeship of the second wave of human expansion. The Eridani-Utopia Terraforming megacorp followed and its vast machines stabilized the climate and ecological processes. Ludd came then, pulled down the machines, and the believers who followed maintained the world as a garden-wilderness of astounding richness. Truly, it is a gem of the Persean Sector.

Your shuttle receives a ping from traffic control: permission to descend.
texts.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆装满经过批准的工业产品的笨重运输船和拖船后面。

这样一来你便有时间细想 Gilead 的面貌了。它的大陆曾经只被外星藻类覆盖，直到人类进行第二波殖民扩张时，被远道而来的孢子母舰播种了类地生命。波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 紧随其后，用巨型机器稳定了气候和生态。那之后卢德来到了这里，摧毁了机器，跟随着他的信徒们则把世界维持着花园般的未开发模样，至今它依然富饶得惊人。的确，它当得起英仙座星域明珠的名号。

这时你的穿梭机收到了交通管制中心的提示：这是允许降落的意思。

texts.en: The landing bay, one of a score or so allocated to outsiders, is packed with parties of Luddic pilgrims dressed in traditional handweave led by robed attendants.
texts.zh: 这座登陆台是分配给外人的二十来个台位之一，它被长袍圣务侍带领着的、身着传统手织品的卢德朝圣者队伍挤满。

texts.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is overseen by the Knights of Ludd, and their traffic control is characteristically strict. Your shuttle queues behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers.

The face of Gilead is filled with green continents, seeded with Earth-life by sporeship and climate-stabilized by Eridani Utopia's vast terraforming machines. Then Ludd came and the Faithful turned the world into a garden-wilderness of astounding richness; it is a gem of the Persean Sector.

Your shuttle receives a ping from traffic control: permission to descend.
texts.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

Gilead 的星球表面上遍布绿洲，孢子母舰在上面播种了类地生命，波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 的巨型机器则稳定了它的气候和生态。那之后卢德来到了这里，跟随着他的信徒们则把世界变成了花园般的未开发模样，至今它依然富饶得惊人。它是英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

你的穿梭机收到了交通管制中心的提示：这是允许降落的意思。

texts.en: Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is overseen by the Knights of Ludd, and their traffic control is typically strict. Your shuttle queues behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and hauler
texts.zh: 离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士监管，并且他们的交通管制非常严格。你的穿梭机排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

texts.en: The face of Gilead is painted with fragile green continents and glittering blue oceans. Ludd came here and the original Faithful, undiluted by the Church hierarchy, liberated the world from Eridani Utopia's terraforming machines. In place of a sprawl of private fortress-plantations and crowded resort playgrounds for the rich, a garden-wilderness of astounding richness bloomed. It is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的表面由纤巧美丽的绿色大陆和闪闪发光的蓝色海洋组成。卢德曾到过这里，那些追随他的、尚未被教会阶级制度侵蚀的最初信徒们，则将这个世界从 波江座-乌托邦 的地貌改造机器手中解放了出来。于是在这颗星球上，取代了杂乱无章的私人堡垒种植园和拥挤的富人度假乐园，一片富饶得惊人的自然花园盛放了，这让它成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

texts.en: The face of Gilead is painted with fragile green continents and glittering blue oceans. Ludd came here, saw Eridani Utopia's vast terraforming machines and designs for profit, and led the first Faithful to liberate the world. In place of sprawling private fortress-plantations and crowded resort compounds, a garden-wilderness of astounding richness was cultivated. It is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的表面由纤巧美丽的绿色大陆和闪闪发光的蓝色海洋组成。卢德曾到过这里，看到 波江座-乌托邦 的巨型地貌改造机器和为了盈利进行的规划后，让最初信徒们解放了这个世界。于是在这颗星球上，取代了杂乱无章的私人堡垒种植园和拥挤的度假区复合体，一片富饶得惊人的自然花园被耕耘而出，让它成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

texts.en: The face of Gilead bears startlingly green continents and glittering blue oceans. First seeded by sporeships, the terraforming contract was granted by the Domain colonial authorities to the Eridani Utopia Terraforming megacorporation. Their vast machines tamed the world, and just as the project was on the cusp of fruition, Ludd came. From a certain perspective, the followers of Ludd stole the world to create their own vision of paradise: a rustic garden-wilderness. Despite the hypocrisy, or perhaps for it, Gilead is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的表面承载着惊艳的绿色大陆和闪烁的蓝色海洋。在最初由孢子母舰播种生命后，一份人之领殖民部门和波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团之间的合同签订了，后者的巨型机器随后开始开垦这个世界。就在项目即将取得成果之际，卢德来到了这里。从某种角度来看，卢德的追随者窃取了这个世界，将它塑造成了他们心目中的天堂：一座质朴的自然花园。尽管虚伪，但或许正因如此，Gilead 成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

texts.en: The face of Gilead is filled with green continents, seeded with Earth-life by sporeship and climate-stabilized by Eridani-Utopia's vast terraforming machines. Then Ludd came and the Faithful turned the world into a rustic garden-wilderness of astounding richness; it is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的星球表面上遍布绿洲，孢子母舰在上面播种了类地生命，波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 的巨型机器则稳定了它的气候和生态。那之后卢德来到了这里，跟随着他的信徒们则把世界变成了一座质朴的自然花园，这使它成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

texts.en: The face of Gilead is filled with green continents, seeded with Earth-life by sporeship and climate-stabilized by Eridani Utopia's vast terraforming machines. Then Ludd came and turned the world into a rustic garden-wilderness of astounding richness; it is a gem of the Persean Sector.
texts.zh: Gilead 的表面被绿色的大地所覆盖。孢子母舰在这里播种了类地生命，波江座-乌托邦集团的巨型环境改造机器稳定了这里的气候和生态。随后卢德游历至此，将这个世界变成了富饶惊人的质朴园野，成就了这一英仙座星域瑰宝。

texts.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is strictly overseen by the Knights of Ludd; your shuttle must queue behind a not insignificant flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers filled with approved industrial goods.

As your shuttle inserts into a holding orbit, an override comes in from traffic control. Your pilot forwards the nav instructions to you for approval: immediate permission to descend on a non-standard route to a site which is not the usual pilgrimage transport complex. Instead, you are being directed to a pad serving a sprawling monastic compound.

The local datasphere, such as it is, is not forthcoming on details.
texts.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

你的穿梭机进入悬停轨道时，交通管制发来了超驰指令。驾驶员将导航指示转发给你以供确认：通行许可来的很快，但目的地并非通常的朝圣者交通复合体。取而代之地，你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线下到一处庞大寺院建筑群中的停机坪上。

哪怕是当地的数据库，也没能提供有关目的地的细节。

options.zh: 沿着对方发来的航线航行

texts.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is strictly overseen by the Knights of Ludd; your shuttle must queue behind a not insignificant flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers filled with approved industrial goods.

As your shuttle inserts into a holding orbit, an override comes in from traffic control. Your pilot forwards the nav instructions to you for approval: immediate permission to descend on a non-standard route to a site which is not the usual pilgrimage transport complex. Instead, you are being directed to a pad serving a sprawling monastic compound.

The local datasphere, such as it is, is not forthcoming on details. You can only assume that Archcurate Jaspis is insisting on meeting with you.
texts.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

你的穿梭机进入悬停轨道时，交通管制发来了超驰指令。驾驶员将导航指示转发给你以供确认：通行许可来的很快，但目的地并非通常的朝圣者交通复合体。取而代之地，你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线下到一处庞大寺院建筑群中的停机坪上。

哪怕是当地的数据库，也没能提供有关目的地的细节。你只能猜这或许是 Jaspis 大祭司 要见你。

options.zh: 沿着对方发来的航线航行

texts.en: You order the pilot to abort your descent rather than follow the unusual nav plan. There is no objection from traffic control or any kind of follow-up comms request as you return to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh: 你下令飞行员取消着陆计划，而非跟着非常规航线走。在返回你$shipOrFleet的途中，没有交通管制或别种形式的后续通信向你传达反对意见。

texts.en:
You return to your shuttle, taking a final breath of air rich with the exhalations of both the greenery and the mass of humanity.

As your pilot swaps take-off pings with traffic control, they pause at an unusual set of nav instructions which are forwarded to your (now retrieved) datapad: you are being directed to a landing which serves a huge monastic complex, some sort of Church administrative center.

The local datasphere is not forthcoming on details. It's difficult to say if this is a security measure or pious neglect.
texts.zh:
吸入最后一口充满了绿色植物和人类气息的空气后，你返回了穿梭机上。

当你的飞行员与交通管制交换起飞信号时，一组不寻常的导航指令打断了他们，随后这些指令被转发到了你的数据平板上：你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线前往一处庞大寺院建筑群中的着陆场，那似乎是教会的行政中心。

当地的数据库没能提供有关细节。很难说这是保密措施还是一种虔诚的忽视。

options.zh: 沿着对方发来的航线航行

texts.en:
You order the pilot to follow the original ascent rather than follow the unusual navigation instructions.

There is no objection from traffic control or any kind of follow-up comms request as you return to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh:
你下令飞行员继续返航，而非跟着非常规航线走。

在返回你$shipOrFleet的途中，没有交通管制或别种形式的后续通信向你传达反对意见。

texts.en:
At the landing pad, you are met by a solemn Luddic Knight. A Knight Initiate stands a few paces behind, trying to match the ease and calm of their superior.

"Captain $PlayerName," the Knight says, "Let me speak welcome on behalf of the Church of Galactic Redemption. I extend to you an invitation from the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis to meet and share refreshment."

The Knight stands aside, motioning with gauntlet to invite you to walk toward the administrative structures.
texts.zh:
在停机坪上，一位庄严的卢德骑士正等着你的到来。一名新晋骑士站在他身后几步远的地方，试图模仿前辈的从容镇静。

"$PlayerName 舰长，" 骑士说，"请允许我代表 银河救赎教会 表示欢迎。同时，我谨代表 Jaspis 宗师大人向你发来会面和共进茶点的邀请。"

骑士站到一旁，用戴着臂铠的手邀请你向行政建筑群进发。

texts.en:
At the landing pad, you are met by a solemn Luddic Knight. A Knight Initiate stands a few paces behind, trying to match the ease and calm of their superior.

"Captain $PlayerName," the Knight says, "Let me once again speak welcome on behalf of the Church of Galactic Redemption. I extend to you an invitation from the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis to meet and share refreshment."

The knight stands aside, motioning with gauntlet to invite you to walk toward the administrative structures.
texts.zh:
在停机坪上，一位庄严的卢德骑士正等着你的到来。一名新晋骑士站在他身后几步远的地方，试图模仿前辈的从容镇静。

"$PlayerName 舰长，" 骑士说，"请允许我再度代表银河救赎教会表示欢迎。同时，我谨代表 Jaspis 宗师大人向你发来会面和共进茶点的邀请。"

骑士站到一旁，用戴着臂铠的手邀请你向行政建筑群进发。

texts.en:
The attendant dutifully explains that the shrine commemorates the holy site where Ludd first stepped onto Gilead and was brought prostrate, to the shock of non-believers, to kiss the earth itself, so overcome was Ludd by the rapturous touch of Divinity.

Ludd's influence spread by its own evident virtue, the attendant explains, and the industrial terraforming machines were brought down and flowers bloomed in the rubble. There is no mention of strikes, global storms, sabotage, apocalyptic flooding and heatwaves, or corporate terror squads in this narrative. Nor does the attendant mention that, technically, an entire planet owned by the Eridani Utopia Terraforming megacorporation was illegally occupied by a radical cult. Rather, the unbelievers wept as Ludd revealed their sins and told them forgiveness was within reach on this garden-world.

It is an appealing morality tale delivered earnestly.
texts.zh:
圣务侍尽职地解释说，这个圣地是为了纪念卢德第一次踏上 Gilead 而建的，那时卢德被神伟大的才能所折服，在无信者们震惊的目光中，弯下腰亲吻了大地。

圣务侍继续解释说，卢德的精神通过其自身明显的优点传播开来，地貌改造工业机器被摧毁，鲜花在废墟中盛开。在叙述中，对方没有提到罢工、全球风暴、蓄意破坏、末日洪水和热浪，也没有提到企业的恐怖组织。圣务侍更没有提到，严格意义上来说，这件事就是 波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 拥有的整颗星球被激进的教团非法占领。取而代之地，对方说，当卢德揭示了他们的罪恶并告诉他们，在这花园世界里宽恕将触手可及的时候，无信者们感激涕零。

真是个引人入胜的道德故事。

texts.en:
The attendant nods, explaining that you must leave your guards behind because this is a place of peace, and all are equal on the Pilgrim's Path.

The request is an implied request for keeping up appearances: a couple of your guards, unarmed and trained for situations requiring this degree of subtlety, attend to your safety as per matter of course. You note other unusually small parties of "pilgrims", plainly but clearly wealthy by their cut and carriage, led by their own shrine-attendants and accompanied by unusually muscled 'distant cousins'.

Nonetheless, the crowds filing out of the transport complex, on a wide highway of beaten earth and cobble, are enormous. Those that cannot walk are carried; no powered transport is provided.
texts.zh:
圣务侍点了点头，解释说你必须让保镖留下，因为这是个和平的地方，朝圣者之路上人人平等。

这不过是个对外在形象的含蓄要求：几个没有携带武器的保镖接受过应对这种微妙情况的训练，他们理所当然地成为了和你一同拜访此地的朝圣者以照顾你的安全。同时你还注意到了其他一些异常的小规模 "朝圣者"，他们的举手投足毫不掩饰地流露出了明显的富有，由专属的圣务侍带领，还有些肌肉发达的 "远房表亲" 陪同。

从运输中心鱼贯而出的人群数量庞大，他们来到了由碎土和鹅卵石铺成的宽阔公路上。由于此地不提供助力交通工具，那些无法行走的人只能由其他人抬着。

texts.en:
The path of the pilgrims leads up a slope covered in trees more enormous than any you've seen before. Though small in scale compared to the celestial phenomena that is your daily bread, their living architecture forms a natural cathedral.

Dispassionate Knights of Ludd watch as attendants shuttle you through a cordoned path in an arc through a final grove of mighty sequoia-analogs atop the promontory at the terminus of the ridge - it is a temple, struts and spars intertwined with the trees. Golden sunlight filters through heavy branches, and as the breeze lifts a whispering chorus of foliage, you catch an earthy scent over the mass of humanity surrounding you.
texts.zh:
朝圣者之路通向了一个山坡，山坡被你前所未见的巨大树木覆盖着 —— 尽管与你见惯了的天体和太空建筑相比还是太小了 —— 他们的活建筑形成了一个天然的大教堂。

神情冰冷的卢德骑士看着圣务侍将你领过一条围栏小路，小路顺着山坡将你领入位于岬角顶端的巨大类红杉园林，这园林乃是一座支柱与树木交织在一起的寺庙。金色的阳光透过茂密的树枝，微风吹动树叶让它们低声合唱，你则透过周围人群捕捉到了泥土的芳香。

texts.en: You have only a brief moment before the high altar of living wood. Small tokens and offerings are piled high amongst low, cheap candles.
texts.zh: 在高高的活木祭坛前，你只能停留一小会儿。小小的纪念品和祭品在低矮廉价的蜡烛之间堆得很高。

texts.en: Thinking quickly, you place Brother Cotton's small book on the pile of offerings. It settles into the scrimshaw, trinkets, and cheap photo-prints like it belongs there.
texts.zh: 你快速思索了一会，把 Cotton 修士的小本子放到了祭品堆上。它融入了那些雕刻物、装饰品和廉价的相片印花，好似它本就属于那里。

texts.en:
And in a moment, it passes.

It is hot, and you are in a large and sweaty crowd full of pilgrims all wrapped up away from you, lost in their own worship.

The attendants do their best to herd the masses along the main pathway. You must push through groups calling and crying and singing and praying.
texts.zh:
转眼间，圣地就不在你眼前了。

炎热的天气里，你被一大群汗流浃背的人群裹挟着前行，这些朝圣者迷失在他们自身的崇拜中。

圣务侍们尽力将群众汇集到主干道上。你必须得挤过那些呼喊、哭泣、唱诵和祈祷着的人们。

texts.en:
You return to your shuttle, taking a final breath of air rich with the exhalations of greenery.

The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.
texts.zh:
吸入最后一口充满了绿色植物气息的空气后，你返回了穿梭机上。

搭乘穿梭机返航的过程一切顺利。

texts.en:
"The faithful must know to keep watch for what is coming," the attendant says with a strange look, then almost - but not quite - smiles.

"I mean not to sound so arcane; it is merely that our Church has endured hard times, and may yet again."
texts.zh:
"忠实的信徒必须时刻对将要发生的事务保持关注。" 圣务侍带着奇怪的表情说，然后几乎 —— 但不完全地 —— 微笑着。

"我知道不必说得如此神秘；这仅仅是因为教会经历过艰难的时光，也许还会再经历一次。"

options.en: You think hard times will come?
options.zh: 你认为艰难的时光会再次到来吗？

texts.en: "I pray that they do not," the attendant says. "We prepare for if they do."
texts.zh: "我祈祷着不会。" 圣务侍说，"但我们也做好了应对的准备。"

texts.en:
It is a smaller path you are led down; not the highway of humanity for the main shrine, this is a smaller, secondary shrine in the lee of a crag dominated by the immense forest.

Pilgrims are offered tea, and water, and ritual washing. The air is filled with sweat, incense, and the scent of pine. A thrum of odd chanting distorted by the breeze lifts and wanes by the whims of the air currents.

You see shrine curates blessing pilgrims. Soon it is your turn.
texts.zh:
你被带到了一条更小的路上；不是通往主圣地的大道，而是位于峭壁背风处林海中的、一座更小的次级圣地。

这里有为朝圣者准备的茶、水和受洗仪式。空气中弥漫着汗水、熏香和松树的香味。一阵奇怪的吟诵声被微风扰乱，随着气流而起伏。

你看到圣地住持们在为朝圣者祈福。很快就轮到你了。

texts.en: The curate casts scented drops and says the words, though it is almost a blur. It is strange to have come so far, for this.
texts.zh: 祭司撒下带着香味的水滴，念着祷文，然而那声音模糊不清。奔波许久就为了这个，还真是奇怪。

texts.en:
All around you see despair and decadence in equal measure channelled into the elaborate rituals of the Luddic Church. Made safe, made convenient; an insulating layer that allows people to live without truly walking Ludd's Path.

It is easy to forget here in the proud edifice of the Church that Ludd held a hammer, too, and was unafraid to use it without hesitation in the face of evil.
texts.zh:
环顾四周，你意识到绝望和颓废同样程度上渗入了卢德教会精心设计的仪式中。安全而方便的仪式保护着人们，让他们在不必真正遵循卢德之道的情况下也能生活下去。

站在这座骄傲的大教堂里，人们很容易忘记卢德手中也曾执重锤，并有勇气在面对邪恶时毫不犹豫地将其挥出。

texts.en: Around you flows a river of faith and ritual. Your fellow pilgrims have chosen their purpose to pursue, that of Ludd's message. In the collective hardship of life in the Persean Sector, as in the collective hardship of the pilgrimage, they find a kind of peace and meaning that is absent in the hollow left by the Collapse.
texts.zh: 你的周围流淌着信仰和仪式的河流。与你同行的朝圣者已经选好所追求的目标，那便是卢德的旨意。在英仙座星域的艰难生活中、在朝圣路上的同甘共苦中，他们寻找到了在 大崩塌 留下的空洞中所缺失的和平和真义。

texts.en:
Around you people put on the motions of pilgrimage and ritual, play-acting the forms of great meaning for their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable what has been built on the intentionally obfuscated rantings of one rabble-rouser. It is impossible to know what Ludd would made of all this.

The Church, of course, makes a good show of pretending to, and it prospers for it.
texts.zh:
在你周围，人们进行着朝圣和仪式相关的各种活动，为他们的先知卢德表演着具有重大意义的仪式。很难相信这一切都是建立在被一个煽动者故意歪曲的话语之上，这让人很难想象卢德会怎么看待这一切。

至于教会，他们自然装作理解卢德，并借此而繁荣壮大。

texts.en:
Around you flows a river of pilgrims. They've invested such meaning into the journey they've made, supposedly in the path of their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable how much has been built on the words of one obscure figure who managed to be blessed by circumstance with great charisma and a moment to bend the arc of history.

What would the - certainly - long-dead Ludd make of what's become of all of it?
texts.zh:
你的周围流淌着朝圣者的人流。他们为自己跟随先知卢德的脚步的旅程找到了意义。令人难以置信的是，那个设法利用了环境、以巨大的感召力在一瞬间弯曲了历史走向的人，他留下的话语究竟都形成了什么。

那么，那位 —— 当然 —— 早已死去的卢德又会怎么看待这一切呢？

texts.en:
Around you a river of pilgrims flows. They've found meaning in the journey they've made between the shrines, following the path of their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable how much has been built on the words of one person who, blessed or cursed by circumstance, bent the arc of history across the face of the Domain and the Collapse.

Looking upon the crowds, the pointed arches, the trees beyond- What would Ludd make of this?
texts.zh:
你的周围流淌着朝圣者的人流。他们为自己跟随先知卢德的脚步、在各个圣地间穿梭的旅程找到了意义。令人难以置信的是，那个被环境祝福，或者说被环境诅咒的、在 人之领 面前，在 大崩塌 的背景下弯曲了历史走向的人，他留下的话语究竟都形成了什么。

看看这人群，尖拱门和远方的树木 —— 卢德会怎么看待这一切？

texts.en: You return to the shaded halls of the transport complex.
texts.zh: 你回到了运输中心被阴影遮蔽的大厅里。

texts.en:
You enter the shaded halls of the transport complex and move toward your shuttle's landing pad.

One of the shrine attendants intercepts you and, with a quick glance at a discreet datapad (swiftly tucked back into voluminous robes), invites you to follow them.

"I am blessed, Captain $PlayerName," the attendant says, "to invite you to complete the Pilgrim's Path on this day."
texts.zh:
你进入了交通枢纽那昏暗的厅堂，接着走向自己的穿梭机所在的停机坪。

圣务侍们中的一位主动迎上了你，他迅速瞥了一眼手持数据平板，又飞快地把它塞回宽松的长袍里，然后邀请你跟上他们。

"我很荣幸，$PlayerName 舰长，" 圣务侍说到，"能够邀请您在今天为您的朝圣者之路画上句号。"

options.en: How do you know of this?

texts.en: The Knight simply makes a small bow in acknowledgement of your description of the Archurate. You suppose they're being politic.
texts.zh: 骑士只是简单颔首，默认了你对大祭司的描述。你觉得他们对此很谨慎。

texts.en: "I know not. It is my duty to extend this hospitality on behalf of the Reverend Archcurate," the Knight says, then with a thought adds, "You are accused of no heresy, or secular crime. Your safety is my duty."
texts.zh: "我不知道。我仅仅是代表宗师大人向您问好。" 骑士说到，思考了一下又开始补充，"您并没有被指控为异端，或是犯下有违教规的罪行。确保您的安全是我的职责。"

texts.en:
The Knight's eyebrows shoot up in surprise. With a blink the Knight recovers composure, and says "Y... es. Of course. This is a request, not a demand. Although. The Reverend Archcurate." A moment's pause. "She suggested that I insist, if necessary."

Beneath the solemnity, the Knight's look pleads for you to not put them in the awkward situation of denying the Archcurate.

You mentally review your model of the Church hierarchy: the Archcurate Conclave is the crown of the Church, meeting or sending representatives to perform the rulings that determine the highest matters; interpreting the canon of Ludd, sanctification, holy law, excommunication. If the Church has rulers, this Archcurate is among them.
texts.zh:
骑士惊讶的扬起眉毛，随即便恢复了镇静，说道，"是...是的，当然了。这是个请求而非命令。即便宗师大人她..." 他停顿了一下，"她建议我在必要时坚持一下。"

在这种庄重的氛围下，骑士恳求你不要让他们因你的抗命而陷入尴尬的境地。

你回想了一下教会的等级制度：教宗密会是教会的最高权力机关。他们有权举行会议或派出代表来裁决教会的事务，此外还能解读卢德的教义、提拔某人、制定圣典或是将某人逐出教会。如果说教会有统治者的话，那这位大祭司一定是其中之一。

options.en: I've changed my mind. Lead on.

texts.en:
You leave the Knight to ponder how to deliver your rejection to the Archcurate.

Your shuttle ascends from the green world. There is no objection from traffic control or any kind of follow-up comms request as you return to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh:
你让骑士自己想想怎么向大祭司传达你的拒绝。

你的穿梭机离开了这个绿色的世界。在返回你$shipOrFleet的途中，没有交通管制或别种形式的后续通信向你传达反对意见。

texts.en:
You are led by the Knight through gardens and the soaring arcades of Luddic Church architecture: half-remembered dreams of gothic cathedrals given flight by the material science of the Domain. It might be thought impertinent to mention this aspect of the construction, of course.

The Knight-Initiate follows behind, footsteps echoing between arched portals, over slate tiles flecked with glittering pyrite like stars in the night.
texts.zh:
骑士带着你穿过了花园与卢德教会建筑群中高耸的拱廊，这种几乎要被世人遗忘的哥特式教堂，竟然被人之领材料学的奇迹腾飞至如此的高度。当然，在这里提到这一点一定会被当做无礼之徒。

新晋骑士紧随其后，脚步声在拱形的大门之间回响。而你们脚下的地板则被发光的黄铁矿点缀着，如同夜空中的星星。

options.en: Does every successful pilgrim get to meet the Archcurate?
options.zh: 每一个成功的朝圣者都能见到大祭司吗？

options.en: Why am I receiving this treatment?
options.zh: 为什么你们这样对待我？

texts.en:
The Knight looks back at you, half-cape fluttering over carefully secured weaponry, with an expression that yours is a stupid question. The tone of the reply is firmly neutral, however.

"No, captain. The Reverend Archcurate requested a meeting with you specifically."
texts.zh:
骑士转身看向你，单肩披风随之扬起，露出了下面还稳妥地挂在身上的武器。那表情在说你的问题真蠢，但是回答的语气却带着一种强硬的中立。

"不，舰长。宗师大人特别指明要和你会面。"

texts.en: "I know not, captain, and could not say," the Knight says crisply, eyes forward.
texts.zh: "我不知道，也不能说，舰长。" 骑士目不斜视，干脆地说。

texts.en:
You pass through wooden doors and halls carpeted in designs of foliage and fauna, presumably of Old Earth: a fawn, a whale; hawks and dragons circling in a blue sky wreathed with leaves of ivy, oak, and palm.

The Archcurate's office appears relatively austere at first glance, but as your eyes adjust, hand-carved wooden paneling emerges, their faces packed with small plants and figures both human and animal. The room is situated to overlook a private atrium-garden. A shaft of sunlight illuminates flowers and catches the softly trickling drops of a fountain.
texts.zh:
你穿过了铺满树叶与动物图案的门和大厅。这些图案似乎来自于古地球：一只小鹿，一头鲸鱼；鹰和龙在布满常春藤、橡树和棕榈叶的蓝天上盘旋。

乍一看，大祭司的办公室显得相对朴素。但随着你仔细观察，却发现了手工雕刻的木质镶条，其上刻满了动植物还有人的图案。这房间的位置刚好能俯瞰私人空中花园；一缕阳光照亮了园中的花海，喷泉的水珠也在阳光中闪动。

texts.en:
"Your Excellency," the Knight calls out too loudly for the space, and bows to the figure within.

The Archcurate Jaspis turns toward you, closing a thick book.

"Come before me, captain," she says. "I would share with you a pot of tea, and my hospitality. Knight Ailanthus, you have my thanks and may leave us be."

A metal carafe with a long handle steams on a heating element, a pot and two simple cups beside.
texts.zh:
"阁下，" 骑士声如洪钟，向里面的人鞠躬致意。

Jaspis 大祭司转身朝向你，同时合上一本厚厚的书。

"坐到我身前来，舰长，" 她开口道，"我愿意与您分享一壶茶及我对客人的欢迎。骑士 Ailanthus ，感谢您的帮助，请让我俩独处吧。"

一个长柄金属水瓶正在加热元件上吐着蒸汽，旁边放着一个茶壶和两个朴实的茶杯。

texts.en: "Water then, if it please you." Her hand opens to indicate a pitcher in the corner, her gaze fixed somewhere past you.
texts.zh: "想喝点水的话，请自便。" 她张手示意角落里的一个陶罐，目光凝视着你身侧的某个地方。

options.en: You wanted to see me. I'm here. Let's get to the point.
options.zh: 你想要见我，所以我来了。让我们开门见山吧。

texts.en: "It is a ritual of welcome, captain," she says as if to a small child, then adds with unexpected acid, "You needn't drink the bedamned tea, or the water, but by Ludd's good grace, accept a gift given."
texts.zh: "这不过是为了表达欢迎之意。" 她的言语像是在安抚一个孩童，却又隐含几分尖刻，"不愿意喝茶或喝水是无妨，但还请接受他人的好意，就当是看在卢德的份上。"

options.en: I don't believe an Archcurate should speak like that.
options.zh: 我不觉得一位大祭司会这样子说话。

options.en: It is my policy not to owe anyone anything.
options.zh: 不欠任何人任何事是我的个人信条。

texts.en: She scoffs. "Oh, so after right and truly blundering the greeting I laid before you, now you are the master of Church affairs? Even I can see plain how you've made such an impression on the ecumene."
texts.zh: 她讥讽道："哦？我之前问候你的时候，你毫无疑问是犯蠢了，结果现在反倒是由你来主持教会事务？这下就连我都能一眼看出，你到底是怎么给世间留下这种印象的了。"

texts.en: "As charming of wit and tongue as hearsay suggested, you must enliven celebration and negotiation in equal part. Even now I find my own self contemplating the necessity of bothering to show hospitality at all."
texts.zh: "传闻你幽默风趣，巧舌如簧，那你也一定能把庆祝和谈判的氛围炒热吧。就算是现在我也在考虑，到底有没有必要展现出一丁点殷勤好客的意思。"

texts.en:
She grabs the long handle of the carafe. "Drink the tea or not. I shall now make it," she says, and gaze still unfocused, fills the teapot.

She is quite blind, you realize.
texts.zh:
她握住水壶的握把，"不论你愿不愿意喝，我都会把茶倒好，" 她边说边动手倒满了茶壶，双眼全程都未曾聚焦。

你意识到，她已目盲。

texts.en:
"Then I share with you water drawn from the well of my home, and my hospitality with it," she says, all part of the ritual. She gets up and retrieves the pitcher of water, placing it next to the tea pot.

Her gaze is still unfocused. She is quite blind, you realize, as she  takes the handle of the carafe of boiling water, and without looking, fills the teapot.
texts.zh:
"那么为了表现我的好客之心，我将与你分享从我家中水井里提的水。" 言下之意，这都是仪式的一部分。她起身端起陶制水灌，把它摆在茶壶旁边。

她的双眼依然未曾聚焦，你意识到她早已目盲。从握住煮沸的水壶握把，到装满茶壶，全程她都没用眼睛去看。

texts.en:
She takes the handle of the carafe of boiling water, and without looking, gaze still unfocused, fills the teapot.

She is quite blind, you realize.
texts.zh:
她握住装了开水的水壶的握把，不看一眼，目光涣散，却把茶壶沏满。

你意识到，她已目盲。

texts.en:
"That even I can see," she says without hesitation. "We both bear burdens with the grace the Creator saw fit to provide; for one, I give thanks that I was not made a boor."

She returns the carafe to the heating element, centering it perfectly.
texts.zh:
"即便如此我也能看明白。" 她没有丝毫迟疑地接了下去，"造物主赐予我们其认为合适的重担，并且我们都心怀感激地承载着；在一切之前，我得感激我没有作为俗人降生。"

她把水瓶放回了加热元件上，水瓶的落点完美居中。

texts.en: "Have water, if you will. My tea will be but a moment."
texts.zh: "如果你想就喝点水吧，茶要待会才好。"

texts.en: "Let us give the tea a moment, child."
texts.zh: "让我们等茶泡好吧，孩子。"

texts.en:
You pour yourself some water and have a sip. It is cold, and it is good.

It is almost disturbingly unlike the water from your own ship, purified from cometary ice, generally, and infused with certain standard additives.
texts.zh:
你自己倒了点水，喝了一口，凉的，但是很好喝。

它和你的星舰上的水有本质上的不同，似乎是从彗星上的冰提纯而来，并且加入了某些标准添加剂。

texts.en: She smiles thinly.
texts.zh: 她淡淡一笑。

texts.en:
"The office I am entrusted to has need for the service of an actor of means and ability."

More quietly, her voice gone low and rough, "A hammer."

The Archcurate places her teacup back on the desk, exactly where it was before, then pours tea into her cup, and then into yours.
texts.zh:
"我所受命的职位需要一个有能力、有手段的人。"

悄然间，她的声音变得低沉而强烈，"一柄重锤。"

大祭司把她的茶杯放回了桌上，茶杯精确落回了它原本所在的地方，那之后，她分别向她自己和你的茶杯中倒入茶水。

texts.en: She either ignored or forgot your desire for water instead of tea. You strongly suspect it is the former.
texts.zh: 她要么是无视，要么是忘记了你要的是水而不是茶。你强烈怀疑是前者。

texts.en: "It is," she says simply. "Let that be the end of it for now."
texts.zh: "是的，" 她简单说到，"眼下就到此为止吧。"

texts.en:
She smiles sardonically. "You have met the Knights. You know full well that in all matters they will break rather than bend and name such waste 'sacrifice'."

"I should not speak so broadly however. There is one who was sent to me to serve for his noviceship. He is the one I want you to find."
texts.zh:
她讽刺地笑了笑："你是见过骑士团的。你也很清楚，他们都是些撞破南墙不回头的家伙，还美其名曰 '牺牲'。"

"不过，话也不能说的太草率。有个新手被派到我手下见习，他就是我想让你找的人。"

texts.en:
"Do you insult or laud me, I wonder," she says. "Anahita Baird is a powerful woman, intelligent and proud. She also makes herself habit of knocking upon the doors of demons."

She sits back, cradling her teacup.

"Or I should say, rather, she sends others to knock in her place." The Archcurate waves a hand dismissively, "I hold not your work for her against your character. If I may return your Janus-faced compliment: what you have done for Baird may even prove more your suitability for what is in my mind."
texts.zh:
"我很好奇，你到底是在侮辱我还是赞美我，" 她说到，"Anahita Baird 是个女强人，才华横溢，自命不凡。她早就养成了敲响魔鬼大门的坏习惯。" 她坐了回去，把茶杯抱进自己的怀里。

"或者，确切来讲，她是派别人替她去敲这扇门。" 大祭司轻蔑地挥了挥手，"我觉得你为她干的活并不符合你的性格。如果我回应了你这口是心非的恭维，那你为 Baird 所做的一切便能印证我的想法"

texts.en:
"No. My hammer is," she nods in your direction, "a humbler being by far than you. But he requires aid in his quest, and for that you might well serve."

She sips some tea, "Do understand that I speak not entirely of war and wrath. A hammer may strike subtly, even quietly, if aimed with skill, wisdom, and piety."
texts.zh:
"不。我手下的 '重锤' 是..." 她朝你颔首致意，"一个比你谦逊得多的人。但他在任务中需要帮助，你或许要为此提供协助。"

她啜饮了几口茶，继续道："请你一定要理解，我所说的协助，并不完全是指掀起战火。只要辅以技巧，智慧与虔诚，即便是重锤出击也可以做到无声无息。"

texts.en:
"The Faith has many enemies, both within and without the Church," she says slowly. "Some know what evil they do; others do not. They must be set right."

"I would labor to do good as Ludd taught us, and by all means available, as Ludd also taught us. In doing good, I serve this office. And to greater purpose, I serve the vision Ludd handed down to us."
texts.zh:
"伟大的信仰举目皆敌，教会面临着内忧外患。" 她缓缓说道，"有些人知道自己作恶多端；还有些一无所觉。他们都将得到惩戒。"

"我必如卢德所教的那般，行善积德，尽心竭力。在这善举中，我得以履行这份职责。为了那崇高的旨意，我将献身于 卢德 为我们传下的神谕。"

texts.en:
She takes a leisurely moment to sip her tea.

"You will of course be paid. The coffers of the Church are not so abundant as Tri-Tachyon's plunder, but if these credits may service a righteous path, let us not cast them aside."

"Such acts are for saints." She smiles a little, "Not for those such as you and I."
texts.zh:
她悠闲地喝了一会茶。

"你当然会得到报酬。教会的财力并不如 速子科技 的那帮掠夺者那样雄厚，但如果能将钱财用于正道之上，倒是不妨为此一掷千金。"

"如此行事则是为了卢德的圣者，" 她微微地笑了笑，"并不是为了你我。"

texts.en:
"The Church," she says, "might reward such zealousness."

A wry smile appears, "Would one place faith in the machinery of offices, of rules and letters and who-serves-whom? I pray that we do not grow our own demon in Ludd's good name."

"Worry not." She leans back, "My advanced age allows me to say such things that could have a novice excommunicated."
texts.zh:
"教会..." 她说到，"...有可能奖励这种狂热。"

苦笑浮现在她的脸上，"人难道会把信仰寄托在一个由职务，规则，信件和上下尊卑所构成的机器上吗？我真心祈祷，我等万万不可以卢德之名恣意妄为。"

"无需担忧。" 她往后靠了靠，"我年岁已高，即便口出妄言，也不会像新人那般遭受绝罚。"

texts.en:
"I understand full well that you wish untempered wrath let loose in the cause of holy justice, captain."

Her blind eyes seem fixed on you.

"Let me provide you a channel for your river of tears and blood. Otherwise the products of all that suffering might be spilled directionless, wasted."
texts.zh:
"我完全理解，你为了神圣的正义而显露出的无法掩饰的愤怒，舰长。"

她空虚的双眼在冥冥之中注视着你。

"我会为你的血泪提供宣泄的途径，否则这些痛苦所带来的力量将会毫无意义地浪费掉。"

texts.en:
The Archcurate reaches under her desk then places a book on the pitted surface. It is the holy book of Ludd given to you by Brother Cotton; you had left it as an offering at the shrine, amongst a mountain of trinkets.

That she has it here, and knows you put it there, suggests much about the capabilities of the Church and the attention being paid to you.

"I understand full well that you wish untempered wrath let loose to wreak holy justice, captain." Her blind eyes seem fixed on you. "At least, you have communed with one who does."
texts.zh:
大祭司把手伸到桌子下，拿出一本书并将其放到了不甚平整的桌面上。那是 Cotton 修士送给你的卢德圣书；之前你把它当作祭品留在了圣地的那堆小饰品之中。

而现在她拿到了这本书，并且她知道这书是你放在那里的，这说明了教会的能耐以及教会对你的关注。

"舰长，我完全明白，你希望在无尽的怒火中施展神圣的审判。" 她那失明的双目似乎一直在盯着你。"至少，你和一个有这种想法的人交流过。"

texts.en:
She turns to a small side-shelf, opens a wooden box, and takes out a delicate, desiccated leaf.

"Do you know Ludd's Parable of the Kudzu?" She carefully opens Cotton's book, places the leaf within, closes it, and pushes it toward you.

She leans forward, then says in a harsh whisper, "Take it to him. We will speak of this later."
texts.zh:
她转向旁边的一个小架子，打开了一枚木盒子，取出了一片精致的枯叶。

"你知道卢德关于 Kudzu 的寓言吗？" 她小心翼翼地打开 Cotton 修士的书，把那叶子放进去，又轻轻合上，将书推到你面前。

她凑到你耳边，尖刻地低语道，"把这本书带给他，我们后面再谈。"

texts.en:
The Archcurate carefully puts her hands together, not unlike a position of prayer.

"Captain. Allow me to put the matter to you directly."
texts.zh:
大祭司虔诚地双手合十，与祈祷的姿势并无不同。

"舰长，请允许我直接告诉你这件事。"

texts.en: "My hammer is," she nods in your direction, acknowledging something, "a humbler thing by far than yourself. But he requires aid in his quest, and for that you might well serve."
texts.zh: "我手下的 '重锤' 是..." 她朝你颔首致意，似乎正确认着什么，"一个比你谦逊得多的人。但他在任务中需要帮助，你或许要为此提供协助。"

texts.en:
"My agent is a novice of the Knights of Ludd. He was assigned to my office in order to achieve his Knighthood. He infiltrated a cell of heretical militants affiliated with the ill-named Luddic Path. I have not heard from him in some time."

Her voice, usually somewhere between confident and sardonic, almost breaks on these last few words.
texts.zh:
"我的特工是卢德骑士团的见习修士。他被派到这里来工作是为了取得骑士爵位。在他潜入臭名昭著的 卢德左径 的一个异端武装成员基地后，我已经有一段时间没有收到他的讯息了。"

她那通常介于自信和讥讽之间的音色，在话语的结尾几乎跑偏了。

texts.en: She proceeds, pointedly ignoring your statement.
texts.zh: 她继续说了下去，并且显然无视了你的指摘。

texts.en:
"If you accept this task from my office, my assistant will provide you with identity files to aid you in finding my agent. You will also be given a modest retainer to fund your efforts, and more if... when you find him."

"You need not answer now. Pray on the matter. Or 'ponder' if that is how you would name it."

She turns back to the book she had open when you entered. "May Providence favor you with a blessed path; I pray it returns to me with an answer in the affirmative."
texts.zh:
"如果你愿意接受以我办公室的名义发布的这项任务，我的助手将为你提供身份文件，以帮助你找到我的代理人。此外你还会得到一笔数额不大的定金，而如果你能找到...不，当你找到他的时候，还会有额外的奖赏。"

"现在不必回答。请先为此事做出祷告，又或许你会把这称为 '琢磨一下'。"

她重新打开了你进来时她正在读的那本书。"愿上天赐予你受到祝福之路，我则希望它能让你给出肯定的答复。"

options.en: Do not expect me to run errands for the Church.

texts.en: She hrums in acknowledgement, attention focused elsewhere now, opening her book with one hand and placing the other upon its open face.
texts.zh: 她轻哼一声表示了解，随即将注意力转到了别处，用一只手打开书，另一只手则放到了那书页上。

texts.en:
"With such haste?" she says, "You need not play-act enthusiasm to impress me. My opinion has always held that decisions of great import should be given ample time to steep."

"Gift me now with silence," she says as she opens her book with one hand and places the other upon its open face.
texts.zh:
"这么快？" 她说，"你不需要用装腔作势的热情来打动我。我认为，重大的决定应该用足够的时间去思考。"

"现在请让我清净一会。" 她边说边用一只手打开书，把另一只手放到了那书页上。

texts.en:
"Your posturing is best held within, captain."

She opens her book with one hand and places the other upon its open face, "Then diffused through meditation," she says.

After a moment she adds, "Unless self-flagellation is your preferred expression of zeal. I judge not."
texts.zh:
"舰长，你最好内敛一些。"

她用一只手打开书，另一只手则放到了那书页上，"然后让自己的态度通过冥想传达。" 她说道。

过了一会她又补充道："除非你热衷于通过自我鞭笞的方式表达热情，我对此不做评判。"

texts.en:
You leave Archcurate Jaspis to her book.

A soft-spoken attendant in robes makes an incongruous datapad appear and coordinates transfer of the Archcurate's comms ID - at least, for her office - then passes you off to the blank-faced Knight Ailanthus to escort you to your waiting shuttle.

Your return to orbit is uneventful.
texts.zh:
你起身离开，给 Jaspis 大祭司留下静心读书的空间。

穿着长袍、说话轻声细语的圣务侍摸出了个和她自己的形象很不搭调的数据平板，将大祭司的通讯 ID 调给了你 —— 至少是她办公室的 —— 然后让面无表情的 Ailanthus 骑士将你护送回穿梭机处。

返回轨道的过程一切顺利。

options.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
options.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

texts.en:
With the flash of official iconography, instructions are returned from the orbital navigation service which attempts to track the innumerable human-made artifacts of the Volturnian sea - floating habitats, sprawling farm envelopes, transient mining platforms, and even ancient-style seafaring vessels.

Your shuttle pierces the atmosphere in a long descent arc, politely slowing to under the speed of sound as it approaches a bank of thick fog illuminated by Askonia's primary. What at first looks like an ethereal castle is revealed by proximity to be a dismal, jostling accretion of barges parasited to a retired extraction rig.
texts.zh:
随着官方图标的闪烁，轨道导航服务机构传回了指示。该机构同时也致力于搜寻 Volturn 海洋里那无数的人工遗物 —— 浮动栖所，杂乱延伸着的农业舱，临时采矿平台，甚至是古代样式的航海船只。

你的 穿梭机 拖着长长的降落尾迹，穿过了大气层。随着那 Askonia 主星所照亮的浓雾渐渐靠近，你礼貌地将速度降至亚音速。起初你好像见到一座飘渺空灵的城堡，近看才发现是一座阴郁的废弃钻井平台，周边挤满了一大堆寄生虫似的驳船。

texts.en:
With the flash of official iconography, your shuttle route permission is denied by the orbital approach authority.

"With apologies, uh, walker, the Shrine of Volturn is currently in a class-red conflict zone." The official is legitimately apologetic.

"There's been, er, rebel activity and we've had some AA incidents targeting civilian shuttles. We can't let anyone approach until order is re-established."
texts.zh:
随着官方图标一闪，轨道进近管制机构驳回了你的穿梭机航线许可。

"实在抱歉，呃，行者，Volturn 圣地目前处于红色冲突区。" 官员确实满心歉意。

"这边，呃，有叛乱活动，还发生过几起针对民用穿梭机的防空误击。等秩序恢复之前，我们不能放任何人靠近。"

texts.en:
Your shuttle settles on the landing pad and is met by no one.

Rusted mount-points remain where weapons emplacements once loomed.

The small squad of Diktat conscripts that used to garrison this platform have surely been deployed elsewhere, and the official you met probably shot as a turncoat. Unless he was given a promotion and assigned to some new backwater with another squad of conscripts to bully.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在停机坪上，无人前来迎接。

昔日武器阵地耸立的地方，只剩锈迹斑斑的安装基座。

曾经驻守这座平台的那小队辛达强权征召兵，想来已被调往别处；先前见过的那名官员，多半被当作叛徒枪决了。除非他反倒升了官，被派到某个新的穷乡僻壤，再去欺压另一队征召兵。

texts.en:
Your shuttle settles on the landing pad and is met by no one.

Rusted mount-points remain where weapons emplacements once loomed. The Sindrian Diktat must have placed a garrison here.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在停机坪上，无人前来迎接。

昔日武器阵地耸立的地方，只剩锈迹斑斑的安装基座。辛达强权必定曾在此驻兵。

texts.en:
Your shuttle settles on the landing pad and is met by no one.

Rusted mount-points remain where weapons emplacements once loomed.

You can only imagine what happened to the small squad of Diktat conscripts that used to garrison this platform.
texts.zh:

昔日武器阵地耸立的地方，只剩锈迹斑斑的安装基座。

曾经驻守这座平台的那小队辛达强权征召兵落得什么下场，你只能自行想象。

昔日武器阵地耸立的地方，只剩锈迹斑斑的安装基座。

曾经驻守这座平台的那小队辛达强权征召兵落得什么下场，你只能自行想象。

texts.en:
Your shuttle settles on the landing pad assigned by the bored local traffic-control officer.

Luddic banners festoon the rusted mount-points where weapons emplacements once loomed - starbursts, coiled ivy, abstract patterns in muted tones.

The combat-tuned sensor suite of your shuttle does detect the giveaway tick-tick of stray radiations from point-defense weapon munitions and power-sources, armed and ready, but tastefully hidden. The Knights are here.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在那名百无聊赖的本地交管员指定的停机坪上。

卢德教会的旗帜挂满了昔日武器阵地耸立处的锈蚀基座 —— 星芒、盘绕的常春藤、色调沉静的抽象纹样。

你穿梭机上那套战斗级传感器，还是捕捉到了点防御武器弹药与供能装置泄漏出的、再熟悉不过的滴滴辐射信号 —— 弹药上膛、蓄势待发，只是藏得颇为雅致。骑士团就在这里。

texts.en:
The shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

"At attention!" the official screams to the conscripts as he comes to greet you, "This is an officer of the Supreme Executor's space auxiliary!"

You endure obsequious smalltalk as he escorts you through the checkpoint and to the heavy doors leading toward the shrine.
texts.zh:
一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

"立正！" 这名官员来接见你时，对着征召兵们大声喊道，"这位是最高元首麾下的太空辅助军！"

你忍耐着他的阿谀奉承，随他通过了检查站，来到了通往圣地的沉重门扉。

texts.en:
The shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

"At attention!" the official screams to the conscripts as he comes to greet you. "I haven't told," he whispers, drawing too close. "And if you need anything, anything, to root out these Luddie terrorists...." he leaves it unsaid, looking for approval in your eyes.

You endure obsequious smalltalk as he escorts you through the checkpoint and to the heavy doors leading toward the shrine.
texts.zh:
一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

"立正！" 这名官员来接见你时，对着征召兵们大声喊道。接着他对你悄声耳语，距离近的有些过头："我刚刚还没说，如果您需要任何东西，任何！来铲除这些卢德恐怖分子..." 他没再继续说下去，只是期望从你眼中看到一丝认可。

你忍耐着他的阿谀奉承，随他通过了检查站，来到了通往圣地的沉重门扉。

texts.en:
A shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

The official produces a trembling facsimile of a smile and looks you up and down.

"A, a pilgrim are you?" he asks unconvincingly. "I'm afraid the shrine is closed today. And tomorrow. Security concerns. The situation has been... unstable."
texts.zh:
一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

这名官员挤出一个像传真画面那样缺乏真实感的笑容，上下打量着你。

"啊，你是个朝圣者？" 他的话听起来没有什么说服力，"恐怕圣地今天，以及明天，都不会开张。这是出于安全考虑，毕竟局势一直...不太稳定。"

texts.en:
The shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

"At attention!" the official screams to the conscripts as he comes to greet you.

一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

"立正！" 这名官员来接见你时，对着征召兵们大声喊道。

texts.en:
Your shuttle drops to the primary landing pad of the Shrine of Volturn, a humble thing that cycled work crews and deliveries in cycles past.

The structure is not unscarred by the rough transition of this world from under the boot of the Sindrian Diktat. New repairs are few.

A squad of Knights of Ludd now guard this place, and their leader steps forward, examining you somberly. His expression is severe, yet ready - a battle-hardened warrior, clearly.

He is gruffly polite and you are allowed past.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在 Volturn 圣地的主停机坪上 —— 这处朴素的所在，往年轮转着接送工班与补给。

这颗星球从辛达强权的铁蹄下艰难易主，建筑上难免留了些伤痕。新修补的地方却不多。

如今一队卢德骑士团守卫着此地，领队上前，神色凝重地打量你。他神情严峻，却蓄势待发 —— 一望便知是久经沙场的战士。

他礼数粗简，却也客气，放你通行。

texts.en:
Your shuttle drops to the primary landing pad of the Shrine of Volturn, a humble thing that cycled work crews and deliveries in cycles past.

The structure is not unscarred by the rough transition of this world between competing branches of the immortal Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在 Volturn 圣地的主停机坪上 —— 这处朴素的所在，往年轮转着接送工班与补给。

这颗星球在那不朽的辛达强权各派相互争斗间几经易手，建筑上难免留了些伤痕。
