这颗星球在那不朽的辛达强权各派相互争斗间几经易手，建筑上难免留了些伤痕。

texts.en:
The surrounding platforms are pitted and charred by street-level fighting with only makeshift repairs made by the locals who have re-occupied this precious 'dry' ground.

A pair of off-duty laborers eye you fearfully, then duck into the maze of suspended walkways creaking between the extraction rig and surrounding barge structures.

The heavy doors to the shrine - holed by particle beam fire (so you judge from long experience) - stand open enough to permit ingress by foot.
texts.zh:
周围的平台被巷战打得坑坑洼洼、焦黑一片，重新占下这片宝贵'干地'的当地人只草草修补了一番。

两名歇工的劳工怯生生地打量你，随即钻进采掘平台与周边驳船结构之间、吱呀作响的悬空步道迷宫里。

圣地厚重的门被粒子束烧穿了几个洞 (凭多年经验你一眼就认得出)，敞开的缝隙刚好容人步行通过。

texts.en:
The surrounding platforms are pitted and charred by street-level fighting with only makeshift repairs made by the locals who have re-occupied this precious 'dry' ground.

A pair of off-duty laborers eye you fearfully, then duck into the maze of suspended walkways creaking between the extraction rig and surrounding barge structures.

The heavy doors to the shrine - the Luddic and anti-Luddic graffiti makes it clear that this is, in fact, the place - stand open enough to permit ingress by foot.

It's been holed by a particle beam. A light weapon by ship-borne standards, you judge. Something a power-armor squad or light agrav sled could utilize...
texts.zh:
周围的平台被巷战打得坑坑洼洼、焦黑一片，重新占下这片宝贵'干地'的当地人只草草修补了一番。

两名歇工的劳工怯生生地打量你，随即钻进采掘平台与周边驳船结构之间、吱呀作响的悬空步道迷宫里。

圣地厚重的门上，亲卢德与反卢德的涂鸦明白无误地表明：就是这儿了 —— 门敞开的缝隙刚好容人步行通过。

门被一束粒子束打穿了。以舰载武器的标准看，该是件轻武器，你估摸着。动力装甲小队或是轻型反重力雪橇用得上的那种...

texts.en:
The surrounding platforms, pitted and charred by street-level fighting, have seen extensive repair due to generous donations from far-flung bodies of the Church of Galactic Redemption. The locals have been quick to accept this charity, and have re-occupied this precious 'dry' ground. At least those who can fit themselves into the shape of this new Luddic society.

A pair of off-duty laborers eye you as they eat noodles, legs hanging off the suspended walkways creaking between the extraction rig and surrounding barge structures.

The heavy doors to the shrine - holed by particle beam fire (so you judge from long experience) - stand open enough to permit ingress by foot. The damage could have been patched, but perhaps it is seen as an object of contemplation.

Something to do with wrath and martyrdom, perhaps.
texts.zh:
周围的平台曾被巷战打得坑坑洼洼、焦黑一片，如今靠着银河救赎教会四方信众的慷慨捐输，已大修过一番。当地人很快接受了这份善举，重新占下了这片宝贵的'干地' —— 至少，是那些能把自己塞进这新卢德社会模子里的人。

两名歇工的劳工一边吃着面条，一边打量你，腿悬在采掘平台与周边驳船结构之间吱呀作响的悬空步道外晃荡。

圣地厚重的门被粒子束烧穿了几个洞 (凭多年经验你一眼就认得出)，敞开的缝隙刚好容人步行通过。破损本可以补上，但或许人们更愿意留着它，当作一件供人沉思的东西。

大约与神怒和殉道有关吧。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is empty, as lonely as a coffin that never embraced the corpse for which it was constructed.

The receiving hall is pocked and scorched by more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Rusty pools of dank water on the floor mingle with suspicious rusty stains.

It smells of salt and rot and smoke.

An enormous hole opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads, though muffled. Someone's left candles here, though they're cold and dark and have gathered small pools of water inside the divits burnt into the paraffin.
texts.zh: 圣地里空无一人，接待大厅里布满了弹孔与烧蚀的痕迹，很明显这是由武器开火造成的。这里的空气混杂着盐味，烟味，还有一股腐败的味道，地板上阴湿的水坑里混杂着可疑的铁锈色痕迹。

texts.en: A shard from a familiar teapot crunches beneath your boot.
texts.zh: 一个熟悉的茶壶碎片在你脚下嘎吱作响。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is warm and well-lit, and lined with patchwork repairs, the walls a hand-built mosaic of corroded metal, ceramic, and plastic.

After a moment you recognize that it is a mural executed in a palette of rust and ruin, a crudely rendered scene of nature - and there, Ludd, an ambigious figure suggested by a ragged silhouette.

It smells still of salt and smoke, but handweave carpeting softens the receiving hall.

Simon the subcurate greets you with a half-bow and an offering of the briny tea of Volturn.
texts.zh:
圣地的前厅暖意融融，灯火通明，四壁打满补丁，是用锈蚀的金属、陶瓷与塑料手工拼成的一幅镶嵌画。

片刻之后你才认出，那是一幅以锈色与残败为调子绘成的壁画，拙朴地描着一处自然景致 —— 而那儿，是卢德，一个由参差剪影勾出的、模棱两可的身影。

空气里依旧是盐味与烟味，但手工织就的地毯让接待大厅柔和了些。

副助祭 Simon 欠身向你行礼，奉上一杯 Volturn 的咸茶。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is not quite empty, as a humbly-robed subcurate greets you with a half-bow, and a quiet word lost in the distorted susurration of waves and wind.

Your eyes roam over the interior of the receiving hall, noting the pocks and scorch of more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Artfully arranged hull-patch plates form a walkway through the rusty pools of water mingling with suspicious rusty stains.

Under the incense, it smells of salt and smoke. A hint of rot.
texts.zh:
圣地的前厅并不算空，一位衣着朴素谦卑的副助祭欠身相迎，低声说了句什么，淹没在浪涛与风声扭曲的沙沙里。

你的目光扫过接待大厅内里，又留意到更多武器开火留下的弹痕与焦灼。这里要轻些，是手持武器。几块船壳补板被巧妙地铺成一条小径，穿过混着可疑锈色污渍的锈水洼。

熏香底下，是盐味、烟味，还有一丝腐坏的气息。

texts.en:
Curate Sacraria Standfast greets you with tea inside the echoing receiving hall before escorting you down to the inner shrine.

You enter the creaking, humid inspection module at the end of a modified extraction stack where the shrine is housed, against all reason. Crates and racks of weapons and ammunition are piled high, crowding the pilgrims/insurgents. Their unwashed bodies smell of sweat and smoke. They speak and pray quietly.
texts.zh:
在回音袅袅的接待大厅之中，神龛祭司 Standfast 备好茶水接待了你，然后护送你前往内部的 圣地。

尽管这不合常理，你还是进入了圣地。它安置在一个潮湿的探测舱室，位于改良型钻井的末端，嘎吱作响。塞满武器弹药的板条箱和架子高高堆起，朝圣者和义军摩肩接踵。他们安静地交谈和祈祷着，未经清洗的身躯散发着汗水和烟熏的气息。

那圆形的金刚石观察窗，将海洋深处那粉碎性的重压阻隔在外，其下的空地上布置着圣地的核心。一些蜡烛在它们那一排排熄灭的同道之中挣扎着，闪烁出恰到好处的微光。一如既往，用已燃的烛火点亮了另一支，也给你一支让你跟上。

texts.en:
Curate Sacraria Standfast coolly acknowledges your presence. She is armed with a small pistol, politely holstered but with the clasp impolitely loosed.

She is equal parts perplexed and annoyed when you request to see the shrine, but she draws back the dusty curtains for you and stands aside.

The shrine looks as abandoned as ever in this back room. Rows of unlit candles are arrayed around the wooden centerpiece carved with images of Ludd's travails. The place is illuminated only by dim shafts of light let in by grimy portholes.
texts.zh:
神龛祭司 Standfast 冷淡地于此地迎接了你。她随身携带的小型手枪规矩地塞在枪套里，但搭扣却肆意地没有扣上。

当你提出要参拜圣地的时候，困惑与些许厌烦两种情绪同等地浮现在了她的脸上，但她依旧为你拉下了尘封的幕帘，并站到了一旁。

在这间后屋中的圣地，看起来已被遗忘了许久。一排排蜡烛环绕着中心的木雕，其上镌刻着卢德的艰苦历程。烛火早已尽数熄灭，但透过那蒙尘的舷窗，一缕幽光依旧笼罩着这个地方。

texts.en:
You are met outside by a jittery-looking local laborer. Not one of the two, from before.

He puts his hands together and nods at you, watery eyes nervously darting to your bodyguards.
texts.zh:
出来时，一名神色惶惶的本地劳工迎上你。不是先前那两人中的一个。

他双手合十，朝你点了点头，水汪汪的眼睛紧张地在你几名护卫身上打转。

texts.en:
"Was a raid," he says. "The Sindies got some word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache."

He makes a nervous glance over his shoulder, though he seems gain confidence as he revisit what is clearly the source of simmering anger.

"Never saw anything like that, but the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is, Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这儿藏了批武器。"

他紧张地回头瞥了一眼，可一回到这桩显然还憋着火的事上，胆子倒像是壮了些。

"那种东西我从没见过，可辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说当时有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半只是普通行者。"

texts.en:
"Was a raid," he says. "The Sindies got some word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache."

He seems to gain confidence as he revisits a simmering anger.

"Never saw anything like that, but the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is, Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这儿藏了批武器。"

一回到这桩憋着火的事上，他胆子倒像是壮了些。

"那种东西我从没见过，可辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说当时有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半只是普通行者。"

options.zh: 出了什么事？有人逃出来吗？
出了什么事？有人逃出来吗？

texts.en:
"All dead. Must have been quick."

The laborer clutches their hands together again, like some instinct to pray.

"I... I should go, boss. We never met," he turns away, then pauses. "Ludd's peace to you."

The laborer disappears, leaving you and your bodyguards on the charred platform. A cold drizzle begins to fall.
texts.zh:
"全死了。应该没受什么罪。"

劳工又把双手攥在一起，像是出于某种祷告的本能。

"我... 我得走了，老板。咱们没见过面，\" 他转身，又顿住，\"愿卢德赐你平安。"

劳工没了踪影，留你和几名护卫站在焦黑的平台上。冷雨淅淅沥沥落了下来。

texts.en:
The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.

You are keenly aware of the thin envelope of technology protecting you from the ravages of vacuum and radiation.
texts.zh:
返程的穿梭机上一路无事。

你格外清楚地意识到，隔着真空与辐射的肆虐护住你的，不过是薄薄一层技术外壳。

texts.en:
"All dead. Must have been quick."

The laborer clutches their hands together again, like some instinct to pray.

"I... I gotta go, boss." They turn away, and pause to look back. "Ludd's peace to you."

The laborer disappears, leaving you and your bodyguards on the charred platform. A cold drizzle begins to fall.
texts.zh:
"全死了。应该没受什么罪。"

劳工又把双手攥在一起，像是出于某种祷告的本能。

"我... 我得走了，老板。\" 他们转身，又回头望了一眼，\"愿卢德赐你平安。"

劳工没了踪影，留你和几名护卫站在焦黑的平台上。冷雨淅淅沥沥落了下来。

texts.en:
Simon leads you through the shrine, humbly rebuilt in much the same form - and there, the enormous, ragged hole still opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads.

Swarms and schools of small candles gather and flicker along the ragged portal. Prayers and memories of the lost.

Their flames outnumber the visitors who pray or whisper quietly; a few may even be off-worlders, judging by their suits and robes bereft of salt-stain.
texts.zh:
Simon 领你穿过圣地，依旧照着原来的样子谦朴地重建过 —— 而那儿，那个巨大的、边缘参差的窟窿依旧朝着底下幽暗的海敞开。你能听见浪头拍打外壁舱板的声响。

成群成簇的小蜡烛沿着破口聚拢、摇曳。是给逝者的祷词与追忆。

烛火比前来祷告或低声絮语的访客还多；从那一尘不染、不见盐渍的衣袍来看，其中几位说不定还是外世界来的。

texts.en:
You step forward over the plates, and see in the center of the platform's main deck an enormous hole which opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads, though muffled. There is a collection of candles set here, some lit, others are dark, with water collected in the divits burnt into the paraffin.

The subcurate notes your gaze.

"Blessed peace," he says in a rough voice, though softly. "Would you like to light a candle for someone?"

Despite the somewhat threadbare robes of a subcurate, you note that the man could be a laborer, maybe a low-status tech. Weathered face, scarred hands.
texts.zh:
你踩着补板走上前，看见平台主甲板中央有一个巨大的窟窿，朝底下幽暗的海敞开。浪头拍打外壁舱板的声响闷闷地传来。这儿摆着一堆蜡烛，有的亮着，有的熄了，烛泪凝出的小凹里积着水。

副助祭留意到了你的目光。

"愿平安与你同在，\" 他嗓音粗哑，却放得很轻，\"要为谁点一支蜡烛吗？"

副助祭的袍子虽有些寒酸，你却看出这人本可能是个劳工，或是身份低微的技术员。饱经风霜的脸，满是疤痕的手。

texts.en:
"It was a raid," he says. "The Sindies... the occupiers got word, somehow. It's said an informer told them there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬... 那些占领军，不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

texts.en:
"It was a raid," he says. "The Sindies... the occupiers got word, somehow. It's said an informer told them there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬... 那些占领军，不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

options.en: Who are you? Is this the shrine?
Who are you? What happened to the shrine?

texts.en:
"I'm called Simon," he says with a glance at you. "Came back after the committee said things were over. Took care of the place. They gave me a title, robes. Guess I found the calling late in life."

"And that," he kicks a foot forward, "was the shrine."

He's quiet for a moment. But he wants to tell the story.

"As I hear it, the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly regular walkers."
texts.zh:
"我叫 Simon，\" 他看了你一眼，\"委员会宣布事情了结之后，我回来了，照看这地方。他们给了个头衔，一身袍子。大概我这辈子悟道得晚吧。"

"至于那个，\" 他抬脚往前点了点，\"就是圣地了。"

他沉默了片刻。可他想要讲出这段往事。

"我听说是这样，辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半是普通行者。"

texts.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But the whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"Are you looking for someone in particular?"
texts.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

texts.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But the whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"Are you looking for someone in particular?"
texts.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

options.en: A curate sacraria. Who keeps the shrine.
options.zh: 是位司祭，掌管圣龛、看护这处圣地。

options.en: No. I came for the shrine.
options.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。
是那位司祭，Moyra Standfast，掌管圣龛。

options.en: No. I came for the shrine.
options.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

texts.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to contemplating the missing shrine.

"Well, this is it."
texts.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回去凝望那已不复存在的圣地。

"嗯，就这样了。"

texts.en:
Simon takes a deep breath, then kneels by the candles. He selects one, flicking the water away, then replaces the stub to its original position.

An igniter clicks in his hand, and he sets a tiny, wavering flame on the wick. It grows, and he withdraws the igniter.

Two flames.

He snaps it shut with practiced hand, leaving just the candle. Then pauses a moment. And puts his hand out, offering you the igniter.
texts.zh:
Simon 深吸一口气，在蜡烛旁跪下。他挑出一支，弹去积水，又把那截烛头放回原处。

他手里咔哒一声打着了点火器，把一簇细小、摇曳的火苗送上烛芯。火苗长了起来，他便收回点火器。

两簇火光。

他手法熟练地把它啪地合上，只留下那支蜡烛。随后顿了片刻。又把手伸出来，把点火器递给你。

texts.en:
You follow Simon's lead, clearing the seawater out of a likely-looking candle, then clicking the igniter to give it flame; a tenuous flicker of life renewed.

Simon takes the igniter back.

He watches the flames for a moment. and his eyes are brighter than before. He rubs at his face with one scarred hand. Fingers missing.
texts.zh:
你照着 Simon 的样子，把一支看着还合用的蜡烛里的海水清掉，再咔哒一声打着点火器给它续上火；一线微弱摇曳、重又燃起的生机。

Simon 把点火器收了回去。

他望着火光看了片刻，眼神比先前亮了些。他用一只满是疤痕的手抹了抹脸。缺了几根指头。

options.en: It is not just a candle.

texts.en:
"The Pneuma lives in these words," he says quietly.

Then, almost embarassed, he signs a spacer's fare-well ("all-secure, acceleration imminent") and steps back toward the ruined antechamber of the shrine, leaving you to your contemplation.

You feel the muted thrum of the shifting platform through your feet, the barest roll as distant waves make their futile assault against the ruin.
texts.zh:
"圣灵寓于这些字句之中，" 他轻声说道。

接着，他几乎有些窘迫地比了个太空人的告别手势 ("一切安稳，即将加速")，退向圣地破败的前厅，留你独自沉思。

你隔着脚底感到平台移动时低沉的震颤，还有那一丝几不可察的摇晃 —— 远处的浪涛正徒劳地撞击着这片废墟。

texts.en:
He does not answer.

He stares sadly at the lonely, flickering flame.

Then, almost embarassed, he signs a spacer's fare-well ("all-secure, acceleration imminent") and steps back toward the ruined antechamber of the shrine, leaving you to your contemplation.
texts.zh:
他没有作答。

他怔怔地望着那簇孤寂摇曳的火苗，神色黯然。

接着，他几乎有些窘迫地比了个太空人的告别手势 ("一切安稳，即将加速")，退向圣地破败的前厅，留你独自沉思。

texts.en: "It is, though," he says. "For those of us who lived."
texts.zh: "可对我们这些活下来的人来说，它就是，\" 他说道。"

texts.en: Simon makes the igniter disappear and watches the flame for a moment. His eyes are brighter than before, and he rubs at his face with one scarred hand.
texts.zh: Simon 把点火器收得没了影，又望着火苗看了片刻。他的眼神比先前亮了些，用一只满是疤痕的手抹了抹脸。

options.en: It is not just a candle.

texts.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Standfast was her name. Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened, I mean. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution. We've been rebuilding."

He shrugs, hands still held together.
texts.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她叫 Standfast。事发那会儿她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。我是说出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。我们一直在重建。"

他耸了耸肩，双手仍合握在一起。

texts.en: "This is it," he says.
texts.zh: "就这样了，" 他说道。

texts.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened, I mean. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution. We've been rebuilding."

He shrugs, almost sheepish, hands still held together.

"I pray for her."
texts.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。我是说出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。我们一直在重建。"

他耸了耸肩，几乎有些局促，双手仍合握在一起。

"我为她祷告。"

texts.en: "This is it," he says.
texts.zh: "就这样了，" 他说道。

texts.en:
The small shrine's centerpiece is set in an open space under a round diamond-matrix window holding back the crushing depths of the sea. A few candles flicker among the ranks of their dead comrades.

As before, Moyra Standfast re-lights a candle from one that is burning, and offers one for you to do the same.
texts.zh:
小小圣地的中心陈设，安放在一扇圆形钻石矩阵窗下的空处，那窗挡住了深海压得人喘不过气的重压。几支蜡烛在它们已然熄灭的同伴行列间摇曳。

和从前一样，Moyra Standfast 就着一支燃着的蜡烛重新点亮一支，又递给你一支，请你照做。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is empty, as lonely as a coffin that never embraced the corpse for which it was built.

The receiving hall is pocked and scorched by more weapons-fire. Lighter here; handheld arms. Rusty pools of dank water on the floor mingle with suspicious rusty stains. It smells of salt and rot and smoke.

An enormous, ragged hole opens to the dark sea below. Nearly half the underside of this platform must be missing. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads. Someone's left candles here, though they've burnt out and gathered small pools of water inside the divits burnt into the paraffin.
texts.zh:
圣地的前厅空空荡荡，孤寂得像一具棺材，从未迎来它本该盛殓的遗体。

接待大厅里又添了更多武器开火留下的弹痕与焦灼。这里要轻些，是手持武器。地上锈水洼混着可疑的锈色污渍。空气里是盐味、腐味，还有烟味。

一个巨大、边缘参差的窟窿朝着底下幽暗的海敞开。这平台近半的底层怕是都没了。你能听见浪头拍打外壁舱板。有人在这儿留了些蜡烛，只是早已燃尽，烛泪烧出的小凹里积了一汪汪水。

texts.en:
"Was a raid," a voice says.

A muted high pitched keen replies; sonic mapping, and just the barest flicker of barely-visible laser sweep to show that your bodyguards have quickly discovered the source of the voice. A murmur of tactical chatter confirms its owner is unarmed.

A rough-looking laborer, maybe a low-status tech, steps from the shadows. His eyes are cast toward the hole in the floor.

"The Sindies got word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，" 一个声音说道。

一声压低了的尖细蜂鸣回响起来，是声呐测绘；还有一丝几乎看不见的激光扫掠微光，说明你的护卫已经迅速锁定了声源。一阵战术耳语确认来人没有携带武器。

一个形容粗粝的劳工，兴许是个身份低微的技术员，从阴影里走了出来。他的目光落在地上那个窟窿上。

"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

"That," he kicks a foot forward, "was the shrine."

"As I hear it, the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."

options.en: No. I came for the shrine.
options.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。
是那位司祭，Moyra Standfast，掌管圣龛。

options.en: No. I came for the shrine.
options.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

texts.en:
He gives you a look, then turns back to contemplating the missing shrine.

"Well, this is it."
texts.zh:
他看了你一眼，又转回去凝望那已不复存在的圣地。

"嗯，就这样了。"

texts.en:
He gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Standfast was her name. Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution."

He shrugs.
texts.zh:
他看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她叫 Standfast。事发那会儿她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。"

他耸了耸肩。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is not quite empty, as a humbly-robed subcurate greets you with a half-bow, and a quiet word lost in the distorted susurration of waves and wind.

Your eyes roam over the interior of the receiving hall, noting the pocks and scorch of more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Artfully arranged hull-patch plates form a walkway through the rusty pools of water mingling with suspicious rusty stains.

Under the incense, it smells of salt and smoke. A hint of rot.
texts.zh:
圣地的前厅并不算空，一位衣着朴素谦卑的副助祭欠身相迎，低声说了句什么，淹没在浪涛与风声扭曲的沙沙里。

你的目光扫过接待大厅内里，又留意到更多武器开火留下的弹痕与焦灼。这里要轻些，是手持武器。几块船壳补板被巧妙地铺成一条小径，穿过混着可疑锈色污渍的锈水洼。

熏香底下，是盐味、烟味，还有一丝腐坏的气息。

texts.en: A shard from a familiar teapot crunches beneath your boot.
texts.zh: 一个熟悉的茶壶碎片在你脚下嘎吱作响。

texts.en:
You note, as you endure obsequious smalltalk, that the conscripts' equipment is as shabby and ill-maintained as your first visit. The official, however, appears to be wearing a stylish new suit not quite close enough to the official Lion's Guard uniform to attract official reprimand.

Past the checkpoint, you step through the heavy doors to the receiving hall of the shrine. Its emptiness is a welcome change of company.
texts.zh:
当你忍受着阿谀奉承的时候，你注意到征召兵的装备和你第一次来访时一样破旧且保养不善。然而，这名官员却穿着一套时髦的崭新装束，和 狮心卫队 的制服有点相似，却又不至于像到招致官方申诉的地步。

通过检查点之后，你迈步走进了圣地接待大厅那沉重的门扉。这里空空如也，反倒比之前的人群要舒心得多。

texts.en:
The antechamber is lined with patchwork repairs, the walls a hand-built mosaic of corroded metal, ceramic, and plastic.

After a moment you recognize that it is a mural executed in a palette of rust and ruin, a crudely rendered scene of nature - and there, Ludd, an ambigious figure suggested by a ragged silhouette.

It smells still of salt and smoke, but handweave carpeting softens the receiving hall.

A minor subcurate greets you with an offer of the briny tea of Volturn.
texts.zh:
前厅四壁打满补丁，是用锈蚀的金属、陶瓷与塑料手工拼成的一幅镶嵌画。

片刻之后你才认出，那是一幅以锈色与残败为调子绘成的壁画，拙朴地描着一处自然景致 —— 而那儿，是卢德，一个由参差剪影勾出的、模棱两可的身影。

空气里依旧是盐味与烟味，但手工织就的地毯让接待大厅柔和了些。

一名低位副助祭上前相迎，奉上一杯 Volturn 的咸茶。

texts.en:
You are led through the shrine, humbly rebuilt in much the same form - and there, the enormous, ragged hole still opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads.

Swarms and schools of small candles gather and flicker along the ragged portal. Prayers and memories of the lost.
texts.zh:
有人领你穿过圣地，它照着原样谦朴地重建过 —— 而那儿，那个巨大、边缘参差的窟窿依旧朝着底下幽暗的海敞开。你能听见浪头拍打外壁舱板的声响。

成群成簇的小蜡烛沿着破口聚拢、摇曳。是给逝者的祷词与追忆。

options.en: I would like to visit the shrine.
I must visit the shrine. I'm quite devout.
options.zh: 我一定要去圣地朝拜。我十分虔诚。

options.en: Perhaps a donation to local security forces will help?
options.zh: 或许为本地安全机构进行一笔捐赠会有所帮助？

options.en: Explain that you are commissioned by the Sindrian Diktat
options.zh: 解释说你和 辛达强权 之间有雇佣协议

options.en: Explain that you are on a secret mission from the Supreme Executor (lie)
options.zh: 解释说你正在执行最高元首的秘密任务 (说谎)

texts.en:
"I see," the official says, arms crossed. "It pains me to inform you that a visit is... quite impossible."

You reflect that he doesn't sound particularly pained, and it appears to be quite possible if he just let you walk through the doors.
texts.zh:
"我明白了，" 这名官员抱着手臂说到，"我很苦恼地告知您，想要参观是...完全不可能的。"

你思索了一番 —— 他听起来并没有特别苦恼，看起来也完全可以让你直接通过。

texts.en:
"Hrm," the official rubs his hands together, "Your devotion to that quaint religion is not in doubt. It is simply that, ah, the Supreme Executor must be... reassured of the loyalty of the more, more... Luddic members of his empire before he allows them to return here."

The official's eyes are moist, but not from any compassion you can sense, "He yearns to allow free worship, but each time the Lion allows his compassion to guide his judgment it is, is abused." The official opens his hands apologetically.
texts.zh:
"嗯，" 这名军官搓了搓手，"你对这个古雅教派的虔诚毋庸置疑。只不过，呃，最高元首 必须...确认一下，他帝国中越来越多的...卢德成员的忠诚，然后才能允许他们回到这里。"

这名官员双眼湿润，但你感觉那不是因为同情，"他是渴望容许信仰自由的，但每当那位 雄狮 让恻隐之心影响了自己的判断，他的仁慈便会遭到滥用。" 官员抱歉地张开了自己的手。

options.en: If only these people would respect law and order.
options.zh: 要是这些人尊重法律和秩序就好了。

texts.en: "Perhaps it may seem that way," the official says, appearing to examine you for subversive elements. "But it's for the best."
texts.zh: "也许事情看起来是那样，" 官员说到，像在考察你是否有破坏意图，"但这是最好的办法。"

texts.en: "A community must learn, learn together to respect the vision of the Supreme Executor. And once they do, they can rest assured that his glorious plan may proceed- to the benefit of all!"
texts.zh: "全社会必须学习，共同学习贯彻最高元首的伟大愿景。一旦他们做到了，就可高枕无忧，因为他光荣的计划将会推进下去 —— 直至造福万民！"

texts.en: "Indeed," the official says, shaking his head with something unlike sadness.
texts.zh: "的确，" 官员一边说着，一边摇头，但不像是心怀悲伤的样子。

texts.en: "Precisely!" the official says, nodding agreement for you.
texts.zh: "正是如此！"官员一边说着，一边对你点头表示赞同。

texts.en: "Yes, of course!" the official says, nodding.
texts.zh: "当然没错！" 官员说着点了点头。

texts.en:
A datapad appears in the official's hand and he looks, squinting to get a read on you. Are you a plant from internal security, a terrorist infiltrator? The options weigh on his face against his greed.

It's no contest.
texts.zh:
一个数据平板出现在这名官员手中，他看了看平板，眯眼打量着你。到底该认定你为内部安全部的坐探，还是打成恐怖主义渗透者？他心里经历着一番天人交战。

结果毫无疑问。

texts.en:
"Oh, oh oh, it is so difficult. The terrorists strike without warning, at women and children and... oh, I am thankful for the Lion. A lesser man would simply bombard this planet into submission, but the Supreme Executor? These are his children, and he is like a father. But even a father only has s-so many resources at his disposal... why, if we had the credits to purchase better armor for our brave young soldiers," he indicates the smoking conscripts, now having a spitting contest off the side of the landing platform.

"Imagine how their mothers would feel if they were hurt by a terrorist bomb..."
texts.zh:
"唉，唉，唉！世事艰难啊！针对妇女儿童的恐怖袭击突如其来，以及...噢，我真心感谢那位 雄狮。卑劣之徒只会肆无忌惮地轰炸这个行星来镇压我们，但若是 最高元首？他真是爱民如子，待我们如父亲一般。但即便是他也只有这么点物资可供调用...为何如此啊，若我们有更多的星币，来给我们勇武的年轻战士们采购更好的护甲..." 他指着那些吞云吐雾的征召兵们 —— 他们正在停机坪边上举行吐痰大赛。

"想象一下，要是这些战士被恐怖袭击所害，他们的母亲又会作何感想..."

options.en: Heartbroken, I'm sure. I'll be leaving now.
options.zh: 我敢肯定她们会心碎不已。那么，我先走了。

texts.en: "5,000 credits," the official shoots back.
texts.zh: "5,000 星币。" 这名官员开始坐地起价。

options.en: What are you feeding those kids, Volturnian lobster?
options.zh: 你给孩子们吃什么伙食啊，Volturn 蓝龙虾吗？

texts.en: "It's a deal," the official says, excreting a wet smile, offering his datapad for your payment confirmation.
texts.zh: "成交。" 官员一边说着一边挤出了满脸的淫笑，拿出他的数据平板来让你付款。

texts.en:
With the bribe transferred, the official nods and leads you through the security checkpoint while making obsequious smalltalk.

"At attention!" he screams, setting the conscripts into a flurry of activity, dropping narcotic-sticks and grabbing firearms.
texts.zh:
收到贿赂之后，官员点了点头，一边带你通过安检一边美言于你。

"立正！" 他大喊道，引发了一系列慌乱的举动 —— 征召兵们迅速丢下麻醉烟，然后抬起枪。

texts.en: Satisfied, the official gives a wave and the thrum of heavy motors winding up preludes the doors of the shrine cracking open just enough to allow your entrance.
texts.zh: 军官满意地挥了挥手，身后立刻传来了重型马达的轰鸣声；圣地的大门随即开了一条小缝 —— 只够你一人入内。

texts.en:
The receiving hall is empty of pilgrims, and mostly dark. Hand-sewn banners hang limply, their bright colors muted in the gloom. Benches and tables lay empty.

You spot a light through a small doorway. The humble office of the curate sacraria, and within, an old woman asleep behind a pot of tea, still steaming, set out on the desk.
texts.zh:
接待大厅一片漆黑，一个朝圣者的影子都没有。抬头望去，手制的横幅无力地悬挂在上面，靓丽的颜色在昏暗中显得黯淡无光。环视内部，大厅中的桌椅全都空着。

你在一个门缝里看到一束光。在神龛祭司那简陋的办公室里面，一个老妇人正睡着，她身前的桌子上还放着一壶冒着热气的茶。

options.en: Cough, scuff your boot; wake her up unobtrusively
options.zh: 咳嗽出声，把靴子往地上蹭，不着痕迹地叫醒她

options.en: Hello! I'd like the see the shrine!
If the tea is that hot, you can't really be asleep.
options.zh: 茶这么热，你不可能是真的睡着了。

texts.en:
As you step in, she opens her eyes and after getting a good look, withdraws a pistol from where she held it under her mantle of hand-weave and places it in a holster.

"I could hardly shoot someone trying to be so polite about sneaking up on an old woman," she says, examining your uniform.
texts.zh:
当你走进房间正打算叫醒她的时候，她睁开了双眼，从手织的斗篷下抽出手枪，并把它收回了枪套。

"明明是在悄悄靠近我这老太婆，却又表现得这么礼貌，真让我一时不好开枪。" 她一边说着，一边打量着你的制服。

options.en: You seem heavily armed for a curate.
options.zh: 作为一个祭司，你看起来似乎武装的太过严实了。

options.en: I mean, are you part of the Volturn insurgency?
options.zh: 我说，你也是 Volturn 叛乱的一份子吗？

options.en: Are you a member of the Volturn insurgency?
options.zh: 你是 Volturn 叛乱者的一员吗？

options.en: Shouldn't you be talking about blessings?
options.zh: 你不应该讨论一下祝福的事情吗？

options.en: I'm here to see the shrine.
I am a pilgrim come for the shrine.
options.zh: 我是一位朝圣者，前来拜谒圣地。

options.en: I could report you for threatening a commissioned officer of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 对于你威胁 辛达强权 委任军官的行径，我可是能进行举报的。

texts.en: "It's just a pistol," she says. "It's not that heavy."
texts.zh: "也就一把手枪而已。" 她说，"这可不算什么 '严实' 的武装。"

texts.en:
She looks at you for a long moment.

"A long time ago, before... many things, the-one-who-would-be Ludd was hunted by the authorities of the Domain. They had electronic eyes everywhere, and hidden ears. But their multitude of small demons did not find the-one-who-would-be, who was hidden among friends and fellow travelers."

"And do you know why?"
texts.zh:
她目不转睛地盯了你许久。

"很久之前，在...许多事情之前，命定之人卢德曾被 人之领 官方追捕。他们的摄像头和监听器无处不在，但这些小恶魔却没能找到藏身于好友和同道之中的那位命定之人。

"你知道为什么吗？"

texts.en:
"OPSEC," she says, kicking a table-leg, setting the tea-set clattering. "Ludd got betrayed in the end, of course, but what can you do? All good things and so on."

Letting out a sigh, she continues in a voice of spirited obedience: "No, officer, I've never heard of this insurgency. Sounds awful."
texts.zh:
"OPSEC，" 她说着，一边踢了下桌脚，把茶具震得乱响，"的确，卢德最终遭到了背叛，但你又能怎么办呢？正如天下没有不散的宴席。"

长叹一声后，她换上一副充满俯首听命的语气继续道："不，长官，我从未听说过这次叛乱。这听起来糟透了。"

texts.en:
She looks at you for a long moment.

"No, officer. I am armed only to protect the shrine from looters and terrorists. You know how times are. The authority of the Supreme Executor is... stretched thin."

You detect more than a hint of disapproval in her eyes, but she knows when not to speak her mind.
texts.zh:
她目不转睛地盯了你许久。

"不，长官。我携带的武器仅用于保卫圣地不受劫匪和恐怖分子的侵害。您知道时局如何，最高元首 的权威...已经捉襟见肘了。"

你从她眼神中看到的远不止一丝腹诽，但她很清楚何时该缄口不言。

texts.en:
She raises an eyebrow. "I could arrange a blessing if that's what you want."

She dips two fingers in a cup of tea and flings the droplets at you. "Blessed be this pilgrim before me, may they find grace on Ludd's path. May Providence be merciful in hardship, and if not, let them bow their head in humble prayer to their Creator, who made the stars all around, begging forgiveness for their sins, and for guidance on their path."

"There," she drops a hand on the table. "You're blessed."
texts.zh:
她眉头一挑。"如果你想要，我可以安排一场祝福。"

她把两根手指浸入茶水，然后将液滴泼洒向你。"愿我面前的这位朝圣者蒙福，愿他在卢德曾行的道途上寻得恩典。愿他在困苦中得见上天的慈悲，如若不然，愿他谦卑俯首，向那创造群星的造物主祈祷，祈求宽恕他的罪愆，指引他的前路。"

"好了，" 她把手往桌上一放。"你已得祝福。"

texts.en:
"I suppose I could arrange a blessing," she says slowly.

"But the shrine is closed, didn't you hear? It would feel," she pretends to search for the words, "Disloyal."

The woman shrugs, open handed.
texts.zh:
"我觉得我倒是可以给你安排一次祝福。" 她缓缓说到。

"但圣地关闭了，你没听说吗？这未免..." 她假装在斟酌用词，"不太虔诚。"

那妇人摊开双手，耸了耸肩。

texts.en:
The tea is rich with umami. Less vegetal, more briny.

"A humble local variety," the woman says. "Tartessian Brown is hard to come by, what with the occupation."
texts.zh:
这茶鲜甜可口，茶味不浓，海味更重。

"一种普通的本地品种罢了，" 那妇人说到，"自从这里被占领之后，就很难弄到 Tartessus 产的棕茶。"

texts.en:
"Then," she says, "I am here to show you to it."

"Simon?" she says to someone behind you, "You may also put your gun away."

You turn to look and Simon does as she asks, giving you an apologetic little half-salute. The curate smiles, and with open hands shows you the way to the inner shrine.
texts.zh:
"那么，" 她说道，"我就带你去吧。"

"Simon？" 她对你身后的某个人说到，"你也可以放下枪了。"

你转身看去，发现 Simon 照做了，还向你微微致以歉意的半礼。祭司微笑着，张开双手为你展示通往内部圣地的道路。

texts.en: "It is my understanding," she says, "That the musings of your Supreme Executor broadly contradict the precepts of the Church of Galactic Redemption - and the teachings of Ludd in particular."
texts.zh: "据我所知，" 她说道，"你那位最高元首的见解，和 银河救赎教会 的戒律 —— 尤其是卢德的教诲 —— 大相径庭。"

options.en: There is common ground. An emphasis on tradition and family.
options.zh: 也有共通之处，比如对家庭和传统的重视。

options.en: I'm not here for a lecture on theology.
options.zh: 我来这里不是为了听神学演说。

texts.en:
The curate leads you to the back of an entry hall and pulls back a heavy curtain. The metal rings attaching it to a rail above clatter, dropping flakes of rust.

Perhaps this is a shrine of humility?

It is a small thing set in the back of a back room, rows of candles are arrayed around the wooden centerpiece carved with images of Ludd's travails. The candles are all dead, but the place is illuminated by dim shafts of light let in by grimy portholes.

"We do not have many visitors, you see," the curate says.
texts.zh:
祭司带你来到门厅后面，拉开一片帷幕。幕布上方滑轨的铁环哗啦作响，锈斑寸寸剥落。

或许，这里是代表谦卑的圣地？

那是一个小物件，安置在里屋的后方。一排排蜡烛环绕着中心的木雕，其上镌刻着卢德的艰苦历程。烛火早已尽数熄灭，但透过那蒙尘的舷窗，一缕幽光依旧笼罩着这个地方。

"如你所见，这里算是无人问津了。" 祭司说到。

texts.en:
Not quite an hour later, you find yourself at the bottom of the sea, in the Luddic shrine of Volturn. It is a creaking and unnervingly humid inspection module at the end of a modified extraction stack; a metal proboscis thrust into the depths of Volturn.

It is also filled with guns, explosives, grenades, cellmags. Crates and racks are piled high, making the small space more cramped. A small shrine is set in an open space under a round diamond-matrix viewport which holds back a titanic mass of water. A few candles struggle to maintain even a decent flicker among the ranks of their dead comrades.

There are pilgrims here, of a sort. Their unwashed bodies smell of sweat and smoke, they speak and pray quietly. The curate sacraria re-lights a candle from one that is burning, and offers one for you to do the same.
texts.zh:
不到一小时，你已深入海底，抵达 Volturn 的卢德 圣地。那是一个潮湿的探测舱室，位于改良型钻井的末端，嘎吱作响，令人不安，如同刺入 Volturn 深处的长喙。

这里还填满了枪支，炸药，榴弹，弹匣。板条箱和架子高高堆起，让本就狭小的空间愈发拥挤。那圆形的金刚石观察窗，将亿万吨水体阻隔在外，其下的空地上布置着一个小小的圣地。一些蜡烛在它们那一排排熄灭的同道之中挣扎着，闪烁出恰到好处的微光。

这里有一些勉强算是朝圣者的人，他们安静地交谈和祈祷着，未经清洗的身躯散发着汗水和烟熏的气息。神龛祭司用已燃的烛火点亮了另一支，也给你一支让你跟上。

options.en: I sense a note of criticism in your tone.
Why do you insist on being so stubborn and backward? I'm trying to help.
options.zh: 你为何如此顽固不化？我这是在帮你。

options.en: If you accepted the Supreme Executor, it wouldn't have to be like this.
options.zh: 如果你接纳了最高元首，事情就不至于此了。

options.en: If the Church has abandoned you, why stay?
options.zh: 如果教会已经抛弃了你，那又何苦再坚持下去？

options.en: A compromise, then. Private prayer, public support for the Executor.
options.zh: 那看来是一种妥协了。私下里举行祷告，但明面上还是支持首长的。

texts.en:
She looks around, as if for the first time. "It is, isn't it."

"Appropriate, though. Reminds us of our place on this world."
texts.zh:
她环顾四周，一切宛如初见。"的确如此，不是吗。"

"但这样才是恰到好处，可以警醒我们，认清自己在这颗星球上的处境。"

texts.en:
"Oh?" She raises an eyebrow at you. "Oh, alright. Lying is a sin, and redemption must begin somewhere."

She raises her chin and looks at you. "The shrine has been all but stomped out by your Sindrian Diktat. Soldiers and MuniSec harass pilgrims and arrest the faithful, then steal our tithes."

"As long as they leave the shrine untouched, however, the Church is willing to turn the other cheek."
texts.zh:
"哦？" 她对你扬了扬眉毛。"对，是的，谎言是种罪恶，而救赎必须从某处开启。"

她抬起下巴看向了你。"圣地几乎被你们 辛达强权 亵渎了个遍。士兵和地方安全部的人在骚扰朝圣者，逮捕我们的信徒，然后偷走我们的什一税。"

"但是，只要他们不触碰我们的圣地，教会就愿意坐视不管。"

texts.en:
"I will consider your position once I can put that same question to those of my flock that were sent to Cruor," she says.

"Until you can give them back," her eyes are bright with tears, "I will do as I do."
texts.zh:
"只有当我能把同样的问题抛向我那些被送去 Cruor 的教众时，我才会考虑你的立场，" 她说道。

"但直到你把他们还给我之前，" 她的眼里闪着泪光，"我只会一如既往。"

texts.en: "There's a suggestion," she says with false cheer. "We could put one of those holo portraits of Andrada right... here," she waves a hand at the center of the shrine. "Really focus our prayers, do some good."
texts.zh: "我这有个建议。" 她装出欢快的语气，"我们可以把 Andrada 的全息肖像放在...这里。" 她冲着圣地中央挥了挥手，"这么一摆，他那肖像可就有点用了，能让我们祈祷更专注了呢。"

texts.en: "My faith is not the Church," she says fiercely. "And they can defrock and excommunicate me for that if they like, it would change nothing here."
texts.zh: "教会不是我的信仰。" 她言辞激烈，"如果他们愿意，他们可以因此取消我的教会资格，把我逐出教会，但这不会改变任何事情。"

texts.en:
"This," she indicates the decrepit shrine around her, "Is the compromise. As dictated by your Executor."

"Any further, then we shall have left the path of Ludd's teachings entirely. So here I remain."
texts.zh:
"这些。" 她指向她周围破败的圣地，"这就是妥协。都是你的首长的作品。"

"更进一步，我们就完全背离了卢德的教诲。所以我决意在此停留。"

options.en: This seems to confirm your part in the insurgency.
options.zh: 这些军火似乎证实了你和 Volturn 叛乱的关系。
这些军火可真是...令人不安

options.en: Are you part of the Luddic Path?
options.zh: 你是 卢德左径 的一份子吗？

options.en: What does the Church think of your part in this insurgency?
options.zh: 你参与 Volturn 的叛乱这件事，教会怎么看？

options.en: It is not just a candle.
Look out the window for a moment

texts.en: "I've made a believer of you," the curate smiles. "Good."
texts.zh: "看来我让你确信这一点了。" 祭司笑着说，"很好。"

texts.en: The curate frowns. "What troubles you about it?"
texts.zh: 祭司皱起眉头，"这些军火有什么让你不安的？"

options.en: The violence. Is this not a religion of peace?
options.zh: 军火象征暴力，你们 卢德教会 不是崇尚和平吗？

options.en: This is a shrine. Is it not a sacred place?
options.zh: 这里可是圣地啊，这种神圣的地方难道可以拿来放军火吗？

options.en: Lack of heavy weapons. How will you fight armored targets?
options.zh: 都没几件重武器，你们要怎么对付防御精良的敌人呢？

texts.en:
"The book does tell us 'Blessed are the peacemakers', yet," the curate looks at you with hard eyes, "Peace does not make itself."

"Ludd was no war-maker, but Ludd knew when to fight. By self-sacrifice, by martyrdom, did not Ludd deliver victory?"

She waves a hand dismissively. "This is rhetoric to you, perhaps. But to me, it is more simple: I will not let more of my flock be taken to the mines of Cruor as sacrifice to some tin-pot Lucifer."
texts.zh:
"卢德圣书中的确有这样的训诫 —— '缔造和平者当受蒙福'，可是，" 祭司看向你，眼神冷酷，"和平终究不会自己实现。"

"卢德并不好战，但卢德知晓何时该战。通过自我牺牲，通过壮烈殉道作战，难道说，卢德没有带来胜利吗？"

祭司挥了挥手，神情愈发轻蔑："在你看来，我刚刚那一番话，可能只是虚浮之辞；然而，我眼里，这番话的含义可就直白得多了 —— 我可不想再看到我的教众被丢进 Cruor 的矿坑里，沦为劣等魔鬼路西法的祭品。"

texts.en: A smile doubles the wrinkles on her face. "I believe we understand one another."
texts.zh: 祭司微笑着，苍老的脸上登时又添了更多皱纹。"我们可真是心有灵犀。"

texts.en:
"No. Not at all." She gives you a look of some disgust. "I am a curate of the Church of Galactic Redemption. What I do and what they do are very different. I hope, I truly hope, you can see that."

Her gaze turns to the weapons, "I admit, there has been... contact. Each day is a test. I pray we do not stray too far from Ludd."
texts.zh:
"不，我才不是。" 她一边回答一边盯着你，眼神里满是厌恶。"我可是 银河救赎教会 的一名祭司，我的所作所为和他们那帮人可不一样。我希望，我真诚地希望，你能看出其中的差别。"

她眼神一转，又看向了军火，"我承认，我们也...接触过他们。与他们接触的每一天，都是对信仰的一次考验。但愿我们不会偏离卢德之道太远。"

texts.en:
"The Church is not one mind, but the body of many brought together in council," she says. "Some support our work here with zeal, and some are content merely to pray."

A dark look comes over her, "I, however, pray that the united face of the Church might not turn from witnessing our suffering. Ludd wept unblinking, it is said; that the Fathers and Mothers of our Church would do the same."
texts.zh:
"教会并非铁板一块，而是众多个体在议会中凝聚而成的整体，" 她说道，"有些人热忱地支持我们在此地的事业，而有些人则仅仅满足于祈祷。"

黯淡的神色攀上她的面庞，"尽管如此，我仍然祈愿教会那团结的容颜，莫要对我们正在遭受的苦难视而不见。据说卢德落泪的双眼也不曾放弃见证；愿我们教会的神父与教母们亦能如此。"

texts.en:
"So the torch is passed," the curate says. "Light of flame, light of faith."

She gives you a sly look, "Or it's just a candle."
texts.zh:
"就这样，火炬受到了传承。" 祭司说道，"火焰之光，信仰之光。"

她看向你，露出了狡黠的神色，"又或许只是一支小小的蜡烛。"

texts.en:
"The Pneuma lives in these words."

She is staring sadly, you think, at the candles before you.
texts.zh:
"圣灵就活在这些文字之中。"

她凝视着你面前的蜡烛，你感到她的眼神中充满了悲伤。

texts.en:
For once, she does not answer.

She is staring sadly, you think, at the candles before you.
texts.zh:
这一次，她并没有做出回应。

她凝视着你面前的蜡烛，你感到她的眼神中充满了悲伤。

texts.en:
Specks float on blue-black like stars in space in the light cast out into the crushing depths. It is an almost unsettling wrongness from a familiar image. Motes of something or other flick to and fro.

"Life prevails even here, under unthinkable oppression," the curate says. "Let us be thankful, too, for the ingenuity granted to us by Providence," she taps the pressure hull, which resounds dully. "See? We do not hate all technology."
texts.zh:
蓝黑色的海洋之上光影斑驳，如同穹顶之上的璀璨星辰，闪耀的光芒穿过重重阻碍，直至破碎的凶险深渊。此形此景几乎是令人如坐针毡般的离经叛道，违背了熟悉的循规蹈矩。点点微尘在其中忽隐忽现，往返穿梭。

"即使在这里，在难以想象的高压之下，生命仍然能蓬勃绽放。" 祭司说道，"让我们也心怀感激吧，感激上天赐予我们的智慧。" 她轻轻敲打着压力外壳，后者回应以低沉的回响，"看到了吗？我们也并不抵触所有科技。"

texts.en: The curate smiles superficially, then with open hands shows you the way to the inner shrine.
texts.zh: 祭司用微笑掩盖了心中的情绪，随即摊开双手，为你指出了通往内部圣地的道路。

texts.en: "Interesting," she lies. "You'll have to tell me more after appreciating the shrine."
texts.zh: "有意思，" 她敷衍道，"参观完圣地之后，你可得多跟我说说。"

texts.en: "Of course not," she says. "Not my job."
texts.zh: "当然不是了。" 她说，"而且那也不是我的职责。"

texts.en:
"Then," she says, "I am here to show you to it."

"Simon?" she says to someone behind you, "You may also stow your weapon."

You turn to look and Simon does as she asks, giving you an apologetic little half-salute. The curate smiles, and with open hands shows you the way to the inner shrine.
texts.zh:
"那么，" 她说道，"我就带你去吧。"

"Simon？" 她对你身后的某个人说到，"你也可以收起武器了。"

你转身看去，发现 Simon 照做了，还向你微微致以歉意的半礼。祭司微笑着，张开双手为你展示通往内部圣地的道路。

texts.en: "A pilgrim? You?" She looks perplexed.
texts.zh: "朝圣者？你？" 她看起来很迷惑。

texts.en:
"You could," she admits, holding your gaze. "Do it or don't, I'm too old to dance around implied threats."

For the first time, she sips her tea. "I could be having that nap."
texts.zh:
"那就请便，" 她附和道，一边迎上你的目光，"报不报随你，我都这把年纪了，可没精力跟你玩什么含沙射影的把戏。"

自你闯入以来，她首次啄了一口茶，一边继续道："刚才我就该接着打盹的。"

texts.en:
She sighs at your outburst and opens her eyes - she seems too composed to have been truly sleeping - then withdraws the pistol which was held under her hand-weave and places it in a holster.

"I can hardly shoot you for interrupting the nap I wasn't having, now can I," she says.
texts.zh:
察觉到你的突然来访，妇人叹了口气，一边睁开了眼睛 —— 她冷静异常，看来根本没睡。然后，她从手织的斗篷下抽出手枪，并把它插回了枪套。

"我会枪毙那些打扰我小憩的家伙，" 她说道，"只是这次我没在打盹，自然也不好朝你开枪，不是吗？"

texts.en:
As you step to the desk and pour a cup, she lets her eyes open and withdraws a pistol from her hand-weave.

This she places in a holster.

"I'll hardly shoot you for being presumptuous over a cup of tea. So yes, do help yourself."
texts.zh:
正当你走到桌前并倒了杯茶时，她睁开双眼，从手织的斗篷下面抽出手枪 ——

然后，她把枪插回了枪套。

"我可不至于因为你自作主张倒了杯茶就给你来上一枪。没事了，请自便吧。"

texts.en:
She smiles as she withdraws the pistol she was holding beneath her hand-weave, opens her eyes, then places the pistol in a holster.

"Observant. If you're a goon, then I must say you're a higher grade than the usual. How may I serve?"
texts.zh:
妇人微微一笑，一边从手织的斗篷下抽出手枪，她睁开眼，然后把枪插回了枪套。

"还挺敏锐。如果你也是辛达的打手，那你至少比起常见的那种级别高些。有何贵干？"

texts.en: "It's a deal," the official says, excreting a wet smile, offering his datapad for your payment confirmation.
texts.zh: "成交。" 官员一边说着一边挤出了满脸的淫笑，拿出他的数据平板来让你付款。

texts.en: His datapad disappears into his coat. "Responding to such c-comments is beneath my dignity," the official says with little enthusiasm.
texts.zh: 他把数据平板塞回外套，"回应这些...议...议论，简直是侮辱我的尊严。" 他冷冰冰地说道。

texts.en:
A datapad appears in the official's hand and he looks, squinting, between you and it several times.

"M-my humblest apologies, $playerSirOrMadam," the official stutters, "I should have been notified, made preparations," he looks around scattershot until his gaze catches on the conscripts.
texts.zh:
这位官员拿出一个数据平板，他反复抬头在你和数据平板之间来回比较。

"我，我衷心向您道歉，$playerSirOrMadam，" 军官结巴道，"我早该得知并且提前做好准备的，"他左顾右盼，最后盯在了征召兵的身上。

texts.en:
"At attention!" he screams, setting off a flurry of activity, dropping narco-sticks and firearms raised at salute.

"Please, please," the official says, leading you past the now at-attention conscripts and through the checkpoint. As you pass, the official speaks loudly about the respect due to an officer, whether merely in the municipal guard or fighting in the auxiliary fleets.
texts.zh:
"立正！"他大喊到，引发了一系列慌乱的举动 —— 丢下麻醉烟，然后抬起枪，再接着是敬礼。

"您请，您请！" 官员说着，带你走过这些立正的征召兵身旁，穿过了检查站。你走过去的时候，这名官员还在冲他们高谈阔论 —— 下至市政卫队，上至辅助军舰队，无论身处何处都必须尊敬长官云云。

texts.en:
You lean in closer, hardening your expression. The official, confused but intrigued, follows your cue and leans in.

You demand, on his life, to know if he is a true follower of Admiral Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor; The Lion of Sindria; the leader of a great movement to purge degeneration from the system while constructing a new, proud Persean people to populate the Sector.

"Y-yes, of course," he says, trembling.

Then he must let you, a secret agent of the Lion's Guard, perform your mission.

"I'll have to... to confirm..." He starts fumbling for his datapad.
texts.zh:
你靠上前去，神情越发坚毅。这名官员虽然有些困惑，但还是好奇地遵照你暗示靠了过来。

你要他以自己的性命发誓，告诉你他是否真正追随 Philip Andrada 上将，最高元首，辛达瑞亚之狮；那位肃清星域中的堕落，并以骄傲的新英仙人民取而代之的伟大领袖。

"是...是的，当然了。"他颤抖着说到。

那他就必须让你 —— 一名 狮心卫队 的秘密探员 —— 履行自己的使命。

"我必须...必须请示一下..." 他开始胡乱摸索他的数据平板。

options.en: That would be a terrible error.

texts.en:
You put a hand out and firmly lower his datapad while maintaining eye contact.

"That would inform the traitors who have infiltrated," you spit at his feet, "-what passes for local security. I should have you shot."
texts.zh:
维持着四目相接的状态，你伸出一只手稳稳地按住了他的数据平板。

"那只会让已经渗透进来的叛徒知道..." 你冲着他的脚啐了一口，"...你们这些所谓的本地安保都是什么货色。我早应该把你枪毙了。"

texts.en:
"I am loyal, I am loyal!" he shouts, sweat rolling down his face, "I swear it!"

He nearly sobs, suppresses the response, then asks in a small voice, "Is this... a test? Who sent..."
texts.zh:
"我是忠诚的，我是忠诚的！" 他大喊着，冷汗从脸上滑落，"我发誓！"

他几乎是呜咽着把自己的反应压了下去，然后用小声询问道："这是否...是一次考验？敢问是哪位派您来..."

options.en: From the top. The very top. Essential mission. Need-to-know.
options.zh: 是上级的意思，最上级。头等要务。你需要知道的就这么多。

texts.en:
The official pales, then whispers "The Supreme-"

You cut him off by raising a finger.

He nods vigorously, flinging sweat. Blind loyalty fills his eyes.

"Yes. Yes, of course. You need to access... but of course. Taking care of the Luddic problem, the terrorists and- I knew it, I knew there was a plan! I'll tell no one. You can count on me."
texts.zh:
官员脸色一变，悄声道："最高元..."

你竖起一根手指，打断了他的话。

他兴奋地点头，汗如雨下，盲目的忠诚充斥了他的双眼。

"是！明白！您需要通行权限...但当然了，要处理卢德信徒问题，那些恐怖分子和...我就知道，我就知道阁下必有计划！我绝不会泄露分毫，请您相信我！"

texts.en:
The official nods, smooths out his uniform, then turns to the conscripts. "At attention!" he screams, sending them into a flurry of activity, dropping narcotic-sticks and grabbing for firearms.

He then marches proudly toward the shrine entrance, halts with a clack of boot-heel, and pivots - all in passable parade form.
texts.zh:
官员点了点头，理顺他的制服，然后转身面朝征召兵们。"立正！" 他大喊道，引发了一系列慌乱的举动 —— 他们迅速丢下麻醉烟，然后抬起枪。

他之后得意地迈向圣地入口，脚跟咯吱一声停顿，而后旋转。所有这些动作都是按阅兵级别执行的。

texts.en:
You return to your shuttle, taking a final breath of sea-air, the stink of rotten material that's encrusted itself on these platforms still in your nostrils.

The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.
texts.zh:
你回到了你的穿梭机，最后一次呼吸这里的海风。在这些平台上，腐烂的污秽已经开始结垢，恶臭残留在你的鼻腔之中。

搭乘穿梭机返航的过程一切顺利。

options.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
options.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

texts.en:
With the flash of official iconography, instructions are returned from the orbital navigation service which attempts to track the innumerable human-made artifacts of the Volturnian sea - floating habitats, sprawling farm envelopes, transient mining platforms, and even ancient-style seafaring vessels.

Your shuttle pierces the atmosphere in a long descent arc, politely slowing to under the speed of sound as it approaches a bank of thick fog illuminated by Askonia's primary. What at first looks like an ethereal castle is revealed by proximity to be a dismal, jostling accretion of barges parasited to a retired extraction rig.
texts.zh:
随着官方图标的闪烁，轨道导航服务机构传回了指示。该机构同时也致力于搜寻 Volturn 海洋里那无数的人工遗物 —— 浮动栖所，杂乱延伸着的农业舱，临时采矿平台，甚至是古代样式的航海船只。

你的 穿梭机 拖着长长的降落尾迹，穿过了大气层。随着那 Askonia 主星所照亮的浓雾渐渐靠近，你礼貌地将速度降至亚音速。起初你好像见到一座飘渺空灵的城堡，近看才发现是一座阴郁的废弃钻井平台，周边挤满了一大堆寄生虫似的驳船。

texts.en:
With the flash of official iconography, your shuttle route permission is denied by the orbital approach authority.

"With apologies, uh, walker, the Shrine of Volturn is currently in a class-red conflict zone." The official is legitimately apologetic.

"There's been, er, rebel activity and we've had some AA incidents targeting civilian shuttles. We can't let anyone approach until order is re-established."
texts.zh:
随着官方图标一闪，轨道进近管制机构驳回了你的穿梭机航线许可。

"实在抱歉，呃，行者，Volturn 圣地目前处于红色冲突区。" 官员确实满心歉意。

"这边，呃，有叛乱活动，还发生过几起针对民用穿梭机的防空误击。等秩序恢复之前，我们不能放任何人靠近。"

texts.en:
Your shuttle settles on the landing pad and is met by no one.

Rusted mount-points remain where weapons emplacements once loomed.

The small squad of Diktat conscripts that used to garrison this platform have surely been deployed elsewhere, and the official you met probably shot as a turncoat. Unless he was given a promotion and assigned to some new backwater with another squad of conscripts to bully.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在停机坪上，无人前来迎接。

昔日武器阵地耸立的地方，只剩锈迹斑斑的安装基座。

曾经驻守这座平台的那小队辛达强权征召兵，想来已被调往别处；先前见过的那名官员，多半被当作叛徒枪决了。除非他反倒升了官，被派到某个新的穷乡僻壤，再去欺压另一队征召兵。

texts.en:
Your shuttle settles on the landing pad and is met by no one.

Rusted mount-points remain where weapons emplacements once loomed. The Sindrian Diktat must have placed a garrison here.

昔日武器阵地耸立的地方，只剩锈迹斑斑的安装基座。辛达强权必定曾在此驻兵。

texts.en:
Your shuttle settles on the landing pad assigned by the bored local traffic-control officer.

Luddic banners festoon the rusted mount-points where weapons emplacements once loomed - starbursts, coiled ivy, abstract patterns in muted tones.

The combat-tuned sensor suite of your shuttle does detect the giveaway tick-tick of stray radiations from point-defense weapon munitions and power-sources, armed and ready, but tastefully hidden. The Knights are here.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在那名百无聊赖的本地交管员指定的停机坪上。

卢德教会的旗帜挂满了昔日武器阵地耸立处的锈蚀基座 —— 星芒、盘绕的常春藤、色调沉静的抽象纹样。

你穿梭机上那套战斗级传感器，还是捕捉到了点防御武器弹药与供能装置泄漏出的、再熟悉不过的滴滴辐射信号 —— 弹药上膛、蓄势待发，只是藏得颇为雅致。骑士团就在这里。

texts.en:
The surrounding platforms are pitted and charred by street-level fighting with only makeshift repairs made by the locals who have re-occupied this precious 'dry' ground.

A pair of off-duty laborers eye you fearfully, then duck into the maze of suspended walkways creaking between the extraction rig and surrounding barge structures.

The heavy doors to the shrine - holed by particle beam fire (so you judge from long experience) - stand open enough to permit ingress by foot.
texts.zh:
周围的平台被巷战打得坑坑洼洼、焦黑一片，重新占下这片宝贵'干地'的当地人只草草修补了一番。

两名歇工的劳工怯生生地打量你，随即钻进采掘平台与周边驳船结构之间、吱呀作响的悬空步道迷宫里。

圣地厚重的门被粒子束烧穿了几个洞 (凭多年经验你一眼就认得出)，敞开的缝隙刚好容人步行通过。

texts.en:
The surrounding platforms are pitted and charred by street-level fighting with only makeshift repairs made by the locals who have re-occupied this precious 'dry' ground.

A pair of off-duty laborers eye you fearfully, then duck into the maze of suspended walkways creaking between the extraction rig and surrounding barge structures.

The heavy doors to the shrine - the Luddic and anti-Luddic graffiti makes it clear that this is, in fact, the place - stand open enough to permit ingress by foot.

It's been holed by a particle beam. A light weapon by ship-borne standards, you judge. Something a power-armor squad or light agrav sled could utilize...
texts.zh:
周围的平台被巷战打得坑坑洼洼、焦黑一片，重新占下这片宝贵'干地'的当地人只草草修补了一番。

两名歇工的劳工怯生生地打量你，随即钻进采掘平台与周边驳船结构之间、吱呀作响的悬空步道迷宫里。

圣地厚重的门上，亲卢德与反卢德的涂鸦明白无误地表明：就是这儿了 —— 门敞开的缝隙刚好容人步行通过。

门被一束粒子束打穿了。以舰载武器的标准看，该是件轻武器，你估摸着。动力装甲小队或是轻型反重力雪橇用得上的那种...

texts.en:
The surrounding platforms, pitted and charred by street-level fighting, have seen extensive repair due to generous donations from far-flung bodies of the Church of Galactic Redemption. The locals have been quick to accept this charity, and have re-occupied this precious 'dry' ground. At least those who can fit themselves into the shape of this new Luddic society.

A pair of off-duty laborers eye you as they eat noodles, legs hanging off the suspended walkways creaking between the extraction rig and surrounding barge structures.

The heavy doors to the shrine - holed by particle beam fire (so you judge from long experience) - stand open enough to permit ingress by foot. The damage could have been patched, but perhaps it is seen as an object of contemplation.

Something to do with wrath and martyrdom, perhaps.
texts.zh:
周围的平台曾被巷战打得坑坑洼洼、焦黑一片，如今靠着银河救赎教会四方信众的慷慨捐输，已大修过一番。当地人很快接受了这份善举，重新占下了这片宝贵的'干地' —— 至少，是那些能把自己塞进这新卢德社会模子里的人。

两名歇工的劳工一边吃着面条，一边打量你，腿悬在采掘平台与周边驳船结构之间吱呀作响的悬空步道外晃荡。

圣地厚重的门被粒子束烧穿了几个洞 (凭多年经验你一眼就认得出)，敞开的缝隙刚好容人步行通过。破损本可以补上，但或许人们更愿意留着它，当作一件供人沉思的东西。

大约与神怒和殉道有关吧。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is empty, as lonely as a coffin that never embraced the corpse for which it was constructed.

The receiving hall is pocked and scorched by more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Rusty pools of dank water on the floor mingle with suspicious rusty stains.

It smells of salt and rot and smoke.

An enormous hole opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads, though muffled. Someone's left candles here, though they're cold and dark and have gathered small pools of water inside the divits burnt into the paraffin.
texts.zh: 圣地里空无一人，接待大厅里布满了弹孔与烧蚀的痕迹，很明显这是由武器开火造成的。这里的空气混杂着盐味，烟味，还有一股腐败的味道，地板上阴湿的水坑里混杂着可疑的铁锈色痕迹。

texts.en: A shard from a familiar teapot crunches beneath your boot.
texts.zh: 一个熟悉的茶壶碎片在你脚下嘎吱作响。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is warm and well-lit, and lined with patchwork repairs, the walls a hand-built mosaic of corroded metal, ceramic, and plastic.

After a moment you recognize that it is a mural executed in a palette of rust and ruin, a crudely rendered scene of nature - and there, Ludd, an ambigious figure suggested by a ragged silhouette.

It smells still of salt and smoke, but handweave carpeting softens the receiving hall.

Simon the subcurate greets you with a half-bow and an offering of the briny tea of Volturn.
texts.zh:
圣地的前厅暖意融融，灯火通明，四壁打满补丁，是用锈蚀的金属、陶瓷与塑料手工拼成的一幅镶嵌画。

片刻之后你才认出，那是一幅以锈色与残败为调子绘成的壁画，拙朴地描着一处自然景致 —— 而那儿，是卢德，一个由参差剪影勾出的、模棱两可的身影。

空气里依旧是盐味与烟味，但手工织就的地毯让接待大厅柔和了些。

副助祭 Simon 欠身向你行礼，奉上一杯 Volturn 的咸茶。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is not quite empty, as a humbly-robed subcurate greets you with a half-bow, and a quiet word lost in the distorted susurration of waves and wind.

Your eyes roam over the interior of the receiving hall, noting the pocks and scorch of more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Artfully arranged hull-patch plates form a walkway through the rusty pools of water mingling with suspicious rusty stains.

Under the incense, it smells of salt and smoke. A hint of rot.
texts.zh:
圣地的前厅并不算空，一位衣着朴素谦卑的副助祭欠身相迎，低声说了句什么，淹没在浪涛与风声扭曲的沙沙里。

你的目光扫过接待大厅内里，又留意到更多武器开火留下的弹痕与焦灼。这里要轻些，是手持武器。几块船壳补板被巧妙地铺成一条小径，穿过混着可疑锈色污渍的锈水洼。

熏香底下，是盐味、烟味，还有一丝腐坏的气息。

texts.en: A shard from a familiar teapot crunches beneath your boot.
texts.zh: 一个熟悉的茶壶碎片在你脚下嘎吱作响。

texts.en:
You are met outside by a jittery-looking local laborer. Not one of the two, from before.

He puts his hands together and nods at you, watery eyes nervously darting to your bodyguards.
texts.zh:
出来时，一名神色惶惶的本地劳工迎上你。不是先前那两人中的一个。

他双手合十，朝你点了点头，水汪汪的眼睛紧张地在你几名护卫身上打转。

texts.en:
"Was a raid," he says. "The Sindies got some word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache."

He makes a nervous glance over his shoulder, though he seems gain confidence as he revisit what is clearly the source of simmering anger.

"Never saw anything like that, but the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is, Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这儿藏了批武器。"

他紧张地回头瞥了一眼，可一回到这桩显然还憋着火的事上，胆子倒像是壮了些。

"那种东西我从没见过，可辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说当时有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半只是普通行者。"

options.zh: 出了什么事？有人逃出来吗？

options.zh: 出了什么事？有人逃出来吗？

texts.en:
"All dead. Must have been quick."

The laborer clutches their hands together again, like some instinct to pray.

"I... I should go, boss. We never met," he turns away, then pauses. "Ludd's peace to you."

The laborer disappears, leaving you and your bodyguards on the charred platform. A cold drizzle begins to fall.
texts.zh:
"全死了。应该没受什么罪。"

劳工又把双手攥在一起，像是出于某种祷告的本能。

"我... 我得走了，老板。咱们没见过面，\" 他转身，又顿住，\"愿卢德赐你平安。"

劳工没了踪影，留你和几名护卫站在焦黑的平台上。冷雨淅淅沥沥落了下来。

texts.en:
"All dead. Must have been quick."

The laborer clutches their hands together again, like some instinct to pray.

"I... I gotta go, boss." They turn away, and pause to look back. "Ludd's peace to you."

The laborer disappears, leaving you and your bodyguards on the charred platform. A cold drizzle begins to fall.
texts.zh:
"全死了。应该没受什么罪。"

劳工又把双手攥在一起，像是出于某种祷告的本能。

"我... 我得走了，老板。\" 他们转身，又回头望了一眼，\"愿卢德赐你平安。"

劳工没了踪影，留你和几名护卫站在焦黑的平台上。冷雨淅淅沥沥落了下来。

texts.en:
The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.

You are keenly aware of the thin envelope of technology protecting you from the ravages of vacuum and radiation.
texts.zh:
返程的穿梭机上一路无事。

你格外清楚地意识到，隔着真空与辐射的肆虐护住你的，不过是薄薄一层技术外壳。

texts.en:
You step forward over the plates, and see in the center of the platform's main deck an enormous hole which opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads, though muffled. There is a collection of candles set here, some lit, others are dark, with water collected in the divits burnt into the paraffin.

The subcurate notes your gaze.

"Blessed peace," he says in a rough voice, though softly. "Would you like to light a candle for someone?"

Despite the somewhat threadbare robes of a subcurate, you note that the man could be a laborer, maybe a low-status tech. Weathered face, scarred hands.
texts.zh:
你踩着补板走上前，看见平台主甲板中央有一个巨大的窟窿，朝底下幽暗的海敞开。浪头拍打外壁舱板的声响闷闷地传来。这儿摆着一堆蜡烛，有的亮着，有的熄了，烛泪凝出的小凹里积着水。

副助祭留意到了你的目光。

"愿平安与你同在，\" 他嗓音粗哑，却放得很轻，\"要为谁点一支蜡烛吗？"

副助祭的袍子虽有些寒酸，你却看出这人本可能是个劳工，或是身份低微的技术员。饱经风霜的脸，满是疤痕的手。

texts.en:
"It was a raid," he says. "The Sindies... the occupiers got word, somehow. It's said an informer told them there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬... 那些占领军，不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

options.en: Who are you? Is this the shrine?

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

options.en: Who are you? What happened to the shrine?

texts.en:
"I'm called Simon," he says with a glance at you. "Came back after the committee said things were over. Took care of the place. They gave me a title, robes. Guess I found the calling late in life."

"And that," he kicks a foot forward, "was the shrine."

He's quiet for a moment. But he wants to tell the story.

"As I hear it, the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly regular walkers."
texts.zh:
"我叫 Simon，\" 他看了你一眼，\"委员会宣布事情了结之后，我回来了，照看这地方。他们给了个头衔，一身袍子。大概我这辈子悟道得晚吧。"

"至于那个，\" 他抬脚往前点了点，\"就是圣地了。"

他沉默了片刻。可他想要讲出这段往事。

"我听说是这样，辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半是普通行者。"

texts.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But the whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"Are you looking for someone in particular?"
texts.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

options.en: A curate sacraria. Who keeps the shrine.
options.zh: 是位司祭，掌管圣龛、看护这处圣地。

options.en: No. I came for the shrine.
options.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

options.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

texts.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to contemplating the missing shrine.

"Well, this is it."
texts.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回去凝望那已不复存在的圣地。

"嗯，就这样了。"

texts.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Standfast was her name. Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened, I mean. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution. We've been rebuilding."

He shrugs, hands still held together.
texts.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她叫 Standfast。事发那会儿她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。我是说出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。我们一直在重建。"

他耸了耸肩，双手仍合握在一起。

texts.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened, I mean. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution. We've been rebuilding."

He shrugs, almost sheepish, hands still held together.

"I pray for her."
texts.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。我是说出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。我们一直在重建。"

他耸了耸肩，几乎有些局促，双手仍合握在一起。

"我为她祷告。"

texts.en: "This is it," he says.
texts.zh: "就这样了，" 他说道。

texts.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is empty, as lonely as a coffin that never embraced the corpse for which it was built.

The receiving hall is pocked and scorched by more weapons-fire. Lighter here; handheld arms. Rusty pools of dank water on the floor mingle with suspicious rusty stains. It smells of salt and rot and smoke.

An enormous, ragged hole opens to the dark sea below. Nearly half the underside of this platform must be missing. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads. Someone's left candles here, though they've burnt out and gathered small pools of water inside the divits burnt into the paraffin.
texts.zh:
圣地的前厅空空荡荡，孤寂得像一具棺材，从未迎来它本该盛殓的遗体。

接待大厅里又添了更多武器开火留下的弹痕与焦灼。这里要轻些，是手持武器。地上锈水洼混着可疑的锈色污渍。空气里是盐味、腐味，还有烟味。

一个巨大、边缘参差的窟窿朝着底下幽暗的海敞开。这平台近半的底层怕是都没了。你能听见浪头拍打外壁舱板。有人在这儿留了些蜡烛，只是早已燃尽，烛泪烧出的小凹里积了一汪汪水。

texts.en:
"Was a raid," a voice says.

A muted high pitched keen replies; sonic mapping, and just the barest flicker of barely-visible laser sweep to show that your bodyguards have quickly discovered the source of the voice. A murmur of tactical chatter confirms its owner is unarmed.

A rough-looking laborer, maybe a low-status tech, steps from the shadows. His eyes are cast toward the hole in the floor.

"The Sindies got word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
texts.zh:
"是场突袭，" 一个声音说道。

一声压低了的尖细蜂鸣回响起来，是声呐测绘；还有一丝几乎看不见的激光扫掠微光，说明你的护卫已经迅速锁定了声源。一阵战术耳语确认来人没有携带武器。

一个形容粗粝的劳工，兴许是个身份低微的技术员，从阴影里走了出来。他的目光落在地上那个窟窿上。

"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

options.en: Who are you? Is this the shrine?

texts.en:
"I'm called Simon. No one important," he says with a glance at you. "Came back after the committee said things were over."

"That," he kicks a foot forward, "was the shrine."

He's quiet for a moment. But he wants to tell the story.

"As I hear it, the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."
texts.zh:
"我叫 Simon，无名小卒罢了，\" 他瞥了你一眼，\"委员会宣布事情了结之后，我回来了。"

"至于那个，\" 他抬脚往前点了点，\"就是圣地了。"

他沉默了片刻。可他想要讲出这段往事。

"我听说是这样，辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半只是普通行者。"

texts.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But this whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"You looking for someone in particular?"
texts.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

options.en: A curate sacraria. Who keeps the shrine.
options.zh: 是位司祭，掌管圣龛、看护这处圣地。

options.en: No. I came for the shrine.

"Well, this is it."

"Standfast was her name. Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution."

He shrugs.

他看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她叫 Standfast。事发那会儿她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。"

他耸了耸肩。

texts.en: "This is it," he says.
texts.zh: "就这样了，" 他说道。

texts.en:
Simon takes a deep breath, then kneels by the candles. He selects one, flicking the water away, then replaces the stub to its original position.

An igniter clicks in his hand, and he sets a tiny, wavering flame on the wick. It grows, and he withdraws the igniter.

Two flames.

He snaps it shut with practiced hand, leaving just the candle. Then pauses a moment. And puts his hand out, offering you the igniter.
texts.zh:
Simon 深吸一口气，在蜡烛旁跪下。他挑出一支，弹去积水，又把那截烛头放回原处。

他手里咔哒一声打着了点火器，把一簇细小、摇曳的火苗送上烛芯。火苗长了起来，他便收回点火器。

两簇火光。

他手法熟练地把它啪地合上，只留下那支蜡烛。随后顿了片刻。又把手伸出来，把点火器递给你。

texts.en:
You follow Simon's lead, clearing the seawater out of a likely-looking candle, then clicking the igniter to give it flame; a tenuous flicker of life renewed.

Simon takes the igniter back.

He watches the flames for a moment. and his eyes are brighter than before. He rubs at his face with one scarred hand. Fingers missing.
texts.zh:
你照着 Simon 的样子，把一支看着还合用的蜡烛里的海水清掉，再咔哒一声打着点火器给它续上火；一线微弱摇曳、重又燃起的生机。

Simon 把点火器收了回去。

他望着火光看了片刻，眼神比先前亮了些。他用一只满是疤痕的手抹了抹脸。缺了几根指头。

options.en: It is not just a candle.

texts.en: "It is, though," he says. "For those of us who lived."
texts.zh: "可对我们这些活下来的人来说，它就是，\" 他说道。"

texts.en: Simon makes the igniter disappear and watches the flame for a moment. His eyes are brighter than before, and he rubs at his face with one scarred hand.
texts.zh: Simon 把点火器收得没了影，又望着火苗看了片刻。他的眼神比先前亮了些，用一只满是疤痕的手抹了抹脸。

options.en: It is not just a candle.

texts.en:
"The Pneuma lives in these words," he says quietly.

Then, almost embarassed, he signs a spacer's fare-well ("all-secure, acceleration imminent") and steps back toward the ruined antechamber of the shrine, leaving you to your contemplation.

You feel the muted thrum of the shifting platform through your feet, the barest roll as distant waves make their futile assault against the ruin.
texts.zh:
"圣灵寓于这些字句之中，" 他轻声说道。

接着，他几乎有些窘迫地比了个太空人的告别手势 ("一切安稳，即将加速")，退向圣地破败的前厅，留你独自沉思。

你隔着脚底感到平台移动时低沉的震颤，还有那一丝几不可察的摇晃 —— 远处的浪涛正徒劳地撞击着这片废墟。

texts.en:
He does not answer.

He stares sadly at the lonely, flickering flame.

Then, almost embarassed, he signs a spacer's fare-well ("all-secure, acceleration imminent") and steps back toward the ruined antechamber of the shrine, leaving you to your contemplation.
texts.zh:
他没有作答。

他怔怔地望着那簇孤寂摇曳的火苗，神色黯然。

接着，他几乎有些窘迫地比了个太空人的告别手势 ("一切安稳，即将加速")，退向圣地破败的前厅，留你独自沉思。

texts.en:
The shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

"At attention!" the official screams to the conscripts as he comes to greet you, "This is an officer of the Supreme Executor's space auxiliary!"

You endure obsequious smalltalk as he escorts you through the checkpoint and to the heavy doors leading toward the shrine.
texts.zh:
一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

"立正！" 这名官员来接见你时，对着征召兵们大声喊道，"这位是最高元首麾下的太空辅助军！"

你忍耐着他的阿谀奉承，随他通过了检查站，来到了通往圣地的沉重门扉。

texts.en:
The shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

"At attention!" the official screams to the conscripts as he comes to greet you. "I haven't told," he whispers, drawing too close. "And if you need anything, anything, to root out these Luddie terrorists...." he leaves it unsaid, looking for approval in your eyes.

You endure obsequious smalltalk as he escorts you through the checkpoint and to the heavy doors leading toward the shrine.
texts.zh:
一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

"立正！" 这名官员来接见你时，对着征召兵们大声喊道。接着他对你悄声耳语，距离近的有些过头："我刚刚还没说，如果您需要任何东西，任何！来铲除这些卢德恐怖分子..." 他没再继续说下去，只是期望从你眼中看到一丝认可。

你忍耐着他的阿谀奉承，随他通过了检查站，来到了通往圣地的沉重门扉。

texts.en:
A shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

The official produces a trembling facsimile of a smile and looks you up and down.

"A, a pilgrim are you?" he asks unconvincingly. "I'm afraid the shrine is closed today. And tomorrow. Security concerns. The situation has been... unstable."
texts.zh:
一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

这名官员挤出一个像传真画面那样缺乏真实感的笑容，上下打量着你。

"啊，你是个朝圣者？" 他的话听起来没有什么说服力，"恐怕圣地今天，以及明天，都不会开张。这是出于安全考虑，毕竟局势一直...不太稳定。"

The shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

"At attention!" the official screams to the conscripts as he comes to greet you.
