texts.zh: A robed subcurate shuffles to meet you. "Blessings upon you. Your arrival was... unexpected," they say. "But no matter. All who come in good faith are welcome to worship at this shrine."

texts.en: A robed subcurate shuffles to meet you. "Blessings upon you. Your arrival... ah, we expected a larger party of pilgrims," they say, "But no matter; the faith of one is the faith of all."
texts.zh: A robed subcurate shuffles to meet you. "Blessings upon you. Your arrival... ah, we expected a larger party of pilgrims," they say, "But no matter; the faith of one is the faith of all."

texts.en:
At your request, the attending subcurate leads you through a brief ceremonial hand-washing, then down a long gallery.

The flow of the curate's robe doesn't quite touch the floor, a welded field of armored plates weathered into intricate patterns by the varied atmospheres of a score of worlds on which the Knights have fought and died. Niches along the walls are occupied by empty helmets.
texts.zh:
在你的要求下，在场的助理祭司带领你进行了一次简短的净手礼，然后领你沿着长廊走了下去。

祭司长袍拂过地面，那是一片用装甲板焊接而成的战场。每个装甲板都带着不同星球大气侵蚀的痕迹，组成了精致复杂的图案，展示着骑士们奋战至死的印记。沿着而建的壁龛被无数空空如也的头盔填得满满当当。

texts.en: At your request, the attending subcurate leads you through a brief ceremonial hand-washing, then down the gallery floored by welded armored plates. Niches along the walls are occupied by empty helmets.
texts.zh: 在你的要求下，在场的助理祭司带领你进行了一次简短的净手礼，然后领你沿着一条地面由装甲板焊接而成的长廊走了下去。沿着而建的壁龛被无数空空如也的头盔填得满满当当。

texts.en:
The shrine is a grand tomb set in an enormous airshaft. The industrial viscera has been transformed into a baroque sculpture of thousands of edged weapons aligned like feathers of a wing, rays of gleaming serrated metal boldly thrust in killing arcs through the vast space.

In the center, surrounded by a galaxy of flickering candles, lie the lead-lined caskets of a squad of martyred Knights. The manner of their deaths, the subcurate explains in reverent whispers, left their bodies unidentifiable and infused with radioactive material which would kill a direct observer even to this day.

You are left in a prayer-niche to contemplate the horror.
texts.zh:
这座圣地是一座华丽的墓穴，坐落在一个庞大的通风竖井内。曾经脉动的工业肺腑已经被一座巴洛克式的雕塑取而代之。成千上万锋利的兵刃犹如羽翼上的翎毛般齐整排列，钢铁的锋芒闪耀着寒光，错落有致地排出了弧形的杀阵，直指那无边的宇宙。

在那中央，无数烛火犹如银河般闪耀，将一队殉道骑士们的铅衬棺木环绕其中。助理祭司虔诚地低语道，他们的死因导致其遗体无法辨认，渗入的放射性物质时至今日仍会让直接观察的人命丧黄泉。

你留在一座祈祷者壁龛之中，深思着这份恐怖。

texts.en:
In the next niche over, a young knight-initiate gives you a challenging look. His head is freshly shaved; he must be very new to the order.

"You're not a Knight," he says quietly, making a show of looking over your uniform. "Nor one of us. Not really. Why are you here, spacer?"
texts.zh:
在对面的壁龛里，一名年轻入门骑士向你送来一个审视的眼神。他剃发的痕迹还很新鲜，想必才刚刚加入骑士团不久。

"你并非骑士，" 他轻声说道，一边装腔作势地上下打量着你的制服，"也不是我们中的一员，至少不像。你为何来到这里，宇宙民？"

options.en: I came here to perhaps find that out.
options.zh: 我此行或许是为了找到那个答案。

options.en: I am here only to see what is to be seen.
options.zh: 我此行只是为了见我应见之物。

options.en: Despite appearances, I am a pilgrim, young knight.
options.zh: 尽管外表如此，但我是一名朝圣者，年轻的骑士。

options.en: So quick to start a fight? You've only just signed up.
options.zh: 这么着急挑事？你才刚报名入团吧。

options.en: I seek a Path not so different from yours.
options.zh: 我所追寻的那条圣道与你们并无二异。

texts.en: Your introspection seems to throw the initiate off. You can see the thought work across his face- are you making fun of me? But it is quickly dismissed, and you are filed under 'not a threat'.
texts.zh: 你的内省似乎让这位新人不知所措。你可以看到他的想法浮现在了脸上 —— 你在消遣我吗？但这表情很快就收了起来，而你也被划进了 '没有威胁' 的行列里。

texts.en: He nods brusquely, then returns his gaze to the lead coffins. "I'm supposed to contemplate their sacrifice. Horrible way to die, like that. You're a," he glances at your garb again, "spacer, right? Ever seen that happen to anyone?"
texts.zh: 他唐突地点了点头，然后把目光转回铅衬的棺木上。"我应该考虑接受像他们那样的牺牲，像那样可怖的死亡。说起来，你是..." 他又瞥了一眼你的装束，"宇宙民，对吧？以前有见过什么人遭遇这样的事吗？"

texts.en: He stares at you for a moment, then slowly returns his gaze to the radioactive martyrs.
texts.zh: 他盯着你看了一会，随后缓缓地将目光转向了那些辐射缠身的殉道者。

texts.en: Subdued chanting, warped by the strange geometry of this cultic industrial space, blends with the air-cyclers. The candles burn clean and bright, gleaming off the multitude of bladed facets adorning every surface of the shrine's interior, a monument to sacral bloodshed.
texts.zh: 在这尊奉教礼的工业区里，一系列奇形怪状的物体，使那压抑的颂唱声扭曲着，最终融化在空气循环器里。蜡烛的光芒清澈明亮，在那遍布圣地内每一个角落的锋刃饰面上闪耀着，这座纪念堂祭奠着那以神之名所挥洒的鲜血。

texts.en: He nods, satisfied with the belief that it is he who will shield people like you from such horrors, then returns his gaze to the radioactive martyrs.
texts.zh: 他点了点头，坚信自己将会保护像你这样的人免遭这般恐怖。他对此心满意足，接着将目光转向了那些辐射缠身的殉道者。

texts.en: He takes a moment to parse your response. You can see it work across his face- are you making fun of me? But the thought is dismissed, and you are filed under 'not a threat'.
texts.zh: 他花了些许时间来理解你的回复。你能够从他的脸上分明地看出他在思考 —— 你在消遣我吗？不过这个念头很快就被摒弃了，而你也被划进了 '没有威胁' 的行列里。

texts.en: "Right," he sticks his chest out a little more, categorizing you safely within his teleology. "I'm sworn to protect your lot, you know."
texts.zh: "确实，" 他的胸膛稍稍挺起，将你稳妥地划入他那与生俱来的使命之中。"我将立誓守护你的命运，望你知晓。"

texts.en:
"I'm a knight, sworn and-" he catches himself raising his voice, looks nervously to check for shrine attendants, "-and a member of the order. I'll die in service of my sacred duty."

He nods brusquely at the trio of lead-lined coffins at the center of the shrine. "Like they did, if I have to. I'm not scared."
texts.zh:
"我是一名骑士，已经立誓并 ——" 他注意到自己不小心说大声了些，有点紧张地看了一下圣地圣务侍是否在附近，"—— 并成为一名骑士团成员。我愿为了我神圣的职责而献身。"

他对着圣地中央的三口铅制棺材坚定地点了点头。"若有必要，我也将像他们那样。我并不害怕。"

options.en: Nod and make an appropriately serious face
options.zh: 点点头，做出符合时宜的严肃表情

options.en: You should be. That death is hell I would not wish upon my worst enemy.
options.zh: 你最好还是怕一怕。毕竟，就算是我的死对头，我也不想让他经历那种地狱般的死亡。

texts.en:
He seems satisfied, just, with your apparent acceptance of his declaration. Out of the corner of your eye you see him turn back toward the center of the shrine, sigh, and resume what you assume to be an initiation-vigil.

Time will have to test him and tell if he will actually be any good as a Knight of Ludd.
texts.zh:
你仅仅是表面上认可了他的宣言，他看起来就已经满意了。从你眼角的余光可以看到，他转身朝向圣地的中央，叹了一口气，又回到了之前的状态 —— 你猜那可能是入团要做的守夜祈祷之类的。

时间将会考验他，并辨明他是否真的足以担任一名卢德骑士。

texts.en:
You see his jaw clench, and quick anger rise in his posture. You wonder briefly at how the shrine attendants would react to a Knight-initiate assaulting a visitor, but out of the corner of your eye you can see the young man steady himself, then turn and lock his gaze toward the center of the shrine, maintaining control and mumbling prayer.

He may actually have what it takes to become a good Knight of Ludd one day.
texts.zh:
你看到他的下巴绷紧了，愤怒迅速在他姿态中升腾。在这稍纵即逝的片刻，你不由得好奇，圣地的圣务侍们会怎么处置袭击访客的新晋骑士。不过，从你眼角的余光可以看到，这位青年稳住了自己，然后转身凝视着圣地的中央，保持着理智，喃喃自语地祈祷着。

有朝一日，他或许真的会拥有成为一名优秀的卢德骑士所需的品质。

texts.en:
Your grim delivery sinks the thought into the young man. You can see it in his eyes, and his pale scalp; yes, fear.

In that fear, he seems to forget trying to get a rise out of you and locks his gaze toward the center of the shrine, mumbling a prayer.

He might actually have what it takes to become a good Knight of Ludd one day.
texts.zh:
你那冷酷的话语将一缕思绪沉入这个年轻人的心底。你可以看到他眼中的动摇，还有那毫无血色的头皮。没错，是恐惧。

在这份恐惧之中，他看起来已经顾不上招惹你了。他牢牢地凝视着圣地的中央，喃喃自语地祈祷着。

有朝一日，他或许真的会拥有成为一名优秀的卢德骑士所需的品质。

texts.en:
The thought disrupts his expectations, and you can see it in his sudden squint. He looks around, making sure no subcurate is watching, then leans closer.

"What like ...the Path?" he whispers in horrified fascination, "Do you know Brother Cotton?"
texts.zh:
从他那骤然斜视的目光中，你能看出，这个想法出乎他的预料。他环视四周，确保没有助理祭司在看着，然后靠得更近了些。

"像什么样的...卢德之道？" 他惶恐着，却又不失痴迷，悄声低语道，"你知道 Cotton 修士吗？"

options.en: I've met him. His views are... unique.
options.zh: 我见过他。他的观点...很独到。

options.en: I've met him. Brother Cotton is a true visionary.
options.zh: 我见过他。Cotton 修士是一位真正远见卓识的人。

options.en: Yes. He's a snake that puts on a polite mask to charm people.
options.zh: 我知道他。他是条毒蛇，戴着彬彬有礼的面具来诱人上当。

options.en: No. But I'd like to. Then do what must be done.
options.zh: 没有，但我想要见他，然后做该做的事。

options.en: No. I have my own Path to follow.
options.zh: 不，我将追随我自己心中的圣道。

texts.en: The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. "Don't tell anyone, but... I mean, you have to admit what Cotton has done is cunning and brave. The... the Creator gave him gifts, and he uses them."
texts.zh: 这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩。"别告诉任何人，不过...我是说，你不得不承认 Cotton 的行动堪称智勇双全。而...造物主赐予他的天赋，他发挥得淋漓尽致。"

texts.en:
A troubled look passes over his face. "The Knights, sometimes it seems like they are more interested in making rules for the sake of rules instead of fighting evil."

With a sigh, the initiate returns his gaze toward the radioactive martyrs.
texts.zh:
他脸上闪过苦恼的神色，"那些骑士大人们，有些时候比起打击邪恶，他们看起来更喜欢为了规则而制定规则。"

随着一声叹息，新人将目光转向了那些辐射缠身的殉道者。

texts.en:
The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. "Don't tell anyone, but... I would like to meet him too. Maybe join him."

He glances guiltily toward the shrine-attendants. "Maybe."
texts.zh:
这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩。"别告诉任何人，不过...我也想见他一面。或许，还会加入他。"

他怀着愧疚瞥了一眼圣地的圣务侍，继续道："或许吧。"

texts.en:
The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. And troubled.

"But... the things he does, I mean," the young man visibly struggles between what he feels and what he has been told. "Maybe he goes too far, but at least he tries, you know?"
texts.zh:
这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩，但也十分困扰。

"但是...他的所作所为，我是说，" 这个年轻人很明显在自己的感受和别人的说法之间挣扎着，"也许他做的太过分了，但至少他在努力，你也明白的吧？"

texts.en: The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. "Don't tell anyone, but... I would like to meet him. Hear what he had to say. Maybe join up."
texts.zh: 这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩。"别告诉任何人，不过...我也想见他一面，听听他要说些什么，或许还会加入他的队伍。"

texts.en:
The initiate nods in response, but is unsure now of your outlook.

"I mean, say what you will about Cotton," he glances guiltily toward the shrine attendants, "He fights for what he believes. At least."
texts.zh:
新人虽然点头回应，但他现在对你的观点有些犹豫。

"我的意思是，你大可以说出自己对 Cotton 的看法，" 他怀着愧疚瞥了一眼圣地的圣务侍，"但至少，他在为自己的信仰而战。"

texts.en:
The shrine is a grand tomb set in an enormous airshaft. The industrial viscera has been transformed into a baroque sculpture of thousands of edged weapons aligned like feathers of a wing, rays of gleaming serrated metal boldly thrust in killing arcs through the vast space.

In the middle, surrounded by a galaxy of flickering candles, lie the lead-lined caskets of a squad of martyred Knights. The manner of their deaths, the subcurate explains in reverent whispers, left their bodies unidentifiable and infused with radioactive material which would kill a direct observer even to this day.
texts.zh:
这座圣地是一座华丽的墓穴，坐落在一个庞大的通风竖井内。曾经脉动的工业肺腑已经被一座巴洛克式的雕塑取而代之。成千上万锋利的兵刃犹如羽翼上的翎毛般齐整排列，钢铁的锋芒闪耀着寒光，错落有致地排出了弧形的杀阵，直指那无边的宇宙。

在那中央，无数烛火犹如银河般闪耀，将一队殉道骑士们的铅衬棺木环绕其中。助理祭司虔诚地低语道，他们的死因导致其遗体无法辨认，渗入的放射性物质时至今日仍会让直接观察的人命丧黄泉。

texts.en:
Subdued chanting, warped by the strange geometry of this cultic industrial space, blends with the air-cyclers. The candles burn clean and bright, gleaming off the multitude of bladed facets adorning every surface of the shrine's interior, a monument to sacral bloodshed.

You are left in a prayer-niche to contemplate the horror.
texts.zh:
在这尊奉教礼的工业区里，低沉的颂唱声被奇异的几何形体所扭曲，融入了空气循环。蜡烛的光芒清澈明亮，在那遍布圣地内每一个角落的锋刃饰面上闪耀着，这座纪念堂祭奠着那以神之名所挥洒的鲜血。

你留在一座祈祷者壁龛之中，深思着这份恐怖。

texts.en: Traffic control gives you its blessing, so to speak, and your shuttle begins its descent to the cold and unforgiving surface of Hesperus.
texts.zh: 说出来你自己都不信，交通管制居然祝福了你，随后，你的穿梭机开始向 Hesperus 冰冷无情的地表降落。

texts.en:
The planet is riven by glaciers like a network of scars on the battered hide of a fossilized monster.

The flight path takes your shuttle into a great canyon of canyons filled with a chaos of ice and stone. The shuttle banks into an off-branch; the ridges of dark rock loom larger.

Now and again you spot the crumbling remains of industry, and among them the occasional lights of a Knight-chartered enterprise or monastic community.
texts.zh:
这颗星球被冰川切割得四分五裂，如同一头石制野兽，疤痕在它那伤痕累累的毛皮上勾连成网。

你的跟随着导航飞入了一个巨大的峡谷中，冰块和岩石凌乱地堆砌着。穿梭机倾斜着飞进峡谷的一条岔路，隐约间，你感觉黑色巨石构成的山脊愈加巨大。

你隐约间看见残破不堪的工业遗迹中，骑士特批企业和隐修社区的灯火正在闪烁。

options.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
options.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

options.en: Secretly take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
options.zh: 秘密搭乘穿梭机去拜访卢德圣地

texts.en:
A well-timed plume of radiation from nearby Daedaleon gives your shuttle cover to sneak through the local traffic control's sensor net.

Your shuttle begins its descent to the cold and unforgiving surface of Hesperus.
texts.zh:
一股辐射羽流从附近的 Daedaleon 如期而至，掩护你的穿梭机躲过了当地交通管制的传感器网络。

你的穿梭机开始向 Hesperus 冰冷无情的地表降落。

texts.en:
You are just beginning to make your way toward the shuttle bay when you receive a ping from your nav officer: the request to land has been denied by traffic control.

Strange. This should be perfectly routine.
texts.zh:
你刚刚开始前往穿梭机停泊港便收到了你领航军官的消息：着陆请求被交通管制中心拒绝了。

奇怪。这请求再普通不过了。

options.en: Request to speak with someone in authority

texts.en:
You put in the order to have a shuttle prepared for a flight to the surface.

"Captain," your Nav officer reports, "Traffic control is denying your flight request."
texts.zh:
你下令让一艘穿梭机做好飞往地面的准备。

"舰长，" 你的领航军官汇报道，"交通管制处否决了你的飞行请求。"

options.en: Get me the Excubitor Orbis on comms.

texts.en:
You put in the order to have a shuttle prepared for a flight to the surface.

"Captain," your Nav officer reports, "Traffic control is denying your flight request."
texts.zh:
你下令让一艘穿梭机做好飞往地面的准备。

"舰长，" 你的领航军官汇报道，"交通管制处否决了你的飞行请求。"

options.en: Get me the Excubitor Orbis on comms.

texts.en: Nav routes your comm-link to the local system network, and after what feels like a longer than necessary wait, the link finally establishes a connection.
texts.zh: 领航员将你的通讯链接路由到本地的系统网络中，在经过一段感觉上超出必要等待所需的时间后，连接终于被建立。

texts.en:
"Affirmative," Nav says. A moments pause. "Captain, I have traffic control on comms."

Nav patches you into the comm-loop, and a young-looking Luddic Knight, probably an initiate, appears before you.
texts.zh:
"好的，" 领航员说到。片刻过后。"舰长，我已经接通了交通管制中心。"

领航员将你接入到通讯回路中，一个看起来很年轻的卢德骑士，可能是个新人，出现在了你的面前。

texts.en: Nav patches you into the link, and a young-looking Luddic Knight - or maybe an initiate - appears before you.
texts.zh: 领航员将你接入链接，然后一个看起来很年轻的卢德骑士 —— 或者是个新人 —— 出现在你的面前。

texts.en:
"Blessed for the day, Captain," they just manage to hide the quaver in their voice. "With apologies, your request to land has been denied."

As you draw breath to reply, the initiate's eyes flick to a notification and go wide.

"Apologies, Captain ... I mean, respectfully. I... the Excubitor Orbis wishes to speak with you," they say without stumbling on the title. Practice, you're sure.

"Transferring link."
texts.zh:
"愿卢德保佑你，舰长。" 他们成功地藏住了他们声音中的颤抖，"十分抱歉，你的着陆请求被拒绝了。"

你吸了一口气，正准备回复，这个新人瞧了一眼通知然后瞪大了他的眼睛。

"抱歉，舰长... 我的意思是，尊敬的。我想说... 行星教卫想要和你通话。" 他们在念头衔的时候倒是十分流利。练过，你很确信。

"正在转接。"

texts.en:
The Excubitor Orbis appears before you.

"Captain $playerName," he says by way of greeting, a stern gaze already fixed on you.

The moment draws longer. He is the image of poise, perfectly content to wait for you to speak. A wrinkle appears, then disappears, by a mouth which appears fixed permanently on the precipice of a frown.
texts.zh:
行星教卫出现在了你的面前。

"$playerName 舰长。" 他以问候的语气说道，同时严肃地盯着你。

时间的流逝仿佛变慢了。他就好像是沉着的化身，全然沉浸于对你的等待之中。嘴角的皱纹若隐若现，像是被永远困在了成型的边缘不断徘徊。

options.en: Why was my travel request denied?
options.zh: 为什么我的航行请求被拒绝了？

options.en: I demand to know why my request was denied!
options.zh: 我要求得知为什么我的请求被拒绝了！

texts.en:
The silence extends, uncomfortably. He blinks, slowly.

He's really doing this. Some kind of test, or challenge. Are you going to let him win?

He isn't giving up. He continues to stare, absurdly, saying nothing. You notice the subtlest flicker in the image as the display corrects for signal fluctuation.
texts.zh:
令人不快的死寂延续着，他缓缓地眨了眨眼。

他居然真的在这么做，像是某种测试或者挑战。你要把胜利拱手相让吗？

他锲而不舍，他一言不发，继续荒唐地盯着。你注意到显示器校正信号波动时，图像产生了些许闪烁。

texts.en: You've played this game before, with Gargoyle. You know how to win. Stay strong.
texts.zh: 你以前就和 Gargoyle 玩过这个游戏，你知道该怎么赢 —— 坚持不懈。

options.en: Why was my travel request denied?
options.zh: 为什么我的航行请求被拒绝了？

options.en: I demand to know why my request was denied!
options.zh: 我要求得知为什么我的请求被拒绝了！

texts.en:
The hum of your ship grows in your ears, the sense of inhabiting your own body in a can hurtling around a gravity well, the incomprehensible webs of influence keeping you both in this place and in the constant dynamism of crisis.

Lower and higher dimensions twist and vibrate, a web conspiring to hold you up - or back - falling and clinging just so. Your technologies tap these invisible quirks of physics to keep you warm, keep you cool; your feet on the deck, the air flowing follow a rhythm, a meter. It is like music, in fact. If you listen carefully...

It would be impossible to speak, now.
texts.zh:
飞船的轰鸣在你耳中不断回响放大，让你意识到自己正身处于一个围绕重力井飞驰的铁罐头中。引力犹如无数无边的大网，让你困入动力持续变动的危局之中，滞留于此。

高低维度互相交织震荡着，一同合谋将你网住，当你即将下坠时将你举起，在你意欲爬升时把你拖住。你身边的各种科技仿佛在有节奏地敲打着种种无形的物理异象，使你保持温暖，让你脚踏实地，令空气保持循环，一切都充满了韵律。其实这犹如乐曲，只要你仔细去聆听...

此刻，难以言述。

texts.en:
You almost jump as the Excubitor Orbis speaks, pulling you back to the moment.

"You possess patience," he says. A new wrinkle appears beside his mouth; what passes for a smile among the Knights of Ludd, you suppose.

"I did not expect it of you."

You've won. Is this victory? It is an uncomfortable feeling.
texts.zh:
行星教卫突然开口，差点吓了你一跳，也将你的思绪拉回现实。

"你很有耐心。" 他说。他的嘴角边又浮现出一抹皱纹；你猜测这在卢德骑士团里可能算是一种笑容吧。

"我没料到你会有如此耐心。"

你赢了。但这真的算得上是胜利吗？这种感觉让你一阵不舒服。

texts.en:
"I ordered your landing request denied," he states plainly. "The protection of this world is my duty."

"I find that those with a history of exceptional acts oft test the charity of Providence by taking exceptional risks."
texts.zh:
"我下令拒绝了你的降落请求，"他开门见山地说道，"保护这个世界是我的职责。"

"我发现那些有着非凡过往的人经常冒着巨大风险来试探上天的慈悲。"

options.en: So I need to convince you that I am not a risk?
options.zh: 所以我需要让你相信我不是一个风险？

options.en: Are you accusing me of criminal intent?
options.zh: 你在指控我拥有犯罪倾向吗？

options.en:
Just tell me how many credits I need to 'tithe'.
#lpp_hesperusExcubitorForce:"With my fleet, how can you stop me?"
options.zh:
告诉我需要缴纳多少 '什一税' 就好。
#lpp_hesperusExcubitorForce:"你要怎样阻止我和我的舰队？"

texts.en:
That wrinkle again, the Sector's smallest smile.

"Spend not your time in this life on folly; even our youngest initiate could see that you wear risk like a badge. The secular procedures at hand are only part of my purview," he says.

"At present I am more concerned with your spirit."
texts.zh:
那个皱纹 —— 或者也可以说是全星域最微弱的笑容 —— 又一次浮现出来。

"奉劝你，此生莫要行愚蠢之事。纵使我等最年轻的新教友也可看出，你危险常伴，有如勋章在身。手头的那些红尘琐事，毕竟只是我职责的冰山一角。" 他说道。

"此时此刻，我更关注你心中的真意。"

texts.en:
That wrinkle again, the Sector's smallest smile.

"Yes, I am quite certain that you have committed many crimes. Secular justice is only part of my purview however," he says gravely.

"Today I am more concerned with your spirit."
texts.zh:
那个皱纹 —— 或者也可以说是全星域最微弱的笑容 —— 又一次浮现出来。

他严肃地说道："的确，我十分肯定，你犯下了诸多罪行。然而，世俗正义不过是我职责的冰山一角。"

"今日，我更关注你心中的真意。"

texts.en:
That wrinkle again, the Sector's smallest smile.

"How debased is our devotion that you would think saying those words would open the path before you."

"And," he continues, "How debased is your spiritual being that you would think to indulge it."
texts.zh:
那个皱纹 —— 或者也可以说是全星域最微弱的笑容 —— 又一次浮现出来。

"我等的奉献是何其卑贱，以至于让你认为那番话语就可为你开通前路。"

"而至于你，" 他继续道，"你的精神又是何其堕落，才会想着沉溺于此。"

texts.en: He drops a heavy hand like a gavel on his desk. "I am uninterested in more words. Listen well now, for I speak my judgment on this matter."
texts.zh: 他像落下拍卖锤一般重重地拍了一下桌子。"我不想再听下去了。现在，好好听我对这件事的判断吧。"

texts.en:
"Your reputation is suspect, captain. I cannot in good conscience allow you access to our shrine," the Excubitor Orbis says. "Find yourself redemption. If you manage to find some degree of it, then we may discuss the matter again."

"Seek virtue, captain," he says by way of farewell.
texts.zh:
"你的恶名让人产生怀疑，舰长。我不能问心无愧地让你访问我们的圣地。" 行星教卫说到，"为你自己寻找救赎吧。如果你能多少找到一些，那我们可以再讨论一下这件事。"

"求善，舰长。" 他以告别的语气说到。

options.en: How about we talk about redemption now.
options.zh: 不如我们现在就谈谈救赎吧。

texts.en:
A long pause.

"I shall order traffic control to give you permission to land, captain," the Excubitor Orbis says finally. "May your spirit find that for which it searches."
texts.zh:
通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。

"我会让交通管制中心给予你降落许可，舰长。" 行星教卫终于开口，"愿你的灵魂能寻找到它所追寻之物。"

texts.en:
"I shall review your request in seven days," the Excubitor Orbis says. "If that is enough for Creation, it will be enough for you to learn patience."

That wrinkle again.

"Blessings be, captain."
texts.zh:
"我将在七天之内审核你的请求，" 行星教卫说到。"如果这时间足够创造天地万物，那么也足够让你学习到耐心。"

他脸上再次浮现出充满褶皱的笑。

"愿你蒙福，舰长。"

texts.en: You have a meeting scheduled with a Mammonite to talk with a third party who might know something about Jethro Bornanew, but it is not yet the agreed upon time.
texts.zh: 你有一个日程安排，准备同一个玛门之仆一起，和某位可能了解 Jethro Bornanew 的人会面。但现在还没到约定的时间。

texts.en: You work your way through the spacers, buying drinks and talking shop. Dropping some good-natured but pointed complaints about the humorless Church-operated customs regime gets you on the right path, and soon enough you find yourself in a smoky escape shaft behind the bar talking to a tech in the local port bureaucracy.
texts.zh: 你开始从宇宙民中寻找门路，和他们一起谈天说地，买酒请客。在对古板的教会海关规程尖锐而中肯地吐槽了几句之后，你马上就摸到了门道。很快，在你反应过来之前，你就已经置身于酒吧后面一个烟雾缭绕的逃生井里，和一位当地港口机构的技术人员攀谈了起来。

options.en: Feel out the possibility of a bribe
options.zh: 试探是否存在行贿的可能

texts.en:
"People like us, just gotta keep our heads down. Pray in public, yeah, live your own life on the quiet, you know?"

They take a drag from a black market drug stick. "Say what you will about the Excubitor Orbis, at least he takes mercy and forgiveness as seriously as he takes all those other 'knightly virtues'."

Between complaints about Luddic society you get the understanding that for 2,000 credits an unauthorized shuttle flight to the shrine of Hesperus could be tagged by a helpful nonbeliever as a regular pilgrim transport.
texts.zh:
"像我们这样的人，就得低着脑袋过活。公开场合得虔诚一点，是啊，私下里自己的日子还是该咋过咋过，你懂吧？"

他们抽了一口黑市毒烟卷，继续道："不管你对行星教卫有几个意见，至少他对待怜悯和宽恕的态度也和他对其他那些 '骑士美德' 一样严肃。"

夹杂在各种对卢德教居民的抱怨和牢骚里，你打听到只要花 2,000 星币就能让一个有能耐的无信者把一趟未经授权前往 Hesperus 的穿梭机飞行计划标记为朝圣者定期运输航班。

texts.en:
"People like us, just gotta keep our heads down. Pray in public, yeah, live your own life on the quiet, you know?"

They take a drag from a black market drug stick. "Say what you will about the Excubitor Orbis, at least he takes mercy and forgiveness as seriously as he takes all those other 'knightly virtues'."

Between complaints about Luddic society you get the understanding that for 2,000 credits an unauthorized shuttle flight to the shrine of Hesperus could be tagged by a helpful nonbeliever as a regular pilgrim transport.
texts.zh:
"像我们这样的人，就得低着脑袋过活。公开场合得虔诚一点，是啊，私下里自己的日子还是该咋过咋过，你懂吧？"

他们抽了一口黑市毒烟卷，继续道："不管你对行星教卫有几个意见，至少他对待怜悯和宽恕的态度也和他对其他那些 '骑士美德' 一样严肃。"

夹杂在各种对卢德教居民的抱怨和牢骚里，你打听到只要花 2,000 星币就能让一个有能耐的无信者把一趟未经授权前往 Hesperus 的穿梭机飞行计划标记为朝圣者定期运输航班。

texts.en: You leave the bar and take a shuttle back to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh: 你离开酒吧，乘坐穿梭机回到了你的$shipOrFleet当中。

texts.en:
You make the arrangements and transfer the credits.

True to their word, the nonbeliever tags your shuttle with the ID for a regular pilgrim transport service.

Your shuttle begins its descent to the cold and unforgiving surface of Hesperus.
texts.zh:
你安排妥当并付了星币。

按照承诺，这个不信奉卢德教派的交通管制处人员把你的穿梭机用朝圣者定期运输航班的 ID 进行了标记。

你的穿梭机开始向 Hesperus 冰冷无情的地表降落。

texts.en:
As you step out of the bar, you find yourself shoved roughly against the corridor wall. The augmented brute holds an ugly little palm-cannon in your face.

"What's yer interest in Jason Korin, spacey?"

His breath is foul.

"Start spillin' or your head'll return to orbit minus yer hull."
texts.zh:
你刚走出酒吧，就被人粗暴地按在走廊墙上。那个改造过的壮汉把一具丑陋的小手炮顶在你脸上。

"你打听 Jason Korin 干什么，太空佬？"

他的口气臭得刺鼻。

"开始吐实话，不然你的脑袋就得脱离舰体、独自回轨道去。"

texts.en:
Your guards manage to return you to your $shipOrFleet before pointed inquiries from the local security apparatus flood the comms buffer.

Besides, you've discovered that Pericles is dead. Someone got to him first and got away without giving Maeus his revenge. He's grasping for someone to blame and found you.
texts.zh:
你的保镖赶在当地治安部门的尖锐质询涌满通讯缓冲区之前，把你送回了你的 $shipOrFleet。

再说，你已经查明 Pericles 死了。有人先你一步找到他，又全身而退，没给 Maeus 报仇的机会。他急着找个人来担罪，就找到了你。

texts.en:
It is a testament to their training that they manage to get you back to your $shipOrFleet before the pointed inquiry from the local security apparatus appears in your comms buffer.

Besides, you've discovered that Pericles is dead. Someone got to him first and got away without giving Maeus a chance for revenge. He was grasping for someone to blame - you - but you settled the matter before he could return to his fleet.
texts.zh:
他们赶在当地治安部门的尖锐质询出现在你通讯缓冲区之前，把你送回了 $shipOrFleet——这足见他们训练有素。

再说，你已经查明 Pericles 死了。有人先你一步找到他，又全身而退，没给 Maeus 报仇的机会。他当时急着找个替罪的人——就是你——可还没等他回到自己的舰队，你就把这件事了结了。

texts.en:
As you step out of the bar a young spacer, suit, rig and all, steps forward.

"Captain $PlayerLastName? Uh..."

The movements of your bodyguards, though subtle, makes it clear they have weapons trained on the kid. She doesn't even notice.
texts.zh:
你刚走出酒吧，一个年轻的女太空客就迎上前来，太空服、装具一概齐全。

"$PlayerLastName 舰长？呃..."

你的保镖动作细微，却明白无误地表明武器已对准这姑娘。她压根没察觉。

options.en: Prepare your sidearm, then step through the door
options.zh: 准备好你的随身武器，然后穿过这扇门

options.en: Call your bodyguards, then step through the door
options.zh: 叫上你的护卫，然后穿过这扇门

options.en: Let your bodyguards do their work
You cannot begin to comprehend the depths of your error, friend.
options.zh: 朋友，你根本想象不到自己错得有多深。

options.en: I'd like to talk to him. Do you know where I can find him?
options.zh: 我想跟他谈谈。你知道上哪儿能找到他？

options.en: If you want a job, the answer is no.
options.zh: 你要是想找活干，答案是不行。

options.en: If you want a job, the answer is yes.
options.zh: 你要是想找活干，答案是可以。

texts.en:
Sharp, low words are exchanged between your kidnappers - and muffled cursing from beside you. Sounds like the Mammonite.

You're pretty sure you're not as worse for the drink as he is. Pretty sure. Hard to tell with your head in a bag.
texts.zh:
你的绑架者们之间交换着尖锐、低沉的话语 —— 还有从你身边传来的低沉的咒骂声。听起来像是玛门之仆。

你很确定你不会像他一样喝得那么醉。非常确定。不过头被套在布袋里，实在是不好判断。

options.en: Draw your sarm. Side-arm, tha'sit. Draw your sidearm.
options.zh: 拔仓，啊对，木仓，拔出你的佩枪。

texts.en:
A gunshot, barely muffled by the sack on your head, claps your eardrums.

You don't hear the Mammonite cursing anymore. The cold shock of dread sobers you.
texts.zh:
一声枪响，几乎被你头上的布袋掩盖，击中了你的耳膜。

你再也听不到玛门之仆的咒骂了，冰冷的恐惧使你战栗。

texts.en:
More low talking. You're dragged a short distance, then lifted to your feet.

"We should speak, face to face. You- let the good $playerBrotherOrSister see."

The hood comes off.
texts.zh:
更多的低语声。你被拖拽了一小段距离，然后被架着站了起来。

"我们应该面对面谈谈。你 —— 摘了这位好$playerBrotherOrSister的头套。"

头套被摘下了。

texts.en:
"Been told you've been asking questions," the man says with a cheap smile. A tooth is missing, another cracked to a point. He smells of mildew, and sweat.

"I'm Sedge." He graciously waves a hand to show you the dismal alley you find yourself in, toward the slumped form sitting in a puddle of its own blood. "Welcome to my Path."
texts.zh:
"有人说你一直在问问题。" 男人带着假笑说道。他的一颗牙丢了，另一颗裂了。身上还带着霉味和汗味。

"我是 Sedge。" 他优雅地挥挥手，向你展示了一下身处的这条阴暗小巷，和一个倒在自己血泊中的尸体，"欢迎走上我的道途。"

options.en: I'm looking for a man called Jethro Bornanew.
options.zh: 我在找一个名叫 Jethro Bornanew 的男人。

options.en: Show a picture of Jethro Bornanew, "Recognize him?"
options.zh: 展示一张 Jethro Bornanew 的照片，"认识他吗？"

options.en: You can't just drink people's tea.
options.zh: 你不能拿起别人的茶就喝。

options.en: Signal for something stronger from the proprietor.
They're afraid. So might-makes-right and terror rules. You think this is righteous?
options.zh: 他们害怕。所以强者为王，恐怖统治。你觉得这是正义吗？

options.en: They respect you. Because you are willing to do what needs to be done.
options.zh: 他们尊重你。因为你愿意做该做的事。

options.en: How can you murder a man in cold blood and think yourself righteous?
options.zh: 你怎能冷酷无情地谋杀一个人并自诩正义？

options.en: You murder because you feel like its right? That's insane.
options.zh: 因为你觉得这是对的就进行谋杀？这太疯狂了。

options.en: What you say about faith alone, not deeds, it... makes sense.
options.zh: 你说的只存信仰，无关行为，这...有道理。

options.en: You do what you want and think faith makes it good? That's insane.
options.zh: 你想做什么就做什么，然后觉得有信仰一切就会好起来？这是疯了。

options.en: What you say about following faith alone, it... makes sense.
options.zh: 你说的只需追随信仰，这...有道理。

texts.en:
"That?" Sedge looks down, as if at a stone on the ground.

"That got careless. That forgot that one does not speak easily of the Path. The Path is sacred. It does not belong in the mouth of a decadent heathen."

His eyes flick downward again, "Like that."
texts.zh:
"他？" Sedge 垂下眼睛，像在看地上的石块。

"他没有谨言慎行。他忘了他不可妄言圣道。卢德之道如此圣洁，怎可出于堕落异端之口。"

他的眼睛又向下撇了一下，"就像他。"

options.en: That led me to you. Will you shoot me as well?
options.zh: 他带我来的。你也要向我开枪么？

options.en: Yes, you did him a mercy.
options.zh: 是的，你对他算是仁慈了。

texts.en: "No." He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
texts.zh: "不。" 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

texts.en: "Yes." He smiles again. "But, $playerBrotherOrSister, you would not find what you're looking for."
texts.zh: "是的。" 他又笑了。"但是，$playerBrotherOrSister，你不会找到你想找的东西的。"

texts.en: "Yes." He smiles again. "But, $playerBrotherOrSister, you would not find what you're looking for."
texts.zh: "是的。" 他又笑了。"但是，$playerBrotherOrSister，你不会找到你想找的东西的。"

texts.en: He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
texts.zh: 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

texts.en: He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
texts.zh: 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

texts.en:
He makes an expression of mock confusion. "I just said. I am Sedge."

He drops the look. "But you want to know who I am to the Path. Who I am to this world, to people who might come here. Who I am to you. Who am I to what you are looking for."

He corrects himself, holding up a finger, "Whom you are looking for."
texts.zh:
他困惑的表情带着点嘲讽。"我刚才已经说过了。我就是 Sedge。"

他收起那副表情。"但你想知道我对于左径来说是谁。对于这个世界，对于将要来到这里的人们来说是谁。对你来说是谁。对你正在找的东西来说是谁。"

他竖起一根手指，自我纠正道，"是你正在寻找的人。"

texts.en:
"Is that what I am?" He pauses a moment, then nods, "It is more, people find me. Those who seek the Path."

The mask of casual ease draws away to show you the ice-cold, self-assured fervor in his eyes. "I judge if their path leads true. If it does," he shrugs; merely the casual business of building an interstellar network of terrorism.
texts.zh:
"这就是我的身份吗？" 他顿了顿，然后点点头，"不止如此，那些希望加入左径的人会来找我。"

他脸上随意轻松的面具被揭下，显露出他眼中冰冷的、自信的狂热。"我负责判断他们的意图是否真实。如果确实如此的话..." 他耸了耸肩，仿佛自己只是在处理组建星际恐怖主义网络这等寻常事务。

texts.en: "Mm." Sedge looks away, making a show of thinking it over, turning your cup - his now - over and over in his hands. "No, I do not recall a Jethro."
texts.zh: "嗯。" Sedge 看向远方，做出努力回想的样子，把你的杯子 —— 现在是他的了 —— 拿在手里翻来覆去。"不，我不记得任何叫 Jethro 的人。"

texts.en:
"Mm." Sedge looks away, making a show of thinking it over. "No, do not recall a Jethro."

The pooling blood is caught by a small stream of run-off and begins to wash a red streak down the alley.
texts.zh:
"嗯。" Sedge 转过头，像是在想这事。"不，没想到哪个叫 Jethro 的。"

血泊汇聚成小股径流，在巷子里流淌出红色的纹路。

texts.en: You draw out your TriPad and activate the Jethro Bornanew file. There is a holo from before he left.
texts.zh: 你掏出 TriPad，打开了 Jethro Bornanew 的档案。里面有一张他离开前的全息影像。

texts.en: You slowly draw your TriPad and activate the Jethro Bornanew file. There is a holo from before he left.
texts.zh: 你谨慎地掏出 TriPad，打开了 Jethro Bornanew 的档案。里面有一张他离开前的全息影像。

texts.en:
Sedge leans over to examine it.

"Ah." He speaks without hesitation, "Yes, I remember now. He went to Mazalot."
texts.zh:
Sedge 探身过来查看。

"啊。" 他毫不犹疑地说道，"对，我现在想起来了，他去了 Mazalot。"

texts.en:
Sedge considers his words for a moment. Sucking spittle through his tooth-gap.

"That man, his faith is true." Sedge swishes again. "But he... did not know his Path."
texts.zh:
Sedge 斟酌了一会，从牙缝里吸着气。

"那个男人，他的信仰坚定虔诚。" Sedge 低声说道，"但是他...没有领悟到他的道途。"

texts.en:
Sedge stands back suddenly, looking away down the alley.

"That a man could believe, truly, and not know his Path? I did not like to see that. I told him he had no place with us."

He speaks without meeting your eyes, "I was told he worked for a time, then bought passage to Mazalot."

"I hope they see what I saw, too. That... he is unfit."
texts.zh:
Sedge 突然后退一步，看向小巷另一边。

"是那个信仰坚定虔诚，但却没领悟到自己道途的男人？那时我不太待见这种人。我和他说过，他和我们不是同路人。"

他说话时没有看你的眼睛，"我听说他工作了一段时间，然后凑够钱去了 Mazalot。"

"我相信那边的人的看法应该和我的一样。就是...他不合适。"

texts.en:
Sedge stands, suddenly, a look of concern on his face.

"That a man could believe, truly, and not know his Path? I did not like to see that. I told him, he had no place with us."

"I was told he worked for a time, then bought passage to Mazalot," he says. "I hope they see what I saw, too. That he is unfit."
texts.zh:
Sedge 突然站了起来，脸上多了一丝关切的神色。

"是那个信仰坚定虔诚，但却没领悟到自己道途的男人？那时我不太待见这种人。我和他说过，他和我们不是同路人。"

"我听说他工作了一段时间，然后凑够钱去了 Mazalot。" 他说，"我相信那边的人的看法应该和我的一样。他不合适。"

texts.en:
You would swear that Sedge is upset.

"No more questions," he spits. "We are done."

He walks away.
texts.zh:
你发誓，Sedge 分明是生气了。

"别再问了，" 他啐道，"我们到此为止。"

他转身走开了。

texts.en: You spot your sidearm on the ground, next to the Mammonite's cooling body.
texts.zh: 你瞟到你的随身武器落在地上，旁边就是玛门之仆冰凉的尸体。

options.en: Grab your sidearm and shoot Sedge in the back
options.zh: 拿起你的随身武器并在 Sedge 背后射击他
从背后向 Sedge 射击

options.en: Have one of your guards shoot him in the back
options.zh: 让你的一名警卫在他背后射击他

texts.en:
The proprietor, who was pretending to polish a samovar, releases an audible sigh of relief before giving you an accusing look. You suspect service will not be enthusiastic for you in this establishment in the future.

You have a lead: Mazalot.
texts.zh:
之前一直在假装擦洗茶具的店主这时发出了一声如释重负的叹息，并用责备的眼神瞪了你一眼。你估计以后再也没法在这享受到什么热情的服务了。

不过你有了条线索：Mazalot

texts.en:
Sedge disappears down a side-alley, and his thugs with him. You are left in the dripping alley with a corpse.

And a lead: Mazalot.
texts.zh:
Sedge 消失在小巷另一头，他的手下和他一起走了，留下你和一具尸体。

还有一条线索：Mazalot

texts.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the small space, a sharp crack that rattles ceramicware.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

There are shouts and screams from patrons. Chaos, and flight. The room empties out, the proprietor ducks behind the bar.
texts.zh:
你拔枪射击。枪声在狭小的空间中回荡，尖锐的声音震得瓷器嗡嗡作响。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

顾客们发出尖叫声。一片混乱，人们纷纷逃离。房间里空荡荡的，老板躲在吧台后面。

texts.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the small space, a sharp crack that rattles ceramicware.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

The proprietor ducks behind the bar and scrabbles out some back door.
texts.zh:
你拔枪射击。枪声在狭小的空间中回荡，尖锐的声音震得瓷器嗡嗡作响。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

老板翻身躲进吧台，从后门爬了出去。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
His sightless eyes stare up at a paper lantern slowly spinning in the rafters, casting a warm and murky light.

He is smiling. And dead.
texts.zh:
他无神的双眼盯着一个在屋檐上慢慢旋转的纸灯笼，倒映着温暖而朦胧的光。

他在笑。他死了。

texts.en:
His sightless eyes stare up at a translucent awning, rain spatter distorting a murky light.

He is smiling. And dead.
texts.zh:
他无神的双眼凝视着半透明的雨篷，雨点扭曲了模糊的光线。

他在笑。他死了。

texts.en:
You leave his body to return to your $shipOrFleet. The Path will know what to do with it.

They are sure to come after you, if they weren't before.
texts.zh:
你丢下了他的尸体，径直返回了你的$shipOrFleet。左径自然知道该怎么处理。

他们肯定会来追寻你的下落了，即便他们此前还没动手的话。

texts.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the alley, a sharp crack.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

Silence follows the echoing shot, broken only by retreating footsteps as his thugs flee the scene.
texts.zh:
你拔枪射击。尖锐的枪声在小巷中回荡。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

回响之后，唯有他手下逃离的脚步声打破了沉默。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
You speak a sharp word into your comms and within seconds an echoing crack shoots down the alley.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

His thugs disappear. Tactical chatter from your guards - equipped with the best - tracks their flight from the spot.
texts.zh:
你对着通讯器说了个词，数秒后，一声巨响在小巷中回荡。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

他的手下消失了。你装备精良的保镖们说着战术术语，追踪着他们的逃跑路线。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
"Why say such a thing? It is done," Sedge says.

"Maybe you want it back?" He smiles.
texts.zh:
"为何说这种话？这事早过去了。" Sedge 说道。

"也许你想我把茶吐出来？" 他露出微笑。

texts.en:
"I can because I do," he says. The smile sublimes away like ice in vacuum.

"I see you don't understand, spacer."

He keeps his gaze pinned on you as he swipes his hand across the table, sending cup and teapot flying to smash against a neighboring drinking-party. They raise a shout of offense.
texts.zh:
"我能，因为我正在这么做，" 他说道，脸上的笑容如同真空中的冰一般升华消散了。

"我看你是不明白，太空佬。"

他一边将目光死死锁在你身上，一边挥手扫过桌面，将茶杯和茶壶扫飞，砸在了邻近的几个酒徒桌上。他们发出愤怒的喊叫声。

texts.en:
A scrape of chairs on floor, and the shouts are quickly hushed by the outraged party's companions. Conversation dies in the room, and everyone at nearby tables takes in the situation. Upon seeing Sedge, they start to quietly file out of the teahouse.

Soon, you are left nearly alone.

Sedge moves his hand through a slow arc, a mockery of blessing, to indicate those who left the room, "They understand."

Another pot of tea and two new cups appear, the proprietor quickly retreating with a crunch of ceramic underfoot.
texts.zh:
在一阵椅子与地板的摩擦声后，那伙怒汉的喊叫声很快就被他们的同伴制止了。房间里顿时没了声音，附近桌子上的每个人都在打量着这一切。在看到 Sedge 后，他们开始一声不吭地涌出了茶馆。

很快，你几乎被独自一人地留在了这里。

Sedge 的手缓缓划过一道弧线，模仿着做出祝福的样子，指向那些离开的人，"而他们明白。"

又一壶茶和两个新杯子被端了上来，店主随即踩着陶瓷碎片迅速退了下去。

texts.en:
You signal the proprietor, who glances at the back of Sedge's head with a questioning look- really? With him right there? You confirm your order with a firm nod.

Soon enough the teapot arrives, smelling of liquor. Two cups are almost dropped and the proprietor retreats.

Sedge watches the whole procedure with his crooked smile, sets the two cups in place, fills them from the pot. He lifts his cup and looks at you expectantly.
texts.zh:
你向老板示意，他用询问的眼神瞥了一眼 Sedge 的后脑勺 —— 真的吗？他就在那里？你肯定地点了点头，确认了要点的东西。

很快，一壶茶就被端上来了，散发着酒香。两只杯子几乎是被扔到了吧台上，老板随即退了下去。

Sedge 歪着头微笑着看着整个过程，他把两个杯子放好，把它们倒满了茶。他举起杯子，期待地看着你。

options.en: Are you allowed to drink this?

texts.en:
"And may we recognize truth on the Path of Providence," he adds, "and not turn away."

Then he downs the spirit.
texts.zh:
"愿我们行在卢德之道，得蒙真理。" 他补充道，"不偏左右。"

然后他一口干掉了那杯烈酒。

texts.en: "God will forgive me," he says, giving the cup a waggle.
texts.zh: "主会恕我的罪。" 他摇晃着杯子说。

texts.en:
"May we recognize truth on the Path of Providence," he says, "and not turn away."

Then he downs the spirit.
texts.zh:
"愿我们行在卢德之道，得蒙真理。" 他补充道，"不偏左右。"

然后他一口干掉了那杯烈酒。

texts.en:
Sedge shakes his head, "You understand nothing. Mammon and Moloch live in your heart and in your mind."

"Righteousness is not a scale to be weighed, good deed against evil. Humanity is a being of sin, cursed by the desecration of the Garden of Earth. Nothing will save you but to follow the Path. It is faith that I follow, it is faith that shows me the way, it is faith alone that is salvation."

"I do as I do because I follow the Path. The true Path ends in Heaven. Faith reveals this."
texts.zh:
Sedge 摇了摇头，"蒙昧无知。恶魔玛门和摩洛克存于你心中，存于你思想之中。"

"公义与否不取决于其施行手段，而取决于行善还是行恶。人是有罪的，因亵渎了地球的神圣花园而担了罪孽。唯有走上圣道才能得救。信此道引领我，信此道启示我，唯此道是我的救主。"

"我行我应行之事，因我谨守卢德之道。这道途真实，通向应许的天堂。信的人便明白。"

texts.en:
Sedge nods. "I have what they do not: faith in the Path. I follow where it leads without fear, without question. Faith alone reveals the righteous Path.

"True faith terrifies the faithless." He leans back, his look softening. He is not boastful, but absolutely earnest. "You see how these little spacers, the Hegemony, the Church-liars, all of them; how they fear us."
texts.zh:
Sedge 点点头。"我有他们没有的东西：对卢德之道的信仰。我遵循此道的指引，既无恐惧，也无疑虑。唯此信仰可揭示正义之道。"

"真正信仰将使不信者惧怕。"他向后靠了靠，神情变得柔和了。他不是在自夸，但却十分真诚。"你看看这些小船员，霸主，教会的骗子们，他们所有人；看他们是多么惧怕我们。"

texts.en: Sedge's eyes narrow at you. "You say, to kill a man is not righteous? You don't know that Mammonite. I do. But," Sedge grunts, "I need not explain my path to you. God will judge."
texts.zh: Sedge 眯起眼睛看着你。"你说，杀人是不正义的？你不了解那个玛门之仆。我了解。但是，" Sedge咕哝道，"我无需向你解释我的道途。神会审判我。"

options.en: I expect some worldly authority will judge you, and not well.
options.zh: 我希望某些世俗权威会审判你，并且不会有好的结果。

options.en: How much blood must you spill to be allowed into Heaven?
options.zh: 你要流多少血才能被允许进入天堂？

options.en: What good deeds of yours outweigh such casual murder?
options.zh: 你有什么善举能抵消这种随意的谋杀？

options.en: You killed an evil man? Then I spoke too soon.
options.zh: 你杀了一个邪恶的人？那我话讲早了。

texts.en: Sedge shrugs. "My path will end. Not today, I think."
texts.zh: Sedge 耸了耸肩。"我的道途将会走到尽头，但不是今天，我想。"

texts.en:
Sedge shakes his head, "You don't understand. You think that way? It shows you worship Mammon and Moloch in your heart and you don't know it."

"Righteousness is not a scale to be weighed, good deed against evil. Humanity is a being of sin, cursed by the desecration of the Garden of Earth. Nothing will save you but to follow the Path. It is faith that I follow, it is faith that shows me the way, it is faith alone that is salvation."

"I do as I do because I follow the Path, not because I think I can buy-," he pauses to spit toward the slumped corpse, "-my way into Heaven."
texts.zh:
Sedge 摇了摇头，"你不明白。你是这样想的吗？这说明你在心中崇尚着恶魔玛门和摩洛克而不自知。"

"公义不可被衡量，行善业可拒邪恶。人是有罪的，因亵渎了地球的神圣花园而担了罪孽。唯有走上圣道才能得救。信此道引领我，信此道启示我，唯此道是我的救主。"

"我行我应行之事，因我谨守卢德之道，而不是我觉得我能买到 ——" 他停顿了一下，向倒在地上的尸体啐了一口，"—— 买到通往天堂的路。"

texts.en: Sedge nods. "My Path crossed his, and his was to end."
texts.zh: Sedge 点点头。"我道途与他的交错，而他的道途走到了尽头。"

texts.en: "It is a good thing you are not God," Sedge cracks a new smile, "Because then I would be in big trouble."
texts.zh: "幸好你不是神。" Sedge 又露出一个微笑，"因为那样我就有大麻烦了。"

texts.en:
"Sense is not faith," Sedge says, correcting you. "But maybe you are still finding the Path."

He pauses, then adds, "Maybe we talk more someday, $playerBrotherOrSister, after your business with me."
texts.zh:
"理性不是信仰。" Sedge 纠正道，"但也许你仍在探寻圣道。"

他停顿了一下，然后补充道，"也许我们下次再聊，$playerBrotherOrSister，在这单生意之后。"

texts.en: You fumble for your sidearm, and find your holster empty. They must have grabbed it.
texts.zh: 你摸索着你的随身武器，发现枪套是空的。一定是被他们拿走了。

texts.en:
You step through the door.

Daylight, a rare gap in the storms, washes our your vision for a moment.
texts.zh:
你走出了门。

阳光，风暴间难得的间隙，使你的视野暂时清晰开阔。

texts.en: A gunshot claps your eardrums.
texts.zh: 一声震耳欲聋的枪声响起。

texts.en:
Almost without thinking, you fall to the side to remove yourself from a potential sweep of fire. Tactical chatter whispers in your ear; calm tones. No one is aiming a weapon at you, but your bodyguards can drop anyone nearby at a word.

The closest shape is a shadow; a figure; a man. Not aiming anything at you. Looking at you, hands open and raised part-way.
texts.zh:
你几乎本能地扑倒向一旁来躲避可能的扫射。耳旁响起战术口令，非常冷静的口吻。没有人用武器瞄准着你，但只要你一声令下保镖就可以干掉在场的任何人。

离你最近的形状的是一个影子；一个身影；一个男人。他没有用任何东西瞄准着你。他看着你，打开的双手半举着。

texts.en: Almost without thinking, you fall to the side with your sidearm raised and ready at the closest shape - a shadow; a figure; a man. Not aiming at you. Looking at you, hands open and raised part-way.
texts.zh: 几乎没有思考，你扑倒在一旁，举起随身武器对准了最近的身影 —— 一个影子；一个轮廓；一个男人。他没有拿武器对着你，而是看着你，打开的双手半举着。

texts.en: Almost without thinking, you fall to the side to remove yourself from a potential sweep of fire. The closest shape before you is a shadow; a figure; a man. Not aiming at you. Looking at you, hands open and raised part-way.
texts.zh: 几乎没有思考，你扑倒在一旁来躲避可能的射击。离你最近的身影的是一个影子；一个轮廓；一个男人。他没有拿武器对着你，而是看着你，打开的双手半举着。

texts.en:
"Been told you've been asking questions," the man says with a cheap smile. A tooth is missing, another cracked to a point. He smells of mildew, and sweat.

"I'm Sedge." He graciously waves a hand to show you the dismal alley you find yourself in, toward the slumped Mammonite sitting in a puddle of their own blood. "Welcome to my Path."
texts.zh:
"有人说你一直在问问题。" 男人带着假笑说道。他的一颗牙丢了，另一颗裂了。身上还带着霉味和汗味。

"我是 Sedge。" 他优雅地挥挥手，向你展示了一下身处的这条阴暗小巷，和玛门之仆倒在自己血泊中的身影，"欢迎走上我的道途。"

texts.en: You unholster your sidearm, check its status, and hold it close but readied.
texts.zh: 你拔出了你的随身武器，检查了其状态，并将其紧握身边，随时警惕着。

texts.en: You give a quiet order to your bodyguards to circle around to your position, confident in their ability to take control of the situation with their specialized training and equipment.
texts.zh: 你悄悄地命令你的保镖围绕你散开，相信他们的专业训练和装备让他们有能力控制局面。

texts.en: "Well?" Another shove, for emphasis. "You'd b-"
texts.zh: "怎么着？\"又是一推，算是强调。\"你最好给——"

texts.en:
The goon's eyes roll up as the stun-pulse hits him. The shock crumples his powerful body like the foil of a cheap stellar shade struck by an asteroid.

The proximity of the effect leaves your teeth itching. Two of your bodyguards cover firing angles as the third bags the goon for interrogation.
texts.zh:
晕眩脉冲击中那打手时，他两眼上翻。电流的冲击把他壮硕的身躯折成一团，像被小行星砸中的廉价星帆薄片。

距离太近，那股余效让你牙根发酸。两名保镖封住射界，第三名把打手捆起来拖走，准备审问。

texts.en:
Someone watching the exchange made a break for it, your guards report in clipped tactical jargon. Ducked around a corner, unclear if involved.

It wouldn't do to start assaulting bystanders, so you must let them go. But It's good odds that someone smarter than this unconscious brute knows he failed.
texts.zh:
有人在旁看着这一切，趁机跑了——保镖用简短的战术行话回报。那人拐过墙角，是否有关尚不清楚。

当街殴打路人不成体统，你只能放他走。不过，比这昏过去的莽汉更聪明的某个家伙，多半已经知道他失手了。

texts.en:
You flip a fractional credit to the underboss watching the port concourse as your guards haul the goon into your shuttle.

They give a nod, and pointedly turn their back and make a casual remark to their underlings. The semiofficial brutes get the message: nothing to see here.
texts.zh:
保镖把打手拖进穿梭机时，你朝那个盯着港口大厅的副头目弹了一枚零头星币。

他点了点头，刻意转过身去，随口对手下说了句什么。那些半官方的打手们都懂了：这里什么都没发生。

texts.en:
* * *

The goon cracks instantly. He may not be smart, but he's smart enough to realize he's eyes-deep in a plot well above his paygrade.

For all the good it does. He's just a heavy in a dirt-side gang who received orders for a job from his boss. The boss, in turns, was hired by 'some fancy off-worlder'.

A spacer?

No. Different world, different system. Some 'Askie' - an Askonian - by the accent.
texts.zh:
* * *

打手立刻就招了。他或许不聪明，但也明白自己卷进的这摊事，远不是他这种层级该碰的。

可招了也没用。他不过是地面帮派里的一个打手，从老大那儿领了活。老大则是被'某个讲究的外星来客'雇的。

是个太空船员？

不。另一个星球，另一个星系。听口音，是个'Askie'——Askonia 人。

texts.en:
You get the name of his boss, a location - the gang's compound - and plenty of irrelevant detail.

It might be informative to visit this gang boss down on Qaras with a half-dozen marines. It might also be polite to get permission from what passes for the local authorities so this can be done quietly, and without causing such offense as would start a firefight between, well, everyone.

You've still got the goon in custody, though.
texts.zh:
你问出了他老大的名字、一个地点——帮派的老巢——还有一大堆无关紧要的细节。

带半打陆战队下到 Qaras，去拜访这位帮派头目，或许能问出些东西。先向当地那套勉强算得上官方的东西讨个许可，也算讲礼数——这样事情能办得安静，不至于闹出那种让所有人跟所有人打起来的场面。

不过，那打手还扣在你手里。

options.en: Have him dumped on the Qaras concourse
options.zh: 把他扔到 Qaras 的大厅里去

options.en: Offer him a job as crew

texts.en: It is done.
texts.zh: 办妥了。

texts.en: You have enough marines to carry out an assertive 'visit' to a local gang leader.
texts.zh: 你手上的陆战队足够对本地一个帮派头目进行一次强硬的'拜访'。

texts.en: You don't have enough marines to carry out an assertive 'visit' to a local gang leader. But there are always unemployed mercs hanging around worlds like Qaras. A dozen or so should do it.
texts.zh: 你手上的陆战队不够对本地一个帮派头目来一次强硬的'拜访'。但像 Qaras 这样的地方，总有无业雇佣兵在晃荡。十来个就够用了。

texts.en: You finally have a moment to consider your next move.
texts.zh: 你终于有片刻工夫考虑下一步。

texts.en:
You're considering your next move when your comms officer interrupts.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Comms request from Qaras. I..." They hesitate for a moment. "With apologies, I think you'll want to hear this one."
texts.zh:
你正琢磨下一步，通讯官打断了你。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。Qaras 发来通讯请求。我...\"他顿了顿。\"恕我直言，这一通您大概会想听。"

texts.en:
You're considering your next move when your comms officer interrupts.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Comms request from Qaras. I..." They hesitate for a moment. "With apologies, I think you'll want to hear this one."
texts.zh:
你正琢磨下一步，通讯官打断了你。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。Qaras 发来通讯请求。我...\"他顿了顿。\"恕我直言，这一通您大概会想听。"

texts.en:
Jason Korin - Jason Andrada - is dead. You could simply be done with Qaras. Let this go, just walk away.

On the other hand, someone else is on the same trail. The intel must have got out somehow. Or Macario is making a play. Or both.

You consider your options.
texts.zh:
Jason Korin——Jason Andrada——死了。你本可以就此了结 Qaras 的事。放下，转身离开。

但另一方面，还有别人也追着同一条线索。情报必定以某种方式泄了出去。要么就是 Macario 在动手。也可能两者皆是。

你权衡着手中的选择。

texts.en:
You've discovered the fate of each of the seven sons of Philip Andrada.

Scattered to the small worlds of the Persean Sector, some died by the hand of assassins, others never truly lived.

But enough survived. The blood of Andrada lives on.
texts.zh:
你已经查清了 Philip Andrada 七个儿子各自的结局。

他们被散落到英仙座星域的小世界，有的死于刺客之手，有的从未真正活过。

但活下来的已经够多。Andrada 的血脉仍在延续。

texts.en:
You've discovered the seven Andradas and found Macario's contingency plan for control of the Sindrian Diktat in the form of Hector Andrada. It is clear, too, that he does not fully control the situation and perhaps never did. He would have never allowed Achilles to live.

History waits in fine balance as each presumptive heir builds strength.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
texts.zh:
你查清了七位 Andrada 其人，也发现了 Macario 为掌控辛达强权所备的后手——Hector Andrada。同样清楚的是，他并未完全握得住局面，或许从来就没握住过。否则他绝不会让 Achilles 活着。

历史悬在一线之间，每位自认的继承者都在积蓄力量。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

texts.en:
You've discovered what so troubled Macario, and discovered his contingency plan for control of the Sindrian Diktat in the form of Hector Andrada. It is clear, too, that he does not fully control the situation and perhaps never did. He would have never allowed Achilles to live.

History waits in fine balance as each presumptive heir builds strength.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
texts.zh:
你查明了究竟是什么让 Macario 如此不安，也发现了他为掌控辛达强权所备的后手——Hector Andrada。同样清楚的是，他并未完全握得住局面，或许从来就没握住过。否则他绝不会让 Achilles 活着。

历史悬在一线之间，每位自认的继承者都在积蓄力量。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

texts.en:
You've discovered what so troubled Macario, and found his contingency plan for control of the Sindrian Diktat in the form of Hector Andrada. It is clear, too, that he does not fully control the situation and perhaps never did. He would have never allowed Achilles to live.

History waits in fine balance as each presumptive heir builds strength. Macario will soon gamble everything; he will be exposed.

And it will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
texts.zh:
你查明了究竟是什么让 Macario 如此不安，也发现了他为掌控辛达强权所备的后手——Hector Andrada。同样清楚的是，他并未完全握得住局面，或许从来就没握住过。否则他绝不会让 Achilles 活着。

历史悬在一线之间，每位自认的继承者都在积蓄力量。Macario 很快就要押上全部；他会暴露。

而只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's sons have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two of seven.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength, as each prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

That will be the time to strike.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两个儿子已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们克隆父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。七人中的二人。

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

那就是动手的时候。

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's heirs have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two of seven. One made weak by Macario's corrupting influence, the other made weak by the League's.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength and prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

That will be the time to strike.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两位继承人已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们克隆父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。七人中的二人。一个被 Macario 的腐蚀性影响弄弱了，另一个则被联盟的影响弄弱。

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

那就是动手的时候。

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's heirs - his true blood - have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two viable heirs of the original seven. But are they made weak by corrupting influence - one by Macario's scheming, the other by the League's? Can Andrada's blood, can his transcendent philosophy, overcome such setback?

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength and prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

One thing is clear: you must choose.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两位继承人——他真正的血脉——已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。最初七人中仅存的两个可继之人。可他们是否已被腐蚀性的影响弄弱了——一个毁于 Macario 的算计，另一个毁于联盟的？Andrada 的血脉，他那套超凡的哲学，能跨过这样的挫折吗？

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

有一件事很清楚：你必须选边。

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's sons have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两个儿子已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们克隆父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

texts.en:
The image stabilizes.

"Intriguing," he says quietly, examining you like he is contemplating a purchase.

"I am called K-O Jove. Qaras is my interest. When interesting things happen here, they become my business."
texts.zh:
影像稳定下来。

"有意思。"他轻声说，打量你的样子像在盘算一桩买卖。

"人们叫我 K-O Jove。Qaras 是我的地盘。这里一旦发生有意思的事，就成了我的事。"

texts.en:
The image stabilizes.

"Perhaps in light of recent events," K-O Jove says quietly, "You'll reconsider my offer."
texts.zh:
影像稳定下来。

"也许鉴于最近这些事，\"K-O Jove 轻声说，\"你会重新考虑我的提议。"

options.en: Was that your goon who pulled a weapon on me?
options.zh: 刚才拿枪顶着我那个，是你的人？

options.en: Was it you in the bar who sent silver-eyes?
options.zh: 酒吧里那个银眼女人，是你派来的？

options.en: Well I've certainly had an interesting time on Qaras.
options.zh: 我在 Qaras 确实过得挺有意思。

options.en: Was that your goon who pulled a weapon on me?
options.zh: 刚才拿枪顶着我那个，是你的人？

options.en: Well I've certainly had an interesting time on Qaras.
options.zh: 我在 Qaras 确实过得挺有意思。

texts.en: "That botch-job?," he answers with a look of mild disgust. "No. Not my style."
texts.zh: "那桩烂活？\"他答道，脸上带着几分嫌恶。\"不是我。那不合我的风格。"

texts.en:
"It was. And you disappointed me," an edge enters $hisOrHer voice. "And found a rougher example of local hospitality, I'm afraid."

He leans back, casual as a predator.

"You need to learn to accept a friendly offer, captain. You need someone to watch your back. Or just as well," a wave, "Your front."
texts.zh:
"是我。而你让我失望了。\"$hisOrHer声音里添了几分锋利。\"恐怕你也领教了本地待客之道里更粗野的那一面。"

他向后靠去，随意得像一头掠食者。

"舰长，你得学学接受一份好意的提议。你需要有人替你看住背后。或者，也一样，\"他一挥手，\"看住正面。"

options.en: We've got off to a poor start. Let call this a new orbit.
options.zh: 我们开头开得不好。就当这是换了一条新轨道吧。

options.en: My guards handled it. Why are you calling?
options.zh: 我的保镖已经处理了。你打来干什么？

options.en: And the goon? Was he your doing?

texts.en:
"I admire a constructive attitude, captain."

The quirk of his lip, loitering like a dumbfire munition drone, grows into something toothy and smile-like for a moment.

"Perhaps we can make the best of an awkward situation."
texts.zh:
"我欣赏有建设性的态度，舰长。"

他嘴角那一撇，先前像一架盘桓不去的无制导战机，此刻咧开，有一瞬成了带牙的笑。

"也许我们能把这尴尬局面变成点好事。"

texts.en:
A pause.

"The fool with the gun wasn't mine, I'll have you know. That was..." the pirate rubs $hisOrHer fingers together in one hand, "artless."
texts.zh:
一段停顿。

"拿枪那个蠢货不是我的人，这你可得听清楚。那手法...\"这个海盗把$hisOrHer的手指并在一起搓了搓，\"毫无章法。"

options.en: And how are we going to do that?
So what is this? What are you selling?
options.zh: 那这算什么？你在卖什么？

texts.en:
He places his hands together.

"You came to Qaras looking for Jason Korin." $HisOrHer tone suggests a shift in the conversation.

"And it looks like you're not the only one. I have a proposal: tell me why he's important to you and I'll tell you where he is."

$HeOrShe holds up a finger. "No fibbing." A wink. "I'll know."
texts.zh:
他把双手交叠在一起。

"你来 Qaras，是为找 Jason Korin。"$HisOrHer的语气一变，话题显然转了个方向。

"而且看来盯着他的不止你一个。我提个条件：告诉我他为什么对你重要，我就告诉你他在哪儿。"

$HeOrShe竖起一根手指。"不许编。"他眨了下眼。"我听得出来。"

texts.en:
He places his hands together.

"You came to Qaras looking for Jason Korin." $HisOrHer tone suggests a shift in the conversation.

"And it looks like you're not the only one. I want to help you, and I will. And I have a request: I'd like to know why he's important to you."

$HeOrShe holds up a finger. "I'll respect your wishes if you don't want to tell. It will leave me ever so curious, so hungry, but," he winks. "I'm sure I'll discover the truth soon enough."
texts.zh:
他把双手交叠在一起。

"你来 Qaras，是为找 Jason Korin。"$HisOrHer的语气一变，话题显然转了个方向。

"而且看来盯着他的不止你一个。我想帮你，也会帮。我只有一个请求：我想知道他为什么对你重要。"

$HeOrShe竖起一根手指。"你若不愿说，我尊重你的意思。那会让我好奇得要命、馋得发慌，不过，"他眨了眨眼。"我确信，用不了多久我自己就能查出真相。"

options.en: He's a clone of Philip Andrada. He fled from... his minders.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他从...他的看护者手里逃了出来。

options.en: I don't wish to reveal that information.
I've already got a lead. You're negotiating from weakness.
options.zh: 我已经有线索了。你这是在弱势谈条件。

options.en: I'll pay you 10,000 credits to just tell me.
options.zh: 我付你 10,000 星币，你直接告诉我。

options.en: Fine. 15,000 credits for information on Jason Korin.
options.zh: 行。15,000 星币，买 Jason Korin 的情报。

options.en: Fine. 15,000 credits for information on Jason Korin.
options.zh: 行。15,000 星币，买 Jason Korin 的情报。

options.en: I don't make deals with criminals.
I don't deal with criminals. Nor can I trust them.
options.zh: 我不跟罪犯打交道，也没法信他们。

options.en: As a fellow corsair, haven't I earned a bit of goodwill?
options.zh: 同为私掠船长，我总该挣得几分情面吧？

texts.en:
Jove is at a loss for words. Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." $HeOrShe looks unsettled, despite $hisOrHer affect. "I see it now. Fascinating."

"For an Andrada, that death was a mercy. I don't say this out of personal hatred, mind; I'm a realist." He raises $hisOrHer eyebrows. "You heard correctly: Jason is dead. Allow me to elaborate."
texts.zh:
Jove 一时说不出话。当然，也就那么一瞬。

"Andrada。\"$HeOrShe神色有些不安，尽管$hisOrHer仍端着那副姿态。\"现在我看清了。真有意思。"

"对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死算是慈悲了。别误会，我说这话不是出于私怨；我是个现实主义者。\"$hisOrHer挑起眉毛。\"你没听错：Jason 死了。让我细说。"

texts.en: He claps his hands together softly. Then speaks, either from memory or reading off a subtle implant.
texts.zh: 他轻轻合掌一拍，然后开口——不知是在凭记忆背诵，还是在读某个植入体的显示。

texts.en:
"Our Jason was a fractious specimen. In his time on Qaras he scuffled with low-level distributors, contacted aspiring revolutionaries, exploded - figuratively, mind - a prospective 'romantic' encounter, and had to be reminded of 'local custom' by a section enforcer."

"And yet, I do not detect in any of these frictive events the seed of a killing grudge. He was in the wrong place at the wrong time with the wrong gang. And that's why he caught a stray shot. An accident of circumstance, a quirk of fate."
texts.zh:
"我们这位 Jason 是个难缠的样本。在 Qaras 这段时间，他跟底层分销商起过冲突，接触过跃跃欲试的革命分子，还搞砸过一次——请注意，是比喻意义上的——一段可能的'风月'，最后还得让一个片区执法员提醒他什么叫做'本地习俗'。"

"然而，从这些摩擦里，我看不出哪一件埋下了杀意的种子。他只是在错误的时间、错误的地点，跟错了帮派。所以他挨了一发流弹。环境造成的意外，命运的怪癖。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe shrugs. "He's attrition, in the end. A statistic."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe耸耸肩。"说到底，他不过是损耗。一个数字。"

options.en: You're telling me he was the victim of a random shooting?
options.zh: 你是说，他死于一场随机的枪击？

texts.en:
"So it appears." $HeOrShe shrugs. "The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work; shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your Jason Korin. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

"Are you dissatisfied with my information? I assure you, my people were thorough." Jove examines you through the link. "You know something I do not, of course. I can only help you as much as you let me."
texts.zh:
"看来如此。\"$HeOrShe耸耸肩。\"枪手当时在办一桩合法但办砸了的清除——活干得马虎，无能得丢人——目标跟你的 Jason Korin 毫无关系。不过是催人老实还债的例行差事，而还债正是文明的根基。"

"你对我的情报不满意？我向你保证，我的人查得很彻底。\"Jove 隔着通讯打量你。\"当然，你知道一些我不知道的事。你能让我帮到多少，全看你自己。"

texts.en:
"So it appears." $HeOrShe shrugs. "The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work; shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your baby Andrada. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

"Are you dissatisfied?" Jove puts on a look of concern. "I assure you, my people were thorough. I must concede, however, the feeling that such a portentous death - Andrada's heir! - ought to have meant more to the world."
texts.zh:
"看来如此。\"$HeOrShe耸耸肩。\"枪手当时在办一桩合法但办砸了的清除——活干得马虎，无能得丢人——目标跟你那位宝贝 Andrada 毫无关系。不过是催人老实还债的例行差事，而还债正是文明的根基。"

"你不满意？\"Jove 摆出一副关切的样子。\"我向你保证，我的人查得很彻底。不过我得承认，我总觉得这么一桩预兆重重的死——Andrada 的继承人啊！——本该在世上留下更大的回响。"

options.en: I'm satisfied. Accidents happen all the time.
I'm satisfied. And I have pressing business to deal with.
options.zh: 我满意。而且我还有急事要办。

options.en: He was a clone of Philip Andrada. He was on the run.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他当时在逃亡。

options.en: The death of Philip Andrada's heir can't be an accident.
options.zh: Philip Andrada 的继承人，不可能死于意外。

options.en: Don't get too comfortable. There are more of them.
options.zh: 别太放心。他们还有更多。

texts.en: "One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate." $HeOrShe watches you very carefully. "You accept this very easily."
texts.zh: "人总会学着接受命运那只反复无常的手。\"$HeOrShe极仔细地打量着你。\"而你接受得太轻巧了。"

texts.en:
"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate." $HeOrShe frowns, looking off somewhere. "Although sometimes it is... assisted."

He sits up, "I have no evidence of this, however. But this is the most interesting thing that's happened on Qaras for some time. There's... work to do."
texts.zh:
"人总会学着接受命运那只反复无常的手。\"$HeOrShe皱起眉，目光投向别处。\"只不过，有时候那只手...是有人在推。"

他坐直了身子。"不过我没有证据。但这是 Qaras 这段时间里最有意思的事。有些...活要干。"

texts.en:
"Now," he smirks. "I suppose you've got that hired gun's boss to track down and beat some information out of."

"Don't worry a bit about deploying a few marines down here," $heOrShe gives a little wave, a mockery of Luddic sacrament. "I give you my blessing in light of the attack on your person. The 'authorities' will turn a blind eye."
texts.zh:
"那么，\"他勾起嘴角。\"我猜你还有个雇佣枪手的老大要去追，揍出点情报来。"

"往这儿派几个陆战队，你完全不必顾虑，\"$heOrShe 摆了摆手，那动作是对卢德圣礼的戏仿。\"既然有人在你身上动了手，我就赐你一份祝福。'当局'会睁一只眼闭一只眼。"

texts.en:
"Burn bright, as they say."

Jove turns away. "But not too bright," he adds quietly.
texts.zh:
"照他们说的，烧得亮些。"

Jove 转过身去。"但也别太亮。"他轻声补了一句。

texts.en: You stare at the blackness of the blank comms interface. Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the pirate is to be believed.
texts.zh: 你盯着通讯界面熄灭后的一片漆黑。Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。若那海盗的话可信，这不过是暴力世界上一场毫无意义的死。

texts.en:
He smirks. "I suppose you've got that hired gun's boss to track down and beat some information out of."

"Don't worry a bit about deploying a few marines down here," he gives a little wave, a mockery of Luddic sacrament. "I give you my blessing in light of the attack on your person. The 'authorities' will turn a blind eye."
texts.zh:
他勾起嘴角。"我猜你还有个雇佣枪手的老大要去追，揍出点情报来。"

"往这儿派几个陆战队，你完全不必顾虑，\"他摆了摆手，那动作是对卢德圣礼的戏仿。\"既然有人在你身上动了手，我就赐你一份祝福。'当局'会睁一只眼闭一只眼。"

texts.en:
He nods slowly, eyes on you. Not quite a bow.

"I appreciate your candor, captain. Those are not cheap words from me."

Thoughts appear to race across Jove's face. "Such a portentous death - Andrada's heir! - here on Qaras. Such a person is not made without many knowing of it. And such a person is not killed without many searching for his killer."

He looks back at you.

"A quick death - a merciful fate for a clone of Andrada. I speak not out of hatred, I'm simply a realist. Few will accept this, of course. Things are going to get interesting around here."
texts.zh:
他缓缓点头，目光没有离开你。算不上鞠躬。

"舰长，我欣赏你的坦率。这话从我嘴里说出来，可不便宜。"

种种念头似乎在 Jove 脸上飞快掠过。"这样一桩预兆重重的死——Andrada 的继承人啊！——就发生在 Qaras。造出这样一个人，不可能瞒过多少人的耳目。而这样一个人被杀，也不可能没有许多人去找凶手。"

他重新看向你。

"死得快——对 Andrada 的克隆体来说，这算是慈悲的结局。我说这话不是出于憎恨，我只是个现实主义者。当然，肯接受这说法的人不会多。这一带要变得有意思了。"

options.en: Good luck. Now I've got a pressing matter to attend to.
options.zh: 祝你好运。现在我还有件急事要办。

options.en: The death of Philip Andrada's heir can't be an accident.
options.zh: Philip Andrada 的继承人，不可能死于意外。

options.en: Don't get comfortable. There are more clones. Or were.
options.zh: 别以为可以松口气。克隆体不止一个。或者曾经不止一个。

texts.en:
"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate." $HeOrShe frowns, looking off somewhere. "Although sometimes it is... assisted."

He sits up, "I have no evidence of this, however. But this is the most interesting thing that's happened on Qaras for some time. There's... work to do."
texts.zh:
"人总会学着接受命运那只反复无常的手。\"$HeOrShe皱起眉，目光投向别处。\"只不过，有时候那只手...是有人在推。"

他坐直了身子。"不过我没有证据。但这是 Qaras 这段时间里最有意思的事。有些...活要干。"

texts.en:
"More..."

His expression freezes in a half-amused mask, a shield of detachment not quite fully raised.

Jove looks away, eyes moving rapidly. "Stars and blood, but of course - Andrada would be a fool not to. What does a clone cost to the Supreme Executor? This-"

He looks back at you, evidently deciding not to share his further thoughts on the subject.

"Your generosity is much appreciated," he says after a moment.
texts.zh:
"不止一个..."

他的表情僵在一副半带笑意的面具上，那层疏离的盾牌还没能完全举起来。

Jove 移开视线，眼睛飞快地转动。"星与血啊，可这当然了——换成 Andrada，不这么做才是蠢货。对最高元首来说，一个克隆体值几个钱？这——"

他重新看向你，显然决定不再把这个话题往下说。

"你的慷慨，我很领情。"他顿了顿才说。

texts.en: Jove gives you a sad look, and lets out a breath. "I respect your decision."
texts.zh: Jove 带着惋惜看了你一眼，吐出一口气。"我尊重你的决定。"

texts.en:
"You think that corridor-gang knew what they were asking?" $HeOrShe leans close, a feral look growing. "They're rubes. Muscle for bullying civilians. Meat for the slaughter."

"I offer you a glittering gift. Don't reject me again."
texts.zh:
"你觉得那帮混走廊的知道自己在问什么吗？\"$HeOrShe凑近了些，眼里的野性一点点涨起来。\"他们是些乡巴佬。给人当打手、欺负平民。就是待宰的肉。"

"我给你的是一份闪光的礼物。别再拒绝我。"

texts.en: "Boring. But I do have my duty to turn a profit." $HeOrShe sighs. "Let's make it 15,000."
texts.zh: "无趣。不过赚钱是我的本分。\"$HeOrShe叹了口气。\"那就 15,000。"

texts.en: Jove nods with a tiny smile that seems a little more satisfied than proper based on his apparent disdain for your credits.
texts.zh: Jove 点了点头，微微笑了笑。他那副看不上你这些星币的样子，跟这个笑里的满足感颇不相称。

texts.en: "No." He crosses his arms.
texts.zh: "不行。"他抱起双臂。

texts.en: His eyes go up as he gives a little shrug.
texts.zh: 他眼睛一抬，轻轻耸了耸肩。

texts.en:
He tilts his head. "How can I be a criminal if there is no law?"

"Come now, captain. Don't hide behind abstractions."
texts.zh:
他偏了偏头。"没有法律，我又怎么会是罪犯？"

"得了，舰长。别躲在抽象概念后头。"

texts.en: "What a delicious notion," he says.
texts.zh: "这念头真叫人受用。"他说。

texts.en:
"Pity I find in you such a sad morsel."

He turns away, as if in disgust. "A 'fellow corsair'. You bore me. Good-bye, captain."

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"可惜，我在你身上只摸到一点可怜的碎渣。"

他别过脸去，仿佛在犯恶心。"一个【同行海盗】。你真让我乏味。再见，舰长。"

通讯断了。

texts.en:
"Pity I find in you a sad morsel." $HeOrShe turns away, as if in disgust.

"A 'fellow corsair'. Don't bore me, $titlePL. Above all, not that."
texts.zh:
"可惜，我在你身上只摸到一点可怜的碎渣。"$HeOrShe 别过脸去，仿佛在犯恶心。

"一个【同行海盗】。别让我乏味，$titlePL。尤其是别拿这个来。"

"Pity I find in you a sad morsel." $HeOrShe turns away, as if in disgust.

"A 'fellow corsair'. Don't bore me, $titleHeg. Above all, not that."

"一个【同行海盗】。别让我乏味，$titleHeg。尤其是别拿这个来。"

texts.en:
"Pity I find in you a sad morsel." $HeOrShe turns away, as if in disgust.

"A 'fellow corsair'. Don't bore me. Above all, not that."
texts.zh:
"可惜，我在你身上只摸到一点可怜的碎渣。"$HeOrShe 别过脸去，仿佛在犯恶心。

"一个【同行海盗】。别让我乏味。尤其是别拿这个来。"

texts.en:
"I suppose. For a," he raises a skeptical eyebrow, "fellow corsair."

A finger is held up. "I'll allow your use of this esteemed badge of dishonor only provisionally, mind."
texts.zh:
"我想想。作为一个，\"他怀疑地挑起一边眉毛，\"【同行海盗】。"

他竖起一根手指。"事先说清楚，这枚光荣的耻辱徽章，我只是暂时准许你借用。"

texts.en:
"I should say no... I mean," $heOrShe gives a delicate wave, "-look at you. But."

A sigh, then, "What Kanta wants, Kanta gets. And you," he looks at you significantly, "get special treatment."
texts.zh:
"我本该说不...我是说，\"$heOrShe 优雅地一挥手，\"——看看你这副样子。可是。"

一声叹息，接着是："Kanta 想要的东西，Kanta 总能拿到。而你，"他意味深长地看你一眼，"能拿到特别优待。"

"I should say no... I mean," $heOrShe gives a delicate wave, "-look at you. But."

A sigh, then, "What Kanta wants, Kanta gets. And you," he looks at you significantly, "get special treatment."

"I suppose. For a," he raises a skeptical eyebrow, "fellow corsair."

A finger is held up. "I'll allow your use of this esteemed badge of dishonor only provisionally, mind."

他竖起一根手指。"事先说清楚，这枚光荣的耻辱徽章，我只是暂时准许你借用。"

"I should say no... I mean," $heOrShe gives a delicate wave. "Look at you. But."

A sigh, then, "What Kanta wants, Kanta gets. And you," $heOrShe looks at you significantly, "get special treatment."
texts.zh:
"我本该说不...我是说，\"$heOrShe优雅地摆了摆手。\"看看你这副样子。可是。"

一声叹息，然后："Kanta 想要什么，Kanta 就得到什么。而你，"$heOrShe意味深长地看着你，"得到特别优待。"

texts.en:
"Right." His hands come together softly.

"I'll have my people have a little look for you. We keep an eye on everything exciting around here - it's as I said. This won't take terribly long."
texts.zh:
"好。"他双手轻轻一合。

"我让我的人替你打听打听。这地方但凡是有点意思的事，我们都盯着——就像我说的。不会花太久。"

options.en: Hold on, you don't even know who Jason Korin is?
options.zh: 等等，你连 Jason Korin 是谁都不知道？

texts.en:
"Why should I?" $heOrShe says with a laugh. "Do you have any idea how many people step off their transport into the dark heart of Qaras each day looking for something, running from something, hiding, using?"

"It's only your interest that's convinced me there's something interesting here, if not amusing. If your 'Jason' matters, my people will find him."
texts.zh:
"我凭什么？"$heOrShe 笑了一声。"你知道每天有多少人从运输船上下来，一头扎进 Qaras 这颗黑暗的心脏？找东西的、躲事的、藏身的、用药的？"

"只凭你这份兴趣，我就信了这里头有点意思——至少不无聊。要是你那位 Jason 真要紧，我的人会找到他。"

options.en: Well you're in for quite a surprise.
Well you're in for quite a surprise.
He is the blood of Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的血脉——辛达强权的最高元首。

texts.en: "Oh?" He looks attentive. "Do tell."
texts.zh: "哦？\"他来了兴致。\"说来听听。"

options.en: No. You seem like a man who appreciates anticipation.
options.zh: 不。你看着像个懂得享受悬念的人。

options.en: He's a clone of Philip Andrada that's gone a bit rogue.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体，有点脱了缰。

options.en: No. You seem like a man who appreciates anticipation.
options.zh: 不。你看着像个懂得享受悬念的人。

options.en: He is the blood of Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的血脉——辛达强权的最高元首。

options.en: He's a clone of Philip Andrada that's gone rogue.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体，彻底脱了缰。

texts.en:
"Ha!" $HeOrShe claps. "I applaud a reversal! I shall wait."

With an ironic shake of his head, $heOrShe fingers fly over a TriPad interface.
texts.zh:
"哈！\"$HeOrShe 鼓起掌来。\"我最爱这种出人意料的转折！那我就等着。"

$heOrShe 带着几分自嘲地摇了摇头，手指在 TriPad 界面上飞快地划过。

texts.en:
"Ha!" $HeOrShe claps. "I applaud a reversal! I shall wait."

With an ironic shake of his head, $heOrShe whispers into a comms unit, eyes still watching you.
texts.zh:
"哈！\"$HeOrShe 鼓起掌来。\"我最爱这种出人意料的转折！那我就等着。"

$heOrShe 带着几分自嘲地摇了摇头，对着通讯器低语几句，眼睛始终没离开你。

texts.en:
* * *

Within the hour, a comms link from $personName is forwarded by your communications officer.
texts.zh:
* * *

不到一个钟头，你的通讯官就转接进来一条来自 $personName 的通讯。

texts.en:
* * *

You're left alone, mercifully, to run up Jove's tab and catch up on your senior officers' status reports.

Well before the turn of an hour, he reappears, affecting his self-satisfied wisp of smile.
texts.zh:
* * *

你被独自留下——倒也清净——正好把 Jove 的账继续往上堆，顺带补看高级军官们的状态报告。

一个钟头还没过完，他就回来了，脸上又挂起那缕自得的浅笑。

options.en: May I assume you found Jason?
options.zh: 我可以认为你找到 Jason 了？

texts.en:
Jove watches you for a moment, holding a TriPad. He doesn't look at it.

"He's dead."

He releases the TriPad so it drops with a clatter.
texts.zh:
Jove 手里拿着一块 TriPad，看了你一会儿，却始终没看它。

"他死了。"

他松开手，TriPad 啪嗒一声落在地上。

texts.en: "A common enough problem, isn't it?"
texts.zh: "这毛病可太常见了，不是吗？"

texts.en:
"And I'm forced to admit this comes as something of a relief. More Andradas causing trouble?"

$HeOrShe frowns. "You must understand, there is a scale of imagination - no, let us call it 'ambition' - which produces inconvenient outcomes for... innovators and free-thinkers."
texts.zh:
"而我不得不承认，这消息多少让我松了口气。又有一位 Andrada 出来惹麻烦了？"

$HeOrShe 皱起眉。"你得明白，想象力是有量级的——不，还是叫它【野心】吧——到了某个量级，就会给...创新者和自由思想者带来些不便的后果。"

texts.en:

$HeOrShe frowns. "You must understand, there is a scale of imagination - no, let us call it 'ambition' - which produces inconvenient outcomes for... innovators and free-thinkers."
