options.en: How, why? Was it a targeted killing?
options.zh: 怎么死的，为什么？是定点清除？

options.en: I'm going to need more information than that.
options.zh: 这点东西不够，我需要更多。

options.en: Did someone figure out who Jason really is?
options.zh: 是有人查出了 Jason 的真实身份？
所以你现在也算【创新者】了？

options.en: I shall not have you speak ill of Andrada's transcendent philosophy!
options.zh: 我不许你这样诋毁 Andrada 那超凡的思想！

options.en: Did someone figure out who Jason really is?
options.zh: 是有人查出了 Jason 的真实身份？
所以你现在也算【创新者】了？

texts.en: "It does not appear as such." Jove produces a brief, coy smile.
texts.zh: "看来不像。"Jove 露出一个短促的、意味深长的笑。

texts.en: "Apparently not. Assuming you're not lying to me, of course." $HeOrShe produces a coy smile.
texts.zh: "看来不是。当然，前提是你没在骗我。"$HeOrShe 露出一个意味深长的笑。

texts.en:
"See, it's funny. Your Jason was a fractious specimen." $HeOrShe eyes the TriPad but does not yet retrieve it.

"In his time on Qaras he scuffled with low-level distributors, contacted aspiring revolutionaries, exploded - figuratively, mind - a prospective 'romantic' encounter, and had to be reminded of 'local custom' by a section enforcer..."

"And yet, I do not detect in any of these frictive events the seed of a killing grudge. Perhaps he encountered the wrong place, the wrong time, the wrong gang. And that's why he caught a stray shot. An accident of circumstance, a quirk of fate."

$HeOrShe shrugs mildly. "He's attrition, in the end. A statistic."
texts.zh:
"你看，有意思的地方就在这儿。你那个 Jason 是个不安分的样本。"$HeOrShe 瞥了眼地上的 TriPad，却没有去捡。

"他在 Qaras 这段时间，跟底层分销商动过手，接触过几个想闹革命的年轻人，还——比喻意义上——炸掉了一场本该成的姻缘，最后得靠片区执法员提醒他什么叫本地规矩..."

"可这些磕磕碰碰里，我看不出哪一件埋着杀机的种子。也许他只是撞上了错的地方、错的时间、错的帮派。于是一发流弹找上了他。时势的意外，命运的捉弄。"

$HeOrShe 无所谓地耸了耸肩。"说到底，他只是损耗。一个数字。"

options.zh: 你是说他是被枪打死的？

options.en: Are you incapable of giving a straight answer?"
options.zh: 你就不能给个痛快的回答？

texts.en:
"It so appears. The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work, shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your baby Andrada. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

He puts on a look of shallow concern.

"You appear dissatisfied with my information, captain?"
texts.zh:
"看来就是这样。开枪的人接的是一桩正当的活，只是办砸了——手法粗糙，无能得丢人——目标跟你那位 Andrada 宝贝毫无关系。不过是催人还债的老套路，文明本身的基石。"

他摆出一副浅淡的关切神色。

"看来你对我的情报不太满意，舰长？"

texts.en:
"So it appears. The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled, attack - sloppy work, shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your Jason Korin. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts; the foundation of civilization itself."

He puts on a look of shallow concern.

"You appear dissatisfied with my information, captain?"
texts.zh:
"看来就是这样。开枪的人接的是一桩正当却办砸了的袭击——手法粗糙，无能得丢人——目标跟你的 Jason Korin 毫无关系。不过是催人还债的老套路，文明本身的基石。"

他摆出一副浅淡的关切神色。

"看来你对我的情报不太满意，舰长？"

options.en: Someone that important to so many doesn't just die.
options.zh: 对这么多人来说这么要紧的一个人，不会就这么死了。

options.en: Jason Korin is a clone of Philip Andrada. His death can't be an accident.
options.zh: Jason Korin 是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他的死不可能是意外。

options.en: I believe you. Accidents happen all the time.
I believe you. Accidents happen all the time. (lie)
options.zh: 我信你。意外天天都有。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate. All else is madness."

His tone darkens. "And for an Andrada? That death was a mercy." Jove leans back, as if bored.

"If you're unsatisfied with what I could provide with what I was given, then the loss is on you. Now I believe we're finished here." The smile again. "For now."
texts.zh:
"人会慢慢学会接受命运那只反复无常的手。除此之外都是疯念。"

他的语气沉了下来。"而放在一位 Andrada 身上？那样的死是种仁慈。"Jove 向后一靠，像是在犯困。

"如果凭我手上这些还满足不了你，那损失算你的。现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

texts.en:
"That's another funny thing. Your Jason doesn't seem important at all."

$HeOrShe narrows $hisOrHer eyes. "I believe you're holding back, captain."

"If you're unsatisfied with what I could provide with what I was given, then that disappointment is on you."

Jove leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
"还有件有意思的事。你那个 Jason，看着一点也不重要。"

$HeOrShe 眯起 $hisOrHer 的双眼。"我觉得你有所保留，舰长。"

"如果凭我手上这些还满足不了你，那这份失望得你自己兜着。"

Jove 向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en: Silver-eyes appears, apparently unbidden.
texts.zh: 银眼女人现身了，仿佛不请自来。

texts.en:
You step from the hidden lounge into the echelon of dark curtains, a velvety black like deep space. The air is close and warm, like a vacsuit with a bad atmo regulator.

Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the criminal is to be believed.
texts.zh:
你从隐秘的休息室走出来，穿过层层叠叠的黑色帘幕——那黑如天鹅绒，像深空本身。空气闷热，像一件大气调节器坏掉的太空服。

Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。如果那个罪犯的话可信，这不过是这座暴戾星球上一场毫无意义的死亡。

texts.en: Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the criminal is to be believed.
texts.zh: Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。如果那个罪犯的话可信，这不过是这座暴戾星球上一场毫无意义的死亡。

texts.en:
You turn to make a casual scan of the bar to find your view blocked by a heavily augmented woman in a dark coat. Her eyes are silver.

"'Pologies, $playerSirOrMadam." She clears her throat. "The boss... wishes for me to do the favor of extending to you an invitation to partake in the back room and share a word on your, uh, pressing query."

She hides a look of relief at making it through what are clearly someone else's words.
texts.zh:
你转身随意扫了一眼酒吧，视线却被一个身穿深色外套、改造痕迹极重的女人挡住。她的眼睛是银色的。

"抱歉，$playerSirOrMadam。\"她清了清嗓子。\"老板...想让我帮忙给您带个话，请您到后面那间屋里坐坐，聊聊您那桩，呃，要紧的事。"

话说完，她藏起一丝如释重负的神色——那显然不是她自己的措辞。

texts.en:
She nods, then turns to lead you into the shadows at the back of the bar.

Behind a clever echelon of black curtains is a door, and behind that door a small, luxurious lounge slouches moodily.
texts.zh:
她点点头，转身领你走进酒吧后方的阴影里。

层层巧妙错落的黑色帘幕之后是一扇门，门后是一间小巧而奢华的休息室，懒散地沉在暗处。

texts.en:
"Interesting," the $post says, watching you with a wisp of smile. As if assessing you like a prize. "Intriguing, even."

The goon, silver-eyes, disappears.

"I am called K-O Jove. Qaras is my interest. When interesting things happen here, they become my business."
texts.zh:
"有意思。\"$post 说，唇角挂着一丝笑，打量着你，像在估一件奖品。\"甚至可以说，耐人寻味。"

那个银眼睛的打手不见了。

"人们叫我 K-O Jove。Qaras 是我的地盘。这里一旦发生有意思的事，就成了我的事。"

options.en: I suppose you might know where I can find Jason Korin?
options.zh: 我想，你也许知道哪儿能找到 Jason Korin？

texts.en:
He laughs toothily.

"Is that what I said? Have care, captain. I am mindful of my claims."
texts.zh:
他咧嘴一笑。

"我说过这话吗？当心，船长。我对自己的名分一向看得仔细。"

texts.en:
He laughs toothily.

"Is that what I said? Have care, $titleHeg. I am mindful of my claims."
texts.zh:
他咧嘴一笑。

"我说过这话吗？当心，$titleHeg。我对自己的名分一向看得仔细。"

texts.en:
He laughs toothily.

"Is that what I said? Have care, $titlePL. I am mindful of my claims."
texts.zh:
他咧嘴一笑。

"我说过这话吗？当心，$titlePL。我对自己的名分一向看得仔细。"

texts.en:
"You're $playerName." He speaks past your question.

A strange expression comes over $hisOrHer face. "You did a very naughty thing, a cruel thing, to Kanta's pet clone."

$HisOrHer eyes dart to meet yours. "It was a beautiful execution. She's not so invincible, is she, Queen Jorien."
texts.zh:
"你是 $playerName。"他没接你的问题。

一种古怪的神情掠过 $hisOrHer 的脸。"你对 Kanta 养的那只克隆体做了件很坏、很残忍的事。"

$HisOrHer 的目光一挑，对上你的眼睛。"那是一场漂亮的处决。她也没那么不可战胜，对吧，Jorien 女王。"

texts.en: "I may," he says, savoring the words.
texts.zh: "也许吧。"他说，把这两个字嚼得有滋有味。

texts.en:
"I may," he says, savoring the words.

"You've been asking around. And not just here," he gives a small wave, taking in this spacer bar.
texts.zh:
"也许吧。"他说，把这两个字嚼得有滋有味。

"你一直在四处打听。而且不只在这儿。"他轻一摆手，把这间太空人酒吧尽数算了进去。

texts.en:
"I may," he says, savoring the words.

"You've been asking around. And not just here," he gives a small wave, taking in the celestial sphere upon which you stand, and its orbits.

"Practically anyone of importance you can bother, it seems. Hardly discreet."
texts.zh:
"也许吧。"他说，把这两个字嚼得有滋有味。

"你一直在四处打听。而且不只在这儿。"他轻一摆手，把你脚下这颗天球连同它的轨道一并算了进去。

"看来凡是有点分量的人，你能烦的都烦了一遍。这可不怎么谨慎。"

options.en: I do what I must to survive.
options.zh: 为了活下去，我只能这么做。

options.en: It was a mistake made in a moment of crisis.
options.zh: 那是危机时刻犯下的错误。

options.en: It's nice to meet a fan of my work.
options.zh: 能遇到欣赏我作品的人，真好。

options.en: The clone was an unholy abomination.
options.zh: 那克隆体是亵渎的孽物。

options.en: So are you going to tell me?
So are you going to tell me about Jason?
options.zh: 那你打算跟我讲 Jason 的事吗？

options.en: So are you going to tell me Jason?
options.zh: 那你打算告诉我 Jason 的事吗？

texts.en: "Don't be so bashful," $heOrShe scolds. "It was an inspired act."
texts.zh: "别这么害臊。\" $heOrShe 责备道。\"那是一记神来之举。"

texts.en: He closes his eyes for a moment. "But that's not why you're here."
texts.zh: 他闭了闭眼。"但你来这儿不是为了这个。"

options.en: We were speaking of Jason Korin. Do you know where I can find him?
options.zh: 我们刚才在说 Jason Korin。你知道哪儿能找到他吗？

texts.en:
"Don't play-act weakness to me," his voice suddenly acid. "It was an inspired act. Possess it, and accept my highest praise."

He closes his eyes, taking a deep breath, then resettles his composure.
texts.zh:
"别在我面前装软弱。\"他的声音骤然转酸。\"那是一记神来之举。认下它，接受我最高的赞誉。"

他闭上眼，深吸一口气，重新整好仪态。

texts.en: He puts his hands together and appears to nod respectfully toward you. It's an uncomfortable but seemingly heartfelt concession.
texts.zh: 他双手合拢，像是郑重地朝你点头致意。这份让步叫人不太舒服，却看上去出自真心。

texts.en:
"Oh." He seems taken a little aback. "I see."

"I give praise to your inspired act." He puts his hands together in an impression of piety and appears to nod respectfully toward you.
texts.zh:
"哦。\"他似乎有些意外。\"我明白了。"

"我为你的神来之举献上赞誉。"他双手合拢，做出一副虔诚的样子，像是郑重地朝你点头。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe smiles, slowly.

"I could be persuaded."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 慢慢笑了。

"我也许能被说动。"

texts.en:
He holds up a hand, the very image of grace.

"I will help you. Because of my admiration for your bold deed."
texts.zh:
他抬手一止，举止优雅得像一幅画。

"我帮你。出于我对你那桩大胆作为的钦佩。"

options.en: Consider me... a fellow corsair, in need of a favor.
options.zh: 就当我是...一个同道的私掠船长，需要你帮个忙。

options.en: This is tedious. Just tell me or don't.
This is tiresome. Cutting the link now. (cut comms)
options.zh: 够了。现在就切断通讯。 (切断通讯)

texts.en:
He holds up a hand, the very image of grace.

"No credits. I will help you because of my admiration for your bold deed."
texts.zh:
他抬手一止，举止优雅得像一幅画。

"不必付钱。我帮你，是因为我钦佩你那桩大胆的作为。"

texts.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response."
texts.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。"

texts.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response. I'm sure the Hegemony can afford it."
texts.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。我确信霸主出得起。"

texts.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response. I'm sure the Persean League can afford it."
texts.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。我确信英仙座联盟出得起。"

texts.en: "Let's not," he says, an edge in his voice.
texts.zh: "别这样。"他说，声音里带了刃。

texts.en: Jove nods, touching a hand to a data interface device, something on his wrist, without looking.
texts.zh: Jove 点了点头，一只手抚上腕上的数据接口，眼睛都没抬。

texts.en:
The smile hardens.

"You need to learn to take pleasure in this business, captain. You'll find precious little happiness in the dead of space."

He pauses.

"Make it worth my time to give you the man you seek."
texts.zh:
笑意凝住了。

"你得学会从这门生意里尝出点滋味，舰长。在深空里，你能找到的快乐少得可怜。"

他顿了顿。

"想让我交出你要找的人，就拿出点东西来，让我觉得这时间花得值。"

texts.en:
The pirate drops $hisOrHer attention from you as if you were a piece of furniture and returns $hisOrHer attention to a quiet holo of what looks to be some sort of bloodsport.

The augmented goon emerges from the shadows to escort you back to the bar.
texts.zh:
那海盗把 $hisOrHer 的注意力从你身上挪开，仿佛你只是件家具，转而回到 $hisOrHer 面前那幅安静的全息影像上——看上去像某种血腥格斗。

那个改造过的打手从阴影里走出来，送你回酒吧。

texts.en: Jove gives you a look somewhere between disappointed and bored.
texts.zh: Jove 瞥了你一眼，那神情介于失望与无聊之间。

texts.en:
You move to step away, and she steps into your path. From the corner of your eye you see a couple of your bodyguards tense up, ready to act.

"Please," she says, expressionless. "That's my ask. Boss don't like to hear no. Gets in a mood."
texts.zh:
你想侧身走开，她却横跨一步挡在前面。你眼角瞥见两名保镖绷紧了身子，随时准备动手。

"拜托。\"她面无表情。\"这是我要办的事。老板不爱听不行。会闹脾气。"

options.en: Still no. Good luck with your boss.
options.zh: 还是不行。祝你老板那儿好运。

options.en: You got an answer. Now clear off.
options.zh: 你已经得到答复了。现在让开。

texts.en:
She half-bows apologetically and removes herself from your path.

Your bodyguards relax.
texts.zh:
她带着歉意半鞠一躬，让开了去路。

你的保镖们松了下来。

texts.en:
She half-bows apologetically and removes herself from your path.

Your bodyguards relax.
texts.zh:
她带着歉意半鞠一躬，让开了去路。

你的保镖们松了下来。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe is finally left at a loss for words.

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." $HeOrShe seems unsettled, despite his affect. "Fascinating."

"I daresay, for an Andrada such a quick death was a mercy. I don't say this out of personal hatred, mind. Just a realist."

$PersonName leans back, as if bored.

"Now I believe we're finished here." That smile again. "For now."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 终于哑口无言。

当然，不会太久。

"Andrada。\"尽管他端着那副神情，$HeOrShe 仍显得心神不宁。\"有意思。"

"要我说，对一位 Andrada 而言，死得这么快反倒是种仁慈。这话不是出于私怨，我不过是个现实主义者。"

$PersonName 向后一靠，像是在犯困。

"现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe is finally at a loss for words. Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." $HeOrShe seems unsettled, despite his unflappable affect. "Fascinating."

"For an Andrada that death was a mercy. I don't say this out of personal hatred, mind. Jut a realist."

$PersonName leans back, as if bored.

"Now I believe we're finished." That smile again. "For now."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 终于哑口无言。当然，只一瞬。

"Andrada。\"尽管他端着那副不动的神色，$HeOrShe 仍显得心神不宁。\"有意思。"

"对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死是种仁慈。这话不是出于私怨，我不过是个现实主义者。"

$PersonName 向后一靠，像是在犯困。

"现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

texts.en:
He frowns very reasonably. "One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate. All else is madness."

Then leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
他皱起眉，一副通情达理的样子。"人会慢慢学会接受命运那只反复无常的手。除此之外都是疯念。"

然后向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en:
He nods, frowning reasonably. "Tragic," $heOrShe says. His tone darkens, "But for an Andrada, that death was a mercy."

He leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
他点点头，眉头皱着，显得很讲道理。"真惨。"$heOrShe 说。语气随即沉下来，"但对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死是种仁慈。"

他向后退靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe frowns very reasonably. "One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate. All else is madness."

Then leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 皱起眉，一副通情达理的样子。"人会慢慢学会接受命运那只反复无常的手。除此之外都是疯念。"

然后向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe nods, frowning reasonably. "Tragic," $heOrShe says. Then $hisOrHer tone darkens, "But for an Andrada, that death was a mercy."

Then leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 点点头，眉头皱着，显得很讲道理。"真惨。"$heOrShe 说。随后 $hisOrHer 的语气沉了下来，"但对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死是种仁慈。"

然后向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en:
"Yes."

$HeOrShe flashes a genuine smile. An alien look.
texts.zh:
"是。"

$HeOrShe 绽出一个真诚的笑。那表情陌生得不像他。

texts.en: "Patience, my dear, patience," he says.
texts.zh: "耐心，亲爱的，耐心。"他说。

texts.en: Instead of an answer, $heOrShe gives you a brief, insincere smile.
texts.zh: $heOrShe 没有作答，只给了你一个短促而毫无诚意的笑。

texts.en: Jove raises an eyebrow, then produces a coy smile. "Please accept my most sincere apologies."
texts.zh: Jove 挑起一边眉毛，随即露出一个意味深长的笑。"请接受我最诚挚的歉意。"

texts.en:
For a moment, Jove appears to be at an uncharacteristic loss for words.

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." He says the name carefully, like holding an armed grenade. "Fascinating. Gone a bit rogue, you say?"

An unsteady grin, then he whispers something into his wrist-comms.
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，Jove 罕见地像是无话可说。

当然，只一瞬。

"Andrada。\"这名字他说得极小心，像捧着一枚拔了保险的手雷。\"有意思。你是说，有点脱了缰？"

他咧嘴一笑，笑意不太稳，随即对着腕上的通讯器低声说了几句。

texts.en:
For a moment, Jove appears to be at a loss for words, his look perplexed.

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." He does a double-glance at you, seeing how you react to hear him say the name. And he says it carefully, like holding an armed grenade.

"Fascinating. Gone a bit rogue, it seems?"

An unsteady grin, then he whispers something into his wrist-comms.
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，Jove 像是找不出话来，满脸困惑。

当然，只一瞬。

"Andrada。"他朝你连看了两眼，想看出你听到这名字时的反应。这名字他说得极小心，像捧着一枚拔了保险的手雷。

"有意思。看来是有点脱了缰？"

他咧嘴一笑，笑意不太稳，随即对着腕上的通讯器低声说了几句。

texts.en:
Jove looks, if anything, both surprised and offended. His mouth hangs slightly open as you cut the comms.

He's clearly working some self-interested angle.

And you've got a lead to follow: the goon's boss, the gang leader who was paid by an Askonian to rough you up.
texts.zh:
真要说的话，Jove 看上去既吃惊又觉得受了冒犯。你切断通讯时，他的嘴还微微张着。

他显然在打自己的算盘。

而你手上还有条线索要追：那个打手的老大，那个被某个 Askonia 人出钱雇来教训你的帮派头目。

texts.en: "You must make time for pleasantries, captain. There's precious little pleasure in the cold of space; we must make our own where it is to be found."
texts.zh: "舰长，寒暄这种事也得腾出时间。太空的寒冷里，可享受的东西少得可怜；哪儿能找到乐趣，我们就得自己在哪儿造出来。"

texts.en: "Hardly," $heOrShe answers with a look of the mildest disgust. "I'm hurt that you would suggest my methods were so unsophisticated."
texts.zh: "差得远。\"$heOrShe答道，脸上一丝极轻的嫌恶。\"你竟说我的手法这么不上台面，这话挺伤我。"

texts.en:
The hint of a smile haunts his lips.

"You certainly have."
texts.zh:
一丝笑意在他唇边徘徊。

"你确实过得挺有意思。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe looks aside. "He wasn't mine, by the way. The one who showed you the gun."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe移开目光。"顺带说一句，拿枪给你看的那个不是我的人。"

options.en: In the bar. It was you who sent silver-eyes.
options.zh: 酒吧里。银眼女人是你派来的。

texts.en: It is done.
texts.zh: 办妥了。

texts.en: It is done.
texts.zh: 办妥了。

texts.en: "What's that suppo-"
texts.zh: "那算是什么意——"

texts.en: "Shut yer hatch, I'm askin' th-"
texts.zh: "闭上你的嘴，老子在问——"

texts.en:
She closes her eyes, takes a breath, and begins.

"I got paid to give you a message, and that's, um, that 'he' had a microsat at the jump-point that tagged your fleet, which is why 'he' isn't here."

Eyes open now.

"I was told to say 'Jove says it'll take more time', and this is a uh, something about fainting? So that 'he' can't find more credits?"
texts.zh:
她闭上眼，吸了口气，然后开口。

"有人付钱让我给你带个话，内容是，呃，'他'在跃迁点布了一颗微型卫星，标记了你的舰队，所以'他'才没在这儿。"

她睁开眼。

"他们让我带话说'Jove 说还得再花些时间'，还有什么，呃，'装晕'之类的？这样'他'就找不来更多星币了？"

options.en: A 'feint', yes. I suppose that makes sense.
options.zh: 一次'虚晃'，对。我想这说得通。
所以他是在浪费我的时间？

texts.en: "That's all I was told," she says nervously.
texts.zh: "他们只跟我说了这些，"她紧张地说。

texts.en:
"That's all I was told," she says, looking nervous.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Are you... do I still have that job?"
texts.zh:
"他们只跟我说了这些，"她说着，神色紧张。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。那个...我那份活还在吗？"

texts.en: The young spacer looks relieved, though still scared. One of your bodyguards forwards her to your purser.
texts.zh: 年轻的太空船员松了口气，可脸上仍带着惧色。你的一名保镖把她领到了你的事务长那里。

texts.en: The young spacer does just as you say, doing her best to hide a look of disappointment.
texts.zh: 年轻的太空船员照你说的做了，竭力掩住脸上的失望。

texts.en: The young spacer performs a passable salute, then scurries off before anything she says displeases you any more.
texts.zh: 年轻的太空船员敬了个勉强像样的礼，随即匆匆退开，生怕再说出什么惹你不快的话。

texts.en: "I... sorry, I don't know. That's all I was told."
texts.zh: "我...对不起，我不知道。他们只跟我说了这些。"

texts.en:
"I... sorry, I don't know. That's all I was told," she says, distressed.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Are you... do I still have that job?"
texts.zh:
"我...对不起，我不知道。他们只跟我说了这些，"她说着，满脸惶恐。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。那个...我那份活还在吗？"

texts.en: "No? I mean, maybe? I didn't get a name, they just-"
texts.zh: "不是？我是说，也许？他们没告诉我名字，只是——"

texts.en: "Oh! No, I mean, that isn't why... I'll just-"
texts.zh: "哦！不，我是说，不是为了那个...我就是——"

texts.en: "Oh! Fantastic, thank you $playerSirOrMadam! But, that isn't why... I'll just-"
texts.zh: "哦！太好了，谢谢你，$playerSirOrMadam！可、可我不是为这个来的...我就是——"

texts.en:
Your comms officer pings you unexpectedly.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I received an unusual communication which- I thought it should be brought to your attention."
texts.zh:
你的通讯军官突然向你发出通知。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我收到了一份特别的通讯，我认为您应当关注它。"

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Someone who claims to work for a man named 'Virens' commed to invite you to a meeting. I did not... at first think to bring it to your attention until the details could be verified."

"Well, ah," they twitch nervously. "We verified the details."
texts.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam。有个自称是 'Virens' 手底下的人发来了通讯，邀请您参加一个会议。我没有...立即向您汇报此事，我本想等到我们能够确认那些细节之后再讲。"

"呃，对，" 对方紧张地说。"我们核实了相关细节。"

texts.en:
And indeed, as your comms officer explains, it turns out that one Nile Virens figures prominently in Mazalot as the leader (alleged) of the local branch of the Luddic Path, though none of the mainstream media or data outlets state this apparently unspoken-by-agreement fact. Virens legally runs a number of charities; Pather fronts (allegedly), and owns properties in most of the significant Luddic-majority settlements on Mazalot.

It's not difficult to read between the lines. Just dangerous.

Unless you are someone who employs top-credit bodyguards and operates a private battlefleet.
texts.zh:
确实，正如你的通讯军官所说，Nile Virens 在 Mazalot 上扮演的一个重要角色其实是 卢德左径 当地分支的领导者 (据传)，尽管没有任何主流媒体或小道消息点明过这一不言而喻的事实。Virens 合法经营着数个慈善机构，其实都是掩护左径组织的前台 (据传)，且在 Mazalot 大多数重要的卢德聚集地中持有地产。

这很危险。听懂这个弦外之意应该不难。

除非能有个雇佣了顶级保镖，并坐拥一支私人作战舰队的家伙。

texts.en:
It's almost shocking that Virens hasn't been arrested already, but his status is a political minefield for the Mazalot Unification Authority. To crack down might instigate another uprising. To not crack down allows Pather influence to simmer just under the boiling point.

And now, Nile Virens has invited you for tea.

Your officers, of course, have rapidly assembled a tactical report on Virens' holdings for your review.
texts.zh:
Virens 至今未被捕，这令人感到难以置信。毕竟他的地位对 Mazalot 统一政权而言，犹如一颗政治地雷。对他采取强硬措施可能激起新的暴动，而不采取行动则会使左径分子的影响力在沸点之下持续酝酿。

而现在，Nile Virens 正邀请你共享下午茶。

自然，你的幕僚们已迅速编制了一份关于 Virens 势力范围的战术报告供你审查。

texts.en:
A well-timed plume of radiation from nearby Daedaleon gives your shuttle cover to sneak through the local traffic control's sensor net.

Your shuttle begins its descent to the cold and unforgiving surface of Hesperus.
texts.zh:
一股辐射羽流从附近的 Daedaleon 如期而至，掩护你的穿梭机躲过了当地交通管制的传感器网络。

你的穿梭机开始向 Hesperus 冰冷无情的地表降落。

texts.en: Traffic control gives you its blessing, so to speak, and your shuttle begins its descent to the cold and unforgiving surface of Hesperus.
texts.zh: 说出来你自己都不信，交通管制居然祝福了你，随后，你的穿梭机开始向 Hesperus 冰冷无情的地表降落。

texts.en:
The planet is riven by glaciers like a network of scars on the battered hide of a fossilized monster.

The flight path takes your shuttle into a great canyon of canyons filled with a chaos of ice and stone. The shuttle banks into an off-branch; the ridges of dark rock loom larger.

Now and again you spot the crumbling remains of industry, and among them the occasional lights of a Knight-chartered enterprise or monastic community.
texts.zh:
这颗星球被冰川切割得四分五裂，如同一头石制野兽，疤痕在它那伤痕累累的毛皮上勾连成网。

你的跟随着导航飞入了一个巨大的峡谷中，冰块和岩石凌乱地堆砌着。穿梭机倾斜着飞进峡谷的一条岔路，隐约间，你感觉黑色巨石构成的山脊愈加巨大。

你隐约间看见残破不堪的工业遗迹中，骑士特批企业和隐修社区的灯火正在闪烁。

texts.en:
Around one last turn of the canyon, the shrine complex appears, a bright spire of habitats, towers, and masts rising from the misty remains of a titanic atmospheric processing plant.

Your trained eye spots the likely positions of heavy weapon emplacements: too-clean cliff-faces at convenient angles, the suspiciously level floors of certain hanging valleys.
texts.zh:
在峡谷的最后一个拐角处，圣地的殿堂出现了。那是一座由栖息地，塔楼，旗杆簇拥而成的尖顶，灯火辉煌，从云山雾罩的巨型大气处理厂废墟中拔地而起。

你久经训练的眼光发现了一些可能布置有重武器的位置：角度适合射击且过于干净的峭壁，某些悬谷上平坦到可疑的地表。

texts.en:
The landing bay antechamber is a baroque gothic-militant display of post-industrial salvage. Dead suits of power armor stand at attention, weapons proudly displayed. Glowing between rivet-encrusted arches are scenes of battle and martyrdom done up in mosaic panes formed of fractured gems; structural diamond and colorful lenses recovered from mining lasers or reactor inspection ports.

The gallery is filled with parties of Luddic pilgrims dressed in traditional handweave meeting with shrine attendants.
texts.zh:
登陆台的前厅里堆砌着后工业时代的文物，展现出巴洛克式的艺术风格，以及哥特式的尚武。能源耗尽的动力装甲摆出立正的姿势，骄傲的展示着手中的武器。嵌着铆钉的拱门之间透出光芒，其内是由宝石碎片打造的马赛克窗格，展现着战斗和殉道的场景。那些结构完美的钻石和色彩斑斓的透镜，是从采矿激光和反应堆检查端口之中回收而来的。

展馆里挤满了身着传统手工服饰的卢德朝圣者，他们正在与圣地的圣务侍们会面。

texts.en:
Traffic control gives you its blessing and your shuttle descends toward the unforgiving surface of Hesperus.

The planet is riven by glaciers like a network of scars on the battered hide of some ancient beast. Your flight path takes you toward one great canyon filled with a chaos of ice and stone, then a child-branch over which walls of dark rock loom. Now and again you spot the crumbling remains of industry, and among them the occasional lights of Knight-chartered enterprises and monastic communities.
texts.zh:
交通管制处为你送上了例行的 "卢德保佑"。你的穿梭机开始降落到冰冷无情的 Hesperus 地表。

Hesperus 的地表被冰川切割得四分五裂，如同一头上古凶兽伤痕累累的毛皮，疤痕勾连成网。你的航线将你带往一个巨大的峡谷，里面凌乱地堆砌着冰块和岩石。接着映入眼帘的是峡谷的一条分支，其上是若隐若现，有如无边城墙的漆黑巨石。你时不时看见摇摇欲坠的工业遗迹，其中间或闪烁着属于骑士特批企业和隐修社区的灯火。

texts.en:
At your request, the attending subcurate leads you through a brief ceremonial hand-washing, then down a long gallery.

The flow of the curate's robe doesn't quite touch the floor, a welded field of armored plates weathered into intricate patterns by the varied atmospheres of a score of worlds on which the Knights have fought and died. Niches along the walls are occupied by empty helmets.
texts.zh:
在你的要求下，在场的助理祭司带领你进行了一次简短的净手礼，然后领你沿着长廊走了下去。

祭司长袍拂过地面，那是一片用装甲板焊接而成的战场。每个装甲板都带着不同星球大气侵蚀的痕迹，组成了精致复杂的图案，展示着骑士们奋战至死的印记。沿着而建的壁龛被无数空空如也的头盔填得满满当当。

texts.en:
The shrine is a grand tomb set in an enormous airshaft. The industrial viscera has been transformed into a baroque sculpture of thousands of edged weapons aligned like feathers of a wing, rays of gleaming serrated metal boldly thrust in killing arcs through the vast space.

In the center, surrounded by a galaxy of flickering candles, lie the lead-lined caskets of a squad of martyred Knights. The manner of their deaths, the subcurate explains in reverent whispers, left their bodies unidentifiable and infused with radioactive material which would kill a direct observer even to this day.

You are left in a prayer-niche to contemplate the horror.
texts.zh:
这座圣地是一座华丽的墓穴，坐落在一个庞大的通风竖井内。曾经脉动的工业肺腑已经被一座巴洛克式的雕塑取而代之。成千上万锋利的兵刃犹如羽翼上的翎毛般齐整排列，钢铁的锋芒闪耀着寒光，错落有致地排出了弧形的杀阵，直指那无边的宇宙。

在那中央，无数烛火犹如银河般闪耀，将一队殉道骑士们的铅衬棺木环绕其中。助理祭司虔诚地低语道，他们的死因导致其遗体无法辨认，渗入的放射性物质时至今日仍会让直接观察的人命丧黄泉。

你留在一座祈祷者壁龛之中，深思着这份恐怖。

texts.en:
In the next niche over, a young knight-initiate gives you a challenging look. His head is freshly shaved; he must be very new to the order.

"You're not a Knight," he says quietly, making a show of looking over your uniform. "Nor one of us. Not really. Why are you here, spacer?"
texts.zh:
在对面的壁龛里，一名年轻入门骑士向你送来一个审视的眼神。他剃发的痕迹还很新鲜，想必才刚刚加入骑士团不久。

"你并非骑士，" 他轻声说道，一边装腔作势地上下打量着你的制服，"也不是我们中的一员，至少不像。你为何来到这里，宇宙民？"

texts.en: Your introspection seems to throw the initiate off. You can see the thought work across his face- are you making fun of me? But it is quickly dismissed, and you are filed under 'not a threat'.
texts.zh: 你的内省似乎让这位新人不知所措。你可以看到他的想法浮现在了脸上 —— 你在消遣我吗？但这表情很快就收了起来，而你也被划进了 '没有威胁' 的行列里。

texts.en: "Right," he sticks his chest out a little more, categorizing you safely within his teleology. "I'm sworn to protect your lot, you know."
texts.zh: "确实，" 他的胸膛稍稍挺起，将你稳妥地划入他那与生俱来的使命之中。"我将立誓守护你的命运，望你知晓。"

texts.en: He takes a moment to parse your response. You can see it work across his face- are you making fun of me? But the thought is dismissed, and you are filed under 'not a threat'.
texts.zh: 他花了些许时间来理解你的回复。你能够从他的脸上分明地看出他在思考 —— 你在消遣我吗？不过这个念头很快就被摒弃了，而你也被划进了 '没有威胁' 的行列里。

texts.en:
"I'm a knight, sworn and-" he catches himself raising his voice, looks nervously to check for shrine attendants, "-and a member of the order. I'll die in service of my sacred duty."

He nods brusquely at the trio of lead-lined coffins at the center of the shrine. "Like they did, if I have to. I'm not scared."
texts.zh:
"我是一名骑士，已经立誓并 ——" 他注意到自己不小心说大声了些，有点紧张地看了一下圣地圣务侍是否在附近，"—— 并成为一名骑士团成员。我愿为了我神圣的职责而献身。"

他对着圣地中央的三口铅制棺材坚定地点了点头。"若有必要，我也将像他们那样。我并不害怕。"

options.en: Nod and make an appropriately serious face
options.zh: 点点头，做出符合时宜的严肃表情

options.en: You should be. That death is hell I would not wish upon my worst enemy.
options.zh: 你最好还是怕一怕。毕竟，就算是我的死对头，我也不想让他经历那种地狱般的死亡。

texts.en:
He seems satisfied, just, with your apparent acceptance of his declaration. Out of the corner of your eye you see him turn back toward the center of the shrine, sigh, and resume what you assume to be an initiation-vigil.

Time will have to test him and tell if he will actually be any good as a Knight of Ludd.
texts.zh:
你仅仅是表面上认可了他的宣言，他看起来就已经满意了。从你眼角的余光可以看到，他转身朝向圣地的中央，叹了一口气，又回到了之前的状态 —— 你猜那可能是入团要做的守夜祈祷之类的。

时间将会考验他，并辨明他是否真的足以担任一名卢德骑士。

texts.en:
You see his jaw clench, and quick anger rise in his posture. You wonder briefly at how the shrine attendants would react to a Knight-initiate assaulting a visitor, but out of the corner of your eye you can see the young man steady himself, then turn and lock his gaze toward the center of the shrine, maintaining control and mumbling prayer.

He may actually have what it takes to become a good Knight of Ludd one day.
texts.zh:
你看到他的下巴绷紧了，愤怒迅速在他姿态中升腾。在这稍纵即逝的片刻，你不由得好奇，圣地的圣务侍们会怎么处置袭击访客的新晋骑士。不过，从你眼角的余光可以看到，这位青年稳住了自己，然后转身凝视着圣地的中央，保持着理智，喃喃自语地祈祷着。

有朝一日，他或许真的会拥有成为一名优秀的卢德骑士所需的品质。

texts.en:
Your grim delivery sinks the thought into the young man. You can see it in his eyes, and his pale scalp; yes, fear.

In that fear, he seems to forget trying to get a rise out of you and locks his gaze toward the center of the shrine, mumbling a prayer.

He might actually have what it takes to become a good Knight of Ludd one day.
texts.zh:
你那冷酷的话语将一缕思绪沉入这个年轻人的心底。你可以看到他眼中的动摇，还有那毫无血色的头皮。没错，是恐惧。

在这份恐惧之中，他看起来已经顾不上招惹你了。他牢牢地凝视着圣地的中央，喃喃自语地祈祷着。

有朝一日，他或许真的会拥有成为一名优秀的卢德骑士所需的品质。

texts.en:
The thought disrupts his expectations, and you can see it in his sudden squint. He looks around, making sure no subcurate is watching, then leans closer.

"What like ...the Path?" he whispers in horrified fascination, "Do you know Brother Cotton?"
texts.zh:
从他那骤然斜视的目光中，你能看出，这个想法出乎他的预料。他环视四周，确保没有助理祭司在看着，然后靠得更近了些。

"像什么样的...卢德之道？" 他惶恐着，却又不失痴迷，悄声低语道，"你知道 Cotton 修士吗？"

texts.en: The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. "Don't tell anyone, but... I mean, you have to admit what Cotton has done is cunning and brave. The... the Creator gave him gifts, and he uses them."
texts.zh: 这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩。"别告诉任何人，不过...我是说，你不得不承认 Cotton 的行动堪称智勇双全。而...造物主赐予他的天赋，他发挥得淋漓尽致。"

texts.en:
The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. "Don't tell anyone, but... I would like to meet him too. Maybe join him."

He glances guiltily toward the shrine-attendants. "Maybe."
texts.zh:
这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩。"别告诉任何人，不过...我也想见他一面。或许，还会加入他。"

他怀着愧疚瞥了一眼圣地的圣务侍，继续道："或许吧。"

texts.en: The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. "Don't tell anyone, but... I would like to meet him. Hear what he had to say. Maybe join up."
texts.zh: 这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩。"别告诉任何人，不过...我也想见他一面，听听他要说些什么，或许还会加入他的队伍。"

texts.en:
The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. And troubled.

"But... the things he does, I mean," the young man visibly struggles between what he feels and what he has been told. "Maybe he goes too far, but at least he tries, you know?"
texts.zh:
这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩，但也十分困扰。

"但是...他的所作所为，我是说，" 这个年轻人很明显在自己的感受和别人的说法之间挣扎着，"也许他做的太过分了，但至少他在努力，你也明白的吧？"

texts.en:
The initiate nods in response, but is unsure now of your outlook.

"I mean, say what you will about Cotton," he glances guiltily toward the shrine attendants, "He fights for what he believes. At least."
texts.zh:
新人虽然点头回应，但他现在对你的观点有些犹豫。

"我的意思是，你大可以说出自己对 Cotton 的看法，" 他怀着愧疚瞥了一眼圣地的圣务侍，"但至少，他在为自己的信仰而战。"

texts.en:
A troubled look passes over his face. "The Knights, sometimes it seems like they are more interested in making rules for the sake of rules instead of fighting evil."

With a sigh, the initiate returns his gaze toward the radioactive martyrs.
texts.zh:
他脸上闪过苦恼的神色，"那些骑士大人们，有些时候比起打击邪恶，他们看起来更喜欢为了规则而制定规则。"

随着一声叹息，新人将目光转向了那些辐射缠身的殉道者。

texts.en: He nods brusquely, then returns his gaze to the lead coffins. "I'm supposed to contemplate their sacrifice. Horrible way to die, like that. You're a," he glances at your garb again, "spacer, right? Ever seen that happen to anyone?"
texts.zh: 他唐突地点了点头，然后把目光转回铅衬的棺木上。"我应该考虑接受像他们那样的牺牲，像那样可怖的死亡。说起来，你是..." 他又瞥了一眼你的装束，"宇宙民，对吧？以前有见过什么人遭遇这样的事吗？"

texts.en: He stares at you for a moment, then slowly returns his gaze to the radioactive martyrs.
texts.zh: 他盯着你看了一会，随后缓缓地将目光转向了那些辐射缠身的殉道者。

texts.en: He nods, satisfied with the belief that it is he who will shield people like you from such horrors, then returns his gaze to the radioactive martyrs.
texts.zh: 他点了点头，坚信自己将会保护像你这样的人免遭这般恐怖。他对此心满意足，接着将目光转向了那些辐射缠身的殉道者。

texts.en: Subdued chanting, warped by the strange geometry of this cultic industrial space, blends with the air-cyclers. The candles burn clean and bright, gleaming off the multitude of bladed facets adorning every surface of the shrine's interior, a monument to sacral bloodshed.
texts.zh: 在这尊奉教礼的工业区里，一系列奇形怪状的物体，使那压抑的颂唱声扭曲着，最终融化在空气循环器里。蜡烛的光芒清澈明亮，在那遍布圣地内每一个角落的锋刃饰面上闪耀着，这座纪念堂祭奠着那以神之名所挥洒的鲜血。

texts.en: At your request, the attending subcurate leads you through a brief ceremonial hand-washing, then down the gallery floored by welded armored plates. Niches along the walls are occupied by empty helmets.
texts.zh: 在你的要求下，在场的助理祭司带领你进行了一次简短的净手礼，然后领你沿着一条地面由装甲板焊接而成的长廊走了下去。沿着而建的壁龛被无数空空如也的头盔填得满满当当。

texts.en:
The shrine is a grand tomb set in an enormous airshaft. The industrial viscera has been transformed into a baroque sculpture of thousands of edged weapons aligned like feathers of a wing, rays of gleaming serrated metal boldly thrust in killing arcs through the vast space.

In the middle, surrounded by a galaxy of flickering candles, lie the lead-lined caskets of a squad of martyred Knights. The manner of their deaths, the subcurate explains in reverent whispers, left their bodies unidentifiable and infused with radioactive material which would kill a direct observer even to this day.
texts.zh:
这座圣地是一座华丽的墓穴，坐落在一个庞大的通风竖井内。曾经脉动的工业肺腑已经被一座巴洛克式的雕塑取而代之。成千上万锋利的兵刃犹如羽翼上的翎毛般齐整排列，钢铁的锋芒闪耀着寒光，错落有致地排出了弧形的杀阵，直指那无边的宇宙。

在那中央，无数烛火犹如银河般闪耀，将一队殉道骑士们的铅衬棺木环绕其中。助理祭司虔诚地低语道，他们的死因导致其遗体无法辨认，渗入的放射性物质时至今日仍会让直接观察的人命丧黄泉。

texts.en:
Subdued chanting, warped by the strange geometry of this cultic industrial space, blends with the air-cyclers. The candles burn clean and bright, gleaming off the multitude of bladed facets adorning every surface of the shrine's interior, a monument to sacral bloodshed.

You are left in a prayer-niche to contemplate the horror.
texts.zh:
在这尊奉教礼的工业区里，低沉的颂唱声被奇异的几何形体所扭曲，融入了空气循环。蜡烛的光芒清澈明亮，在那遍布圣地内每一个角落的锋刃饰面上闪耀着，这座纪念堂祭奠着那以神之名所挥洒的鲜血。

你留在一座祈祷者壁龛之中，深思着这份恐怖。

texts.en: "You joined the faithful in resisting, albeit symbolically, the Hegemony oppressors who desecrate the holy world of Jangala. It is a small thing, and surely inadequate, but," $heOrShe smiles, "Your first step on the Path won't stomp our enemies out all at once."
texts.zh: "尽管只是象征性地，你还是成为了抵抗着亵渎圣地 Jangala 的 霸主 压迫者的忠诚者一员。这虽然微小而不足，" $heOrShe微笑着说道，"你在卢德之道上踏出的第一步并不能一步登天般摧毁我们的敌人。"

texts.en: "I am told that Brother Cotton would like you to be told of his kind regards." $HeOrShe lifts an eyebrow, "I shan't ask why, though it does make one curious."
texts.zh: "Cotton 修士希望我替他传达亲切的问候。" $HeOrShe挑起一侧眉毛，"虽然我不会问为什么，但确实让人好奇。"

texts.en: "And a young Knight Initiate - former Initiate, I should say - spoke well of your simple words on Hesperus which set him on a new Path."
texts.zh: "还有一位年轻的新晋骑士 —— 或者说，前骑士 —— 对你在 Hesperus 所说的简单话语赞不绝口，这让他踏上了一条新的道途。"

texts.en: "It is said that you walk with us. Perhaps not quite on the same Path, but close enough that we might pray together with truth in our hearts."
texts.zh: "据说你与我们同行。也许那不完全是同一条道途，但它们之间足够近，这让我们可以真诚地一同祈祷。"

texts.en:
"You are known to us. You have spoken in support of the Path that is necessary and righteous to faithful walkers," $heOrShe smiles grimly for a moment, then drops it.

"So if you truly wish to serve the Path, cease your search. Do not pry into our operations, do not ask after one or another 'missing' recruit."
texts.zh:
"我们知道你。你曾发言支持左径，支持那条对忠实的求道者而言必要且正义的卢德之道。" $heOrShe狞笑了一会，然后收起表情。

"那么如果你真的希望侍奉于左径，就停止你的追寻。不要窥探我们的行动，不要探问无论哪个 '失踪' 的新成员。"

texts.en:
"You are known to us. You shed blood for the Faith on Jangala by the Hegemony's cruel hand." $HeOrShe smiles grimly, "Yes, we know of you."

$HeOrShe drops the smile, and continues. "Serve the Path again: cease your search. Do not pry into our operations, do not ask after one or another 'missing' recruit."
texts.zh:
"我们知道你。在 Jangala，你在 霸主 残酷的手上为信仰流过血。" $HeOrShe狞笑着，"对，我们知道你的事。"

$HeOrShe收起笑容，继续说道，"再次侍奉左径吧：停止你的追寻。不要窥探我们的行动，不要探问无论哪个 '失踪' 的新成员。"

texts.en:
"I was told to cut you from the sky, to burn your fleet and scatter your ashes to the blessed vacuum." $HeOrShe smiles grimly, "But then I received a message. Brother Cotton believes that Providence has sung of your role in the final battle."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, dropping the smile. "I know not what to make of this. Nonetheless, I... ask... that you cease your search for this 'missing' recruit." $HeOrShe sighs, recognizing how pathetic this sounds.

"Ask yourself," $heOrShe pleads, "Who do you serve by this action? What lies at the end of this Path?"
texts.zh:
"有人叫我将你从天空斩落，燃尽你的舰队然后将你的骨灰撒入这神圣的虚空。" $HeOrShe狞笑着，"但我之后收到一条消息。Cotton 修士相信上天认可你在最终之战里的贡献。"

$HeOrShe摇着头，收起笑容。"我不知道该怎么做。不管怎样，我...请求...你不要再寻找这个 '失踪' 的新成员了。" $HeOrShe叹道，意识到这听起来多么可悲。

"问问你自己，" $heOrShe恳求道，"在这个行动中你为谁服务？在这条道途的尽头有什么？"

texts.en: "You tread a dangerous path, $playerBrotherOrSister. I was sent here to cut you from the sky and scatter your ashes to the blessed vacuum. I pray that this shall not be necessary."
texts.zh: "你踏上了一条危险的道路，$playerBrotherOrSister。我被派来将你从天空斩落，将你的骨灰撒入这神圣的虚空。我希望我没有必要这么做。"

texts.en: "I will cut you from the sky, burn your fleet and scatter your ashes to the blessed vacuum." $HeOrShe smiles grimly, "This is where your path ends, for you have asked forbidden questions and searched for forbidden things."
texts.zh: "我会将你从天空斩落，燃尽你的舰队然后将你的骨灰撒入这神圣的虚空。" $HeOrShe狞笑着，"你既然问寻禁忌，那这便是你的终结。"

options.en: I'm not going to stop my search.
If that is what the Path demands, I will cease. (lie)
options.zh: 若是卢德之道所需，那我会就此停手。 (说谎)

options.en: I serve the Faith, and I search for a servant of the Faith. What would battle serve?
options.zh: 我为信仰服务，我在寻找信仰的仆从。战斗又有什么用呢？

options.en: I wish to serve the Path; finding Bornanew will serve the cause we share.
options.zh: 我愿奉卢德之道； 找到 Bornanew 对我们共同的事业是有益处的。

options.en: Finding Bornanew will serve the Path. Have faith.
options.zh: 找到 Bornanew 既是侍奉卢德之道。坚定你的信仰。

options.en: What else did Brother Cotton say? Is that all?
options.zh: Cotton 修士还说了什么？就这些么？

options.en: I need to contact Brother Cotton. I have something for him.
options.zh: 我需要联系 Cotton 修士。我有些东西给他。

options.en: You demand what your puny fleet cannot impose. Flee now.
options.zh: 你那弱小的舰队可给不了你底气。现在快逃吧。

options.en: You talk a lot. Sure you're up for this?
options.zh: 废话还挺多。你确定你准备好了么？

options.en: Stand down, $brotherOrSister. I am following the orders of Livewell Cotton.
options.zh: 停下，$brotherOrSister。我正在听从 Livewell Cotton 的命令。

texts.en: "But you must," $heOrShe says, almost perplexed. "I shall attack if you do not desist."
texts.zh: "但你必须如此，" $heOrShe几乎是困惑不解地说出这些话，"你再不停下，我就要动武了。"

texts.en: "But you must," $heOrShe says unhappily.
texts.zh: "但你必须那样，" $heOrShe不高兴地说。

texts.en:
"Well decided, $playerBrotherOrSister. We share Faith, if not our Path, but that is enough. We must do all in our worldly and spiritual power to halt that so-called church's perversion of Ludd's teachings."

$HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together, "Blessed be this day; may your Path lead you to righteous glory."
texts.zh:
"好决定，$playerBrotherOrSister。我们拥有同样的信仰，也许不是同行于圣道，但也够了。我们需竭尽世俗和灵性之力，去阻止那所谓的教会扭曲卢德的教导。"

$HeOrShe紧握$hisOrHer的双手，"愿今日蒙福；愿你的道途引领你得公义的荣耀。"

texts.en:
"Well decided, $playerBrotherOrSister. We share Faith and a Path, and that must be enough. We must do all in our worldly and spiritual power to halt that so-called church's perversion of Ludd's teachings."

$HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together, "Blessed be this day; may your Path lead you to righteous glory."
texts.zh:
"好决定，$playerBrotherOrSister。我们拥有同样的信仰，同行于道途，这就够了。我们需竭尽世俗和灵性之力，去阻止那所谓的教会扭曲卢德的教导。"

$HeOrShe紧握$hisOrHer的双手，"愿今日蒙福；愿你的道途引领你得公义的荣耀。"

texts.en:
"I pray that I could believe you," $HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together for a moment, "But you are not of the Faith, nor of the Path. What value is the word of one who so denies the light of Ludd?"

$HeOrShe lets $hisOrHer hands drop. "Nothing. It is worth nothing. Even the truth, if indeed it is truth, is a lie in your heretic's mouth."
texts.zh:
"我祈愿我可以相信你，" $HeOrShe握住$hisOrHer的双手，"但你既无信仰，又不奉行卢德之道。一个否认卢德之光的人，他的言语又有何价值？"

$HeOrShe让$hisOrHer的手垂下。"没有。毫无价值。即使是真的，假使的确是真的，也是从你这异端之口中说出的谎言。"

texts.en:
"You too must pray on this, $playerBrotherOrSister," $heOrShe says with genuine concern. "It is a narrow Path we tread, and easily lost by those who pervert the teachings of Ludd and name their heresy Truth."

"Let me speak truth to you; I wish not to battle you. The strength of the Faithful is wasted when we fight amongst ourselves; and the devil-spawn of the Domain laugh as they watch. They think we're misguided fools, you know."
texts.zh:
"你需为此祈祷，$playerBrotherOrSister。" $heOrShe真诚的关心着你。"我们所行的圣道如此狭窄，极易为那些信奉异端邪说，扭曲卢德教导之人所迷惑。"

"让我来告诉你真相：我不想与你战斗。当我们自相残杀时，信徒的力量就被虚耗；而那些 人之领 的恶魔之子会看着我们大笑。你知道的，他们觉得我们是被误导的蠢货。"

options.en: We are no fools. Save your strength, $brotherOrSister.
options.zh: 我们不是蠢货。省省力气吧，$brotherOrSister。

options.en: You would be a fool, and a heretic besides, to stand in my way.
options.zh: 如果你挡了我的路，那你就是个蠢货，而且还是个异端。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe stares hard into your eyes, at least the holo-image of them, then brings $hisOrHer hands together. "May Providence show me the way; by the stars and the pneuma and the revelation."

After a moment, $personName opens $hisOrHer eyes.

"Let me speak plainly now: I shall trust your Path. Wherever it leads you, remember what we fight for."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe直视着你的眼睛，至少是全息影像上的眼睛，然后将$hisOrHer的手合起。"愿上天示我前路；以星辰、圣灵和启示。"

过了一会，$personName 张开$hisOrHer的眼睛。

"让我直说吧：我愿相信你的道途。无论此道引你去何方，别忘了我们为何而战。"

texts.en:
$HisOrHer eyes go hard. "It is as I fear. The false Church has corrupted you. It was said that the Adversary would cloak their lies in the sacrament, and here it is before me."

"May God's holy vacuum purify you," $heOrShe hisses.
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer双眼紧盯着你。"这就是我害怕的。你已经被那虚假的教会腐化。据说大敌会用圣礼掩盖谎言，正如我现在所见。"

"愿神圣的虚空将你净化。" $heOrShe嘶哑地说。

texts.en:
"You must pray on this, $playerBrotherOrSister," $heOrShe says with genuine concern. "It is a narrow and perilous Path we tread, beset by the false teachings of the Church on one side, and by the devil-spawn of the Domain on the other."

$HeOrShe sighs, and brings $hisOrHer hands together. "May Providence show me the way; by the stars and the pneuma and the revelation."
texts.zh:
"你需为此祈祷，$playerBrotherOrSister。" $heOrShe真诚地关心着你，"我们所行的圣道狭窄而崎岖，被虚伪谎言的异端教会所困，又被 人之领 的恶魔之子所围。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，然后将$hisOrHer的手合起。"愿上天示我前路；以星辰、圣灵和启示。"

texts.en:
After a moment, $personName opens $hisOrHer eyes.

"Let me speak plainly now: I shall trust your Path. Wherever it leads you, remember what we fight for."
texts.zh:
过了一会，$personName 张开了$hisOrHer的眼睛。

"让我直说吧：我愿相信你的道途。无论此道引你去何方，别忘了我们为何而战。"

texts.en:
"I did not speak with Brother Cotton directly. A message was relayed," $heOrShe looks at you with curiosity and concern as $heOrShe speaks.

"My Path is to obey, so I obey."
texts.zh:
"我并没有直接同 Cotton 修士谈过。信息是被转达的。" $heOrShe说道，一边用着好奇而关切的目光看着你。

"我的道途是遵从，所以我便遵从。"

texts.en: "I... it is not my place." $HeOrShe rubs $hisOrHer forehead nervously. "I will... report your words to my superior. I can promise nothing."
texts.zh: "我... 我不负责这个。" $HeOrShe紧张的点了点$hisOrHer的脑袋。"我会... 向我的上级转达你的要求。我也不能给出任何保证。"

texts.en:
"I but asked," $heOrShe says, distressed. "And I shall not disobey Brother Cotton's orders. If you will not listen to my words, then I beg you pray. Pray! And listen for the song of the angels, because you will hear no more from me."

$HeOrShe cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
"我只是问问。" $heOrShe苦恼的说，"我也不会违背 Cotton 修士的命令。如果你不想听我的话，那我请求你祈祷吧。祈祷吧！以听天使之颂歌，因你将不会听见我的言语。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯。

texts.en:
The Pather shakes $hisOrHer head; grim, determined.

"In that, you are mistaken. I prayed that our Paths would align, and a fellow $playerBrotherOrSister could walk with me. But here it ends for you- in God's holy vacuum."

The comms are cut.
texts.zh:
左径摇了摇$hisOrHer的头；冷酷，坚定。

"在这一点上，你错了。我祈祷你我的道途将要并行，一位 $playerBrotherOrSister 可以与我同行。但你的道途将在这里走向尽头 —— 在这神圣虚空之中。"

通讯被切断了。

texts.en:
The Pather shakes $hisOrHer head; grim, determined.

"I obey, and I obey unto a righteous death in God's holy vacuum."

That said, $heOrShe cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
左径摇了摇$hisOrHer的头；冷酷，坚定。

"我遵从，我遵从直到在神圣虚空之中为公义而献身。"

这么说着，$heOrShe切断了通讯。

texts.en: "Brother Cotton spoke to you?" $HisOrHer eyes narrow.
texts.zh: "Cotton 修士和你说话了？" $HisOrHer的眼睛眯起。

options.en: Yes, over tea. Would that we all could serve the Path with such grace and charm.
options.zh: 是的，边喝茶边谈。愿我们都能以如此的优雅和魅力侍奉于卢德之道。

texts.en:
"Would that we could indeed," $heOrShe says, perhaps thinking to some slight or misstep $heOrShe observed in the fellow Faithful.

"It is said that Brother Cotton hears the song of the angels, the whisper of pneuma itself. It is not for human ears, they say." $HeOrShe looks away wistfully, "He is like a prophet of old; touched by the divine."

Aware of how this sounds, $heOrShe quickly adds, "Not like Ludd, of course. The Word, that is another matter. What I mean to say is that, truly, it must be blessedly glorious."
texts.zh:
"要是我们能这样就好了，" $heOrShe说道，或许是想起了$heOrShe在一众信徒中曾经观察到的一些怠慢或是错误的行为。

"据说 Cotton 修士能听到天使的歌声，也就是圣灵的低语。他们说，这不是人类能听到的。" $HeOrShe深情地望着远方。"他就像古代的先知，被神灵所点化。"

意识到这听起来有些不妥当，$heOrShe连忙补充到，"当然了，不是像卢德那样。圣言中所述的，那是另一回事了。我实际上想说的是，那一定是无上光荣的。"

options.en: It must; truly we are blessed to walk aside him.
options.zh: 必须如此。我们能与他同行真是蒙了神的祝福。

texts.en:
"Truly! Oh, I am overcome- forgive me, I must pray."

Putting $hisOrHer hands together, the Pather goes on for some time about how wonderful Brother Cotton is, and how we should all follow his example and be so blessed.

And so on; you put your hands together and mumble something to keep up the act. Soon enough, the show is over, and persuade the Pather that $heOrShe may close the comms without yet another blessing.
texts.zh:
"真的！哦，我太激动了 —— 原谅我，我必须祈祷。"

将$hisOrHer的手合拢之后，左径分子滔滔不绝地赞颂 Cotton 修士是多么耀目，以及我等应当如何效仿他，才能以此蒙受赐福。

如此这般；你将双手合拢，含糊地念叨几句以跟上这出好戏。很快，表演拉下了帷幕，你也说服左径分子关闭了通讯，免得$heOrShe再来一轮祝颂。

texts.en:
The leader of the pilgrims you have transported from $lpt_sourceName insists on having the 'excellent captain' see $lpt_hisOrHer group off.

"You should visit the $lpt_visitTargetNameShort, captain," $lpt_heOrShe insists. "I was once an unbeliever; the experience is quite transformational."

"Of course, I understand that this is a journey you must choose to undertake for yourself." $lpt_HeOrShe flashes a perfect smile and makes a pious gesture, then offloads to a private shuttle $lpt_heOrShe has hired to transport $lpt_himOrHer and $lpt_hisOrHer party to the shrine.
texts.zh:
你从 $lpt_sourceName 带来的朝圣者的领头人非要 "杰出的舰长" 来为他们送行。

"你应该去看看圣地，舰长。" $lpt_hisOrHer坚持道。"我也曾是个无信者；那是段脱胎换骨的体验。"

"当然，我也知道这是个必须由你自己选择去行的旅道。" $lpt_HeOrShe做着虔诚的手势，一边露出了一个完美的微笑，然后搭上了$lpt_HeOrShe为他们一行雇来送他们去圣地的私人穿梭机。

$lpt_HeOrShe flashes a perfect smile, "Of course, I understand that this is a journey one must choose for oneself." $lpt_HeOrShe makes a pious gesture, then offloads to a private shuttle $lpt_heOrShe has hired to transport $lpt_himOrHer and $lpt_hisOrHer party to the shrine.

texts.en:
"And I would like to accept your help, with thanks and prayer." She dips her head for a moment.

"The Volturnian Self Defense Covenant has many needs," her look grows harder, more calculating. "Though our cause is righteous, and the Faithful willing, empty hands and privation are the weapons of saints. The rest of us," she says wearily, "have more worldly needs."

She taps at a battered datapad and shows you a priority-sorted procurement table appears.

"Heavy weapons. Supplies. Credits." A smile. "If the pneuma moves you to such charity, that is."
texts.zh:
"你的援手，我领了，连同谢意与祷告一并收下。" 她低头欠了欠身。

"Volturn 自卫公约缺的东西多，\" 她的神色硬了几分，也精明了几分。\"我们这边理是直的，信众也肯出力，可空着两手、熬着清苦，那是圣徒才使的兵器。其余的人嘛，\" 她语带倦意，\"总还有些俗世上的需求。"

她在一台破旧的数据平板上点了几下，把一张按轻重缓急排好的采购表指给你看。

"重武器。补给。星币。\" 她一笑。\"若圣灵催你行这份善举的话。"

texts.en:
"You give us hammer and sword alike, captain," she says. "The strongholds and war machines of the Diktat shall prove less inpenetrable than the Lion might wish thanks to these heavy weapons."

"Take care for yourself also. A cargo transfer of this size is not easily hidden despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
texts.zh:
"舰长，锤与剑你都一并给了我们，\" 她说道。\"有了这批重武器，辛达强权的堡垒与战争机器，怕是再不会如辛达瑞亚之狮所愿那般牢不可破。"

"你自己也当心。这么大一批货过手，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

texts.en:
"You provide us hammer and sword alike, captain," she says. "The strongholds and war machines of the Diktat - whether by one name or another - shall prove themselves less inpenetrable than the Lion's cubs might wish thanks to these heavy weapons."

"Take care for yourself also. A cargo transfer of this size is not easily hidden despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
texts.zh:
"舰长，锤与剑你都一并供给我们，\" 她说道。\"有了这批重武器，辛达强权的堡垒与战争机器 —— 不管它改叫什么名号 —— 怕是不会再如那几头狮崽所愿那般牢不可破。"

"你自己也当心。这么大一批货过手，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

texts.en:
"You have given us all we have asked. The United Front is pledged to a general uprising when the opportunity presents itself. There are dark rumors from Sindria, from the den of the beast himself..."

Her look is of weariness, of a burden long carried and not soon relieved.

"Now, we wait - and pray. And once more, you have my thanks."
texts.zh:
"我们开口要的，你都给齐了。统一战线已立誓，只待时机一到便全面起事。Sindria 那边传来些不祥的风声，就从那头野兽自己的窝里..."

她神情倦怠，像是扛了太久的一副担子，一时半会儿还卸不下来。

"眼下，我们等 —— 也祷告。再者，多谢你了。"

texts.en:
"You have given us all we have asked. The Faithful spill their blood daily for this uprising... and spend their lives, a currency too dear to long contemplate."

Her look is of weariness, of a burden long carried and not soon relieved.

"But we fight," she straightens her posture, hands together. "And pray. You you have my thanks and blessing, captain."
texts.zh:
"我们开口要的，你都给齐了。信众们日日为这场起事流血...连性命也一并花出去，这代价太重，教人不敢细想。"

她神情倦怠，像是扛了太久的一副担子，一时半会儿还卸不下来。

"可我们仍在打，\" 她双手合十，挺直了身子。\"也仍在祷告。舰长，我的谢意与祝福都给你。"

texts.en:
"You have my deepest graditude, $playerName," she says.

"These credits open great possibilities, for all and sundry must be purchased - and smuggled - to bolster our cause." She pauses. "To say nothing of bribing the faithless servants of Andrada to free our walkers and whisper to us the Lion's secrets..."
texts.zh:
"$playerName，我真是感激不尽，" 她说道。

"有了这批星币，局面就活了 —— 各样东西都得买、都得偷运进来，才撑得起我们的事。\" 她顿了顿。\"更别说还得拿钱去打通 Andrada 那些不信神的爪牙，放我们的人出来，再替我们套出辛达瑞亚之狮的秘密..."

texts.en:
She looks down, frowning, at her battered datapad.

"It will, however, take some time to distribute these funds without attracting the attention of the Spider."
texts.zh:
她皱着眉，低头盯着那台破旧的数据平板。

"只不过，要把这笔钱散出去又不惊动辛达瑞亚之蛛，总得费些时日。"

texts.en:
She looks down, frowning, at her battered datapad.

It will take some effort, however, to distribute these funds without attracting the attention of the... new authorities." She sighs. "Whatever they call one Diktat or the other, they are truly the sons of their father."
texts.zh:
她皱着眉，低头盯着那台破旧的数据平板。

"只不过，要把这笔钱散出去又不惊动...新当局，总得费些手脚。" 她叹了口气。"管它叫这个辛达强权还是那个辛达强权，骨子里都是一父所生的儿子。"

texts.en:
"You are truly given by Providence," she says.

"These supplies will feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and... give us time." She clasps her hands together. "When the time is right, our uprising will break open the darkness like the dawning of the sun. So I pray."

"And you, captain. Ware the Diktat patrols - a cargo transfer of this size is not easily hidden, despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
texts.zh:
"你真是天意所赐，" 她说道。

"这批补给会让饥者得食、伤者得治，还...替我们争来时间。\" 她双手合十。\"待时机一到，我们的起事便会像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。我如此祈盼。"

"还有你，舰长。当心辛达强权的巡逻队 —— 这么大一批货过手，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

texts.en:
"You are truly a gift of Providence," she says.

"These supplies shall feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and give us time." She clasps her hands together. "Our uprising shall break open the darkness like the dawning of the sun. So I pray."

"And you, captain. Ware the Diktat patrols - whether one Diktat or the other, a shipment of this size is not easily hidden despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
texts.zh:
"你真是天意送来的礼，" 她说道。

"这批补给将让饥者得食、伤者得治，替我们争来时间。\" 她双手合十。\"我们的起事终会像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。我如此祈盼。"

"还有你，舰长。当心辛达强权的巡逻队 —— 不管换了这个还是那个，这么大一船货，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

"真该按分钟跟你收费，" 他自言自语地嘟囔了一句。
OR
"行吧，\" 他狐疑地看了你一眼，\"你下一套说辞又是什么？"
OR
他只是叹了口气。

options.en: Is there good money in running pilgrims?
options.zh: 运送朝圣者能赚不少钱么？

options.en: Tell me about the shrine you are travelling to.
options.zh: 跟我讲讲你要去的那处圣地吧。

options.en: I've been visiting the shrines. Just visiting.
options.zh: 我参观过那些圣地。只是参观。

options.en: I too am on a pilgrimage of sorts.

options.zh: 什么？我可不是什么怪物。
关于圣地的话题到此为止。

texts.en:
$name shakes $hisOrHer head with a patient smile.

"I like to think of the reward as a spiritual bounty. Most pilgrims are simple people; those who cannot pay their own way have their passage paid by the Church, or by the charitable offerings of the more prosperous among the Faithful."

"Of course, from time to time, one encounters a new convert who is accustomed to a more... worldly lifestyle. They tend to favor less humble accommodations than my fleet offers. You might find such characters seeking passage in a spacer bar."
texts.zh:
$name面带耐心的笑容，摇了摇头。

"我更愿意把奖励想为灵魂上的回报。很多朝圣者都是普通人；自己无力自费朝圣之人的旅费会由教会负责，又或由更加富裕的教徒的慈善捐赠支持。"

"当然，我们还是时不时会遇到更加习惯...世俗生活的新教徒。他们一般倾向于比我们舰队更加朴素的环境。你或许能够找到这类人在太空佬聚集的酒吧寻求搭载。

texts.en:
"Each shrine is built to venerate the holy ideals taught to us by the prophet Ludd. Each is dedicated to a particular passage, concept, or in memoriam of an event. It's... "

$HeOrShe catches $himOrHerself, "... Well, it can get complex. One of the clergy attending to the shrine can best explain their meaning and assist pilgrims in applying that meaning to their own spiritual journey."
texts.zh:
"每个圣地都是为了纪念先知卢德教给我们的神圣理想而建设的。每个圣地都对应一个特定的段落、概念，或纪念一个事件。它是... "

$HeOrShe突然停下来，"...嗯，这就说来话长了。住持圣地的神职人员可以完美解释它们的意义，并协助朝圣者将这一意义应用于他们自己的精神旅程。"

texts.en: "We are travelling to the dead world of Killa."
texts.zh: "我们前往死亡世界，Killa。"

texts.en: "We're travelling to Volturn, though it is... a troubled place."
texts.zh: "我们要前往 Volturn，尽管那里...情况复杂。"

texts.en: "We are travelling to Jangala."
texts.zh: "我们正在前往 Jangala。"

options.en: Killa is a ruin. How can there be a shrine?
options.zh: Killa 是座废墟，怎么能是圣地？

options.en: Volturn? The Sindrian Diktat allows you to visit the shrine?
options.zh: Volturn？辛达强权 允许你去圣地？

options.en: A shrine on Jangala? Isn't the biosphere toxic?
options.zh: 位于 Jangala 的圣地？那里的生物毒素怎么办？

texts.en:
"Ah." $HeOrShe thinks for a moment. "I suppose that seeing as we are among friends and faithful, we may speak openly of such things."

$HisOrHer warmth fades, replaced by a solemn tone. "The shrine of Killa commemorates those murdered by the abhorrent and unholy 'planet-killer' device, and indeed is dedicated to all of those murdered in wars of wrath."

"It is... a grim reminder, a warning, a place of grief. One all too often forgotten." $HeOrShe goes quiet for a moment.
texts.zh:
"啊。" $HeOrShe思索了一下。"我想既然我们身处朋友和信徒之中，我们也能打开天窗说亮话了。"

$HisOrHer的温暖被更加沉重的口气替代。"Killa 是用来纪念所有被那万恶的行星杀手所谋杀之人，以及所有因愤怒而起的战争所枉死之人的圣地。"

"那里... 对我们是一个沉重的提醒，一个警示，一个哀悼之地。也是一个太容易被遗忘之地。" $HeOrShe沉默了片刻。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe thinks for a moment, the speaks in a solemn tone. "The shrine of Killa commemorates those murdered by the abhorrent and unholy 'planet-killer' device. It is dedicated to all of those murdered in wars of wrath."

"It is... a grim reminder, a warning, a place of grief. One all too often forgotten." $HeOrShe goes quiet for a moment.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe思索了片刻，随后用沉重的口气说道。"Killa 是用来纪念所有被那万恶的 行星杀手 所谋杀之人，以及所有因忿怒而起的战争所枉死之人的圣地。"

"那里是... 对我们是一个沉重的提醒，一个警示，一个哀悼之地。也是一个太容易被遗忘的地方。" $HeOrShe沉默了片刻。

options.en: Can you tell me how to find it?
options.zh: 你能告诉我怎样找到那里吗？
多跟我讲讲这个 '行星杀手' 的事情。

texts.en:
"I'm sorry, captain," $name says, looking uncomfortable. "The shrine... it is a sacred place, and obscure by design. I am a fleet commander foremost, so it is not my place to start you on such a weighty pilgrimage. You must speak to one of the clergy entrusted with care for the shrines."

"Perhaps on Gilead, or Jangala?" $heOrShe adds apologetically, trailing off.
texts.zh:
"对不起，舰长。" $name 看上去不太舒服地说道，"那个圣地... 是个神圣之处，而且其设计上就颇为隐秘。我到底只是个舰队指挥官，轮不到由我来指引你走上如此沉重的朝圣之途。你必须得和负责维护 圣地 的教士们讨论此事。"

"比如去 Gilead，或者 Jangala？" $heOrShe抱歉地补充道。

texts.en: "Um. Let us speak of other things," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh: "唔。让我们谈点别的吧。" $heOrShe说道。

texts.en:
"Um," $name looks at you strangely. "It's really all in the name: Planet-killer."

"It is a terrible thing, and I prefer not to speak of it lightly."
texts.zh:
"呃..." $name 给了你个奇怪的眼神。"名字已经说的很清楚了：行星杀手。"

"那是个可怖之物，我不愿轻易将其提起。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe looks troubled.

"The last I heard they had instituted some kind of 'temporary lockdown' in the name of 'public safety'," $heOrShe says, then gets a defiant look. "Andrada means to repress the Faith. He would stamp us out, if he could. If," $heOrShe repeats, "he could."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe看上去有些担忧。

"我最后一次听到相关的消息，就是他们为了 '公众安全' 实行了什么 '暂时戒严'。" $heOrShe面带抵触地说道。"Andrada 打算打压我们的信仰。假如他能，他会将其踏平。假如..." $heOrShe重复道，"他能。"

texts.en:
"To humans, yes. Eventually. My understanding is that because we can't live there, and yet it is full of life, is a lesson in humility and acceptance."

"I hear, there are certain extremists of the faithful who willingly expose themselves to the xeno-life without a mask. No medications, nothing." $HeOrShe leans back, looking equally appalled and delighted.

"I could never do that! The stories one hears, mercy of blessed Ludd..."
texts.zh:
"对人类来说，是毒素。迟早会是。我的见解是这是教导我们虚心知足的一课，就算我们无法居住在那里，那里依旧能够充满生命。

"我听说那里有些最为极端的信徒甚至愿意不带面具直接接触异星生命。也不用药品，什么都不用。" $HeOrShe看上去既欣慰，又有些反感。

"我是做不到那样的！圣卢德的慈悲在上，我听说过的那些事..."

texts.en: $HeOrShe seems to remember $hisOrHer role, taking on a more professional countenance, "But that is idle talk, and you know what is said of idleness. Where were we..."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe似乎想起了自己的职责，表情也变得更专业起来，"但那都是闲话，而你知道什么是重点。我们讲到哪里了..."

texts.en:
"Indeed. Purely secular interest, I'm sure."

$HeOrShe raises both hands in placation. "I mean no offense, of course. Though you do not count yourself among the faithful, I appreciate your interest in our beliefs - and I won't deny some small joy in the possibility that your interest may bring you closer to Ludd, one way or another."

"I am not here to proselytize, but I shall answer your inquiries faithfully." $HeOrShe smiles to $himOrHerself.
texts.zh:
"是的，我相信你这是单纯世俗角度的兴趣。"

$HeOrShe抬起双手安抚道。"自然，我无意冒犯。虽然你不自视为信徒，我还是感谢你对我们信仰的兴趣 —— 而且不论如何，你的兴趣或许能带你更接近卢德，而这一点让我颇为欣慰。"

"我不是来此布道的，但是我会忠实的回答你的问题。" $HeOrShe笑道。

texts.en: "Indeed? Then I welcome you in the spirit of Ludd," $heOrShe makes a sign of devotion, "May Providence provide you with a bright path alongside those I shepherd to the spiritual betterment they, too, seek."
texts.zh: "果真如此？那我以卢德之精神欢迎你。" $heOrShe做了一个表示虔诚的手势。"愿天意引领你和我所带领之人走上精神升华的光辉之路。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, acceding.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头，同意了。

texts.en:
You share a few flattering quips and a story about some prominent local officials, earning quiet, cheers, or laughter at the appropriate moments.

You shift the monologue toward a light-hearted review of each of the Luddic shrines you visited, earning tense laughter, but you manage to turn what at first appeared to be subversive implications into a heartfelt conclusion which results in earnest applause from spacer and Faithful alike.

Some of the stories might even be true. Or not. What's important is the connections you're making - or pretending you already made - with the local power-players.
texts.zh:
你讲了一点带讨好意味的俏皮话，还分享了本地高官们身上的一个故事，人们时而安静，时而欢呼，时而大笑，时机都选得很恰当。

说着说着，你停止了自说自话，开始轻轻松松地 "评鉴" 你一路上走过的每个卢德圣地，在引得大家哄堂大笑的同时，你还隐去了你某些初见有些颠覆性的暗示，转而以深切的感受作结，于是太空佬们和虔诚信徒最后都诚挚地鼓起掌来。

你讲的故事里，有些甚至可能是真的，但无论真假，故事本身并不重要，重要的是你以此建立了 —— 或者说假装建立了 —— 与本地高官之间的联系。

texts.en:
Some time later, in a quiet corner, the bartender hands you a tall glass of cool water with a nod.

Refreshed, and things having quieted down, you have a chance at last to look around.
texts.zh:
过了有一阵子，在酒吧安静的角落里，服务生为你递上了一大杯冰水用来醒酒，还对着你点了下头。

等你精神恢复了，周围也安静下来了，你终于有机会四处看看了。

texts.en:
$personLastName raises an eyebrow. "Begging sweet Ludd's forgiveness, spacer, but if I did know such a good man, I would be wary of letting his name escape my lips too easily."

"Condemn not the ignorant for they know not their error, as the book says, but Grace of the Path, protect me - and you - from inquiries best not made lest a terrible swift hammer full upon us." $HeOrShe smiles nervously.

"Let us speak of other things," $heOrShe says. "The weather! Unpleasant lately, no?"
texts.zh:
$personLastName 扬起了眉毛。"愿亲爱的卢德恕我无罪，宇宙民，但我真要认识那么一个好人，我是不会轻易吐出他的名字的。"

"无知者无罪，如教典所言，但卢德之道的光辉啊，请保佑我 —— 还有你 —— 不为多嘴多问而获罚。" $HeOrShe紧张地微笑道。

"我们聊点别的吧。" $HeOrShe说道，"天气！最近真糟啊，对吧？"

texts.en:
$personLastName raises an eyebrow. "Begging sweet Ludd's forgiveness, my fellow $playerBrotherOrSister, but if I did know such a good man, I would be wary of letting his name escape my lips too easily."

"But we're all pilgrims of the faith here, are we not?" $HeOrShe lets the hint of a smile appear, enjoying the chance to tease at hidden knowledge. "A pilgrim like you should visit a more worldly shrine. Come down port-side. There is a teahouse where the outworlders and Mammonites gather. There you will find your answer."

The spacer bar, in other words. As much as a teahouse-speakeasy can pass for a decent bar in this place.
texts.zh:
$personLastName 扬起了眉毛。"愿亲爱的卢德恕我无罪，我的 $playerBrotherOrSister，但我真要认识那么一个好人，我是不会轻易吐出他的名字的。"

"但我们都是信仰的朝圣者，是吧？" $HeOrShe露出了一丝微笑，似乎很享受这个话里藏话的机会，"像你这样的朝圣者应该去看看凡尘中的圣地。从左舷下来。这儿有一个外来人员和玛门之仆聚集的茶馆。你会在那里找到想要的答案的。"

换言之，就是那家太空佬酒吧。在这种地方，一家有点地下副业的茶馆已算得上是个条件不错的酒吧了。

options.en: Let him know that I'll meet... him... there.
options.zh: 告诉他我会去那里...见...他。

options.en: Perhaps our paths should not cross just yet.
options.zh: 也许我们的道还不该相交。

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, not meeting your eye. "Then it shall be. Blessings upon you captain."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头，没有直视你的眼睛。"就是这样了。祝福你，舰长。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, meeting your eyes. "Then it shall be. Blessings upon you, $playerBrotherOrSister."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe盯着你的眼睛点了点头。"那就这么定了，祝佑你，$playerBrotherOrSister。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, not meeting your eye. "Perhaps your path will take you far from here. Captain."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头，没有直视你的眼睛。"也许你的道途将带你远离这里。舰长。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, meeting your eyes. "Perhaps, $playerBrotherOrSister, your Path does not yet meet with that of the good man."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe盯着你的眼睛点了点头。"那么也许，$playerBrotherOrSister，你的道途还不会和那个好人相遇。"
